postings.title: Banco de Talentos I Telesales Executive - Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
Acerca del Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos el Grupo QuintoAndar, el ecosistema inmobiliario más grande de América Latina . Guiados por el propósito de ayudar a las personas a amar el lugar donde viven , creamos tecnología y soluciones que simplifican toda la experiencia de la vivienda, desde el alquiler hasta la compra y venta.

Estamos presentes en 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Ecuador y Panamá) y contamos con un hub de tecnología en Portugal , reuniendo a más de 3.100 personas unidas por el desafío de transformar el sector. Con el respaldo de inversionistas globales como SoftBank, General Atlantic y Kaszek, hemos levantado más de US$ 755 millones y hoy somos una compañía valuada en US$ 5,1 mil millones .

Lideramos la transformación del mercado siendo pioneros en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial a gran escala en el sector inmobiliario. Nuestras plataformas suman más de 50 millones de visitas al mes, administrando más de 350 mil contratos de alquiler activos y movilizando R$ 20 mil millones al año.

Si buscas resolver problemas complejos con autonomía, tecnología de punta e impacto a gran escala, adelante, estás en tu casa.

Para conocer más sobre nuestra historia, ingresa a: grupoquintoandar.com/es/

Ubicación y Modelo de Trabajo

Nuestro equipo de Telesales Executive trabaja bajo el modelo “híbrido”, siendo necesario estar presencialmente en la oficina, ubicada en Buenos Aires, 2 veces por semana.

Sobre el Equipo y el Desafío

El área de Telesales tiene como misión estratégica impulsar la expansión del negocio mediante la adquisición sostenible de nuevas cuentas y el aporte de revenue.

El éxito del rol de Telesales Executive radica en la capacidad para gestionar el pipeline comercial, huntear oportunidades de mercado mediante inbound marketing y ejecutar procesos de venta consultiva.

Operan en un modelo de alta sinergia cross-functional, trabajando en colaboración con Marketing para la alineación de captación por plazas prioritarias, y con el equipo de Customer Success para asegurar un handoff sin fricciones que asegure el éxito del cliente y mitigue el riesgo de bajas tempranas (Churn).

Foco Comercial: Prospección masiva, generación de volumen en la base de clientes y aseguramiento del cumplimiento de los KPIs básicos de adquisición de cuentas nuevas en los segmentos iniciales.

Tus Responsabilidades

• Hunteo Comercial Activo: Identificar y prospectar de manera proactiva nuevas oportunidades de negocio inmobiliario mediante diversos canales digitales (llamadas telefónicas, WhatsApp Business y correo electrónico) de los leads recibidos por inbound marketing.

• Hunteo comercial activo telefónico a través de plataforma Genesys y derivación de gestión a distintas áreas.

• Cumplimiento de Metas: Alcanzar los objetivos mensuales de cantidad de cuentas nuevas ingresadas a la plataforma.

• Ejecución de Venta Consultiva: Realizar demostraciones vía meet/zoom de la plataforma, traduciendo características técnicas en beneficios de negocio y resolviendo las dudas operativas básicas del cliente.

• Gestión de Pipeline: Mantener actualizado de forma diaria el estado de las oportunidades en la plataforma registrando datos precisos y limpios del proceso comercial.

• Fomento de Métodos de Pago Automáticos: Impulsar de forma prioritaria la venta con adherencia a tarjeta de crédito o débito automático desde el cierre inicial para optimizar los cobros futuros.

• Gestión de Franquicias y Eventos: Liderar presentaciones de captación en eventos (presenciales/virtuales), capacitaciones según convenios de su zona y ser el responsable administrativo de las altas de franquicias asignadas.

Lo que buscamos (Requisitos)

• Experiencia: Mínimo 3 años en roles de Venta Consultiva B2B / SaaS; demostrando capacidad para realizar demos virtuales de la plataforma (vía Meet/Zoom), traduciendo funcionalidades técnicas del la misma.

• Gestión de Pipeline & Stack de Ventas: Experiencia intermedia/avanzada en manejo de CRM, manteniendo datos limpios, y plataformas de llamadas masivas/outbound como Genesys.

• Gestión de Canales Múltiples: Fluidez en etiqueta telefónica, WhatsApp Business y correos comerciales para contacto masivo y ágil de prospectos.

Soft Skills y Competencias

• Resiliencia y Tolerancia a la Frustración: Capacidad para mantener una actitud positiva y un alto nivel de energía ante objeciones recurrentes o rechazos de clientes.

• Comunicación Efectiva y Elocuencia: Destacada etiqueta telefónica y escrita, con fluidez verbal y claridad para transmitir la propuesta de valor.

• Organización y Velocidad de Respuesta: Habilidad para clasificar y priorizar un alto volumen diario de prospectos comerciales de manera ágil y expedita.

• Proactividad: para destrabar bloqueos operativos en el contacto inicial y mover con rapidez al cliente hacia el cierre.

¿Cómo es nuestro Proceso de Selección?

Diseñamos un proceso transparente, directo y enfocado en evaluar tu potencial técnico y comportamental, dándote la oportunidad de conocer a nuestros equipos y rutas de carrera:

• Postulación y Revisión de Perfil.

• Entrevista Equipo de Reclutamiento.

• Entrevista con Hiring Manager.

• Evaluación Técnica (Caso práctico - desafío).

• Propuesta y ¡Bienvenido/a!

Importante: Evaluamos todas las postulaciones de manera individual y garantizamos respuesta para todas las personas. Toda la comunicación se realiza por correo electrónico, así que asegúrate de revisar tu bandeja de entrada y permitir los correos del dominio @quintoandar.com.br .

Beneficios

• Plan médico.

• Wellhub.

• Licencia parental extendida.

• Reintegro de Guardería.

• Gastos de teletrabajo (monto mensual).

• Descuentos en servicios del día a día.

• Día libre por cumpleaños, Día del Padre y Día de la Madre.

Diversidad e Inclusión en Grupo QuintoAndar

postings.title: Grupo QuintoAndar| Growth Marketing Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Acerca del Grupo QuintoAndar
Somos el Grupo QuintoAndar, el mayor ecosistema inmobiliario de América Latina. Guiados por un propósito compartido de ayudar a las personas a amar el lugar donde viven, contamos con un portafolio diversificado de marcas y soluciones en diferentes países de América Latina y también con un Hub de Tecnología en Portugal. Desarrollamos tecnologías e innovación para transformar e impulsar la experiencia de vivienda en su totalidad.

Juntas, nuestras marcas líderes ofrecen soluciones que cubren todas las etapas del proceso de viviendar: Inmuebles24 (México), Zonaprop (Argentina), Adondevivir y Urbania (Perú), Plusvalía (Ecuador), ImovelWeb y QuintoAndar (Brasil).

Con el apoyo de un equipo de inversionistas y consultores de clase mundial, como Kaszek, Qualcomm, General Atlantic y SoftBank, QuintoAndar Group está actualmente valorado en más de 5.100 millones de dólares y sigue creciendo año tras año.

Aquí trabajarás con los mejores profesionales del mercado, en un entorno que respira innovación, colaboración y alto rendimiento. Para conocer más sobre nuestra historia, visita https://grupoquintoandar.com/es/ .

Ubicación y Modelo de Trabajo Híbrido para vacantes con modelo híbrido
Nuestro equipo trabaja bajo el modelo “híbrido”, siendo necesario estar presencialmente en la oficina, ubicada en Buenos Aires.

Etapas del Proceso Selectivo:

Las etapas de nuestros procesos de selección tienen como objetivo evaluar tus experiencias y brindarte la oportunidad de conocer a nuestros equipos y oportunidades de carrera, y están estructuradas en los siguientes pasos:

•

• Application Review

• People Interview

• Hiring Manager Interview

• Case

• Stakeholder Interview

• Offer

Acerca del puesto

Integrada en el equipo de Growth, el área de Classifieds - Spanish-speaking LATAM es responsable de atraer inquilinos y compradores potenciales para los inmuebles disponibles en nuestros diferentes portales, apalancando estrategias de medios pagados para fortalecer nuestra red. Nuestro principal objetivo es potenciar y optimizar el proceso de adquisición, conectando de forma eficiente a compradores e inquilinos con las inmobiliarias de nuestro ecosistema.

Trabajando en colaboración con los equipos de Producto y Operaciones, buscamos maximizar el impacto de las campañas por medio de segmentaciones estratégicas, pruebas rigurosas y análisis de datos estructurados, garantizando que todo el embudo de conversión esté alineado con las metas de crecimiento del negocio.

Principales Responsabilidades:

• Planificación de iniciativas y roadmap: Apoyar al equipo en la planificación, ejecución y optimización de campañas de performance en canales como Facebook Ads y Google Ads, enfocadas en la adquisición de inquilinos y compradores potenciales para nuestros portales de Clasificados en América Latina.

• Colaboración con Operaciones y Producto: Trabajar de la mano con los equipos de operaciones y producto responsables de nuestros productos de Classifieds, colaborando en la ejecución de iniciativas cross-fucionales.

• Análisis de Datos: Conducir análisis detallados de performance, generando insights para mejorar las estrategias. Además, liderar la estructuración de la captura, organización y visualización de datos para potenciar una toma de decisiones ágil y acertada.

• Visión Financiera (Economics): Colaborar activamente en el análisis de economics (CAC, ROI, Payback) de esta operación de adquisición, asegurando la escalabilidad sostenible de los canales.

Requisitos:

•
Licenciatura / Graduación en Ingeniería, Economía u otras carreras de perfil analítico;

•
Fuertes habilidades analíticas para interpretar datos y tomar decisiones basadas en números;

•
Experiencia consolidada en Growth Marketing, preferiblemente con una sólida trayectoria táctica en la operación de campañas de adquisición pagada (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, etc.);

•
Conocimiento sólido de métricas de performance (CPC, CPA, ROI, ROAS, CTR, etc.);

•
Experiencia con herramientas de analítica, como Google Analytics, Amplitude o similares;

•
Conocimiento en lenguajes de programación para el desarrollo de análisis, como SQL o Python;

•
Inglés avanzado.

Importante:

• ¡Nuestro proceso de selección comienza con el registro! Si realmente deseas formar parte de nuestro equipo, asegúrate de completar esta primera etapa. Revisamos cada postulación con atención y siempre damos una respuesta, aunque la persona no siga en el proceso.

• Toda la comunicación se realiza por correo electrónico, así que estate atento a nuestros mensajes y libera el dominio @quintoandar.com.br para que nuestros correos no terminen en la carpeta de spam.

Beneficios

• Plan médico

• Wellhub

• Licencia parental extendida

• Reintegro de Guardería

• Gastos de teletrabajo (monto mensual)

• Descuentos en servicios del día a día

• Día libre por cumpleaños, Día del Padre y Día de la Madre

Diversidad e Inclusión en Grupo QuintoAndar

Durante la inscripción, verás algunas preguntas sobre diversidad. Estas son confidenciales y tienen como objetivo apoyar nuestras acciones de diversidad e inclusión. En vacantes afirmativas, la información podrá ser utilizada para verificar el alineamiento con el público objetivo de la oportunidad y, en estos casos, podría tener carácter eliminatorio. Para vacantes no afirmativas, esta información no afecta tu postulación y se utiliza únicamente para ayudarnos a mejorar continuamente nuestras prácticas e iniciativas de inclusión a lo largo de tu trayectoria con nosotros.

Privacidad y Protección de Datos

El Grupo QuintoAndar actúa de conformidad con las leyes de privacidad y protección de datos, y garante la seguridad de sus datos personales. Para saber más, consulte nuestro Aviso de Privacidad para Personas Candidatas . Si tiene dudas o desea ejercer sus derechos como titular de los datos, póngase en contacto con nosotros a través de nuestro Canal de Atención .

postings.title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Staff Software Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
About Grupo QuintoAndar

We are Grupo QuintoAndar, the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America. Guided by a shared purpose of helping people love where they live, we have a diversified portfolio of brands and solutions across different countries in Latin America, covering all phases of the housing journey. We also have a Technology Hub in Portugal. We develop technology and innovation to transform and enhance the overall living experience.

With the support of a world-class team of investors and advisors, including Kaszek, Qualcomm, General Atlantic, and SoftBank, Grupo QuintoAndar is currently valued at over USD 5.1 billion and continues to grow year over year.

Here, you will work with top professionals in the market, in an environment that breathes innovation, collaboration, and high performance. To learn more about our story, visit: https://grupoquintoandar.com/pt/ .

Location & Remote Work for technology and remote-first roles

Our technology team operates under a "remote-first" model, which means we work from home and can live anywhere in Argentina. We also offer the option of working from our Buenos Aires offices or partner coworking spaces, up to twice a week.

As a Staff Software Engineer , you will act as a premier technical anchor and individual contributor for our engineering organization. Operating with a line-level and organization-wide scope of impact, you will own the technical strategy and architectural roadmap of complex, large-scale products or platforms that are critical to the company's long-term vision.

We believe that technology scales execution, but senior talent scales judgment. This is an advanced leadership role that requires navigating cross-team technical architecture, managing technical alignment with stakeholders, and handling organizational and product dynamics across multiple structures.

Key Responsibilities (What you will do):

• Architectural direction & strategy: Set the core architectural direction for complex platform scopes. Identify and generate new org-wide technical opportunities, defining the technical strategy and roadmap required to execute them.

• Simplifying complex challenges: Break down vague, unstructured, and highly ambiguous problems into execution-ready technical scope. Create simple, highly maintainable systems with clear documentation and well-defined interfaces that can be easily operated even by junior engineers.

• Engineering excellence & trade-off ownership: Drive the technical quality for larger or complex team scopes by establishing engineering standards and best practices. Act as a technical advisor, defining policies and proactively mitigating obstacles for software, product, and data quality across multiple domains.

• Team influence & mentorship: Act as an absolute reference in technical leadership within Engineering. Provide senior technical assessments to management to inform project strategy and composition. Actively mentor senior engineers (including B6 and B7 levels), accelerating their technical growth without relying on formal authority.

• Guard the tech bar: Act as a lead interviewer for senior and principal technical roles, setting the bar during our hiring, sourcing, and internal allocation processes.

Position & technical challenges:

Because we are scaling multiple strategic fronts simultaneously, we run a unified hiring process for our Staff positions. Instead of locking you into a single team from day one, we focus on assessing your leadership, systemic thinking, and architectural skills first.

At the final stage of the process, we will present you with 2 or 3 of our most critical technical challenges across different products and platforms. Together, we will choose the allocation that best aligns your expertise and career aspirations with our highest-impact business needs.

Regardless of the final allocation, your day-to-day will deeply involve solving systemic issues where multiple services cannot be understood in isolation. You will step into environments requiring high-concurrency solutions, complex data consistency, and the decoupling of mission-critical systems.

What we are looking for (Requirements):

• 10+ years of experience in software development, with a consolidated background leading the delivery of high-volume, high-concurrency, and mission-critical distributed systems.

• Deep knowledge of modern software architecture paradigms, distributed data consistency, fault tolerance, and system optimization.

• Proven ability to analyze and articulate engineering trade-offs concretely (e.g., simplicity vs. flexibility, velocity vs. reliability, build vs. buy).

• Demonstrated capability to remove barriers to collaboration, conduct difficult structural conversations smoothly, build strategic roadmaps, and foster an inclusive engineering culture.

• Experience designing systems that cross team boundaries and remain maintainable as teams and products scale.

• Fluency in Spanish and excellent English skills (verbal and written) are mandatory, as we use English daily for code, architecture documentation, and global alignment.

Important

• Our hiring process starts with the application! If you truly want to be part of our team, please complete this step of the process. We analyze all candidates individually and provide feedback to all applicants.

• All communication will be conducted via email, so please stay tuned for our messages and release the domain @quintoandar.com.br to ensure our emails are not sent to spam.

Hiring Process Stages

The stages of our hiring processes aim to assess your experiences and allow you to meet our teams and explore career opportunities. They are structured as follows:

• Application

• Technical CV screening

• People Interview with Recruiters

• Tech Screening with Engineering Team (Code AI live case)

• Technicals Interviews (architecture live cases and tech leadership)

• Offer

Benefits

• Medical plan

• Wellhub

• Extended parental leave

• Reinstatement…

postings.title: Key Account Manager - GBA Oeste
postings.descriptionText:
Acerca del Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos el Grupo QuintoAndar, el ecosistema inmobiliario más grande de América Latina . Guiados por el propósito de ayudar a las personas a amar el lugar donde viven , creamos tecnología y soluciones que simplifican toda la experiencia de la vivienda, desde el alquiler hasta la compra y venta.

Estamos presentes en 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Ecuador y Panamá) y contamos con un hub de tecnología en Portugal , reuniendo a más de 3.100 personas unidas por el desafío de transformar el sector. Con el respaldo de inversionistas globales como SoftBank, General Atlantic y Kaszek, hemos levantado más de US$ 755 millones y hoy somos una compañía valuada en US$ 5,1 mil millones .

Lideramos la transformación del mercado siendo pioneros en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial a gran escala en el sector inmobiliario. Nuestras plataformas suman más de 50 millones de visitas al mes, administrando más de 350 mil contratos de alquiler activos y movilizando R$ 20 mil millones al año.

Si buscas resolver problemas complejos con autonomía, tecnología de punta e impacto a gran escala, adelante, estás en tu casa.

Para conocer más sobre nuestra historia, ingresa a: grupoquintoandar.com/es/

Ubicación y Modelo de Trabajo

Nuestro equipo de Key Account Manager trabaja bajo el modelo “híbrido”, siendo necesario estar presencialmente en la oficina, ubicada en Buenos Aires, 2 veces por semana.

Sobre el Equipo y el Desafío

El Hunter de Expansión es un perfil netamente estratégico y de apertura de mercado. Su misión principal es desembarcar y consolidar la presencia de la compañía en nuevas zonas geográficas, nuevas plazas o verticales de negocio no exploradas (como abrir nuevas zonas en GBA o penetrar el modelo híbrido en el interior). No maneja cartera existente; su foco es el crecimiento desde cero,

Tus Responsabilidades

• Apertura de Nuevas Plazas: Liderar la estrategia de entrada comercial en nuevas geografías, mapeando competidores locales y detectando barreras de entrada.

• Captación Agresiva (Paid Publisher): Introducir los modelos de monetización y planes premium de la compañía en el nuevo mercado, logrando los primeros cierres clave.

• Generación de Demanda Local: Desarrollar relaciones sólidas desde cero con los principales actores del mercado objetivo (inmobiliarias locales, desarrolladores)

• Alianza con Operaciones: Trabajar de la mano con los equipos de producto y marketing para adaptar el discurso comercial a las particularidades culturales y económicas de la nueva plaza.

• Growth Comercial: Asegurar que la nueva plaza alcance la masa crítica de listing o facturación necesaria en los plazos estipulados por el Business Plan (BP).

Lo que buscamos (Requisitos)

• Experiencia: Mínimo 3 a 5 años en roles de desarrollo de negocio ( Business Development ), ventas corporativas de campo (territoriales) o expansión en empresas de tecnología/proptech.

• Habilidades Blandas: Autonomía extrema, pensamiento estratégico, visión de negocio, adaptabilidad al cambio y habilidades de comunicación a nivel ejecutivo.

Ubicación y Modelo de Trabajo

Nuestro equipo de Estrategia trabaja bajo el modelo “híbrido”, siendo necesario estar presencialmente en la oficina, ubicada en Buenos Aires, 2 veces por semana.

Sobre el Equipo y el Desafío

El equipo de Estrategia para Hispanoamérica opera como un núcleo consultivo sénior encargado de impulsar el crecimiento y la sostenibilidad del ecosistema de Grupo QuintoAndar.

Búscamos un perfil con sólida capacidad cuantitativa y un marcado liderazgo ejecutivo, capaz de sintetizar análisis complejos en narrativas persuasivas que influyan en la toma de decisiones del C-Level y aseguren la alineación estratégica en toda la región.

Tus Responsabilidades

1. Supervisar el Negocio (Salud y Liquidez del Marketplace )

•
Mantener una visión independiente y altamente cuantificada de la salud general de los marketplaces de Grupo QuintoAndar en la región (Zonaprop, Inmuebles24, Plusvalía, Urbania, etc.).

•
Analizar a fondo las dinámicas de liquidez, identificando con precisión dónde se está formando el equilibrio entre oferta y demanda, dónde se está rompiendo y por qué.

•
Identificar de forma proactiva las brechas de mercado, diferenciando claramente entre realidades estructurales del sector y problemas operacionales internos, asegurando que las fallas se detecten antes de que los equipos operativos las escalen.

2. Identificar el Próximo Negocio (Innovación y Crecimiento Estratégico)

•
Monitorear continuamente los modelos emergentes de bienes raíces residenciales y PropTech a nivel global y regional (ej. servicios transaccionales, fintech inmobiliaria, herramientas SaaS, corretaje digital).

•
Evaluar oportunidades de crecimiento y determinar si Grupo QuintoAndar debe desarrollar ( build ), comprar ( buy ) o asociarse ( partner ) para integrar estos modelos.

•
Realizar evaluaciones integrales que abarquen viabilidad, encaje estratégico, impacto potencial, requerimientos de capital y estrategias de salida al mercado ( go-to-market ).

3. Liderar el Proceso de OKR (De la Estrategia a la Ejecución)

•
Liderar el mecanismo estratégico que conecta el diagnóstico con la ambición, asegurando que las prioridades estratégicas de alto nivel se traduzcan directamente en acciones operativas.

•
Enfocar a la dirección en el número reducido de iniciativas de alto apalancamiento que realmente moverán la aguja del negocio.

•
Establecer métricas claras, puntos de referencia ( benchmarks ) y marcos de desempeño para evaluar si las apuestas estratégicas están entregando los resultados previstos.

4. Influencia en el Liderazgo

•
Desarrollar casos de negocio sólidos e interdisciplinarios respaldados por datos y presentarlos directamente al liderazgo regional y a los Country Managers .

•
Cuestionar el status quo de manera constructiva, guiando a los equipos ejecutivos a replantear supuestos, reasignar capital o cerrar proyectos de bajo rendimiento.

Lo que buscamos (Requisitos)

•
Experiencia: 6+ años de experiencia total en Consultoría de Estrategia de primer nivel, Estrategia Corporativa, Operaciones de Negocio ( BizOps ) o Crecimiento Estratégico en marketplaces tecnológicos / PropTech de alto crecimiento.

•
Dominio de Marketplaces : Profundo entendimiento de las dinámicas de marketplaces , bucles de liquidez, unit economics y métricas clave (CAC, LTV, take rate , retención, tasas de conversión).

•
Rigor Analítico y Estratégico: Capacidad excepcional para traducir conjuntos de datos complejos e incompletos en marcos estratégicos claros, modelos cuantitativos y hallazgos accionables.

•
Influencia Ejecutiva: Trayectoria comprobada en influir sobre ejecutivos C-level, liderar equipos matriciales e impulsar el cambio organizacional mediante una comunicación persuasiva.

•
Conocimiento de la Industria: Comprensión del panorama inmobiliario en América Latina, tendencias PropTech y el ecosistema de clasificados digitales.

•
Idiomas: Fluidez o nivel profesional avanzado tanto en inglés como en español (el portugués es un plus).

Propuesta y ¡Bienvenido/a!

postings.descriptionText:
EBANX is one of the most successful fintechs to emerge from Latin America — and today, we are building a truly global payments company. Our mission has remained constant from day one: to unlock access and enable companies and consumers to participate in the digital economy, no matter where they are.

What started as a bold vision has grown into a platform that connects some of the world’s largest digital businesses with customers across 21 of the fastest-growing markets. We operate where complexity exists — turning local challenges into global opportunities, and building the infrastructure that allows payments to move further, faster, and smarter.

We are a team of builders and problem-solvers. We think globally, act with curiosity, and believe diversity of thought is a competitive advantage.

As EBANX enters its next phase of hyper growth, we are looking for people who want to shape the future of payments, expand what’s possible, and help connect businesses and consumers across borders.

• Fluent English (written and spoken).

• Experience in high-growth fintechs or global payment companies operating across Latin America and other multi-regulatory environments.

• Experience applying AI, automation, machine learning, or advanced analytics to enhance transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, investigations, and financial crime operations.

postings.title: Growth Rider Manager
postings.descriptionText:
En Cabify creemos que una nueva forma de movilidad urbana es posible. Un ecosistema que permita tener menos autos privados en las calles, vehículos más sostenibles y rutas más eficientes.

Ciudades en las que sus calles estén pensadas por y para las personas, y no para los coches. Productos y servicios que, mediante alternativas de movilidad sostenibles y eficientes, generen valor económico, social y medioambiental.

Y no solo es que creamos en ello, sino que trabajamos la magia para hacerlo posible. Si compartís con nosotros el mismo propósito, seguí leyendo porque… ¡Este es tu lugar!

Misión del Puesto

Buscamos un Growth Manager para sumarse al equipo de Riders Growth para Cabify Argentina y Uruguay. El rol está enfocado en liderar la estrategia de crecimiento y retención de nuestra audiencia de pasajeros, asegurando una propuesta de valor excepcional y un modelo de negocio sostenible. Es una posición orientada al análisis y ejecución, pero también con un fuerte enfoque en el desarrollo y liderazgo de equipos.

¿Cómo nos ayudarás a cumplir nuestra misión?

• Gestión del Ciclo de Vida y Crecimiento de Audiencia: Diseñar e implementar estrategias integrales para hacer crecer la base de pasajeros activos y aumentar su recurrencia, monitoreando y optimizando de extremo a extremo todo el ciclo de vida de la audiencia.

• Propuesta de Valor : Cuidar, definir y mejorar continuamente la propuesta de valor para asegurar la satisfacción y fidelidad de los usuarios.

• Gestión de Presupuesto: Liderar la asignación, ejecución y optimización del presupuesto de descuentos y campañas digitales de performance.

• Innovación y Desarrollo: Descubrir y validar nuevos productos, funcionalidades o nichos de mercado que impulsen el crecimiento.

• Estrategia de Comunicación y Campañas Digitales: Coordinar la estrategia de comunicación hacia la audiencia de pasajeros en conjunto con el equipo de marketing.

• Liderazgo de Equipo : Gestionar, mentorear y potenciar el desarrollo de un equipo directo a cargo.

• Buscar mejoras constantes en la manera en la que hacemos las cosas, persiguiendo eficiencia operativa mediante la adopción de nuevas tecnologías.

¿Qué buscamos?

• Afinidad con nuestros principios.

• Graduado en Ingeniería, Administración de empresas, Economía, Negocios, o campo relevante.

• Más de 3 años de experiencia en roles similares. Se valorará la experiencia previa en empresas de tecnología.

• Experiencia en roles con liderazgo/coordinación de equipos.

• Base analítica sólida.

• Personas altamente motivadas con excelentes habilidades para resolver problemas y priorizar cargas de trabajo cambiantes en una industria dinámica.

• Habilidades estratégicas y compromiso en la búsqueda de soluciones para desafíos complejos.

• Comunicación efectiva con diferentes stakeholders y poder de influencia para hacer que las cosas sucedan.

• Contar con una base sólida de soft skills, ya que son imprescindibles en nuestra cultura: saber trabajar en equipo, dar y recoger feedback constructivo y tener espíritu de mejora continua.

• Conocimientos en herramientas de datos y análisis y entendimiento de KPIs (Se valorará tener conocimiento en Tableau.)

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Somos un equipo repleto de gente feliz y motivada. Flexibilidad, buen ambiente, crecimiento e impacto ¡asegurados! Cabify viene cargado de beneficios para que los disfrutes en tu viaje junto a nosotros:

🏥Plan de medicina prepaga OSDE 310

🤸Horario flexible, teletrabajo y semanas full remote

🔋Recharge Days

🏝️Cabify days: una semana adicional de vacaciones

💸Crédito mensual para usar en nuestra App de Cabify

🎟️ Beneficios y descuentos con Club LA NACIÓN

🎉Eventos divertidos para disfrutar junto a tu equipo

🖥️Equipo de trabajo para que desarrolles todo tu talento

Cabify se enorgullece de ser un lugar de trabajo con igualdad de oportunidades. Celebramos la diversidad y estamos comprometidos con crear un entorno inclusivo para todas las personas, independientemente de su origen, género, religión, orientación, edad o capacidad. ¡Únete a nosotros!

Nosotros administramos el servicio de envío de paquetería y mercancías de Cabify, una pieza clave en la logística urbana. Tu misión será ser el motor de nuestro crecimiento comercial B2B, identificando y calificando oportunidades de alto valor en logística y e-commerce. postings.title: Operational Excellence Coordinator
postings.descriptionText:
OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE COORDINATOR

En Cabify creemos que una nueva forma de movilidad urbana es posible. Un ecosistema que permita tener menos coches privados en las calles, vehículos más sostenibles y rutas más eficientes.

Ciudades en las que sus calles estén pensadas por y para las personas, y no para los coches. Productos y servicios que, mediante alternativas de movilidad sostenibles y eficientes, generen valor económico, social y medioambiental.

Y no solo es que creamos en ello, sino que trabajamos la magia para hacerlo posible. Si compartes con nosotros el mismo propósito, sigue leyendo porque… ¡Este es tu sitio!

Sobre el puesto

Cómo Operational Excellence Coordinator tu rol será colaborar e impulsar la consecución de esta misión y objetivos para los mercados de Argentina y Uruguay, garantizando el mejor servicio y la mejor experiencia posible a los conductores de Cabify, buscando su fidelización en la app a largo plazo.

El puesto se encuentra dentro del equipo de Operational Excellence (OEX), el cual pertenece al área de Customer Operations (COPS). Dentro de COPS, los equipos de OEX y Customer Support tienen la misión de ser los garantes de los estándares de servicio por los cuales Cabify se destaca. El área de COPS es quizás el área más transversal de Cabify, teniendo que trabajar con todos los departamentos, lo que garantiza mucho aprendizaje, desafíos y diversión.

¿Cómo nos ayudarás a cumplir con nuestra misión?

• Siendo la principal referencia estratégica y operativa dentro del equipo de OEX para conductores y liderando este equipo.

• Operativizando y controlando la propuesta de valor definida para conductores, con foco en garantizar un servicio seguro, fiable y superior a través de la optimización y control de procesos eficientes, confiables y sin desperdicios, teniendo la capacidad de transformarlos.

• Detectando oportunidades de mejora en las distintas etapas del customer journey de nuestros conductores: desde que inician su registro para ser nuevos usuarios y durante toda su experiencia en viajes y posterior a los viajes.

• Entendiendo los principales puntos de fricción para cada uno de los procesos y estableciendo propuestas de mejora, basándose siempre en el análisis del valor de cada una para la toma de decisiones.

• Liderando proyectos de mejora para el área, en la búsqueda continua de soluciones efectivas, escalables y eficientes.

• Trabajando de la mano con equipos de soporte para asegurar la mejor calidad de servicio, desde el punto de vista de la atención al cliente.

• Optimizando procesos críticos a través de la implementación de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial (LLMs, Prompt Engineering, OCR, etc) y de la automatización de tareas para escalar las operaciones, en conjunto con equipos locales y globales.

• Alineando directrices de proyectos globales para su eficiente implementación local y escalando necesidades del mercado hacia equipos globales mediante la documentación de requerimientos y evidencia cuantitativa.

¿Qué buscamos?

• Profesional en Ingeniería o afín con experiencia de al menos 3 años en cargos de optimización de procesos, mejora continua o en posiciones similares en empresas de tecnología.

• Será considerado como un plus tener experiencia en estos roles dentro de empresas de tecnología.

• Experiencia excluyente de al menos 2 a 3 años liderando y gestionando equipos de forma directa, preferentemente con perfiles analíticos o técnicos.

• Manejo avanzado de herramienta Excel / Google Sheets (excluyente).

• Manejo de herramientas de Business Intelligence (Tableau, Power BI, o Looker, etc) para consultas de bases de datos, armado de gráficos y desarrollo de tableros básicos, con demostrada capacidad para hacer análisis e interpretación de indicadores. (excluyente)

• Experiencia comprobable en la implementación de flujos con herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial (IA) con el fin de optimizar procesos operativos (excluyente).

• Capacidad de manejar muchos frentes simultáneamente y de dialogar con múltiples interlocutores, logrando mantener una agenda ordenada de trabajo por objetivos.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita, con capacidad para interactuar eficazmente con diversos stakeholders, escalar problemas, dar visibilidad a iniciativas y validar cursos de acción.

• Personas proactivas, autónomas y con ganas de impulsar un cambio.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Somos un equipo repleto de gente feliz y motivada. Flexibilidad, buen ambiente, crecimiento e impacto ¡asegurados! Cabify viene cargado de beneficios para que los disfrutes en tu viaje junto a nosotros:

• Tomar ownership sobre los resultados, comprendiendo el problema a resolver, cuestionando lo necesario y tomando decisiones que contemplen tanto los aspectos técnicos como el producto y el negocio.

• Trabajar con autonomía y adaptarse a cambios de prioridades, avanzando, validando, aprendiendo e iterando aun cuando las especificaciones no estén completamente definidas.

¿Qué buscamos?

• Experiencia sólida en ingeniería de software, con una base técnica que te permita evaluar soluciones, detectar problemas y tomar buenas decisiones más allá del código generado por IA.

• Experiencia real utilizando herramientas de IA para desarrollar software y capacidad para incorporarlas a tu workflow de manera efectiva.

• Conocimientos sólidos de Python y Django , bases de datos relacionales y estructuración de datos.

• Experiencia diseñando y desarrollando APIs REST e integraciones con distintas fuentes de datos.

• Criterio y disciplina de testing, entendiendo cuándo y cómo utilizar distintos niveles de validación.

• Capacidad para diagnosticar problemas, optimizar performance y encontrar causas raíz.

• Criterio arquitectónico para evaluar alternativas, entender trade-offs y tomar decisiones considerando impacto, riesgos y mantenibilidad.

• Interés genuino por participar del SDLC de punta a punta, y no limitarte a una etapa específica del desarrollo.

• Experiencia con Angular o frameworks similares es un plus.

• Experiencia previa en productos SaaS o ITSM es un plus.

Beneficios

Nuestros beneficios incluyen oportunidades de desarrollo profesional, clases de inglés, capacitaciones técnicas internas y externas, días adicionales de vacaciones y licencia por paternidad, seguro de salud privado de primer nivel, reintegro por trabajo remoto y un bono fijo para compras relacionadas con gastronomía.

postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

As a Customer Success Manager at Alpaca, you are the front line in our pursuit of enabling financial markets access for everyone on the planet. You’ll work with our partners (customers) from contract signature through renewal, ensuring they have a positive experience leading to successful outcomes. Reporting to the Director, Success, this role supports Alpaca’s B2B offerings, helping customers launch US securities and crypto trading apps worldwide.

Things You Get To Do:

• Act as the primary contact for B2B/enterprise customers, accountable for building and maintaining strong relationships with key contacts throughout the customer lifecycle

• Ensure customer satisfaction, retention, and success

• Manage escalations, internally and externally, with a focus on customer empathy

• Maintain regular contact with customers to understand their business priorities, monitor their progress toward achieving key results, and continually identify and mitigate risks (relationship, commercial, etc.)

• Work with partners to accurately forecast growth and identify and monitor progress toward shared goals

• Drive adoption of Alpaca features (new and existing) among our Live Partners

• Identify and disseminate best practices and pitfalls

• Represent the partner internally across multiple groups, including Marketing, Product, and Operations

• Maintain positive relationships, internally and externally, to drive overall success and overcome obstacles

• Provide internal communication and reporting on overall account status, health, and risk

• Develop a success strategy for ensuring customer success

• Identify areas and consider solutions for improvement and optimization within Alpaca

• Deliver QBRs and executive reports that align customer goals with platform outcomes

• Serve as a trusted advisor to customers’ leadership teams, aligning Alpaca capabilities with their go-to-market strategy

• Own the full customer lifecycle post-signature, including onboarding, activation, expansion, and renewal

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and our Broker-Dealer to leverage process understanding, champion partner needs, and influence roadmap priorities

• Perform ad-hoc duties and responsibilities as assigned

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

• 4–6 years of experience in a customer success role managing customer relationships

• Comfortable working US hours (ET) in a remote setup

• Understanding of and experience with key technology concepts, such as SaaS and APIs

• FinTech experience, especially within the broker-dealer business

• Experience working with both large and small companies

• A dedicated interest in Alpaca's mission to enable financial services access to everyone on the planet

• Ability to work remotely and independently and to self-manage time and obligations

• Flexibility to jump in where and when needed to help drive Alpaca's growth

• Desire to learn

• Ability to manage customer relationships across companies of various sizes

• A team player who thrives on ownership, transparency, and being relentlessly partner-first. We move fast, support each other, and aim to grow together.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

• Startup mindset suited to a fast-paced, high-growth environment

• Experience working with international B2B clients

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

• Engage the right people, fast. Identify the owning team by service, symptom and blast radius, page them, and expand the responder set the moment the first team is wrong or not enough. When a page goes unanswered, escalate - and escalate the escalation. Bring in the leaders who must make business calls: feature flags, traffic shedding, failover, freeze-or-ship.

• Hold the bridge, and protect the people fixing it. Keep engineering and technical support uninterrupted - questions from stakeholders, partners and executives come to you. Be the single source of truth to the partner communications team on impact, severity and timing: you decide when a status page update or partner contact is needed, they write and send it, and chasing a late or stale update is yours.

• Run follow-the-sun handoffs. Deliver warm, high-fidelity handoffs across regions: current impact and severity, mitigation path and next actions, who is in the room, outstanding decisions, and what must not be dropped. The incoming commander confirms ownership before you step away - command never goes dark at a region boundary.

• Close the loop, on the clock. Maintain the timeline of facts as the incident runs rather than reconstructing it afterwards - in a regulated business that record has to hold up long after the call ends. Once mitigated, make sure a blameless retrospective is scheduled with a named owner and a timebox, and record where the cause sits - that choice sets which follow-up items are mandatory. Every action item needs a real ticket, one named accountable, a priority and a category, delivered inside the agreed service level. If a postmortem produces nothing but low-priority items, treat that as a signal the analysis stopped early and escalate to SRE rather than passing it on.

• Automate the coordination away. Coordination is the part of this job that should eventually belong to a machine. Every manual prompt you send - the update that is due, the question nobody answered, the partner nobody contacted - is a candidate for automation, and the direction we are heading is AI handling the routine so commanders can spend their attention on judgement. • Establish quality standards: Set evaluation guidelines, documentation, and review practices.

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will build and own the frameworks, tooling, and CI/CD infrastructure that let Alpaca’s engineers ship new features quickly and reliably. This is a software engineering role at its core: you will spend most of your time writing Go, designing automated test frameworks, and digging into application code and Kubernetes when needed. Just as importantly, you will help redefine how we use AI to raise the bar on quality - leveraging LLMs and AI-driven tooling to generate tests, catch regressions before they ship, and turn every incident into durable, automated coverage. We are looking for engineers who treat quality as an engineering discipline and see AI as a force multiplier for it - people who build the systems that make testing fast, reliable, and effortless for the teams that depend on them.

Things You Get To Do

• Design and build automated test frameworks across our REST and gRPC API surface.

• Leverage AI and LLM-based tooling to accelerate test generation, harden regression coverage, and turn production incidents into automated tests - embedding these practices into the frameworks the whole engineering org relies on.

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines - we use a mix of GitHub Actions and Google Cloud Build.

• Design and execute load, stress, and scalability tests to ensure our platform can handle growing demand.

• Introduce chaos engineering practices - designing fault-injection and resilience experiments that surface failure modes before our customers do.

• Standardize tooling and infrastructure to improve the day-to-day developer experience.

• Partner with other teams to raise test coverage, reliability, and speed across services.

• Dig into application code to root-cause failures and drive fixes to completion.

• Mentor and guide product engineers, fostering a culture of quality and continuous improvement.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

• You have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer building and maintaining production systems.

• You have written code in strongly typed languages and have at least 1 year of experience with Go.

• You are fluent with AI-assisted engineering - you actively use LLM-based tools in your workflow and have a clear point of view on where they elevate quality (and where they don’t).

• You have built and maintained CI pipelines before - ideally with GitHub Actions or Google Cloud Build.

• You have designed and built automated test frameworks, and you understand the challenges microservices pose for reliable integration and end-to-end testing.

• You are familiar with Kubernetes beyond the basics - you can write a Helm chart for a new service with relative ease, you understand best practices around security, and you have prior job experience or certifications to prove this.

• You have worked at a startup before - you understand that things don’t always go according to plan, that there is significant technical debt, that some tasks just need to be done, and that sometimes there are no processes or documentation to guide your hand.

• You are not afraid of taking a task from start to finish - gathering requirements, figuring out and implementing the best technical solution, then deploying and monitoring the results.

Who You Might Be (Bonus Points)

• You have used AI/LLM tooling to build QA automation - test generation, flaky-test triage, or incident-to-regression pipelines - and can speak to what worked and what didn’t.

• You have written code in Python or TypeScript, and can build efficient Dockerfiles and secure container images.

Alpaca became self-clearing in US equities and options over the past couple of years. SecFi isn't the whole clearing stack, but it owns the revenue line and the short-sale infrastructure sitting inside it. About the Role

We are seeking a Staff Full Stack Engineer to lead the technical direction of the team that builds Alpaca's Trading API product. Trading API serves developers, traders, and institutions who trade directly with Alpaca. The team owns that customer experience end to end: how customers access the platform, how their accounts are structured and secured, and the applications they use to trade.

The work spans the stack: customer-facing trading applications, the identity, account, and permission systems behind them, and integrations for partner apps and AI agents. The team also builds customer-facing trading features end to end, across our API.

This is a high-trust domain. These systems decide who can act on an account and what they are allowed to do. A defect can expose customer data, let the wrong person place a trade or move money, or lock a customer out at the moment they need to trade. The customer-facing surfaces also carry real-time trading: an order ticket or positions view that shows stale or wrong data can lead to a bad trade. We are looking for an engineer who has built and owned systems like this — identity and authorization, account models, and trading or financial applications — and who is as comfortable designing an authorization model as shipping the interface built on top of it.

You will not manage people directly. You will lead through architecture, code, design reviews, and mentorship, and you will remain a principal contributor. You will be the senior technical anchor for the team, partnering with the engineering manager, Product, and Design, and working closely with the trading, margin and risk, and platform teams behind the API.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the architecture and technical roadmap for how customers access and use Trading API: identity and authentication, authorization and permissions, account and sub-account models, partner OAuth, and customer-facing trading and account-management applications.

• Design the access model for increasingly complex account structures — multiple users per account, sub-accounts, entity and advisor accounts, and delegated API and agent access — so that permissions are explicit, auditable, and enforced on the server.

• Lead technical delivery of next-generation Trading API customer applications, including real-time market data, order entry, and positions and order views, as the product expands to new customer surfaces.

• Drive the move from legacy monolith endpoints to a dedicated application backend, with clear API contracts between customer applications and platform services such as trading, accounts, transfers, ledger, and market data.

• Set the security bar for customer-facing systems: session and credential handling, MFA and passkeys, OAuth flows, rate limiting, input validation, and fast, durable responses to security findings.

Most brands are running on a fragile patchwork of middleware, custom integrations, manual spreadsheets, and legacy OMS platforms that were never designed for modern omnichannel complexity.

That’s exactly what Pipe17 solves.

Pipe17 is the AI-native Enterprise Order Operations Platform . We replace the entire stack of iPaaS + OMS with a single unified operational layer that manages orders, inventory, products, fulfillment, and exceptions in one place. 300+ managed connectors. AI-powered workflows. Go-live in weeks, not quarters. No developer dependency. No systems integrator required.

Every brand replatforming onto Shopify needs to solve what happens after checkout. Every brand scaling into new channels, adding 3PLs, expanding into marketplaces, or onboarding retail trading partners hits the same wall - their post-purchase operations can’t keep up. Pipe17 is the answer to that problem, and right now the vast, vast majority of these brands don’t know we exist.

Brands like Estée Lauder, Allbirds, e.l.f. Beauty, Made In Cookware, Olly, Wyze, Dude Wipes, and Black Rifle Coffee Company already run their post-checkout operations on Pipe17. TikTok Shop named us “Best Enterprise Integration.” We’re defining a new category - Order Operations - and we’re looking for someone to go take the market.

This is a business-building role inside a category-defining company. You’re not joining a mature sales org. You’re helping build one.

• Develop creative, multi-channel outbound strategies. Cold calls, targeted emails, LinkedIn, events, industry communities - whatever works. You’ll figure it out because that’s what you do

• Map accounts and find the right buyers - VP of Operations, VP of Ecommerce, VP of Supply Chain, CTO, CFO - and get meetings that nobody else can get

Run a Full-Cycle Sales Process

• Own the deal from first touch to closed-won

• Partner with Sales Engineering to run discovery and demos that show prospects how Pipe17 replaces their entire iPaaS + OMS stack with one platform

• Work complex buying committees across Operations, IT, and Finance - and build business cases that make the ROI obvious (our customers are seeing 85% operational cost reduction and 99% fewer fulfillment errors)

• Sell the vision of Order Operations as a category - not just a product swap, but a fundamentally different approach to running post-checkout commerce

At Pipe17, our values aren’t just words on a wall. They’re how we operate every day.

We are a high-performance team built around ownership , urgency , curiosity , and a strong bias for action .

We set bold goals, hold ourselves accountable, and move fast to solve customer problems. Every team member owns their decisions and drives outcomes. No one waits for permission.

Thoughtful use of AI is part of how we scale ourselves and our impact.

We learn from each other, improve constantly, and rally around our mission: unify commerce after the buy button.

If these values resonate with how you like to work, you’ll fit right in.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Pipe17 is the modern commerce operations platform connecting orders, inventory, and fulfillment across every channel and 3PL. We're at an inflection point — demand is outpacing our current sales capacity and we're building the team to match. This AE role is for a closer who can handle both inbound pipeline and self-generated outbound, selling into ops and supply chain leaders at mid-market and enterprise merchants who are scaling past what their current stack can handle.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own the full sales cycle — discovery through close — for mid-market and enterprise new logo accounts.

• Run a balanced inbound/outbound motion: work qualified pipeline from marketing and SDRs while independently generating outbound in your territory.

• Sell into operations, supply chain, and ecommerce leadership with a value-based approach — lead with pain and quantified impact, not features.

• Multi-thread across stakeholders: champion, economic buyer, technical evaluator, and executive sponsor.

• Accurately forecast your pipeline and maintain clean CRM hygiene throughout every stage.

• Partner with Solutions Engineering on technical discovery and custom demos for complex deals.

• Bring structured thinking to deal strategy — using MEDDIC or equivalent to qualify and advance opportunities.

MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

✓ Experience selling into 3PLs or Shopify or DTC Brands

✓ 7+ years of AE closing experience in a SaaS or software platform environment (not services or implementation).

✓ Demonstrated experience selling to operations, supply chain, or ecommerce buyers — not just marketing or IT.

✓ Fluency in value-based selling — you lead with business impact and quantified pain, not demos or feature lists.

✓ Track record at early-stage or growth-stage companies where process was limited and you had to build your own motion.

✓ Proven ability to close $50K–$500K+ ACV deals with multi-stakeholder buying processes.

✓ Experience in at least one of: OMS/order management, feed management/syndication, 3PL/fulfillment, and commerce.

✓ Experience working with Partner ecosystem to generate pipeline

✓ Ability to use AI to help do your job more efficiently and improve your sales skills & process

STRONG DIFFERENTIATORS

• Named methodology fluency: VBS, MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, Challenger, or equivalent.

• Background at a commerce ecosystem company.

• Experience selling an OMS or integration platform to 3PL, brand, or marketplace operators.

• Existing network of merchant, agency, or 3PL relationships in the Shopify ecosystem.

• History of winning competitive displacement deals — not just greenfield.

Compensation (US FTE)

• Competitive salary

• Great healthcare + dental + vision coverage

• Retirement plan

• Pick your own equipment. We'll set you up with whatever Apple laptop + monitor combo you want plus any software you need.

• Unlimited vacation policy. Plus we require you to take at least 2 weeks off each year. We see most employees take 4 weeks off per year. This isn't a vague policy where unlimited vacation means no vacation

About Us

Pipe17 is the AI-native Enterprise Order Operations Platform for brands and 3PLs. We replace the fragmented stack of iPaaS, middleware, and legacy OMS with one unified operational layer that manages orders, inventory, products, fulfillment, and exceptions across every channel and partner.

With 300+ managed connectors, AI-powered workflows, and an industry-first MCP Server for agentic commerce, Pipe17 lets brands go live in weeks, scale into new channels in days, and run post-checkout operations without developer dependency or systems integrators.

Our customers reduce operational costs by up to 85%, cut fulfillment errors by 99%, and launch new channels in days instead of months. Pipe17 is trusted by enterprise brands including Estée Lauder, Allbirds, e.l.f. Beauty, Made In Cookware, Wyze, Olly, Black Rifle Coffee Company, and Dude Wipes, as well as leading 3PLs including Ryder, FedEx, and Barrett Distribution.

Pipe17 is a venture-funded software company headquartered in Seattle, WA with a significant presence in the San Francisco Bay Area. The company is backed by GLP Capital Partners, a leading investor in ecommerce logistics, and with Series A funding.

postings.title: Accountant
postings.descriptionText:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Accountant who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

This position is based in LATAM for an accountant with 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience to join our finance team. Supporting a US-headquartered, NASDAQ-listed public company, you will perform accounting tasks, drive monthend close schedules under US GAAP and ensure compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal controls.

What You'll Do:

• US GAAP & Month-End Close: Execute monthly journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, cash reconciliations and variance analysis compliant with US GAAP standards; support quarterly/annual financial reviews and audits.

• SOX Compliance & Internal Controls: Maintain audit-ready documentation and execute internal control testing in compliance with SOX 404 requirements.

• Audit Preparation: Maintain organized documentation and supporting schedules for quarterly/annual financial reviews and audits.

What We Look For:

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent.

• 2 to 4 years of progressive accounting experience. Exposure to US GAAP is a requirement; exposure to public company operations (or USheadquartered subsidiaries) is a plus.

•
Regulatory Knowledge: Solid foundation in US GAAP and basic exposure to SOX compliance / internal controls framework.

•
Systems: Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

•
Communication & Hours: Professional English fluency (written and spoken) is required; ability to work aligned with US Central time zones.

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Strong analytical, operational, organizational, technical, management and problem-solving skills

• Ability to multitask and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Works well in a team environment

• Excellent communicator

• Comfortable working with ambiguity

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Compensation:

The compensation range for the role is $2,500 - $4,500 USD GROSS per month as a contractor. Specific compensation offered to a candidate may be dependent on factors such as education, experience, qualifications, and alignment with market data.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Executive Recruiter who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

You will serve as a strategic partner to leadership, driving full-cycle executive searches for C-suite roles and board of directors appointments. • 5 years of progressive experience in executive recruitment, with a strong track record of placing C-suite executives and board members.

If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Fraud Data Analyst to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will have a passion for uncovering fraudulent activities and a strong understanding of fraud prevention strategies. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, investigating, and preventing fraudulent transactions and activities, utilizing your analytical skills and experience with SQL to query and analyze data. You will play a crucial role in protecting our company and our customers from financial loss and reputational damage.

Due to the requirements of the position, only English resumes will be accepted.

What You'll Do:

• Monitor transactions and customer accounts to identify and investigate suspicious or fraudulent activity.

• Utilize various fraud detection tools, systems, and techniques to identify emerging fraud trends and patterns.

• Conduct in-depth investigations into suspected fraudulent activities, gathering evidence and documenting findings.

• Analyze large datasets using SQL to identify anomalies, patterns, and insights related to fraudulent behavior.

• Develop and implement fraud prevention rules, strategies, and controls.

• Stay up to date with industry best practices, emerging fraud threats, and new technologies in fraud detection and prevention.

What We Look For:

• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g. Economics, Computer Science, Analytics, or a related field).

• Minimum of two (2) years of experience in a fraud detection, prevention, or investigation role.

• Minimum of two (2) years of experience working with SQL and Python.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.

• Understanding of common fraud typologies (e.g., account takeover, identity theft, payment fraud, etc.).

• Experience with fraud detection tools and platforms is a plus.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex issues.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.

• High level of integrity and a commitment to ethical practices

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Qualifications

• Work experience in fintech, payments, lending, banking, or financial institutions is a plus

• Degree in statistics, math, finance, economics, or related quantitative discipline; graduate degree a plus

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Title: IT Operations Analyst

Hiring Manager: Dave Bergen

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated IT Operations Analyst who is best in class, with a high IQ and a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with strong prospects for continued growth and increased ownership.

Compensation

The compensation range for the role is $2,000 - $2,600 USD GROSS per month as a contractor. Specific compensation offered to a candidate may be dependent on factors such as education, experience, qualifications, and alignment with market data. Exceptional candidates may receive salaries outside of the posted ranges.

Due to the requirements of the position, only English resumes will be accepted.

What You'll Do:

• Be the one of the main points of contact for device inventory procurement, deployment, physical security, and management for employees in Colombia, including macOS and Windows OS-based devices.

• Respond promptly to incoming ITSD tickets in Jira, working on the issue from inception to completion.

• Contribute to working down assigned items in our existing Jira backlog of initiative-based elements as we work to continue to be a more proactive IT Operations team.

• Maintain a high level of technical change awareness regarding our large application stack and be well-versed in IT Security. You should possess the ability and confidence to convey this information accurately to the larger engineering team and, in some cases, the organization as a whole.

• Obtain and provision hardware and software requests as assigned. This position requires on-call responsibilities and occasional after-hours work.

• Conduct IT Operations onboarding training for organization new hires, as well as processing IT-focused employee termination responsibilities

• Contribute to existing and future IT audit work on access control history and quarterly software vendor audits.

What We Look For:

• Applicants must be fluent in English.

• Experience between 2 -6 years

• Has a team-oriented mindset, sharing the workload but also being willing to step up when resources are minimized. Our ideal candidate is an excellent communicator who shows patience and a willingness to learn.

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

• Systems and skills knowledge should include a high aptitude in cloud-based productivity suite administration, macOS device management and configuration using enterprise tools, IT service management platforms with experience in ticket automation and workflow design, enterprise Windows device management using third-party solutions, productivity software suite administration, and management of enterprise endpoint security platforms.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

• Possess the ability to be a self-starter:

• Identify a problem.

• Assess the situation and any variables

• Work quickly and accurately to resolve the problem

• Identify areas where processes can be improved to reduce the reoccurrence of existing problems

• Take the initiative and work autonomously to implement the improvement.

• Ability to react to a rapidly changing organization with a true start-up mentality.

• Experience and comfort working on an agile team – an ideal candidate should be familiar with agile concepts, including Jira ticketing classification, pointing, and meeting workflows.

• Possess a high level of organization with the ability to document workflows accurately and in a manner that can be replicated. Change management is critical to the success of our IT Operations team for both auditing purposes and process improvement. Our ideal candidate would have experience and comfort in bringing these skills to Sezzle.

• Experience working with PCI-DSS, SOC 2 Type 2, and CIS controls; specifically in implementation, documentation, administration, and continued adherence to these controls.

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup cultur…
