postings.descriptionText:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry is seeking an experienced and charismatic engineer for a critical customer-facing Senior Solutions Engineer role. This role supports Sales by providing perspective, feedback, and sharing knowledge learned from the front lines of the aerospace and defense engineering and manufacturing community. This role is a unique blend of customer engagement, technical expertise, and project management. Solutions Engineering will report into the Pre-Sales Engineering community, which is dually led by Sales and Operations.

This is a unique opportunity to join a dynamic and growing company at the forefront of digital manufacturing. If you are a successful, experienced, team-focused engineer with digital fluency and a sincere enthusiasm about the aerospace industry, this could be the right role for you.

How You'll Contribute:

Customer Engagement and Sales:

• Partner with Account Executives to drive account growth and retention

• Discover, illuminate, digest, organize and execute major projects

• Join Account Executives in onsite visits with customers when appropriate

• Proactively identify and address potential manufacturing challenges (including DFM)

• Stay informed about upcoming customer projects and initiatives to ensure alignment with Xometry's capabilities

• Gather customer insights and feedback to inform sales strategies

Pre-Sales Engineering:

• Assist Pre-Sales Engineering with knowledge gathering, digestion, and ultimately compiling correct and competitive quotes

• Combine customer knowledge, Xometry partner knowledge, and Xometry system knowledge to rapidly address customer needs and shepherd projects to delivery

• Provide project management and oversight on complex opportunities

What You'll Bring to Xometry:

• 10+ years of relevant experience in aerospace and defense engineering and manufacturing roles

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering is required

• Experience using Xometry’s services from a customer perspective. Partner perspective is a bonus

• Deep familiarity with the methods, materials, culture and products of organizations such as Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, Blue Origin, Anduril, General Dynamics, Moog, SpaceX

• Strong understanding of manufacturing principles, including drawings and GDT

• Particularly strong experience in CNC machining. Composites, Plastics, Harnesses and Sheet Metal Fab are bonuses

• Familiarity with ISO9001, AS9100d, ITAR, NIST and other common and critical compliance and certification requirements

• Excellent English communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills. This must extend into remote/digital environments

• Ability to travel to customer and/or partner sites as needed. 25%-35% travel is typical

• Mountain or Pacific home time zone preferred

• Experience with CRM systems such as Salesforce

• Proficiency in Google Suite and Microsoft Office Suite

Please submit your resume in English

postings.title: Social & Community Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry is looking for a Social & Community Manager to own how the brand shows up, sounds, and responds across organic social and community spaces every single day. You will be the face of Xometry online — the daily voice, the person engaging in the communities where our buyers and suppliers already are, and the one making sure nothing falls through the cracks when someone reaches out. This role is part storyteller, part community builder, part first responder. You keep the content calendar on track and partner with our agency on production, but the voice, the engagement, and the day-to-day judgment calls are yours. You'll stand up the tools and triage process that let us listen and respond in real time, and you'll pull in subject matter experts when a conversation needs real technical credibility behind it.

How You’ll Contribute:

• Serve as the face of Xometry and operational lead for organic social & community — owning daily voice, community engagement, and servicing triage

• Represent Xometry in buyer and supplier communities (forums, Reddit, YouTube)

• Stand up a social listening/servicing tool

• Own the social content calendar and partner with the agency on content creation

• Establish a servicing triage process for community and social inquiries

What You'll Bring to Xometry:

• 7+ years experience managing organic social and/or online community programs, ideally in a B2B or technical industry

• Strong writing skills and a distinct, adaptable voice — comfortable engaging authentically in forums, Reddit, and other community spaces

• Experience with or working knowledge of social listening/servicing tools

• Ability to triage and prioritize inbound engagement, knowing when to respond directly and when to loop in subject matter experts

• Comfort partnering with an agency on content production while retaining ownership of voice and strategy

• A proactive, community-first mindset — you notice what's happening in the conversation and show up in it

#LI-Remote
Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

For US based roles: Xometry participates in E-Verify and after a job offer is accepted, will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

postings.title: Website Project Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

We are seeking a highly organized and client-savvy Website Project Manager to serve as the engine behind our website build delivery for mid-market manufacturing clients. This is a unique opportunity for a solution-oriented project management practitioner to bridge the gap between technical B2B buyers and the internal teams who bring their websites to life.

You will thrive at the intersection of client relationship management and operational delivery, specializing in translating ambiguous, non-marketing language from manufacturing clients into clear, actionable direction for designers, developers, and content editors. As both the client's primary point of contact and the internal team's source of truth, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of standard and mid-complexity website build projects, from kickoff through launch, ensuring they are delivered on schedule, within scope, and within budget — without requiring daily oversight from leadership.

How You'll Contribute:

• Project Delivery & Leadership:

• Own project delivery end-to-end, leading post-sale website build projects from kickoff to launch with minimal daily oversight

• Manage resourcing to keep project velocity on pace with milestones by coordinating with department heads to secure design and development resources

• Coordinate quality assurance and risk mitigation by working with QA to confirm deliverables meet internal and client standards, and identify and resolve risks before they affect the timeline

• Client Relationship Management:

• Serve as the primary client contact for assigned manufacturing clients: run client meetings, deliver weekly status updates, and turn client input into clear direction for internal teams

• Decode client intent for the internal team by employing analytical skills and curiosity to determine their true business needs, especially when their feedback does not align cleanly with standard marketing terms (e.g., inquiring about their standard customer profile rather than asking for a “target persona”)

• Guide projects toward sound solutions by gathering usable feedback on deliverables, offering real-time resolutions, and clearly relaying client feedback to production team members for implementation

• Scope, Budget & Documentation:

• Protect project scope and margin by proactively flagging scope creep early, discussing scope expansion or preservation solutions with clients, and communicating contract adjustments with sales partners

• Author and maintain project documentation that serves as the team's source of truth: project schedules, creative briefs, and functional requirements

• Strategic UX & Cross-Functional Coordination:

• Analyze and address user experience deficiencies by providing clients with strategic counsel on content organization, structural navigation adjustments, call-to-action optimizations, and module layout implementation

• Coordinate cross-project with Senior PMs and Digital Marketing Managers on enterprise accounts that run concurrently with a client's website project

What You'll Bring to TMS:

• Experience: Project management experience with demonstrated success managing multiple simultaneous projects at varying levels of complexity

• The Solution-Oriented Mindset: Strong critical thinking and adaptability under changing project conditions, with the ability to decode ambiguous or unconventional client requests, translate them for internal teams, and propose alternatives that keep a project within scope

• Technical Fluency: Practical understanding of how websites function, including the ability to make minor edits (text changes, image swaps) directly in WordPress or HubSpot. Proficiency with Asana or comparable project management software, and Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive, Gmail, Calendar). Comfort working across Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Slack

• Communication & Stakeholder Management: Working understanding of B2B user experience principles in digital environments, and comfort asking clarifying, non-jargon questions of clients who may not have marketing vocabulary or clearly defined audiences

• Location: Hybrid, based in Lexington, KY; Waltham, MA; or North Bethesda, MD (or GSS, pending HR determination)

Nice to Have:

• Prior experience at a digital or marketing agency, specifically in a client-facing delivery role

• CAPM or PMP certification

• Hands-on WordPress administration experience beyond basic content edits

• Prior exposure to manufacturing, industrial, or other technical B2B clients

• Familiarity with AI tools such as Gemini or Claude to speed up documentation and communication work

Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

For US based roles: Xometry participates in E-Verify and after a job offer is accepted, will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

Leading Your Team

Strategic Advisory

• Drive pre-sales: Partner with sales and solutions teams during scoping and proposal phases, contributing the technical depth needed to scope work accurately and give prospects confidence in Caylent's ability to deliver.

Hands-On Delivery

The expectation is the same in both cases — you are the person the engagement depends on technically.

Growing the Practice

•

• Raise the bar internally: Mentor engineers and architects through real work, contribute to technical interviews, and build reference architectures and accelerators that make the broader ML practice better.

• 10+ years in machine learning or AI, with a proven track record of leading client-facing engagements in a consulting or advisory capacity.

• Demonstrated people management experience — hiring, performance calibration, career development, and the ability to have difficult conversations directly and constructively.

• Deep, current knowledge of the AWS ML and GenAI ecosystem, with the ability to make and defend architectural decisions across the full ML lifecycle — from data and feature engineering through training, deployment, and monitoring.

• Deep expertise in at least two or three ML domains — whether classical ML, computer vision, NLP, time series, or others — combined with the judgment to assess, architect, and advise across the broader ML landscape.

• Proven ability to architect and govern production ML systems end-to-end, translating MLOps, LLMOps, and broader AI operations complexity into standards that engineering teams can execute and executives can act on.

• Proven ability to operate independently in complex, ambiguous customer environments — navigating competing priorities, aligning stakeholders, and translating ML tradeoffs into business risk and value for both technical and executive audiences.

GoFundMe is the world’s most powerful community for good, dedicated to helping people help each other. Join us! GoFundMe is looking for a dedicated Artificial Intelligence (AI) Specialist to join our Early Careers Program and Data & AI Team to help elevate our analytics at GoFundMe. The Data & AI Team at GoFundMe is building the future of intelligent, helpful systems that power generosity at scale. Join us! GoFundMe is looking for a dedicated young professional Data & Analytics Specialist to join our Emerging Talent Fellowship Program & Data and Decision Science team to help elevate our analytics at GoFundMe. This role will support the Decision Science roadmap through the cultivation, curation, and visualization of timely and relevant data for our team and other stakeholders at GoFundMe.

You’re an ideal candidate if you love all things data and want to accelerate your career in data and analytics at a fast-growing organization. You have demonstrated experience working with data, are highly collaborative, and are passionate about evangelizing and showing what is possible with data.

This program runs from March 2027 - August 2027 and is based in Buenos Aires, with fellows (young professionals) expected onsite three days per week.

• Develop high-level dashboards in Looker to support data-driven strategy and insights

• Collaborate with the Decision Science team to drive ad hoc requests and define metrics for dashboard development

• Identify hypotheses, participate in experiment design; make clear, coherent and holistic recommendations based on test results

You

• Highly data-driven and excited to grow your career in Data Analytics

• Currently pursuing a degree related to Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science or Operations Research

• Have an understanding of data visualization and BI tools (i.e. Looker or Tableau)

• Familiarity with SQL and cleaning/processing data

• Passion for organization and documentation

• Have working knowledge of data lineage and cataloging (e.g., OpenLineage, DataHub, Atlan, or similar) and of data governance, privacy, security, and compliance.

• Have experience with cloud cost management and FinOps practices, including cost attribution, forecasting, and optimization.

postings.descriptionText:
Rol: Technical Delivery Lead / Staff Architect

Reporta a: VP LATAM

Departamento: Delivery

Alcance: Delivery, transversal a todos los proyectos y equipos técnicos de LATAM

Ubicación: Córdoba o CABA (Argentina)

Modalidad: Híbrida (presencialidad mínima requerida 6 veces al mes)

Propósito del Rol

Garantizar la excelencia técnica del portfolio de LATAM, actuando como el socio técnico estratégico (Technical Partner) del Delivery Manager. Este rol lidera la viabilidad de las soluciones, la adopción de prácticas de desarrollo asistido por IA y la excelencia operativa. Es el puente donde la estrategia técnica (Architect) se materializa en resultados de negocio (Delivery), asegurando escalabilidad, innovación y calidad en cada proyecto.

Estrategia y Responsabilidades Críticas

1) Sinergia y Technical Partnering

Colaboración estrecha con los Delivery Managers y Project Managers en la definición de Account Plans, aportando la visión técnica a largo plazo, validando la factibilidad de las propuestas comerciales (Upselling/Cross-selling) y gestionando técnicamente los escalamientos de alta criticidad para asegurar la continuidad del negocio, integrando en esta labor un alto dominio de soluciones enterprise, data e AI como eje fundamental del offering de Santex.

2) Rollout y Evolución de Procesos Agénticos

Liderar el despliegue y la evolución continua de los workflows agénticos, integrando aprendizajes obtenidos para optimizar el SDLC de forma permanente. Es un requisito excluyente que este rol actúe como referente interno de agentización e impulse el uso intensivo de AI-assisted development. Responsable de ayudar a Delivery a implementar y medir la eficiencia operativa derivada del uso intensivo de la IA, asegurando mejoras de productividad sin detrimento de la calidad técnica.

3) Monitoreo de buenas prácticas de desarrollo

Asegurar que los equipos de Delivery apliquen de forma consistente las buenas prácticas de desarrollo definidas por la organización: calidad del código, pruebas, documentación, seguridad y uso adecuado de las herramientas. Detectar desvíos tempranamente y accionarlos, comenzando por anticiparse a las no conformidades críticas.

4) Intervención técnica en proyectos

Actuar como punto de escalada técnica ante problemas complejos en proyectos: bloqueantes de arquitectura, decisiones críticas de diseño, conflictos tecnológicos o situaciones de riesgo técnico. Intervenir con criterio y rapidez para desbloquear equipos y proteger la calidad de la entrega.

5) Generación proactiva de soluciones en Pre-sales

Actuar como generador proactivo de propuestas de solución técnica. Basándose en un profundo entendimiento de las necesidades, desafíos y oportunidades del cliente, diseña estrategias tecnológicas que impulsen su negocio, superando el rol de soporte reactivo y posicionándose como consultor técnico estratégico que aporta valor incremental. Asegurando que dichas propuestas estén fundamentadas en el alto dominio de soluciones enterprise, data e AI, posicionándolas como el core del offering de valor de Santex.

6) Setup de equipos e inicio de proyectos críticos

Asistir activamente a los Delivery Managers en la conformación y configuración de los equipos de ingeniería para afrontar nuevos proyectos. Esto incluye apoyar a Delivery en los procesos de screening técnico.

Acompañar el despliegue de las bases y el framework de trabajo durante las etapas iniciales para garantizar un arranque sólido y exitoso del proyecto.

Apoyar a los managers en la identificación de las oportunidades de desarrollo de los líderes técnicos de cada equipo.

7) Input para la matriz de desarrollo de personas

Aportar criterio técnico a la matriz de desarrollo individual del área de Delivery: identificar brechas de habilidades, proponer niveles de seniority esperados por rol y tecnología, y definir los hitos técnicos que los colaboradores deben alcanzar en su plan de carrera.

Funciones Esenciales

• Gestión Agéntica: Iterar workflows basándose en métricas, liderar el AI Tech Board y medir la eficiencia operativa (productivity gains vs. quality).

• Intervención Técnica: Resolver bloqueos de arquitectura, performance o deuda técnica, actuando como punto de escalada técnica.

• Pre-sales Proactivo: Realizar Discovery técnico, diseñar soluciones, y estimar recursos para asegurar la viabilidad comercial y técnica de las propuestas.

• Monitoreo de Buenas Prácticas: Auditar calidad mediante revisiones, métricas (GitHub, etc.) y planes de mejora.

• Screening y Setup: Apoyar a Delivery en el screening técnico y configurar las bases sólidas para el arranque de proyectos críticos.

KPIs de Éxito

• Eficiencia Operativa: % de incremento en productividad mediante IA sin detrimento de la calidad técnica (defect rate).

• Excelencia Técnica: Reducción de incidentes post-entrega y deuda técnica en proyectos clave.

• Liderazgo de Talento: Progreso técnico de los equipos supervisados (brechas de habilidades cerradas).

• Impacto Comercial: Tasa de conversión y valor incremental en propuestas de pre-sales.

Qualifications

• Formación académica en ingeniería de software o afines.

• Experiencia como Arquitecto de Software, Staff Engineer, Technical Manager o Engineer Manager.

• Dominio experto (power user) en herramientas de AI-coding de vanguardia, con un marco de desarrollo claro y replicable.

• Dominio de español e inglés.

• Conocimiento profundo en soluciones basadas en IA, más allá del desarrollo asistido por IA, para colaborar con el área de IA de Santex en la creación de soluciones para clientes, reforzando el posicionamiento de la empresa como referente en IA en LATAM.

• Plus: Experiencia en consultoría de servicios tecnológicos.

Liderazgo y Habilidades Humanas

Comunicación efectiva: Comunica de manera clara y efectiva ideas técnicas complejas tanto a colegas técnicos como a stakeholders no técnicos. Escucha activa para identificar necesidades y preocupaciones.

postings.title: High-Speed Analog Layout Design Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Celero Communications is a fast-growing semiconductor startup developing high-performance coherent DSP technology for next-generation AI infrastructure. We recently announced a $275M Series C following the validation of the industry’s first 2nm coherent DSP silicon. Bloomberg also reported that Alphabet’s CapitalG has backed Celero at a $3B valuation. As we continue to grow, we’re hiring exceptional talent across the United States, Canada, and Argentina for a variety of exciting opportunities.

We are seeking a High-Speed Analog Layout Design Engineer to drive the layout design of complex analog and mixed-signal IP blocks that are at the heart of our advanced optical communication systems. As a key member of the Analog & Mixed-Signal (AMS) design team, you will lead layout development of critical blocks such as ADCs, DACs, PLLs, and other high-performance analog/mixed-signal circuits. You will interface closely with circuit designers, CAD/PDK teams, and other layout engineers to ensure first-pass silicon success. This is a hands-on technical role ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys mentoring others while contributing directly to cutting-edge chip development.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead and own the physical layout design of complex analog/mixed-signal macros (e.g., ADCs, DACs, PLLs), from floor planning through final verification
• Collaborate closely with schematic designers to create optimal layout solutions considering performance, matching, symmetry, and reliability
• Mentor and guide junior layout engineers/contractors across multiple time zones, enforcing best practices in layout design and verification
• Perform and debug full hierarchy LVS, DRC, PERC, ERC, and other signoff checks using industry-standard tools (Pegasus, Calibre, etc.)
• Contribute to chip-level planning including top-level floor planning, block integration, power grid implementation, and signal routing
• Participate in layout design reviews and provide technical leadership for layout quality, verification completeness, and schedule adherence
• Support automation initiatives through scripting and tool customization (SKILL, TCL, Python is a plus)

Required Qualifications
• Minimum 1+ years of hands-on analog/mixed-signal layout design experience and in advanced CMOS/FinFET technologies
• Proven track record of top-level integration IP layout macros and preparing IPs for handoff to Physical Design
• Proven leadership in owning major IP layout macros or full-chip-level layout at FinFET nodes (TSMC preferred)
• At least 1+ years of experience with TSMC FinFET process nodes (N3, N5, N7, or N16)
• Deep understanding of device physics, layout-dependent effects (LOD, WPE, OSE, LDE, etc.), and their impact on circuit performance
• Strong expertise in layout best practices for device matching, noise isolation, ESD protection, symmetry, and parasitic minimization
• Proficiency in floor planning, hierarchical block integration, routing strategy, and power/ground grid design
• Expertise with Cadence Virtuoso, Calibre, Pegasus, and other layout and verification tools
• Familiarity with layout verification flows, including LVS, DRC, PERC, Density, DFM, ERC, and Antenna rules
• Experience working in collaborative environments with international and remote teams
• Strong documentation and communication skills with the ability to clearly present layout trade-offs and status to cross-functional teams
• Experience using revision control systems for layout design management

Preferred Qualifications
• Exposure to optical or high-speed analog interfaces is a strong plus
• Working knowledge of SKILL, TCL, or Python for layout automation or design flow optimization
• Proven ability to collaborate with international teams (U.S., Canada, Argentina)
• Strong organizational skills with high attention to detail and follow-through
• Ability to multi-task and prioritize in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
• Proactive, eager-to-learn mindset with excellent problem-solving skills

What We Offer
• The chance to play a foundational role at a high-growth semiconductor start-up
• Exposure to a wide variety of cross functional teams
• A collaborative, international team culture where ideas and initiative are valued
• The opportunity to grow alongside Celero as we scale and shape the future of our industry
• A foundational role at a fast-growing semiconductor start-up shaping the future of AI and data center connectivity

postings.title: AI Workflow Engineer | LATAM
postings.descriptionText:
Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud - managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We are seeking an AI Workflow Engineer !

About the Role:

Backblaze is running a company-wide AI transformation program, and this role is where strategy becomes something you can actually use. As AI Workflow Engineer, you will be the hands-on builder inside the AI Program Office - embedded alongside the Director, AI Enablement, and deployed into non-GTM, non-Engineering business teams to prototype, build, and ship AI-powered workflow solutions that make a measurable difference in how work gets done.

This is not a research role or a strategy role. You will spend your time building: prompt architectures, automation flows, lightweight agents, API integrations, and demos that help a business team see - concretely - what AI can do for them. You will move across functions, which means you need to understand how businesses actually operate. The ideal background is someone who started in a business-facing role - finance, operations, marketing, customer success, HR - and developed serious hands-on AI and automation skills on top of that foundation.

You will work closely with the Director, AI Enablement, who owns the program management and delivery layer. Your job is to make their scoped solutions real - fast, iteratively, and with enough rigor that what you build can go to production.

What You Will Do:

Build and Ship AI Workflow Solutions

• Take scoped use cases from the Director, AI Enablement and build working solutions: prompt layers, automation flows, lightweight agents, RAG implementations, and API integrations that connect AI tools to the systems business teams already use

• Build working prototypes quickly - the goal is to show a team what is possible in days, not weeks, then refine based on what actually lands

• Translate a documented workflow assessment into a technical design, select the right tools for the job, and own the build through to a deployable solution

• Maintain solution documentation that is clear enough for handoff, iteration, and audit - not just for engineers, but for the business owner who will live with it

Embed in Business Teams

• Spend time inside the functions you are building for - Finance, HR, Legal, Marketing Ops, Customer Success, and others - understanding how the work actually flows before you redesign it

• Run working sessions with team members to map current-state workflows, surface friction points, and identify where AI creates real leverage versus where it creates noise

• Build credibility with non-technical stakeholders by showing them working solutions, not decks - and by being honest about what will and will not work

• Support user acceptance testing and early adoption, troubleshooting issues close to launch and iterating based on real usage

Support the AI Program Office

• Build demos and proof-of-concepts that help the Director, AI Enablement make the case for a use case - or disqualify it early before resources are committed

• Contribute to vendor and tool evaluations with a builder's perspective: not just whether a tool claims to do something, but whether it actually works in the context of a specific workflow

• Feed learnings from the build process back into the program - what worked, what did not, what should be standardized across functions

• Work on tactical quick wins and longer-horizon strategic builds at the same time, switching contexts across active use cases as priorities shift

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• You have completed at least one workflow assessment alongside the Director and produced a working prototype from it

• At least one solution you built is in active use by a business team, with a named owner and feedback loop in place

• You have worked inside at least two different business functions and understand their core workflows well enough to identify the next use case without being told

• The Director, AI Enablement trusts you to own the build layer independently - scoping conversations happen together, execution happens with you driving

The Right Fit:

• 2-4 years of experience that includes meaningful time working inside a business-facing function - operations, finance, marketing, customer success, HR, or similar - not just in Engineering or IT

• Hands-on experience building with AI tools: prompt engineering, automation platforms (Make, Zapier, n8n, or equivalent), API integrations, and at least working familiarity with RAG architectures and agent frameworks

• Proven ability to take a messy real-world process, understand it from the inside, and build something that makes it faster or better - not just technically cleaner

• Comfortable working with non-technical stakeholders: you can explain what you are building without jargon, gather requirements without a formal spec, and manage expectations when a prototype needs three more iterations

• Strong enough with code or no-code tools to get solutions to a deployable state independently - you do not need an engineer to ship your work

• Able to manage multiple active projects at different stages without dropping anything - a quick win in HR…

postings.descriptionText:
About Backblaze

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $136M ARR and is the leading specialized storage cloud, managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We’re seeking a Sr. Reliability Engineer ll (DBA) to join our team!

About the Role

We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) with a DBA (Database Administration) focus to help ensure the stability, scalability, and reliability of our production database systems - primarily Vitess (distributed MySQL) and Cassandra - alongside the rest of our services and infrastructure. This role operates within procedures and runbooks established by our senior DBA SREs, and focuses on building automation, maintaining observability, and supporting incident response to keep customer-facing systems performing at their best.

The SRE will collaborate with engineering, product, and operations teams to embed reliability practices into day-to-day development and operations while contributing to tools and processes that improve efficiency and reduce manual effort

Key Responsibilities

Database Administration

• Operating and maintaining high-availability database systems — primarily Vitess (distributed MySQL) and Cassandra — against established architecture and runbooks.

• Optimizing database performance through query tuning, indexing strategies, and schema design.

• Executing documented backup, recovery, and replication procedures to ensure data durability; escalating architecture-level changes to senior DBA SREs.

• Ensuring database security compliance and access control.

Service Reliability & Operations

• Support the availability and durability of critical services across production environments.

• Monitor service health using SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets, and escalate issues when thresholds are at risk.

• Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-incident reviews to drive service improvements.

• Follow established ITIL/OSS processes (incident, change, problem, and capacity management).

Automation & Tooling

• Develop automation for common operational tasks, reducing manual intervention and toil.

• Contribute to monitoring, logging, and alerting frameworks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Catchpoint, ELK), and help integrate runbooks with FireHydrant.

• Work with CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and infrastructure as code tools (Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins).

• Write scripts (Bash, Python, Go, etc.) to improve system reliability and efficiency.

Collaboration

• Partner with engineering, product, and operations teams to support resilient system design and operations.

• Assist in capacity planning and disaster recovery exercises.

• Work with vendors and service providers to troubleshoot service issues and track SLA performance.

• Document systems, share learnings, and help grow a reliability-minded engineering culture.

Continuous Improvement

• Contribute to playbooks, runbooks, and operational documentation.

• Identify recurring issues and propose long-term improvements.

• Promote reliability-focused practices within development and operations teams.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

• 2–4 years of experience in site reliability, systems engineering, or operations centered around database systems.

• Exposure to large-scale, production-grade systems. This is a Level 2 role executing established database operations procedures — architecture and design ownership sits with our Level 3 DBA SREs.

Technical Skills

• Solid Linux systems administration and troubleshooting skills.

• Familiarity with service reliability concepts - monitoring, alerting, incident response, and root cause analysis.

• Proficiency in at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or Go).

• Understanding of containers (Kubernetes, Docker) and microservices concepts; comfort operating in a Kubernetes/Vitess-on-K8s environment (kubectl, mysqlsh, Vitess keyspaces) is a plus.

• Knowledge of incident response and operational best practices.

• Hands-on experience with MySQL performance tuning, replication, and disaster recovery; direct experience with Vitess or other distributed/sharded MySQL systems is a plus, but not required — strong MySQL fundamentals matter most.

• Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL database management.

Preferred Attributes

• Experience in a SaaS, service provider, or distributed systems environment.

• Familiarity with ITIL/OSS practices and SLO/SLA’s

• Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn new technologies.

• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

• Ability to work independently, take ownership, and drive projects from problem discovery through resolution.

postings.descriptionText:
Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud - managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We are seeking a Sr. AI Security Engineer to join our team!

About The Role

Backblaze is seeking a Senior AI Security Engineer to design and implement safeguards for internal AI usage , with a focus on agentic systems, developer protection, and runtime security .

This is a hands-on role for a practitioner who has built and deployed security controls , not just defined policy. You will enable teams to safely use AI by creating enforcement layers, identity controls, and detection capabilities that constrain and monitor AI-driven activity.

What You’ll Do:

Agentic AI Safeguards

• Architect and implement guardrails for tool-using AI systems , including:

• Tool access controls and allowlists

• Context and memory isolation

• Step-level validation of agent actions

• Apply mitigations aligned to the OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 (e.g., prompt injection, unsafe tool use, data leakage, excessive autonomy)

Runtime Security Controls

• Build enforcement mechanisms that govern AI behavior at execution time:

• Interceptors, proxies, or middleware for tool/API calls

• Policy decision and enforcement layers

• Rate limits, execution bounds, and kill-switches

• Prevent unsafe or unauthorized actions initiated by AI systems

Non-Human Identity (NHI)

• Design and implement identity and access controls for agents and automation , including:

• Short-lived credentials and scoped permissions

• Clear separation between human and non-human access

• Strong binding of identity to task context and execution

• Ensure all AI actions are attributable and auditable

Observability & Detection

• Implement logging and tracing for AI activity :

• Prompts, tool usage, and decision flows

• Build detection capabilities using:

• Behavioral baselining and anomaly detection techniques

• Identify and alert on:

• Abnormal tool usage

• Suspicious prompt patterns

• Unexpected data access

Threat Modeling (MAESTRO)

• Perform agentic system threat modeling using MAESTRO , including:

• Mapping agent capabilities, trust boundaries, and attack paths

• Modeling misuse and adversarial scenarios

• Translate findings into practical safeguards and detection logic

Developer Safeguards

• Protect developers using AI tools by:

• Preventing sensitive data exposure

• Validating AI-generated code and actions

• Constraining unsafe automation

• Enable safe usage of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor ) with:

• Security validation layers

• Controlled prompting and output handling patterns

The Right Fit:

postings.descriptionText:
Location: 100 % remote Contract:   Full-time, Independent Contractor     Posting   Jurisdictions :   To support US Eastern Time working hours      

Our Firm:

Sterlington PLLC is a full-service law firm focusing on complex corporate, litigation, executive compensation, and private wealth matters. As a firm, we focus on the economics as well as the legal aspects of our matters.
Among other strengths, Sterlington is the ultimate law firm for founders, senior executives, and UHNWIs as well as their related businesses.

Learn more at: www.sterlingtonlaw.com/

The Opportunity

As the firm scales, our associates need people management, feedback that helps them grow, and a real sense of belonging .

You'll own attorney development from the ground up. You'll build the feedback cadence, development programs, and sense of community that turns associates into long-term, fully utilized members of the firm.

Success at six months looks like associates who feel part of something bigger, are receiving real and consistent feedback, and are growing, reflected in stronger utilization. From there, the ambition grows: measurably better associate engagement and the launch of programs to enhance our attorneys’ experience at Sterlington .

You'll join the People Team and work closely with firm leadership.

What You'll Do:

• Build a feedback cadence. Built around our firm-wide culture of feedback, support team members in receiving the feedback they need to propel their growth, not just an annual review.

• Manage stakeholder relationships. Work closely with partners and firm leadership, tailoring your approach to each; this isn't a one-size-fits-all function.

• Create a sense of community. Develop the programs and touchpoints that make associates feel like they belong to the firm, not just assigned to it.

• Own learning & development. Design and manage L&D programs end-to-end, course design grounded in adult learning theory, that build associates' skills and support their career progression.

• Coach and mentor. Work directly with associates as a people manager: coach individuals, resolve performance concerns, and help them navigate their development.

• Use data to drive decisions. Analyze utilization and performance data to identify where associates are under- or mis-utilized and turn that into action.

• Bring a point of view on talent. Contribute to talent acquisition efforts, including future programs that grow our attorney team, and apply a working knowledge of US employment law where it touches development and performance.

• Speak with authority. Represent attorney development as a real function within the firm: confidently, directly, and with the credibility to influence how the firm thinks about its people.

What We're Looking For :

• A legal or attorney-development background. Ideally, you've done this work inside a law firm or legal tech environment. You understand what makes attorneys tick, and what "development" actually means in that context.

• This role calls for judgment rather than years served. You'll need to step into ambiguous situations, identify what's missing, prioritize it, and work the room to make it happen .

• Strong L&D program design skills. You know how to build training grounded in adult learning theory to achieve your objectives, not just schedule sessions.

• Real coaching and mentoring experience. Ideally, you've been a people manager before. This role is about developing people directly, not just administering a program.

• Working knowledge of US employment law. Not a legal expert, but comfortable enough to know when something needs a closer look.

• A data-driven streak. Comfortable pulling together utilization and performance data to spot problems and make the case for action.

• Excellent English communication. Written and verbal. You'll be coaching attorneys and influencing leadership, so this needs to be a strength, not a gap.

• Americas time zone, ideally ET. You'll need real overlap with the team and the attorneys you're supporting.

• The right temperament. People who thrive here don't wait to be told what to do. They're resilient, direct, transparent, and genuinely want to be part of a team. Comfort with ambiguity is table stakes, and being AI-forward and tech-savvy is essential.

At Sterlington, we believe that world-class talent has no boundaries. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where unique perspectives are valued and every individual has the opportunity to thrive. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply.

The Opportunity

Sterlington is looking for a Business Operations Manager to implement AI workflows and run the execution layer of the Head of Firm Management's portfolio. The Head of Firm Management leads the firm and sits on its management committee, and the portfolio spans every function: strategy, partner matters, planning cycles, firm-wide initiatives and external relationships. This role sits at the center of that portfolio, ensuring that priorities are visible, decisions are made on time, and commitments are delivered without friction.

You will be accountable for what reaches the Head of Firm Management and what is resolved before it does. That means holding a live view of every open commitment across the portfolio, converting a continuous inbound flow into a ranked and decided list, and closing out what does not require her. Where the cadence for a workstream does not yet exist, you will design it in partnership with the Head of Operations so that it is consistent with how the rest of the firm runs.You will ensure that the operational dimension of the firm's leadership is reliable, anticipatory, and unobtrusive, working in alignment with the broader support infrastructure of the firm, never duplicating it.

What You'll Do:

• AI-Driven Process Innovation: Drive continuous improvement by refining workflows for greater efficiency and scalability, integrating AI tools in a measured, high-judgment manner to enhance tracking, summarization, briefing preparation and internal coordination.

• Demand and Priority Management: Own the inbound flow of partner requests, firm issues and external approaches. Decide what reaches the Head of Firm Management, what is redirected, and what is closed out, with a reason attached to every call.

• Leadership Operating Rhythm: Run the cadence of firm leadership: management committee preparation, planning cycles, leadership meetings and reviews. Translate the firm's planning and reporting cycles into a working rhythm for the portfolio, and design what does not yet exist.

• Decision Support: Prepare concise, decision-ready briefings, committee papers and status summaries that allow the Head of Firm Management to act quickly and with confidence, then drive execution on those decisions.

• Stakeholder Management: Coordinate across partners, senior lawyers, business services and external parties, serving as the primary liaison on her behalf, driving follow-through, accountability and timely escalation where needed.

• Execution Ownership: Take initiatives she does not have the capacity to run, own them end to end, and report on them once rather than continuously.

• Risk Mitigation: Anticipate gaps, misalignments and potential delays, and resolve them before they surface.

• Experience in business operations, chief of staff, strategy or operations roles working directly to a senior leader, with the authority to act rather than to relay

• A track record of creating a way of working rather than inheriting one, inside someone else's framework rather than around it

• Judgment you can explain: a method for deciding on another person's behalf, including declining requests from senior people while keeping the relationship intact

• Professional services, law firm or equivalent complex stakeholder environment is a strong plus

• Native or full professional English fluency required

• Structured, systems-oriented mindset: you introduce clarity without over-engineering

• Discretion and composure. You will hold the firm's most sensitive information

Contract: Full-time, Independent Contractor

Our Firm

Sterlington PLLC is a full-service law firm focusing on complex corporate, litigation, executive compensation, and private wealth matters. As a firm, we focus on the economic as well as the legal aspects of our matters. Among other strengths, Sterlington is the ultimate law firm for founders, senior executives, and UHNWIs as well as their related businesses.

We are remote-first, and our support teams work as one global Legal Operations function across multiple time zones.

Learn more at www.sterlingtonlaw.com

The Opportunity

We are looking for a first-class Legal Practice Assistant to provide white glove support service to our firm’s partners and attorneys. By gaining a deep understanding of each partner’s practice, you will support them to execute on client matters, run the administrative engine behind the work, coordinate with stakeholders across the firm, and help ensure our business and our clients’ goals are achieved.

We are looking for someone who is curious and practical in using AI and technology to improve day-to-day work, streamline processes and support attorneys more efficiently.

This is a broad role for someone who wants more than calendar management. Alongside core executive support, you will work on documents, matter coordination, process and project management. As we scale, we are adding elite talent to this team.

Schedule: This role covers weekends only, 9am to 5pm ET.

What You’ll Do

• The partner’s day. Complex, multi-time-zone diaries: schedule, protect, and make the call when two things collide. Inboxes with judgment, not just volume: triage, surface, draft the first pass, chase what has gone quiet. Meeting packs, briefing notes, agendas, and the follow-up actions afterwards. Travel end to end, including the changes in flight and the reconciliation afterwards.

• The client-facing paperwork. Engagement letters prepared, circulated and tracked through to signature and return. Client and prospect correspondence written to a standard that reflects who we act for. Contact records and CRM entries that are accurate because you keep them that way.

• The documents. Formatting, versioning, comparison, and preparing the execution copy to firm standard. Filing that means anyone can find the document, not just you .

• Time and billing, to the flagging line. Prompting and chasing time capture. Flagging billable items, disbursements and expenses to Finance for processing. You need enough billing literacy to spot what matters. You will not be processing it.

• How you work. Anything belonging to the wider function goes through the Legal Operations intake channel rather than into your own list. You work to the team’s published response standards. You reach for AI first and tell us when you have found a faster way.

What We’re Looking For

• 5+ years supporting partners, senior fee earners or C-suite executives, ideally in law or professional services.

• Fluent English, verbal and written

• Strong proficiency with MS Office, Aderant or similar practice management software, PowerBI or similar data analytics dashboards, Claude, CoPilot or similar AI tools, Asana or similar project management tools

• Excellent organizational and project management skills; able to carry several workstreams without dropping detail

• Ability to remain poised under pressure, multitask, and prioritize effectively

• Strong team orientation and a preference for collaboration

• Experience with a practice management, billing, time-capture or document management system — or evidence you have learned a comparable system quickly

At Sterlington, we believe that world-class talent has no boundaries. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where unique perspectives are valued and every individual has the opportunity to thrive. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply.

postings.title: Transaction Coordinator
postings.descriptionText:
Transaction Coordinator

House Buyers of America is looking for a remote Transaction Coordinator to ensure all acquisitions and dispositions go to settlement in a timely manner. This position a contract role (no benefits included) requiring work to be done 8:30-5:30 EST Monday- Friday. The compensation range is $10-15/hr USD.

What you will do:

• Ensure acquisitions are processed in a timely manner to ensure properties get on market quickly

• Act as a dedicated representative to customers throughout the settlement process

• Review and enter contracts/settlement statements and ensure they are entered into our CRM properly

• Manage relationships with title companies and ensure that all settlements are being processed timely

• Assist with property marketing including ordering professional pictures, generating online listings, and staging properties

• Partner with the construction department to ensure all projects are completed prior to listing

• Assist House Buyers of America’s expansion into new geographic markets

About You:

• You have 2+ years of experience in the settlement/title industry

• You have a High School Degree (Bachelor’s degree preferred)

• You have great communication and computer skills (including Microsoft Office)

• You thrive on working in a fast-paced environment

Why we are a great place to work:

• Our company is FULLY REMOTE

• Our awesome company culture includes: competitive pay great benefits, great people, casual dress, team events, work hard/ play hard environment

• 2025 Revenue is up 60% year over year compared to 2024

• 2025 Ratified acquisitions are up 70% year over year compared to 2024

• Q4 2025 sales are up 100% compared to Q3 2025

• Q4 2025 revenue is up 152% compared to Q4 2025

• Q4 Ratified acquisitions are up 64% compared to Q4 2025

• We are continuing our nationwide expansion, now operating in 44 states plus Washington, DC.

House Buyers of America is a leading national home-buying company helping homeowners sell with confidence through a simple, transparent, and hassle-free process . Founded in 2001 and operating in 44 states , the company blends decades of real estate expertise with technology-driven operations to deliver speed, certainty, and consistent outcomes . House Buyers of America has been recognized for its industry impact, including Ernst & Young Entrepreneur of the Year and inclusion on the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing companies.

House Buyers is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate by sex, creed, race, or by age. www.HouseBuyersOfAmerica.com

The compensation range is $10-$15/hr USD

Transaction Coordinator

House Buyers of America is looking for a remote Transaction Coordinator to ensure all acquisitions and dispositions go to settlement in a timely manner. This position a contract role (no benefits included) requiring work to be done 8:30-5:30 EST Monday- Friday. The compensation range is $10-15/hr USD.

What you will do:

• Ensure acquisitions are processed in a timely manner to ensure properties get on market quickly

• Act as a dedicated representative to customers throughout the settlement process

• Review and enter contracts/settlement statements and ensure they are entered into our CRM properly

• Manage relationships with title companies and ensure that all settlements are being processed timely

• Assist with property marketing including ordering professional pictures, generating online listings, and staging properties

• Partner with the construction department to ensure all projects are completed prior to listing

• Assist House Buyers of America’s expansion into new geographic markets

About You:

• You have 2+ years of experience in the settlement/title industry

• You have a High School Degree (Bachelor’s degree preferred)

• You have great communication and computer skills (including Microsoft Office)

• You thrive on working in a fast-paced environment

Why we are a great place to work:

• Our company is FULLY REMOTE

• Our awesome company culture includes: competitive pay great benefits, great people, casual dress, team events, work hard/ play hard environment

• 2025 Revenue is up 60% year over year compared to 2024

• 2025 Ratified acquisitions are up 70% year over year compared to 2024

• Q4 2025 sales are up 100% compared to Q3 2025

• Q4 2025 revenue is up 152% compared to Q4 2025

• Q4 Ratified acquisitions are up 64% compared to Q4 2025

• We are continuing our nationwide expansion, now operating in 44 states plus Washington, DC.

House Buyers of America has been recognized for its industry impact, including Ernst & Young Entrepreneur of the Year and inclusion on the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing companies.

House Buyers is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate by sex, creed, race, or by age. www.HouseBuyersOfAmerica.com

Ser dueño/a de todas las comunicaciones CRM (email, push, WhatsApp) del país que te toque.

Trabajar con stakeholders senior (brand managers, comercial managers, equipos de producto) para definir qué comunicar, a quién y cuándo.

•
Cruzar y analizar datos: SQL, queries, dashboards. bajar info, la cruzás, sacás insights y los traducís en acciones concretas.

•
Iterar con A/B testing: ¿Funciona mejor un emoji o no? ¿La audiencia está bien segmentada? ¿El copy es muy largo? Experimentás, medís, aprendés.

•
Presentar resultados con criterio: no copy-paste de números. Si un test salió bien, explicás por qué. Si salió mal, proponés qué cambiar.

•
Proponer y defender: No sos un order-taker. Si una campaña no tiene sentido, lo decís. Si una audiencia está mal, la cuestionás.

•
Balance estratégico + operativo: Hay que mandar comunicaciones todos los días, pero también pensar en cómo mejorarlas continuamente.

Manejo sólido de datos: SQL, queries, cruce de información. Esto es clave. No hace falta ser un data engineer, pero sí tener fluidez para bajar, analizar y sacar conclusiones.

Experiencia en CRM, lifecycle marketing o comunicaciones digitales: Ya trabajaste gestionando campañas, segmentando audiencias y midiendo performance.

•
Capacidad de comunicación efectiva: Trabajás con managers y sr. managers todo el tiempo. Sabés cómo comunicar ideas, resultados y pushback cuando hace falta.

•
No le tenés miedo a lo operativo: Acá hay ejecución diaria.

Experiencia con Insider, Braze, Iterable o plataformas similares.

Background en travel, e-commerce, fintech o marketplaces.

postings.title: Manager — Cloud Platform (Traffic)
postings.descriptionText:
Somos Despegar, parte del ecosistema de Prosus, y hace más de 25 años revolucionamos la forma de viajar en América Latina ✈️. Construimos tecnología que transforma experiencias y conecta a millones de personas con sus sueños de viaje.

Buscamos Engineering Manager para liderar el equipo de Traffic dentro de Cloud Platform. El equipo es responsable de todo el stack de componentes de la infraestructura de tráfico: ingress, load balancing, service mesh, API gateways y todo lo que garantiza que el tráfico de nuestras aplicaciones fluya de manera eficiente, segura y escalable sobre AWS y Kubernetes. Actualmente esta infraestructura es crítica, ya que permite el funcionamiento de todo el tráfico de Despegar, aproximadamente 2k microservicios con 10M RPM, teniendo gran impacto en toda la empresa. A su vez, forma parte de la columna vertebral de Nebula, nuestra plataforma interna que abstrae la complejidad de la infraestructura para que los equipos de desarrollo se concentren en construir producto. También es responsable del stack de Secretos y Certificados: Vault, KMS.
El rol combina liderazgo de ingeniería con fuerte participación técnica, ya que no hay un Product Manager dedicado: el manager es responsable de priorizar el roadmap, dialogar con los equipos consumidores de la plataforma y balancear el esfuerzo técnico con el impacto en el negocio.

Principales Responsabilidades:
• Liderar al equipo de Traffic: 1:1s, feedback frecuente y honesto, planes de desarrollo profesional, performance reviews y crecimiento de cada colaborador.

• Asegurar el delivery del equipo con calidad, predictibilidad y operación saludable de la infraestructura de tráfico en producción.

• Proponer y ayudar en la definición de metodologías de trabajo, para mejorar la eficiencia del equipo y reducir puntos de dolor o fricción en el trabajo diario (ej: gestión de incidencias, manejo de reuniones efectivas, organización de seguimiento y progreso, estimaciones, etc)

• Participar activamente en las decisiones de arquitectura, proponer soluciones y desafiar constructivamente las propuestas del equipo.

• Definir y priorizar el roadmap con mentalidad de producto: entender las necesidades de los equipos clientes de Nebula, balancear deuda técnica vs nuevas funcionalidades y decidir qué se construye y qué no.

• Mantener comunicación activa con otros equipos de Cloud Platform y con los equipos consumidores de la plataforma.

• Gestionar incidentes productivos: ser responsable de que el equipo responda de forma correcta y oportuna, dar visibilidad y status, e impulsar postmortems y mejoras de largo plazo.

• Promover la investigación e incorporación de nuevas tecnologías que aporten valor a la plataforma (ej. nuevas versiones de service mesh, estrategias de traffic management, observabilidad de red).

• Velar por la salud técnica (deuda técnica, observabilidad, seguridad y buenas prácticas de ingeniería) de todo recurso bajo su responsabilidad, generando un marco de trabajo que de tiempo e incentive al equipo a atender estas cuestione.

• Visión estratégica: Generar junto a referentes del área backlog a largo plazo.

¿Qué buscamos?
• +2 años de experiencia como Engineering Manager liderando equipos de desarrollo.

• +5 años de experiencia en desarrollo de software, idealmente en backend.

• Sólidos conocimientos en arquitecturas escalables y resilientes, sistemas distribuidos y gestión de dependencias.

• Experiencia con infraestructura en la nube, idealmente AWS (EC2, RDS, EKS).

• Conocimientos en orquestación de contenedores con Kubernetes y Docker.

• Experiencia con networking y traffic management: load balancers, service mesh, ingress controllers, API gateways, protocolos HTTP/TCP/gRPC.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación para explicar conceptos técnicos complejos de manera clara y articular con múltiples equipos.

• Espíritu propositivo para desarrollo de backlog de largo plazo y habilidades de priorización con mentalidad de producto centrado en el usuario.

• Mentalidad de owner: accountable, orientado a resultados y capaz de trabajar con alta autonomía y alto alineamiento.

• Background en diseño de microservicios y gestión de clústeres a escala.

Nice to have:
• Experiencia previa liderando equipos de infraestructura o platform engineering.

• Experiencia con tools de observabilidad de red (tracing, métricas, debugging de tráfico).

• Experiencia con estrategias de despliegue avanzadas (canary, blue-green, traffic splitting).

• Hands-on: Además de liderar al equipo, esperamos que impulsen y lleven adelante iniciativas técnicas estratégicas, participando activamente en el diseño, implementación y evolución de la plataforma.

Autonomía real para tomar decisiones e impactar desde el día 1
Cultura de aprendizaje continuo: fallamos rápido, aprendemos y escalamos
Equipo diverso, colaborativo y sin silos
Oportunidades de crecimiento en un ecosistema global (Prosus)
Valoramos el ownership, la innovación y poner a las personas en el centro.

¿Te imaginas optimizar equipos comerciales usando IA mientras transformas la industria de viajes en Latinoamérica?
En Despegar, la travel-tech más grande de la región con más de 25 años disrumpiendo la industria, estamos buscando un Sr. Commercial Planning Analyst que no solo entienda de datos, procesos y estrategia comercial, sino que viva y respire automatización e Inteligencia Artificial en su día a día.
Somos parte de Prosus, uno de los ecosistemas tech más grandes del mundo. Si te motiva el impacto a escala, trabajar con autonomía, aprender rápido de los errores y ejecutar con velocidad… este es tu lugar.
🚀 El desafío
Serás pieza clave en la optimización estratégica del equipo comercial, transformando procesos manuales en flujos inteligentes, priorizando iniciativas de alto impacto y acelerando resultados mediante IA, automatización y análisis data-driven.

🎯 Principales Responsabilidades:
1. Liderar proyectos de optimización comercial end-to-end

Diseñar, ejecutar y escalar proyectos que aumenten la productividad comercial del equipo B2B que gestiona la cartera de agencias de viajes de la región. Enfocarse en los proyectos que muevan las palancas clave: frecuencia de compran, conversión, cobertura, activación de la cartera, calidad de la gestión y tiempo efectivo de venta (liberando al equipo de tareas no comerciales). Desde el diagnóstico inicial hasta la implementación y la medición de impacto.

2. Estructurar casos de negocio data-driven para priorizar iniciativas

Identificar oportunidades, formular hipótesis, definir métricas de éxito y armar casos de negocio que justifiquen inversiones en tecnología, procesos o automatización. Priorizar por impacto vs. esfuerzo.

3. Iterar mediante experimentación ágil

Monitorear el rendimiento de las iniciativas, validar hipótesis con pilotos y A/B testing, identificar qué funciona y qué no, y ajustar rápido para maximizar impacto o descartar lo que no da resultado.

Qué construimos

4. Gestionar la implementación y optimización del CRM

Liderar el despliegue del CRM (idealmente HubSpot) para la gestión de la cartera de agencias: diseñar flujos comerciales automatizados, configurar integraciones y asegurar la adopción del equipo mediante capacitación y acompañamiento.

5. Ejecutar proyectos de automatización con IA

Diseñar e implementar soluciones con agentes de IA, ingeniería de prompts y herramientas no-code que eliminen tareas repetitivas del equipo comercial y multipliquen su productividad.

6. Desarrollar inteligencia comercial (dashboards y analytics)

Crear tableros interactivos, modelos de análisis y reportes automatizados sobre ventas, cartera y actividad comercial. Definir KPIs, construir funnels y proyectar metas alineadas al budget.

7. Coordinar iniciativas cross-funcionales con stakeholders clave

Trabajar con Revenue, Producto, Marketing, TI y UX: recopilar feedback, co-diseñar soluciones, negociar prioridades y garantizar una ejecución alineada entre equipos.

8. Diseñar governance y procesos comerciales escalables

Establecer frameworks de trabajo, definir políticas de operación comercial y construir procesos end-to-end que funcionen de forma consistente a nivel regional sin depender de intervención manual.

Título profesional en Ingeniería, Ciencias Económicas (Economía, Finanzas), Actuaría o carreras afines.

Inteligencia Artificial aplicada: Ingeniería de Prompts, diseño y uso de agentes de IA

What's the opportunity? 
 
We’re looking for a People Operations Specialist to join our global team. This role is key to ensuring smooth People operations across multiple countries. From payroll and benefits to global mobility and labor relations, you’ll play a central role in making sure our employees are supported, our processes run seamlessly, and our company remains compliant with local regulations. If you’re detail-oriented, thrive in dynamic environments, and enjoy collaborating with different stakeholders, this is the opportunity to make a real impact.

What I will be doing? 
• Monthly Payroll Management : Consolidate payroll inputs from multiple sources (BambooHR, Monday, Insurance, etc.). Submit data to external providers, audit final reports, and coordinate with Treasury for funding and salary payments.

• Global Labor Relations : Review and update labor documentation, including localized contract clauses, country-specific requirements, etc.

• Compliance & Audit : Manage social security and tax payments. Maintain the Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for all countries to ensure process continuity and audit readiness.

Summary

El DTM trabaja dentro del área de Delivery, en conjunto con el Project Manager de Delivery (DPM), dando soporte a todos los aspectos técnicos necesarios para la implementación de los productos en clientes.
Su función es mantenerse actualizado sobre los productos, conociendo cómo funcionan en términos de funcionalidades, características técnicas y opciones de configuración disponibles, para garantizar una integración correcta y exitosa en el entorno del cliente.
El DTM participa desde el kickoff del proyecto, aportando definiciones técnicas y acompañando el proceso de planificación e implementación en un rol de asesoría, garantizando resolución rápida de problemas. Es clave su capacidad de detectar proactivamente cualquier inconveniente que pueda afectar la instalación y ejecución correctas del producto.
El foco del DTM es liderar técnicamente la implementación de las soluciones, acompañando al cliente desde el diseño de la arquitectura hasta la puesta en producción. postings.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Our client is an enterprise AI platform that helps critical organizations accelerate AI adoption. It combines a multi-model AI platform, local deployment teams, and expert advisors to operationalize AI across customer, employee, and back-office workflows — including support, sales, HR, legal, finance, procurement, and IT. The platform is built on a layered architecture covering infrastructure, business context, orchestration, and management, with a focus on security, compliance, scalability, and full customization. The company operates across 30+ global markets and is backed by top-tier venture firms.
 
About the Role
Maybe you are already building with Agentic AI and are frustrated by how rarely it reaches production. Or maybe you have started experimenting and know you want to work on these systems properly, not just around the edges. In this role, you will not spend your time building demos that go nowhere. You will help deploy Agentic systems into production at major enterprises, on timelines measured in weeks and months, not years.
 
What You Will Do
This is a hands-on role for high-caliber software engineers who enjoy hard technical problems, real ownership, and work that has visible impact. Every client environment is different. The expectation is the same: get it working in production.
You will work directly with customers to understand operational challenges and success criteria, translate open-ended problems into clear technical designs and implementations, own delivery of the platform and guide clients on best practice, build AI agents that integrate with customer systems, data sources, and APIs, conduct ad hoc workshops with client teams, write production-quality code to support integrations, logic, and workflows, own deployments — including reliability, performance, and continuous improvement — test with real data, measure outcomes, and iterate quickly, collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to improve the platform, and contribute to tools, documentation, and delivery practices that help the team scale.
 
Why Join
You'll be part of a fast-growing startup working on cutting-edge agentic solutions — the hottest topic in enterprise right now. You'll join a team of high-agency builders coming from top tech companies. It's a global company with a local team, and you'll be part of the founding team. The role offers a mix of home office and local client travel, along with a great salary and early-stage stock options.
 
Who You Are
Several years of professional software engineering experience, with a solid technical background as a backend engineer, full-stack engineer, or a profile close to solutions architect
Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems, and leading architecture decisions
Ability to approach software engineering as a generalist — a problem-solver who can tackle new challenges and isn't tied to a single technology
Experience integrating platforms into customer environments using APIs, cloud infrastructure, MCP, and production data flows
Comfortable working directly with customers and owning ambiguous problems; prior client-facing experience is a plus, though not required
Clear communication skills and a strong ownership mindset
Familiarity with AI / LLMs and a genuine interest in building AI-powered systems that work in practice
 
Nice to Have
Experience in forward deployed, solutions engineering, or customer-facing roles
Exposure to AI agents, automation, or conversational systems
Experience being part of a fast-growing startup and enjoying that pace
Familiarity with cloud environments
Experience with TypeScript, Go, or Python

postings.title: DevOps / SRE / DevSecOps Engineer (AWS) -  Latin America, Remote
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Requirements
• 5+ years professional experience in DevOps, SRE, or DevSecOps roles

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS services (ECS/Fargate, RDS/Aurora, ALB, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, KMS, S3)

• Experience operating Aurora/PostgreSQL in production, including multi-AZ failover, read replicas, and replica lag monitoring

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation)

• Experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker and ECS/Fargate

• Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines

• Experience with deployment automation and tested rollback paths, including rollback drills

• Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, or similar)

• Experience with load testing (k6 or similar) and operating services against latency SLOs and error budgets

• Security-first mindset: experience with vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance/hardening practices

• Experience supporting SOC 2 (or similar) audit evidence and client security reviews

• Experience with incident response, on-call rotations, and root-cause analysis

• Substantial background working with large, complex systems

• Ability to overlap US business hours

• Bachelor's degree required

• Extreme ownership and accountability for deliverables

• Client-focused dedication to team commitments

• Best practices knowledge and adherence

• Strong problem-solving ability

• Positive mindset and can-do attitude

• Meticulous attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with S3 Object Lock and long-term archival for audit/compliance retention

• Experience supporting secure multi-tenant environments (e.g., PostgreSQL Row-Level Security)

• Experience supporting database migration tooling and expand/contract schema changes

• Experience in compliance-sensitive or audit-heavy domains (e.g., fintech, telecom/TCPA compliance)

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote
