postings.descriptionText:
At SunnyData, our mission is to help customers build a highly scalable architecture, robust data engineering pipelines, easy data consumption layers and more importantly build ML and AI applications to power their business and drive outstanding business outcomes. As a Business Analyst, you ensure that both ongoing and upcoming work delivers business value to the client. Additionally, you confirm the technical delivery team has the essential resources, clear priorities, and requirements to succeed when they begin their participation in a project.



The Impact You Will Have

 - Collaborate with clients to understand their business needs and objectives

 - Design and develop business architectures that align with clients strategic goals

 - Identify opportunities for leveraging data and AI to improve business processes and outcomes

 - Collaborate with technical teams to ensure the successful implementation of solutions

 - Conduct gap analysis and recommend improvements to existing business processes, including data governance

 - Lead workshops and meetings to align stakeholders on project goals and deliverables

 - Bridge the gap between business strategy and technical execution, translating complex challenges into scalable data solutions

 - Develop accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that elevate our delivery capabilities

 - Identify new opportunities and help expand client relationships




What We Look For

 - 5+ years of experience in business analysis or product development, ideally within Data and Analytics

 -  Strong SQL skills for complex data analysis, validation, and troubleshooting

 -  Proficiency with visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, etc.)

 -  Familiarity with APIs

 -  Understanding of data management, analytics, and AI technologies

 -  Direct client-facing experience in a consulting or professional services organization

 -  Skilled at facilitating workshops, managing conflict, and building consensus

 -  Experience translating business needs into functional and technical specifications

 -  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

 -  Data-driven decision maker who quantifies business value and ROI

 -  Analytical thinker who can break down complex problems into actionable solutions

 -  Ability to work independently and as part of a team

 -  Committed to delivering excellence and exceeding client expectations

 -  Strong business acumen with an entrepreneurial mindset




Preferred Experience

 -  Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher)

 -  Databricks certification (e.g., Data Analyst Associate)

 -  Business process modeling and analysis

 -  Data, AI, and governance strategy development and implementation

 -  Project management and leadership

 -  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

 -  Strategic thinking and business acumen

 -  Conceptual modeling and analysis

 -  Change management and stakeholder engagement



Education

 - Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology, or related field is preferred.





Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:

ANALYTICS (BI) ENGINEER

We believe a solid foundation is the key to achieving outstanding data driven results: highly scalable architectures, robust data engineering pipelines, simple data consumption layers and accurate ML and AI applications. We are seeking a Data Analytics Engineer to support ongoing reporting and data engineering needs. This role will focus on building and maintaining business reports in different suites of BI tools, as well as performing modeling and transformation with large datasets.

A proactive mindset, strong communication skills and ability to collaborate closely with cross-functional teams are key.


The Impact You Will Have


1. BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE & REPORTING

 - Develop, modify, and maintain dashboards and reports in BI tools such as PowerBI, Tableau and Databricks AI/BI.

 - Translate business requests (submitted via ticketing system) into accurate and actionable data visualizations.

 - Ensure consistency in definitions, metrics, and data logic across reports.

 - Optimize queries and dashboards for performance and clarity.

 - Document logic and assumptions behind key metrics and dashboards.


2. DATA ENGINEERING & DATA MODELING

 - Advanced SQL knowledge and proven proficiency in writing and optimizing SQL queries

 - Proven work in dashboard engineering projects, with a focus on storytelling and usability

 - Perform data modeling and transformation tasks to ensure reliable downstream reporting.

 - Troubleshoot data discrepancies and validate data accuracy across systems.

 - Collaborate on improvements to data structure and warehouse organization when needed.

 - Clean, reusable SQL objects supporting long-term reporting needs.

 - Improved clarity and consistency in metric definitions.

 - Reduced back-and-forth on reporting requests due to thoughtful implementation.

What We Look For

 - 4+ years of related experience in analytics/BI and data engineering.

 - Strong SQL proficiency (advanced querying, joins, CTEs, aggregations, window functions).

 - Hands-on experience with cloud based data warehouse.

 - Experience building dashboards and reports in BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI.

postings.title: Mathematics Expert (LATAM & Europe)
postings.descriptionText:
Help shape the future of AI by designing challenging math problems that test and improve reasoning in cutting-edge models.

 - Location: Remote

 - Type: Contract / Part-time

 - Commitment: 20 hours per week

 - Compensation: Up to 40 USD / hr

 - Project duration: 2 months, with potential extension

 - Availability: Immediate start




ABOUT THE ROLE

We create high-quality STEM training data for frontier AI models. Our data is used directly in training and evaluation pipelines at leading AI labs to improve model reasoning in technical domains.

We are looking for experts in Mathematics to design rigorous, deterministic problems that are genuinely challenging for state-of-the-art AI systems. Each problem must have exactly one verifiable correct answer and be submitted together with a complete, verified solution.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design advanced mathematical problems for frontier AI training and evaluation

 - Create deterministic problems with exactly one correct answer

 - Write complete, verified solutions and clearly document the reasoning process

 - Develop problems that test deep mathematical reasoning, not just memorization

 - Where relevant, use Python or specialized tools to build computational workflows

 - Ensure all outputs are technically precise, reproducible, and well-written in English




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Master’s or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related field

 - Strong research or industry experience involving mathematical modeling, proof-based reasoning, applied mathematics, or computational mathematics

 - Strong Python skills; comfort with libraries such as numpy, scipy, pandas, or similar

 - Solid grasp of algorithms, numerical methods, and computational approaches

 - Ability to design original, difficult problems that mirror real mathematical workflows

 - Excellent attention to detail and technical writing skills in English




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with symbolic math systems, theorem provers, optimization solvers, or other mathematical software

 - Background in olympiad-level, graduate-level, or research-level problem design

 - Experience evaluating model reasoning, benchmarking, or technical assessment design

postings.descriptionText:
We are looking for experienced Quantitative Finance Experts who would like to apply their knowledge to help train and evaluate generative AI models.

Payment

 - Current pay rate for core project work by Quantitative Finance experts: $150 USD per hour.
   
   

About the opportunity

 - We are looking for talented Quantitative Finance Experts to help train AI models.

 - This is a freelance opportunity.

 - The work is fully remote.

 - Hours are flexible.

 - You can work whenever is best for your schedule.

 - Projects may involve reviewing, writing, and evaluating content related to Quantitative Finance.

 - Your expertise will help improve the accuracy, reasoning, and usefulness of AI-generated responses.

You may contribute your expertise by:

 - Assessing the factual accuracy of AI-generated text.

 - Reviewing whether AI responses are relevant to Quantitative Finance prompts.

 - Identifying errors, gaps, or weak reasoning in model outputs.

 - Crafting high-quality questions related to Quantitative Finance.

 - Answering technical Quantitative Finance questions.

 - Evaluating and ranking multiple AI-generated responses.

 - Providing feedback that helps AI models improve over time.

 - Ensuring that domain-specific concepts are explained clearly and correctly.

Examples of desirable expertise

 - A PhD in Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, or a related field, such as:
   
   - Mathematical Finance
   
   - Econometrics
   
   - Statistics
   
   - Applied Mathematics
   
   - Economics with a strong quantitative focus
     
     

 - Professional experience in a highly technical or analytical finance role, such as:
   
   - Quant researcher
   
   - Quant trader
   
   - Quantitative analyst
   
   - Risk modeler
   
   - Financial engineer
   
   - Researcher or analyst at a hedge fund

postings.title: Human Data Evals Lead (Remote/US/LATAM)
postings.descriptionText:
Reports to: CEO

Owns: data proposals, sample development, quality, and pilot delivery

Location: Remote / Latam / US



THE ROLE

You will own Anyone AI’s data initiatives and proposals to AI labs, from the data proposal or responding to requests, through pilot delivery. You own how we build proposals and develop the sample packages and benchmarks: frontier-grade packages across reasoning, coding, agents, and tool use, multi-modal and others, produced in collaboration with subject-matter experts, with expert-verified ground truth, multi-model headroom results, and QC that survives buyer-side scrutiny. You are the person who designs the sample that demonstrates our quality, converts pilots into production engagements. On a small team, this is the operational center of the Human Data Division.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Proposals & requests. Study public benchmarks and eval targets, and turn them into proposals and sample packages that demonstrate capability and win the work. Respond to lab data requests and pilots.

 - Sample & benchmark development. Design and build the sample packages, working with subject-matter experts. Every package meets the bar of our current sample set:
   
   - Expert-verified, exact-match-checkable ground truth and gold reasoning trajectories.
   
   - Multi-model evaluation showing real headroom, and proof the task discriminates the model, not just that it's hard.
   
   - Rigorous QC structure: calibration layers, severity-weighted rubrics, deterministic verifiers, evidence maps, etc.

 - Subject-matter experts. Recruit, brief, calibrate, and review a pool of experts across coding, agentic/tool-use, and STEM/reasoning. Raise their output to our standard and keep it there; be the arbiter of what "correct" and "frontier-difficulty" mean.

 - Lab relationships. Be a direct point of contact for lab partners on Slack and calls, with support from the CEO and the wider team. Keep senior lab contacts informed, surface what they actually need, and pull in the CEO and subject-matter experts when the conversation calls for it.

 - Pilot delivery. Own pilots end to end: scoping, SOW, staffing, production, QC, and delivery. Nothing ships before it's lab-ready, and nothing comes back rejected as "not frontier-level" without us already knowing why.


EXPERIENCE

 - Originated data or benchmark proposals for AI labs, translated eval targets into sample tasks that demonstrate capability, and owned the engagement through delivery.

 - Deep evaluation and quality expertise: LLM benchmarking, with real strength in code-model evaluation.

 - Built QC processes and artifact standards that met enterprise or lab requirements, and set a quality bar a team of experts was held to.

 - Thrives in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the rules are still being written, and delivers under pressure.

Qualifications

 - 5+ years in technical delivery, quality, or program management, with recent experience in AI/ML data, model evaluation, or benchmarking.

 - Hands-on experience delivering data or evaluation work to AI labs or enterprise ML teams, scoping through delivery.

 - Working fluency with how frontier models are evaluated: benchmarks, rubrics, pass rates, headroom, and what makes a task discriminate a model.

 - Proven people/vendor leadership, you've recruited, calibrated, and held a team or expert pool to a quality standard.

 - Fluent English. Spanish is a nice to have.

 - Strategic read. Track where each lab is heading, surface the next opportunity, and feed origination signal back to the Human Data Evals Lead.


EXPERIENCE

 - Owned a client or partner relationship and grew it — turned an initial engagement into expanding, repeat work.

 - Operated in a customer-facing technical role (delivery lead, TAM, forward-deployed, or account/engagement management) where you scoped work and carried commercial responsibility.

 - Worked with or sold to AI labs, ML teams, or technical enterprise buyers, and held your own in a senior technical conversation.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years in account management, engagement management, technical delivery leadership, or partnerships, with recent exposure to AI/ML data, model evaluation, or benchmarking.

 - Fluent in how frontier data and evaluation work is bought and judged — enough to scope it credibly and defend quality to a sophisticated buyer.

 - Track record of growing accounts and converting pilots to production.

 - Strong commercial instincts and comfort with ambiguity in an early, fast-moving environment.

 - Fluent English. Spanish is a nice to have.

At Anyone AI, we close this gap by upskilling the best talent from LatAm through an accelerated, hands-on training program designed and led by AI industry experts.

Anyone AI is backed by top global investors like GFC -Global Founders Capital- (investors in Facebook, LinkedIn, Slack, etc), Canvas Ventures (early investor in Coursera), Latitud Fund (the largest community of angel investors for LatAm), Magma Partners, Lotux VC, among others.



Run the race of your life

This is an opportunity to transform the AI industry and positively impact thousands of lives in Latin America. This position offers self-motivated, collaborative individuals the chance to make a direct impact on Anyone AI’s products and services. You will have the opportunity to challenge yourself while contributing to the development of a revolutionary accelerated training program. This program is designed to invest in people from LatAm, helping them master ML and AI and secure a job in the space.



About the Role

We are seeking a Data & Operations Specialist who thrives at the intersection of process automation and data workflows. This role is both highly technical and operationally strategic: you’ll design and maintain automation workflows, manage key processes (admissions, education, career services, billing), and ensure data accuracy across all areas.



You’ll be hands-on with tools like Zapier, Hubspot, Google Sheets, AppScripts, Notion/Airtable, APIs, and ideally Supabase. At the same time, you’ll take ownership of operations, ensuring efficiency, scalability, and reliability. Your work will directly improve operational efficiency, financial accuracy, and the experience of our fellows.




Responsibilities

 - Support cross-functional teams (admissions, career, placement, billing) with data and automation needs.

 - Design and maintain automation workflows with Zapier, Typeform, Hubspot, AppScripts, Notion/Airtable, and external APIs.

 - Build and maintain BI dashboards (Looker Studio, Google Sheets).

 - Use lightweight database solutions (e.g., Supabase) to structure and sync data across internal processes.



Skills & Experience

 - Technical expertise:
   
   - Strong hands-on experience with Zapier, Hubspot, Google Sheets, AppScripts, APIs, and process automation tools.
   
   - Proficiency with Looker Studio (or similar BI tools for dashboarding and reporting).
   
   - Solid understanding of databases; comfortable working with no-code/low-code structured systems (e.g., Airtable, Notion) and basic SQL (Supabase).
   
   - Preferred: experience with Python, n8n, Lovable, or similar automation platforms.

 - Operational experience
   
   - Proven background in workflow automation and operations management.
   
   - Experience with finance, billing, or HR processes is a strong plus (bonus if in edtech, bootcamps, or online learning).

 - Mindset & skills
   
   - Analytical, detail-oriented, and highly data-driven.
   
   - Strong organizational and communication skills; able to manage multiple processes in parallel.
   
   - Ownership mentality: equally comfortable building technical solutions and running end-to-end operational processes.
   
   - Entrepreneurial and growth-oriented mindset, thriving in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with an iterative development process.
   
   - Excellent team player who builds trust internally and with users, customers, and partners, with highly effective communication skills in English and Spanish.
   
   - Highly analytical, data-driven, and capable of working independently and making real-time decisions, with a strong work ethic and a "get-the-job-done" attitude.



AnyoneAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not make hiring, employment or promotion decisions based on race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.

postings.title: Research Scientist (Remote/US/LATAM)
postings.descriptionText:
Research Scientist, LLM Evaluations & Benchmarking 

Anyone AI Labs
Reports to: CEO · Remote / LatAm / US

The role Evaluation is one of the hardest open problems in AI: we still don't have reliable ways to measure what frontier models can and can't do, and the field mostly runs on benchmarks that are saturated, contaminated, or measuring the wrong thing. You'll own that problem at Anyone AI, measuring frontier model capability. 

This is a research role at heart: you decide what a good evaluation  is  , design the benchmarks that prove it, and defend the methodology under lab scrutiny. You'll build frontier-grade evaluation packages across reasoning, coding, agents, tool use, and multi-modal — grounded in expert-verified truth, validated against multiple models, and QC'd to survive buyer-side review. 

Responsibilities 

● Evaluation research. Turn eval targets into original benchmark designs. Own the hard measurement questions: construct validity, item discrimination, headroom, reliability, contamination, and capability elicitation. Push toward evals that stay informative as models improve. 

● Benchmark development. Build evaluation packages with subject-matter experts, each with expert-verified ground truth, multi-model headroom results, and rigorous QC (calibration layers, severity-weighted rubrics, deterministic verifiers). 

● Experts. Recruit, calibrate, and review a pool across coding, agentic/tool-use, and STEM/reasoning. Be the final arbiter of correctness and frontier difficulty. 

● Lab relationships. Be a technical point of contact for labs, with CEO support. Understand what they're trying to measure and translate it into an evaluation design. 

● Delivery & dissemination. Turn lab requests into winning sample packages and own pilots end to end. Where the work generalizes, help turn it into public benchmarks and papers: we support publishing at venues like NeurIPS Datasets & Benchmarks, ICLR, and ACL.

What we're looking for 

● Research background in ML evaluation or benchmarking (a track record of published or open benchmarks, eval/measurement research, or equivalent hands-on work that labs have relied on). 

● Deep LLM/frontier-model benchmarking expertise, with real strength in code-model and agentic evaluation. 

● Fluency with the measurement problem itself: construct validity, psychometrics, rubrics, pass rates, headroom, contamination, and what makes a task genuinely discriminate a model. 

● Interest in the safety side of evaluation, capability elicitation, robustness, and measuring the things that are hardest to measure honestly.

postings.title: Lead AI / ML Instructor
postings.descriptionText:
Our vision: Mastering machine learning is hard, frustrating, and takes time. The talent shortage is the mother of all problems in AI. At AnyoneAI, we upskill people from LatAm to solve the AI talent gap through an accelerated and practical training program dictated by AI industry experts. In AI, people are the new capital, and we invest in them in exchange for a share of their future income.



Our mission: We aim to supply the demand of 100,000 AI/ML developers in the next 10 years, from LatAm to international markets, with focus in the US.



We are founding members of Deep Vision AI, one of the first companies in the computer vision / AI space, which was acquired in early 2020 by DFW Capital Partners. Anyone AI is backed by top global investors like GFC (Global Founders Capital) -investors in Facebook, LinkedIn, Slack, Canva, Trivago, Delivery Hero, Revolut, etc-, Canvas Ventures (early investor in Coursera, Evernote, MuleSoft, etc) and Latitud Fund (the largest community of angel investors for LatAm).



Run the race of your life

This is a chance to help change the AI industry and change thousands people’s lives in LatAm. This position provides self-motivated, collaborative individuals the opportunity to make a direct impact on Anyone AI products and services. You will have the opportunity to challenge yourself while contributing to develop an accelerated training program designed to invest in people from LataAm and help them master ML and AI to land their first job in the field, in less than 6 months.



About the Role

We are currently looking for a hands-on senior instructor able to dictate lectures and assignments to students in ML for the Anyone AI part-time ML Developer training. The instructor will be responsible for facilitating live class sessions, contributing to prepare class materials, and providing feedback and guidance to students. You will use your expertise to design high-quality and effective learning experiences. Your experience and skills in the AI space, and ability to educate and communicate will all be critical for this role.



Responsibilities

 - Initially, you’ll review and adapt lectures and assignments on ML/AI in the assigned format, LMS, Jupyter Notebooks, or other tool of choice. Contribute to the development and/or update course curriculum in consultation with the team.

 - Once the training starts, you’ll deliver live lectures or assignments at the time specified by Anyone AI. Total time commitment is 8 hours a week including other activities.

 - You’ll deliver lectures on ML/AI topics, and perform code review with the fellows.

 - You’ll respond to student questions and learning needs in a timely manner through Slack, Zoom or related tools. Mentors and other team members will also support this activity.

 - You’ll provide regular feedback on student performance and issues or special attention they may require through the 5 month training program.

 - You’ll update materials periodically, and regularly monitor course evaluations in order to make adjustments and improvements to the curriculum.

 - You’ll meet with the Program Coordinator and Mentors regularly to coordinate activities for the successful completion of the training program.



Skills & Experience

 - Technical background in math, programming, and machine learning.

 - Hands-on experience in AI/ML, solving real-world problems.

 - Expert level proficiency in using Machine learning packages for Python (numpy, Pandas, scikit-learn, etc); experience with deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc), deployment with Docker, and AWS or similar cloud environment, data science libraries (Pandas, Airflow, etc) and databases (SQL, etc).

 - Interest in student engagement, motivation, and teaching.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication English skills.



Nice to have

 - Bachelor, Master, PhD or equivalent degree in computer science / computer engineering, or equivalent industry experience in areas like machine learning, data science or related. It is a nice position for PhD candidates who are also interested in teaching.

 - Previous experience as an instructor or lecturer in the areas of AI, machine learning, data science, robotics or similar

 - Experience designing/revising curriculum and measuring student performance is a plus.



AnyoneAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not make hiring, employment or promotion decisions based on race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.

postings.descriptionText:
Our vision: Mastering machine learning is hard, frustrating, and takes time. The talent shortage is the mother of all problems in AI. At Anyone AI, we upskill people from LatAm to solve the AI talent gap through an accelerated and practical training program dictated by AI industry experts. In AI, people are the new capital, and we invest in them in exchange for a share of their future income.



Our mission: We aim to supply the demand of 100,000 AI/ML developers in the next 10 years, from LatAm to international markets, with focus on the US.



We are founding members of Deep Vision AI, one of the first companies in the computer vision / AI space, which was acquired in early 2020 by DFW Capital Partners. Anyone AI is backed by top global investors like GFC (Global Founders Capital) -investors in Facebook, LinkedIn, Slack, Canva, Trivago, Delivery Hero, Revolut, etc-, Canvas Ventures (early investor in Coursera, Evernote, MuleSoft, etc) and Latitud Fund.



Run the race of your life

This is a chance to help change the AI industry and change thousands of people’s lives in LatAm. This position provides self-motivated, collaborative individuals the opportunity to make a direct impact on Anyone AI products and services. You will have the opportunity to challenge yourself while contributing to developing a revolutionary accelerated training program designed to invest in people from LatAm and help them master ML and AI.



About the Role



Responsibilities



 - Plan and implement new designs for educational content for our training programs, website, presentations, email marketing, brochures, or other sales materials.

 - Optimize existing user interface designs.

 - Test for intuitivity and user experience and make improvements to increase user engagement.

 - Communicate with internal clients to understand their business goals and objectives.

 - Create UX/UI prototypes for new product ideas.

 - The primary tools you will use are Figma, Framer, Claude Design.



Skills & Experience

 - Bachelor or related study in graphic design, UX/UI.

 - 2+ years of experience in graphics design, hands-on experience in design, ideally EdTech.

 - Strong entrepreneurial and growth mindset.

 - Thrive in a quick, dynamic environment with an iterative development process.

 - Excellent team player that builds trust internally and with our users, customers and partners.

 - Highly analytical and data-driven individual.

 - Able to work independently and make decisions in real-time.

 - Strong work ethic and a "get-the-job-done" attitude in a fast-paced, startup environment.

 - Ability to work collaboratively across many functions and with different teams within the organization.

 - Highly effective and professional communication skills with a track record of communicating complex processes to entry-level or junior team members and helping them thrive in their work environments.



Anyone AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not make hiring, employment or promotion decisions based on race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.

Help shape the future of AI by designing realistic financial analysis and accounting tasks that challenge advanced AI agents.

 - Location: Remote

 - Type: Contract / Part-time

 - Commitment: 20 hours/week

 - Compensation: US$30–60/hour

 - Project duration: 2 months, with potential extension

 - Availability: Immediate start


ABOUT THE ROLE

At Anyone AI, we create high-quality training and evaluation data for frontier AI models. We're looking for Financial Analysts and Accounting Experts with practical experience in financial modeling, accounting, budgeting, forecasting, reconciliation, and financial reporting.

You'll develop and validate realistic financial tasks that assess whether AI agents can analyze financial information, build accurate models, identify discrepancies, interpret financial statements, and complete complex professional workflows. Your expertise will help establish reliable reference solutions and meaningful evaluation criteria.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design realistic financial analysis and accounting tasks based on corporate finance and business operations.

 - Build and validate financial models, forecasts, operating budgets, and cash flow projections.

 - Analyze balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements, and supporting financial documentation.

 - Prepare financial reconciliations, journal entry analyses, and variance reports.

 - Develop tasks involving financial planning, investment analysis, valuation, and business performance assessment.

 - Identify inconsistencies, missing transactions, incorrect formulas, and reconciliation errors.

 - Review AI-generated financial analyses for accuracy, completeness, and logical consistency.

 - Collaborate with technical contributors to establish reproducible tasks and objective evaluation criteria.

 - Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including financial formulas, data analysis, and model validation.

 - Experience preparing financial forecasts, budgets, reconciliations, or management reports.

 - Strong analytical thinking and attention to numerical accuracy.

 - Ability to explain financial assumptions, calculations, and conclusions clearly.

 - Experience with IFRS, US GAAP, or other recognized accounting frameworks.

 - Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or NetSuite.

postings.title: Treasury Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
As our Treasury Analyst, you will own the day-to-day visibility and accuracy of our cash position across a multi-brand, multi-entity DTC e-commerce business. You’ll make sure we know where our cash is, how it’s moving, and what we expect it to look like ahead, giving the team reliable data to make better financial decisions.

This is a highly hands-on role for someone who is comfortable working across banks, payment processors, legal entities, and currencies. You’ll manage cash reporting and forecasting, processor and bank reconciliations, intercompany activity, payment runs, and working capital while helping us build more scalable and reliable treasury processes.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Maintain an accurate daily consolidated cash position across all legal entities and banking partners.

 - Build and maintain a rolling 13-week cash forecast, identifying and explaining key changes, risks, and variances week over week.

 - Reconcile payment processor settlements to bank deposits and the general ledger, including settlement timing, reserves, and deposit mechanics.

 - Track and document intercompany transfers across entities, keeping balances, schedules, and supporting documentation accurate and current.

 - Prepare payment runs by gathering approved invoices, scheduling payments, and maintaining clear supporting documentation for approval.

 - Maintain working capital reporting across supplier payment terms, deposits, balance schedules, and cash conversion cycles, updating cash models as terms change.

 - Monitor chargebacks and disputes and maintain clear visibility into their impact on cash.

 - Track merchant account health, including reserve levels, processing limits, and decline patterns, identifying and escalating anomalies early.

 - Maintain accurate bank account records across entities, including signatories, access, and mandates.

 - Support month-end close through accurate and timely cash and bank reconciliations.

 - Help standardize cash forecasting, settlement reconciliation, and treasury processes as we continue building a more scalable financial infrastructure.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 3+ years of hands-on experience in treasury, cash management, financial operations, payments reconciliation, or a related role.

 - Strong experience reconciling high-volume transaction data across payment processors, marketplaces, banks, or similar environments.

 - Experience building and maintaining cash forecasts, ideally including rolling short-term cash forecasting.

 - Strong understanding of payment processor settlements, including timing differences, reserves, deposits, and reconciliation.

 - Experience working across multiple legal entities and currencies.

 - Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, with the ability to build and maintain reliable financial models rather than simply work from existing templates.

 - Experience with accounting platforms such as QuickBooks Online and payment processors such as Adyen, Stripe, or similar tools.

 - Familiarity with subscription and rebill businesses and the impact of chargebacks, disputes, reserves, and processing performance on cash.

 - Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the persistence to investigate discrepancies across multiple systems until they reconcile.

 - A highly proactive and autonomous approach. You’re comfortable identifying issues early, investigating root causes, and driving them through resolution without requiring detailed direction.

 - Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to maintain accurate documentation and clearly explain cash movements, variances, and risks.

 - Fluent English.

postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT US

Our mission is to reinvent the way people learn, starting with language.

Learning a language can change a life by opening doors to new cultures, careers, and communities. Two billion people around the world are actively trying to learn a language, but the best way to learn (one-on-one tutoring) is hard to access at scale and hasn’t been meaningfully improved in decades. Speak is building a human-level, AI-powered tutor in your pocket: a conversation-first experience that lets learners actually speak, get instant feedback, and progress through carefully designed lessons. The result is a complete path from beginner to confident speaker across multiple languages.

Speak first launched in South Korea in 2019, where Speak has now become the number one language learning app, and we now serve learners across many markets and 15+ languages. Speak is one of the world’s leading AI companies, with over $150m raised in venture investment from OpenAI, Accel, Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and more, with a distributed team across San Francisco, Seoul, Tokyo, Taipei, and Ljubljana.




ABOUT THIS ROLE

Speak is the #1 English learning app in Korea, and we are hiring a Head of Korea to build what comes next. You'll own the entire B2C marketing engine directly for our first and largest market across brand, growth, partnerships, and creative. You’ll foster the healthy & organic brand and position we've earned while finding the next stage of profitable growth. The path you pave will also become references and the playbook for other global markets at Speak, naturally leading to a global scope. 

You'll completely own the market’s budget and an experiment-driven channel portfolio spanning influencer and creator, paid UA, organic and social, and partnerships. You'll also partner with our B2B Sales and Product teams to test new acquisition and monetization levers, bringing Korea B2C insights into broader business strategies and goals. A strong-yet-lean team of marketers and designers are waiting for you - and you will provide development & direction, while hiring new members to meet growing business needs. Non-marketing functions within the Korea office (CX, B2B, People & Ops) will not report to you directly, but you'll have strong influence over the larger market operation and the culture in this office as senior leadership.

 


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Own Speak Korea's B2C marketing strategy end to end, setting the direction on audience, messaging, and channel mix.

 - Grow B2C ARR against the market plan while meeting blended LTV/CAC goals, owning the full funnel across app and web.

 - Hold and extend our #1 position in the Education category, targeting above 50% top-of-mind awareness in our core segment and building the mid-funnel through consideration and branded search.

 - Build, coach, and retain a top-tier talent across Brand, Growth, Partnerships, B2B, and Marketing Design.

 - Partner with Product to prove new acquisition and monetization levers, including freemium variants, family and bundle offers, and new activation paths.

 - Create B2C & B2B synergy around demand generation and market fit to strengthen Speak’s position as both a consumer & an enterprise product, working with regional & HQ B2B leaders and teams.

 - Act as the bridge to SF headquarters, translating Korea insights into global playbooks and bringing global learnings back to the local market, including all the cultural nuances.

 


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 12+ years in integrated marketing function facing Korea market, ideally in consumer tech or high-growth startups.

 - Proven full-funnel marketing leadership, spanning acquisition through retention.

 - Balance between brand and performance management, assessing values of marketing actions by both qualitative & quantitative measures.

 - Strong analytical and experimentation rigor, comfortable with LTV/CAC modeling and channel economics, and able to distinguish genuine result from noise.

 - Demonstrated experience building, coaching, and managing marketers & designers of various levels and specialties.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward execution.

 - Native fluency in Korean, in both the language and the market/culture.

 - Business fluency in English; communicating with the global team at Speak on a daily level should not be a blocker to get things done.

 - Ability to travel as needed, most often to San Francisco HQ.

 


WHILE IT'S NOT REQUIRED, IT'S AN ADDED PLUS IF YOU ALSO HAVE:

 - Senior leadership experience (director level+) at a Series C (or similar) consumer tech company.

 - Experience scaling from 1 to 10, creating demand rather than only capturing it.

 - Depth in Korea's influencer and creator ecosystem, with high sensitivity to creative & social trends.

 - Experience managing/influencing functions beyond marketing in a given flagship/regional office.

 - Personal brand & story around language learning - carrying a passion that aligns to Speak’s mission.




WHY WORK AT SPEAK

 1. Join a fantastic, tight-knit team at the right time: we're growing very quickly, we've most recently raised our Series C from some of the top investors in the valley, and we've achieved product-market fit in our initial markets. You'd join at a magical time when a single person could significantly change the course of the company.

 2. Do your life's work with people you’ll love working with: we care strongly about our craft and want every person at Speak to feel like they're growing every day. We believe in the idea that working with people you both enjoy and have respect for makes everything better. We hire thoughtfully and only work with people we admire deeply.

 3. Global in nature: We're live in over 40 countries and launching in a number of new markets soon. We have dedicated offices in San Francisco, Ljubljana, Seoul, Tokyo, and Taipei, and you’ll have the opportunity to talk to users in each of these regions on a regular basis as well as travel.

postings.descriptionText:
MEET SIENA

Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.



THE TEAM

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading.


THE ROLE

You take the hardest problems customers hit in production and solve them end to end: a webhook that stopped firing, an agent filling the wrong parameter, a report that won't reconcile. You find the real cause, work the customer to resolution, then build the automation so it doesn't come back. This is the front door to deployment and platform work at Siena, with a clear path into Forward Deployed Engineering or deeper platform work.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own hard problems end to end: trace, reproduce, fix, or hand engineering a clean reproduction. Get on the call when that's the fastest path

 - Debug the agents and the prompts. Diagnose whether a misfire is prompt, knowledge base, config, or model, then fix it so it holds under real traffic

 - Build so it doesn't happen twice. For every fix, ship the runbook or tool that stops it recurring

 - Close the loop to Product. Surface patterns, not one-offs, backed by metrics

 - Raise the team's floor. Lift what the whole team can resolve, not just what you can

 - Know where your scope ends. Escalate genuine product bugs and outages with a clean reproduction, not a shrug

 - Within 90 days, name the top recurring failure patterns and attack them at the root, not just patch symptoms


WHO YOU ARE

The Bar: If you're missing any of these, this isn't the role for you.

 - You solve problems end to end. Given a customer, some logs, and a vague symptom, you find the break and can tell a customer-side cause from a product bug

 - You're fluent with AI agents and prompts. You've built or debugged LLM workflows and know how they break: prompts, knowledge bases, retrieval, the gap between test and live

 - You're excited to build automation, not just fix what's in front of you. You think in leverage. This is the signal that matters most

Strong Signal: Not dealbreakers, but what separates a good hire from a great one.

 - You like talking to customers. You'll get on a call and resolve the real problem live, not just the reported one

 - Comfortable in our core stack (Node.js, TypeScript, React, Express) or close enough to ramp fast

 - Fluent with AI coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent) to script, clean data, or navigate a new codebase fast

 - You own problems nobody assigned you, and you make the people around you better through docs and walkthroughs

Nice to Have: Bonus, not required.

 - Observability tooling (Grafana, Honeycomb, Sentry)

 - Internal tooling that turned manual work into a system

 - Ecommerce or DTC exposure

Not a Fit If:

 - You stop at "it's not our bug" instead of finding the real cause

 - You'd rather build the fix than talk to the customer who hit it

 - You want a backlog of well-scoped tickets, not ambiguous production fires


WHY SIENA?

Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.

Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.

Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.

AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.


OUR VALUES

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback - both giving and receiving it - because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.


OUR APPROACH TO AI

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.

At Siena, we're not just looking for people who can do a job. We're looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that's you, we look forward to your application.


HOW WE HIRE

We use AI-assisted screening tools as part of our hiring process. All decisions are made by humans. You can request a human-only review at talent@siena.cx.

 - You can tell a real bug from expected behavior and spot the pattern across tickets, not just close them one by one

Strong Signal: Not dealbreakers, but what separates a good hire from a great one.

 - Product-minded above all: you go outside your job description to champion change and influence what gets built

 - You've taken themes across tickets or customer feedback and used them to push product or roadmap direction

 - A clear communicator who moves between technical and non-technical people without losing either

 - AI-native: you use AI tools to do real work at scale, and you reach for new ones without being asked

 - E-commerce or DTC brand experience

Nice to Have: Bonus, not required.

 - Social media or community management background

 - Hands-on CX at scale

 - Conceptual understanding of APIs, Shopify themes, or prompt engineering (technical depth helps, isn't core)

Not a Fit If:

 - You're coming from a Deployment Manager, senior PM, or account management background looking for a lateral move. That's a different pipeline

 - You see a support queue as beneath you rather than as a source of signal

 - You want to close tickets and move on, not spot the pattern behind them


WHY SIENA?

Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.

Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.

Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.

AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.


OUR VALUES

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback - both giving and receiving it - because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.


OUR APPROACH TO AI

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.

At Siena, we're not just looking for people who can do a job. We're looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that's you, we look forward to your application.


HOW WE HIRE

We use AI-assisted screening tools as part of our hiring process. All decisions are made by humans. You can request a human-only review at talent@siena.cx.

postings.title: Especialista de Producto - Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
Sobre Halter:

En Halter, nuestra misión es ayudar a los productores y ganaderos a gestionar sus operaciones de forma más productiva y sustentable. Nuestros clientes usan Halter para liberarse de las limitaciones de las prácticas convencionales. ¿Te imaginás ver a 500 animales levantarse y caminar tranquilamente hacia su próxima parcela? Sin cuatriciclos, sin perros, sin alambrados. Solo un rodeo caminando a su ritmo. La gente dice que parece magia. Nuestros clientes están revolucionando el pastoreo con Halter. Está cambiando vidas y transformando toda una industria. 

La gente se suma a Halter para hacer un trabajo con propósito. Al unirte a nosotros, vas a estar resolviendo problemas desafiantes dentro de un equipo de primer nivel y una cultura pensada para el alto rendimiento. Nuestro equipo piensa distinto, trabaja más duro y se compromete más. Estamos comprometidos a generar un cambio real en el mundo — no es fácil, y la verdad es que nos encanta que sea así de difícil. 

Contamos con el respaldo de inversores de primer nivel como Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Peter Beck de Rocket Lab e Icehouse Ventures. 

Para saber más, visitá nuestro LinkedIn e Instagram. 

Estamos buscando un Especialista de Producto que actúe como el principal representante de Halter en América del Sur durante nuestro lanzamiento en la región. Este es un rol pionero. Vas a trabajar directamente con nuestros primeros productores mientras desplegamos Halter en sus campos, aprendiendo qué hace falta para que el producto funcione de manera brillante en este entorno, y transmitiendo esos aprendizajes al resto de la empresa para que podamos construir e iterar en consecuencia. 

Vas a trabajar de cerca con la casa central de Halter en Nueva Zelanda y con nuestros equipos comerciales en América del Sur para asegurarte de que el producto entregue valor innegable desde el primer día y que estemos construyendo lo correcto para nuestros productores. 

Halter es una de las AgTech de más rápido crecimiento del mundo, y la tecnología más transformadora disponible para el pastoreo a base de pasturas. Con los collares y la app de Halter, los productores pueden cercar y mover virtualmente su ganado, y monitorear en tiempo real la ubicación y el comportamiento del mismo. 

Buscamos personas con visión amplia que entiendan cómo hacer que las cosas sucedan — gente que resuelve problemas de forma natural y se siente cómoda en un entorno dinámico y de alta energía donde va a ser desafiada a diario. Nuestra persona ideal es alguien profundamente comprometido con entender nuestro producto y las necesidades de nuestros clientes. Sobre todo, te va a importar el ganado y los productores que trabajan con él, y vas a defender sus intereses en toda la

organización. 

Se requiere disponibilidad para viajar a nivel nacional e internacional en este rol. 

 

Sobre el rol:

¿Cómo podría ser tu día a día? 

• Salir a los campos para ayudar a desplegar Halter con nuestros primeros clientes — esto es trabajo de campo, no de escritorio. 

• Construir relaciones sólidas con nuestros productores pioneros, entender en profundidad cómo operan y aprender qué necesita hacer el producto para entregar valor real en este contexto. 

• Transmitir esos aprendizajes de forma clara y rigurosa a nuestros equipos de producto e ingeniería en Nueva Zelanda, para que siempre estemos construyendo lo que más importa. 

• Ayudarnos a entender los matices de la producción ganadera en América del Sur — los animales, la tierra, las prácticas — y compartir ese contexto en toda la empresa. 

• Pensar de forma crítica sobre el producto de principio a fin e identificar qué necesitamos corregir, mejorar o construir a continuación. 

• Trabajar con nuestros primeros clientes para asegurarte de que estén aprovechando al máximo Halter y viendo resultados reales. 

• Colaborar con el equipo comercial para mantener una fuerte alineación a medida que escalamos. 

• Hacer todo lo necesario para que Halter triunfe en Sudamérica. 


Lo que buscamos: 

• Experiencia trabajando en la producción ganadera de América del Sur. Esto es requisito excluyente. 

• Pasión por los animales y el futuro de la ganadería en la región. 

• Interés por la tecnología y genuina curiosidad por cómo funciona nuestro producto. 

• Un comunicador sólido que pueda traducir lo que ve en el campo en feedback claro y accionable para un equipo remoto de producto e ingeniería. 

• Capacidad demostrada para pensar de forma crítica ante un problema y llegar a conclusiones sólidas e innovadoras. 

• Comodidad con la incertidumbre. Esta es una entrada temprana al mercado y las cosas van a ser imperfectas; vas a prosperar con eso en lugar de frustrarte. 

• Aprendizaje rápido con las ganas de trabajar duro junto a un equipo que está haciendo cosas que nunca se hicieron antes. 

• Una actitud de "manos a la obra" con la resiliencia para superar los desafíos. 

• Disponibilidad para viajar y trabajar de forma flexible, incluyendo fines de semana cuando sea necesario.

• Se requiere dominio del idioma inglés para colaborar con la casa central.

El dominio del inglés es un requisito para esta posición. El proceso de selección incluirá entrevistas en inglés y una parte significativa del trabajo diario también se desarrollará en este idioma. Buscamos personas que se sientan cómodas comunicándose, participando en conversaciones profesionales y trabajando efectivamente en inglés. Si no te sentís cómodo/a manteniendo conversaciones profesionales en inglés, esta posición probablemente no sea adecuada para vos.



Sumate al equipo:

Halter está comprometida con promover un lugar de trabajo diverso e inclusivo — un espacio donde cada uno pueda ser uno mismo y hacer el mejor trabajo de su vida. To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.




WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:


 - 3-5 years of experience in relationship management/account management roles.

 - Experience in dairy farming or within the agriculture sector with a deep passion for helping farmers succeed.

 - Strong business acumen.

 - Positive attitude and collaborative team player who excels at overcoming challenges.

 - The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment with a high degree of autonomy.

 - A hunger for success and personal growth, and an eagerness to evolve alongside a world-class team.




WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE:


 - Revenue Retention & Expansion: You will own the retention, renewals and expansion targets of Halter’s existing revenue in the region.

 - Ensure farmers are extracting full value from Halter to achieve their goals and ultimately understand the impact it’s having on their farming business.

 - Account Management: Responsible for renewing customer agreements and expanding the revenue of existing Halter customers, by adding value in every interaction to drive on-farm goals and performance.

 - Deployment: Supporting the onboarding, training and implementation of the Halter system on customers' farms, ensuring all relevant farm owners, managers, and workers are able to successfully use the system.

 - Relationship Building: Proactively cultivate genuine and trustworthy relationships with farmers, their teams, and families, fostering strong connections and understanding.

 - Farmer Success: Strategically partnering with customers to establish clear business goals, timelines, priorities and metrics of success.

 - Problem-Solving: Provide prompt and effective communication and support to farmers and team members, addressing technical or operational challenges with expertise and efficiency.

 - Community & Networking: Represent the Halter brand with pride, lead local discussion groups, and proactively build strong networks within the community for increased brand visibility and connections.

 - Customer Advocate: Acting as the voice of the customer and bridging the gap with our product teams to provide important context about what is happening on the ground with our farmers and their animals.

 - Technical Expertise: Working closely with our product teams to provide technical and practical advice from a farmer’s perspective on everything reproduction, pasture and agronomy.

 - Contribute to a positive team environment, supporting others to succeed and role modelling Halter’s Operating Principles.




OUR BENEFITS:

 - Delicious snacks and drinks are available for your daily flow.

 - Healthy body, healthy mind. We're partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well-being.

 - We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family.

 - Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual $1000 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

 - Our time to recharge is valued, we're offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.

 - Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.







HALTER IN AUSTRALIA:

Halter entered Tasmania two years ago and has rapidly expanded to now have 20% of the state's dairy herd with Halter - a thriving customer base managed by a talented, local team. Halter recently entered Queensland and NSW, and now has a growing team and customer base across both states.

In Victoria and South Australia, Halter is preparing to launch operations following recent regulatory approval for virtual fencing. In Western Australia, Halter does not yet have customers. In these states there is a groundswell of demand for Halter across thousands of farmers. In Australia, virtual fencing is regulated by individual states' animal welfare legislation. Until recently, several states had legislation that did not permit farmers to use high-quality virtual fencing technology. With NSW parliament's announcement regulating virtual fencing, and Victoria and South Australia following suit, these barriers are now lifting.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

This is a rare, newly created opportunity to work alongside Halter’s phenomenal senior executives leading Halter’s Product and Engineering functions. The pace, technical complexity and cross-functional coordination make it challenging and interesting in the best way.

As our EA for Product, you’ll create clarity and leverage where hardware, software and product strategy intersect. You’ll bring structure to busy calendars, remove operational friction and ensure the right things get attention at the right time.

You’ll have broad exposure across Hardware Engineering, Platform, Firmware, Product Management and Design, embedded in the teams building technology that’s changing how farming works, not just orbiting them.

You’ll own the fundamentals of executive support and do them brilliantly: calendars, travel, meetings and relationships. But you’ll also go deeper, protecting focus, shaping priorities and keeping momentum high across teams shipping hardware and software to farms and ranches every week.

This role is ideal for someone who loves solving problems, is curious about how things get built and thrives when every day is different. We’re scaling incredibly fast, so you’ll need to be smart, adaptable and ready to jump in.

You won’t just manage diaries. You’ll influence how work flows, how decisions land and how our Product and Engineering leaders operate day to day.




WHAT YOU’LL DO





EXECUTIVE SUPPORT

 - Own complex calendars across multiple time zones, protecting focus and resolving conflicts early.

 - Coordinate domestic and international travel, from farm visits to manufacturing partner trips.

 - Manage expenses, meeting briefs and inboxes with speed and accuracy.

 - Prioritise requests, keep conversations moving and protect executive time.


PRODUCT AND ENGINEERING RHYTHM

 - Keep key team rhythms running smoothly, from planning sessions and product reviews to all-hands and offsites.

 - Coordinate events, offsites and regular farm and customer visits end to end.

 - Track priorities, follow up on actions and unblock stalled decisions.

 - Connect Product and Engineering with the wider business.


SYSTEMS AND IMPROVEMENT

 - Own small projects from start to finish.

 - Spot friction and build lightweight systems that simplify how work gets done.

 - Solve problems from first principles and close every loop with clear ownership and deadlines.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re changing the way the world farms - and with that comes a responsibility to the producers worldwide who trust us with their animals. Halter collars aren’t serviced, aren’t repairable and need to last 6-10 years, anywhere across the globe. The only way we achieve that is by improving our product based on the root cause of each failure that occurs in the field - those investigations happen in our Failure Analysis lab.

As a Failure Analysis Technician, you'll be the hands at the start of every failure investigation. You'll receive returned collars from the field, put them through incoming inspection and triage, tear down units to preserve the evidence, and run the test setups that replicate failures. You'll close out the failure modes we already understand, and hand the novel failures to our Failure Analysis Engineers as a clean, complete evidence package. You'll also own the logistics of getting samples to external labs.

This is a hands-on, high-volume, detail-driven role. We're looking for someone who wants to be genuinely excellent at the craft of getting evidence out of failed hardware. Every root cause Halter finds rests on that evidence being captured correctly, consistently and without contamination - and on knowing the difference between a failure we've seen before and one we haven't.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Perform incoming returns inspection and triage

 - Classify units into the correct disposition and close out common documented failure modes.

 - Carry out controlled teardown to the team's defined procedure on standard unit types, preserving evidence for downstream analysis; including recording of findings, photographs, measurements in the team’s Failure Analysis system

 - Build, wire and configure test setups; run tests and capture results

 - Package, document and ship samples to external labs

 - Other duties as required from time to time.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Hands-on experience in a lab, workshop, production or field service environment - an electronics, mechatronics or engineering background is preferred

 - Practical hands-on skills: comfortable with electrical test equipment such as multimeters and power supplies; basic soldering and wiring.

 - Genuine care for accuracy and process discipline - you follow the procedure as written, record data properly, and speak up when something doesn’t look right rather than letting it through.

 - Clear, honest communication, and comfort working alongside engineers and asking questions when something isn’t clear.

 - Talking directly with farmers, understanding what’s happening on farm and helping them get things back on track fast.

 - Troubleshooting issues and using data, tools, AI and your own judgment to solve problems that matter.

At Halter, we’re building world-class virtual fencing technology that transforms the way farmers and ranchers work. We tackle complex, real-world problems with technical solutions, helping farmers lift productivity, care for their animals, and farm more sustainably.

We’re looking for a Virtual Fencing Support Specialist to join our Guidance Operations team. This is a great role for someone who’s passionate about ag, understands farming deeply and thrives on problem solving.

This role sits right at the intersection of tech and farming. We’ll train you to become an expert in virtual fencing; understanding the technology inside out, and how animals interact with it. You’ll work in a small, focused team handling the trickier support queries we get from farmers, digging into data, diagnosing issues, and helping deliver world-class support.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Hardware at Halter is truly unique. We design and build devices that are fitted to an animal, and must remain operational 24/7 for 6-10 years out in the field. To achieve this, we iterate and improve our products continuously, so a mechanical role at Halter can be quite diverse. We own our designs right the way through, from sketching how a device might fit on an animal, to testing in the lab to see how it might break, to spending time on the production line finding ways to improve the product. We like to do things quickly, no matter which phase of the design we're in, which makes the role fast-paced and adaptive. We're endlessly challenged by our farmers, our animals, and our lofty production targets; so there's never a dull day.

For the next stage, we need talented, disciplined mechanical engineers who know how to develop hardware. With plenty of new markets and revenue streams to unlock, there will be no shortage of exciting mechanical projects, all of which require problem solving, critical thinking, and the ability to execute to a high standard. These projects will offer ample opportunity for up-skilling, leadership, mentorship and career development. At Halter, our teams are small and agile, which means you get to work on the most important projects, and contribute to the company's success, whatever your role may be.

2027 will be Halter's biggest year yet, and this is your chance to be a part of it.



WHAT WOULD BE VALUABLE:

 - Highly reliable device design.
   
   - Experience developing robust products. E.g. automotive, agricultural or military.
   
   - Exposure to the full product life cycle.

At Halter, data is the lifeblood of everything we build. Every second, collars stream behavioural, location, and health signals from cows in paddocks across the globe. Pair that with remote sensing, grazing data and pasture cover, and you have the foundation for helping farmers make smarter decisions every single day. But that's only one piece. Internally, we rely on production data from our manufacturing floor, field performance data from collars in the wild, and product analytics to shape how we build and scale. 



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Data Engineer with strong backend instincts to join our Data Engineering team to build the pipelines that make all of this work together. Day-to-day you'll partner closely with our machine learning, product, and platform teams to design systems that are reliable, observable, and ready for what's next. Whether it's optimising ingestion for billions of daily events, building robust transformation layers, connecting disparate data sources into a coherent whole, or ensuring data quality at scale you'll own problems end-to-end. If you want your work to have a tangible impact on how the world farms, this is the role for you.




WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines that move data reliably from source to insight.

 - Own data modelling decisions: clean schemas, sensible abstractions, and infrastructure that scales with the business.

 - Work closely with machine learning, product, and platform teams to ensure data is accessible, accurate, and ready when they need it.

 - Apply AI tools (like Claude Code or Cursor) to improve velocity while keeping pipelines easy to understand and evolve.Champion data quality by building validation, monitoring, and alerting so issues surface before they cause problems downstream.

 - Help define and evolve data practices and standards across the organisation, balancing pragmatic delivery with long-term maintainability.

 - Support and mentor other engineers through design conversations, code reviews, and generous context sharing.

 - Stay hands-on, helping shape not just the plumbing, but the data products that drive decisions.Contribute to the reliability and freshness of our data systems, especially when things get tricky at scale.

 - Help evolve our testing strategies, CI/CD workflows, and infrastructure patterns for data.
   
   


WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - You understand how to build systems that are observable, testable, and easy to debug

 - You're a product-minded engineer. You care about why we're building something, not just how.

 - You embrace ambiguity. At Halter, the problems worth solving rarely come with a clear spec. You're comfortable navigating uncertainty and making pragmatic calls.

 - You're deeply curious and motivated by impact. Bonus points if you're genuinely interested in agriculture, but what matters most is that you want your work to matter.

 - You're a highly effective collaborator. You lift the people around you through clear communication, generous knowledge sharing, and a low ego.

At Halter, we know how much farmers care - for their animals and their pasture. But the tools they rely on haven’t kept up, and we’re on a mission to change that. Halter helps farmers make smarter decisions - fast. We reckon good pasture management is the key to more productive and sustainable farms. More grass. Healthier soil. Happier animals. And more time back for the people doing the work.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for standout Junior/Intermediate Engineers with a deep product instinct: people who care as much about the problem as the solution. You'll take on challenges that genuinely haven't been solved before. We don't mind whether your strengths sit on the frontend, backend, full stack, or on the platform side that gives every other engineer leverage. What matters is that you ship robust, thoughtful work, lift the bar on how we build, and use AI tools well.




THE KIND OF PROBLEMS OUR TEAMS SOLVE

Halter is one system: hardware, software, and AI, running live on real farms. Our engineering teams own different slices of that system, but the problems all rhyme:

 - Turning thousands of collars and billions of sensor events into a single, calm decision in a farmer's hand.

 - Modelling the physical world (animals, pasture, terrain) accurately enough to act on in real time.

 - Building mobile and web experiences that hold up at 5am whilst out in a paddock in the rain.

 - Designing platforms and pipelines that scale with our incredible pace of growth without the seams showing.

 - Engineering against constrained hardware, flaky rural connectivity, and the messiness of the physical world, and shipping with pace despite it.

Every team here ships software that has to work in a paddock, not just a browser tab.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design, build, and deliver features and systems end to end, from the surfaces farmers touch to the services and infrastructure behind them.

 - Make smart architectural calls, then back them up by writing the code.

 - Work closely with engineering, design, and product to ship high-impact features quickly.

 - Collaborate with other engineers through design conversations, code reviews, and context sharing.

 - Contribute to the reliability and performance of our systems, especially when things get tricky. Every team owns its services end-to-end, with an on-call rotation.

 - Get out on farm. Deep domain knowledge matters, and you'll be expected to develop it.




YOU'LL BE GREAT IF YOU

 - Have designed and delivered complex systems in production and have the experience (and scars) to show for it.

 - Think like a product engineer: you care about the customer experience, not just clean code.

 - Know how to use AI tools well to lift team output and focus on the harder stuff.

 - Have experience supporting and collaborating with other engineers.

 - Are comfortable in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where adaptability beats perfection.

 - Have worked in cloud environments. AWS is a bonus.

 - A degree in software engineering (or equivalent) is nice to have, but not essential.




DEPENDING ON WHERE YOU SIT ON THE STACK, SOME OF THESE WILL LAND HARDER THAN OTHERS:

 - Frontend / Mobile: strong UX intuition, modern frontend frameworks (React, React Native a bonus), an eye for performance and polish on real devices.

 - Backend: building and scaling REST APIs, distributed systems, and event-driven services. Comfort with both relational and non-relational databases. Node.js, Kotlin, Go, or systems that integrate with hardware/IoT a bonus.

 - Full stack: all of the above, end to end, across web, mobile, and the services that power them.

 - Platform: you love building tooling that makes the whole company move faster, including the AI tooling that's reshaping how engineers work. Strong AWS and Terraform at scale, with experience across CI/CD, observability, and on-call tooling.

As Failure Analysis Lead, you will be the person who answers the critical question: why did this fail? When a collar dies in our ongoing reliability stress screening, or a batch shows unexpected yield loss on the production line, you will be the person who opens it up, gathers the data, and finds the truth. You will work hands-on with a small team of dedicated technicians, systematically investigating failure modes, forming and testing hypotheses, and translating findings into concrete recommendations that flow back to our production and hardware design teams.

Every failure contains information, and your job is to extract that information rigorously and turn it into action: changes to processes, components, test coverage, or design. The right person for this role will be deeply curious, methodical, and comfortable working in ambiguity.

You will be embedded at our contract manufacturer in Thailand, whilst working closely with the Halter Production team and connected directly to hardware design engineers in New Zealand. You will be a critical link in the feedback loop that keeps our product reliable and improving.

Failure Investigation

 - Own the end-to-end analysis of all hardware failures from reliability testing, production line yield losses, and any other source in the factory.

 - Conduct structured, first-principles investigations: physical teardown, electrical measurement, data analysis, and hypothesis testing.

 - Work to distinguish between random defects, systematic process issues, design weaknesses, and component quality problems.

 - Own the failure analysis backlog: ensure every failure that requires investigation is triaged, tracked, and resolved to a conclusion.

Root Cause Analysis & Documentation

 - Develop clear failure hypotheses and design experiments to validate or disprove them.

 - Document findings with precision in Notion and create structured debug processes to scale up the team of technicians.

 - Maintain a structured failure database that builds institutional knowledge over time.

Feedback to Production & Design

 - Translate failure analysis findings into evidenced recommendations provided to Production Engineering, Design Engineering, Supplier Quality, or the Contract Manufacturer.

 - Raise issues early when failure trends suggest systemic risk, and support the escalation process where needed.

Managing the Technician Team

 - Direct and coordinate a small team of technicians embedded at Calcomp, assigning debug tasks, maintaining quality of data collection, and developing their technical capability.

 - Set clear standards for how failures are handled, measured, and recorded, and maintain those standards consistently.

 - Build a well-organised, well-equipped failure analysis workflow at the factory.

Reliability Monitoring

By the end of the week, you might be on farm with a Territory Manager, listening to what’s actually keeping farmers up at night and turning those insights into sharper sales execution and feedback for other leaders across Halter.

You’ll work closely with marketing, customer, product, operations, and global sales leadership to make sure Halter’s go-to-market strategy is sharp, scalable, and deeply connected to the realities of Australian farming.

This is one of the most important growth roles in the business, but also for Australia, and the person who lands it will know that.






WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - We’re looking for a rare kind of market leader, someone who has built high-performing teams before, knows what exceptional looks like, and has the scars, standards, and instincts to prove it.

You understand that the numbers show you where to look, and the people tell you what’s really going on.

Agriculture experience would be a genuine advantage, but more important is respect for the industry, curiosity about how farming businesses operate, and the ability to earn trust with people whose livelihoods depend on the decisions they make.

This is not a role for someone waiting for a perfect playbook. It’s for someone who can build one.
