You’ll be responsible for building an efficient operational system from the ground up, getting out onto farms, and making sure our hardware infrastructure runs without a hitch. One moment you’re diagnosing a technical issue in the field, the next you’re delivering collars to a new producer. You’ll be the go-to person on the ground, the kind of person who takes ownership and gets things done.

You’ll work closely with dedicated teams in Australia, and at Halter’s Auckland HQ. You’ll play a key role in making sure our pioneering producers in the region get an unmatched experience from day one.




WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE

 - Infrastructure maintenance: Oversee the upkeep and repair of Halter’s on-farm infrastructure to keep operations running smoothly.

 - Hardware diagnosis: Diagnose issues with our hardware and feed that information back to the right team quickly.

 - Deployment support: Get out onto farms to help deploy Halter. Troubleshoot issues, support installations, and make sure things go well.

 - Field insights: Feed your learnings back clearly to our product and engineering teams, so we’re always building what matters most for Australian cattle producers.

 - On-call: Be part of our global on-call roster to support tower-related incidents and proactively find solutions in a timely manner.

 - Data analysis: Collect, interpret, and analyse data from our hardware to optimise processes and improve operational efficiency. Spot issues before they become problems.

 - Maintenance system: Help build and manage a maintenance system tailored to the Australian market.

 - Collaboration: Work closely across Halter’s teams to stay aligned and drive strong customer outcomes.

 - Travel: With producers spread across Australia, you’ll be on the road regularly. Expect 3 to 4 days a week and some nights away from home.

 - Whatever else it takes: You’ll do what needs doing to make Halter continue to succeed in Australia.




WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR

 - Hands-on experience: Practical experience with tools, electrical work, construction, networking, or equipment fitting is a must.

 - Go-getter attitude: You’re proactive, you take ownership, and you’re not afraid to figure things out on the go.

 - Strong communicator: You can translate what you’re seeing in the field into clear, actionable feedback for a remote product and engineering team.

 - Time management: You manage your own time well and get tasks done on schedule without someone looking over your shoulder.

 - Team player: You work well with people across different locations and time zones.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity: This is early-stage market entry. Things will be imperfect. You’ll thrive on that rather than be frustrated by it.

 - Commitment to excellence: You take pride in delivering the best possible service and making sure Halter’s infrastructure is always at its best.

 - Willingness to travel: You’re up for regular and sometimes spontaneous travel across the region.

Our hardware fleet operates across farms and ranches globally, and as we scale, we need better systems, better tooling, and smarter workflows to support our farmers faster and more reliably. We’re looking for a highly motivated Intermediate Field Operations Engineer to join our Field Operations team. This role is ideal for someone with a computer science or software-oriented background who enjoys solving real-world problems, building internal tools, and improving how teams operate at scale.


This role sits at the intersection of hardware operations, customer impact, and engineering. You will spend part of your time running the day-to-day work, such as monitoring fleet performance, triaging issues, working tickets, and coordinating resolution. The other part of your time will be dedicated to designing and building internal tooling, dashboards, automations, and process improvements that make the Field Operations team more effective and allow us to scale globally.  - Investigate and respond to technical support tickets related to collar functionality and tower performance

 - Collaborate closely with customer teams to ensure efficient handover and resolution of technical issues

 - Communicate cross-functionally with Deployment, Product, and Engineering teams to align on incidents, root causes, and follow-ups

 - Contribute to and maintain internal documentation and knowledge bases for known collar and tower issues

Tooling, systems, and scaling improvements

 - Identify opportunities to remove manual work and improve internal workflows across Fleet Operations

 - Own and build internal tools that support fleet monitoring, investigation, and incident response for a scalable global operating model

About the role:

Halter is looking for a  hungry and driven sales leader to work with our sales team and grow Halter in VIC, specifically around Central and Northern Victoria. We're looking for a go-getter who is out in the field, meeting farmers, championing Halter and converting them into customers. A ‘never give up attitude’ is crucial for this role; you will be a significant contributor to the growth and success of Halter in Victoria.

You’ll be responsible for setting and managing quotas and commissions for the Victoria, sales capability management and mentoring for Territory Managers.

You’ll use your strong sales background to drive end-to-end sales, from cold calling and on-farm meetings to deeply understanding our customers’ farm systems. You'll detail Halter’s value proposition, progress the sale, and ultimately close the deal. Make your mark with Halter and help us push the boundaries of farming, connecting animals and humans like never before.




WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE

 - Setting and managing quotas, commissions and other sales management tasks for the sales team

 - Coaching, mentoring and developing our junior sales staff to help drive their professional growth to reach targets

 - Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals/introductions, industry events and other channels, as well as fielding and responding to inbound inquiries

 - Meet high growth sales targets by managing pipeline through to close, including screening, qualifying, executing on-farm demonstrations and successfully negotiating contracts with customers

 - Collaborating with Customer Success to ensure successful post-sales handoff, implementations, customer satisfaction and account renewal

 - Providing support, insight and communication to help build and foster trusting and enduring relationships with customers as they wait for deployment

 - Leveraging opportunities and participating in relevant industry/Halter events and demonstrations

 - Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand

 - Focusing on the customer and their needs, providing feedback to help drive the product roadmap

 - Working with the team to optimise and evolve the sales process to become faster, more efficient and more predictable as the company scales
   


WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR

 - A complete end-to-end sales skill set with at least five years of experience

 - Proven track records and examples of successfully sourcing new prospects, securing meetings with new leads and creating new sales opportunities

 - Someone highly experienced in value-based sales with a proven history of closing deals and high-volume sales results

 - Well-prepared with solid communication skills to present Halter's value proposition

 - Experience in dairy farming or within the agricultural sector is a must-have

 - A person who is results-driven, highly motivated with exceptional time management skills

 - Adaptability in a high-stakes sales environment and the ability to think on your feet

 - Sales experience in the technology-based industry is preferred

 - A university degree or equivalent would be excellent but not a must.
   

Our Benefits:

Healthy body, healthy mind. We're partnered with Medibank Health Insurance to support your well-being.

We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family.

Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual $1000 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

Our time to recharge is valued, we're offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.

Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.

 

Halter in Australia


Halter first entered Tasmania two years ago and today operates on over 30% of the state's dairy herd - a thriving customer base managed by a talented, local team. THE ROLE

Halter is a phase of incredible expansion with hardware right at our core. There are immense challenges and huge opportunities ahead as we grow into new geographies and work towards becoming the operating system for the next generation of agriculture. Our hardware needs to withstand everything from extreme temperatures to cows fighting each other all while continuing to function seamlessly. This requires a technical team with world-class talent, which is where you come in.

Delivery is a new function dedicated to helping engineers and technical teams across Halter do their best work. As the company scales, there is a growing need to keep all the teams working in lock-step with each other. One of the most critical jobs at Halter is to make sure that priorities are aligned and vague, nebulous problems get turned into firm, actionable plans. That’s where you come in.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

You will be responsible for making sure the right people are in the room as you discuss project roadmaps and how to keep things on track. You will see around corners and highlight risks that other teammates did not think of. You will make sure that overhead and unnecessary processes are stripped away so that technical teams have the time and space to execute. You will make sure that all projects are moving at maximum velocity coupled with driving clarity on the path forward across all hardware and operations teams.

Your success will be measured by delivery of projects into mass production. This includes how well you navigated the team through obstacles and the speed at which those problems are resolved.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Coordinate delivering projects across current and future hardware programs. This involves working across hardware design, firmware, reliability, production, operations, and supply chain teams.

 - Build and maintain strong relationships across every discipline. Understand each team's constraints and dependencies well enough to anticipate problems and bring the right people together before things slow down.

 - Lead programs with a lightweight delivery cadence. Make sure that technical teams are not bogged down with process but are aware of what everyone’s responsibilities are and how to move the project forward.

 - Drive clarity and ensure people across the organization and levels are crystal clear about the state of projects and next steps. Be an expert at distilling confusing threads into clear summaries and next steps.

 - Surface trade-offs early and cleanly so decision-makers can move fast.

 - Ensure that engineering builds happen on-time and remove blockers during build execution.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Experience driving complex hardware products from development through to production across cross-functional teams

 - Hardware engineering experience. Engineering degree preferred but not required.

 - A mindset for urgency. Everything we work on in the hardware space directly impacts farmers and the company, so velocity is the name of the game.

 - A knack for clear communication. You bias towards zero-inbox and make sure no details get missed without filling slack channels with unnecessary information.

 - Willingness to travel to Asia. A lot of our job requires being hands-on at the factory and supplier sites, and you should have experience in factory environments and influencing suppliers to achieve fast results.

 - Openness to wearing multiple hats. As a scale-up, Halter is still young in its journey to build out the hardware organization. You are not afraid to do what it takes to get projects across the line, even if it does not fall explicitly within your job description.

 - Low ego and comfortable with discomfort. You lean into hard conversations, raise the awkward thing early, and never shy away from tension when it needs to be resolved. You have strong opinions and a desire to solve all kinds of problems, but you hold those opinions loosely and change your mind fast when someone has a better answer.

 - You're fun and a joy to work with. Hardware delivery is intense. You bring energy, humour, and optimism, and people are better for having you around.

Canals builds software for wholesale distributors, helping them operate more efficiently through automation and AI.

Our customers are the companies responsible for moving the materials that power the real economy; electrical supplies, plumbing products, roofing materials, HVAC equipment, and more. Every day, thousands of people rely on Canals to help process orders, manage purchasing, handle accounts payable, and streamline critical business workflows.

We're a profitable, rapidly growing company with a team of roughly 140 people distributed across North and South America. We care deeply about building great products, hiring exceptional people, and creating an environment where talented individuals can do the best work of their careers.


THE ROLE

Our customer base is growing fast, and we’re looking for a Junior Software Engineer eager to learn and grow with us. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers building scalable, high-performance systems that solve real-world problems in logistics and automation.

This is a great opportunity to gain exposure to modern engineering practices, real customers, and a product that delivers measurable business impact.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Work closely with senior engineers to design, build, and maintain backend systems that power our platform.

 - Contribute to feature development, bug fixes, and performance improvements.

 - Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation to ensure quality and maintainability.

 - Collaborate with product and design teams to bring ideas from concept to production.

 - Learn new tools and technologies, and grow into greater ownership over time.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Typically, 0–2 years of professional experience as a software engineer (internships or projects count!).

 - Solid programming fundamentals and familiarity with at least one backend language (Go, Python, Node, etc.).

 - Curiosity and a desire to understand how complex systems fit together.

 - Eagerness to learn from others and contribute to a collaborative, high-performing team.

 - Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

 - Interest in startups, AI, or logistics a plus.


WHY JOIN CANALS

We're building software that solves real problems for an industry that keeps the world running. Our customers rely on our platform every day to operate their businesses.

We've found strong product-market fit and continue to grow quickly, creating opportunities for people who want to have a meaningful impact on the trajectory of a company.

We believe great people build great companies. That's why we invest heavily in hiring, development, and creating an environment where talented individuals can do the best work of their careers.

You'll work alongside ambitious, thoughtful teammates who care deeply about what they do, challenge each other directly, and have a lot of fun along the way.

We value ownership, transparency, and continuous improvement. Good ideas can come from anywhere, and people are trusted to make things happen.

We're remote-first, flexible, and distributed across North and South America, bringing together talented people from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences.



Canals.ai is an equal opportunity employer. In addition to EEO being the law, it is a policy that is fully consistent with our principles. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to status as a protected veteran or a qualified individual with a disability, or other protected status such as race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, pregnancy or age.

postings.title: IT Operations Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
WHO ARE WE?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

 

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

 

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.



Where does this role fit in?

 - Build, operate and continually improve the technology platform that lets every UpGuardian work securely, efficiently and with minimal friction.

 - You’ll own the lifecycle of our corporate technology end to end: identity, endpoints, SaaS and the service practices that hold them together. You’ll automate the repetitive parts, instrument the rest, and make security a property of how systems are built rather than a task someone remembers to do.

 - This is an engineering role, not a ticket queue. If you see the same request three times and your first thought is “why is a human still doing this?” - you’ll fit.

 - Security is an outcome of excellent operational engineering here, not the primary function of the role.



What will you do?

Platform, identity and fleet

 - Google Workspace, Okta (or equivalent IdP), and MDM (Kandji, Jamf or similar) across a mostly macOS and ChromeOS fleet

 - You’ll own SaaS administration and lifecycle, asset management, endpoint standards and compliance, and the joiner–mover–leaver process end to end

Zero Trust and secure access

 - Operate and continually improve our Cloudflare Zero Trust environment across ZTNA, Secure Web Gateway, DNS filtering, tunnels and identity and device aware access policies

 - You’ll help move us away from traditional network trust, maintain secure access to internal applications and services, troubleshoot access and connectivity issues, and make sure security controls don’t create unnecessary friction for employees

Automation and internal tooling

 - Automation is the default approach, not a stretch goal. If a task happens more than twice, it’s a candidate for code

 - You’ll work with REST APIs, Python, Apps Script, Terraform, n8n and AI assisted workflows to build internal tooling that removes work rather than making it faster to do by hand

Service operations

 - Incident, problem and change management. Service catalogue, knowledge base, service metrics, capacity planning and operational readiness

 - You’ll define these practices where they don’t exist yet and improve the ones that do

Reliability and continuous improvement

 - Zero touch provisioning, endpoint compliance, fleet health, monitoring, reporting, SaaS governance and self service. Making internal platforms boringly reliable is the goal

Security, embedded

 - Deploy and maintain security controls, harden endpoints, support security incidents, reduce operational risk and keep baselines current

 - Security is part of how you’ll operate the platform rather than a separate function you’ll own

What will you bring?

You won’t have all of this. Tell us which parts you’d be learning, and we’ll tell you honestly whether that works

 - Depth across enterprise SaaS and identity - you’ve administered Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, an IdP such as Okta or Entra, and MDM at organisational scale. You’re comfortable with SSO, SAML, SCIM, DNS and certificates

 - Zero Trust, hands on - you’ve worked with ZTNA, Secure Web Gateway or modern network access controls, ideally Cloudflare Zero Trust or a similar platform such as Zscaler, Netskope, Tailscale or Entra Private Access. You understand identity and device aware access and the principles behind replacing traditional network trust

 - You don’t need to be a Zero Trust specialist, but you should be comfortable taking ownership of an existing Cloudflare implementation, troubleshooting it and making it better

 - You genuinely automate - you write code using Python, Apps Script or similar, work confidently with REST APIs, and can point to internal tooling you’ve shipped that removed recurring work permanently

 - Fleet management maturity - you’ve worked with macOS at scale, zero touch provisioning and endpoint compliance baselines

 - Service operations experience - you’ve run incident and change practices, defined metrics and built documentation people actually use

 - Security and infrastructure fundamentals - you’re comfortable with endpoint hardening, identity security, DNS, certificates, secure network access and making sensible risk trade offs

 - Process improvement instinct - you make the system better, not just the outcome of one request
   
   

What will give you an edge?

 - Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code

 - Cloudflare

 - n8n or similar orchestration

 - AI and LLM-assisted workflows

 - Deep macOS expertise

 - Chrome Enterprise

 - Working in a security-first or audited environment (SOC 2, ISO 27001)
   
   

What's in it for you? 

 - Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being

 - WFH set-up allowance: To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard

 - $1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance

 - Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.

 - 18 weeks paid Parental Leave: Irrespective of parenting role

 - Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave

 - Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate com

postings.title: Content Writer
postings.descriptionText:
WHO ARE WE?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

 

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

 

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.



WHERE DOES THIS ROLE FIT IN?

You’ll be a key member of UpGuard’s Growth Squad, focused on driving organic growth. Based in South Africa and reporting to the Content Writer Manager, you’ll write high-quality content that answers the real questions our prospects and customers are asking, from in-depth articles to comparison and competitor pages on our website.

How people find answers has changed dramatically with the rise of LLMs and AI search engines, and this role is central to making sure UpGuard shows up with content that’s genuinely helpful and conveys authority and trust. Working closely with the Growth Marketing team, you’ll turn research and briefs into accurate, authoritative content, and keep our existing content fresh and competitive.




WHAT WILL YOU DO?

 - Answer the questions that matter: Write high-quality, genuinely useful content that answers the real questions our prospects and customers are asking, whether they find it through a search engine or an AI assistant.

 - Make complex topics clear: Turn cybersecurity and risk concepts into content that’s accurate, insightful, and a pleasure to read.

 - Keep our content at its best: Refresh and improve existing articles and pages so they stay accurate, current, and genuinely helpful.

 - Help buyers make informed decisions: Write and maintain comparison and competitor pages that are accurate, fair, and persuasive.

 - Own your work from draft to live: Publish and format your content in our CMS, including headings, metadata, internal links, and image alt text.

 - See the impact of your work: Work with the Growth Marketing team to review how your content performs and use those insights to make the next piece even better.

 - Maintain Voice and Tone: Ensure every piece of content adheres strictly to the UpGuard brand Voice and Tone.
   
   


WHAT WILL YOU BRING?

 - 3+ years of professional content writing experience, including writing content optimized for search, ideally within the B2B SaaS or Cybersecurity domain.

 - A portfolio of content you’ve written that answers real audience questions, such as long-form articles, comparison pages, or other search-focused content.

 - A solid understanding of SEO and how it’s evolving with AI search, including search intent, keyword usage, content structure, internal linking, and metadata.

 - Hands-on experience uploading and formatting content via a website CMS.

 - Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical or risk management concepts into clear, engaging and authoritative content.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with an unwavering commitment to editorial quality, consistency and accuracy.

 - Proven ability to manage multiple pieces of content at once in a fast-paced environment, working from briefs with a high level of independence.

 - Strong collaborative spirit, capable of working effectively with web, growth and creative teams.

 - Fluency in English (verbal and written), our primary working language, with a base of operations in South Africa.
   
   


WHAT WILL GIVE YOU AN EDGE?

 - Experience writing content that drives measurable traffic and leads for a business.

 - A background in cybersecurity, vendor risk, or third-party risk management.

 - Confidence using AI tools in your writing process, including refining and elevating AI-generated drafts into accurate, high-quality, human content.
   
   


WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

 - Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being

 - WFH set-up allowance: To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard

 - $1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance

 - Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.

 - 18 weeks paid Parental Leave: Irrespective of parenting role

 - Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave

 - Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance

 - Top-spec hardware: All team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role

 - Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work

 




UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why!

 

As an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

 

Please Note: Not all roles can be performed from the United States. Please check your specific job listing to confirm its advertised location. If the role you are applying for is listed as based in the US, we are currently only able to support hiring in the following locations: CA, CO,

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer - Buenos Aires, Argentina (Hybrid)
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en


ABOUT THE ROLE

Our Engineering team helps Nu create and scale the technology that powers the best financial products in Latin America. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices, using a variety of technologies and architectures to build resilient, secure, and highly scalable systems.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the technical direction of multiple teams, driving the design and evolution of large-scale distributed systems that serve millions of customers. While we value experience with our tech stack, we are confident that engineers who are eager to learn will be successful here — and we will teach you Clojure as our main backend language.

 - You will build and evolve
   
   - Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture
   
   - High-throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka
   
   - Continuous Integration and Deployment pipelines on AWS
   
   - Data storage solutions using Datomic and DynamoDB
   
   - Monitoring and observability with Prometheus
   
   - Services running as much as possible in Kubernetes
   
   We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We work in small, independent teams that feel like startups within the company and avoid unnecessary coupling and centralization whenever realistic. We understand that execution is key to success and continuously optimize our processes to remove bottlenecks.

 


YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Setting technical direction for multiple teams, ensuring alignment with Business Areas and architecture strategies

 - Working with large-scale distributed systems and understanding their broad architecture and trade-offs

 - Driving pragmatic innovation while ensuring resilient, secure, and flexible solutions that scale across products and geographies

 - Mentoring engineers across teams and helping maintain a high technical bar organization-wide

 - Writing, testing, instrumenting, documenting, and maintaining high-quality code

 - Pairing and participating in code reviews to support the growth of others in and around your teams

 - Collaborating closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to build new end-to-end experiences

 - Ensuring comprehensive observability, performance monitoring, and robust error handling across team services

 - Participating in on-call rotations for your team and responding to incidents as necessary

 - Focusing primarily on backend applications, while being open to contributing to mobile and frontend development according to business needs


WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PERSON WHO HAS

 - At least 4 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments

 - Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies

 - A proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands or millions of users

 - A strong background in object-oriented or functional programming languages, with the ability to work across multiple languages

 - Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives across multiple teams, even without direct authority

 - Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across organizations

 - Practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and prior experience with CI/CD

 - Strong communication skills to identify and prevent risks, and explain trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

 - Advanced English skills

 


LOCATION

Buenos Aires, Argentina 
Argentina · Avenida del Libertador General San Martín 1000 – Vicente López

 


OUR BENEFITS

Our benefits are designed to support your wellbeing, development, and life outside of work. They include:

 - Chance of earning equity

 - Health Insurance

 - Life Insurance

 - NuCare

 - International business travel insurance

 - NuLanguage

 - Vacations

 - Parental leaves

 - Work from home allowance

Even if you feel you don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply — your unique skills and experiences may be just what we're looking for, and we're excited to learn more about what you can bring to our team.

 


WORK MODEL FOR THIS ROLE

Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit  https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/ https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/.

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here https://script.google.com/a/macros/nubank.com.br/s/AKfycbwvrewE58oGSbRWIVv8CyCWN68GLxpPVsfYYXv-ZHg94QFsTJmi82rF1x0yt-OTs2W0DQ/exec

About the role

Our mission is to evolve the platform architecture and workflows that let Insurance scale across more customers, more products, and new markets, and to close the gap between AI capabilities built centrally and their reliable adoption in production.

As a Staff Software Engineer - Insurance, you will be a senior technical leader across two connected fronts: diagnosing and evolving our service architecture as the platform scales, and leading the rollout of AI/agentic tooling across the team's engineering workflow, from spec and code generation to testing and validation.

You will operate at platform scale, building infrastructure and practices other teams depend on, while partnering closely with Product, Data, Security, Compliance, and Insurance partners. You'll be part of a lean, entrepreneurial team that delivers outsized business impact while protecting millions of customers, sitting at the intersection of embedded insurance, Nu's most important customer surfaces, and our insurer partners. This team is also one of the earliest adopters of agentic engineering within Nubank, putting you at the center of how that transformation actually happens.

 - Providing AI-first engineering leadership, setting the standards and practices for how the team builds and evolves with AI/agentic tooling.

 - Cutting through ambiguity, surfacing trade-offs and aligning cross-functional teams (Product, Data, Security, Compliance, Insurance partners) around clear outcomes.

 - Ensuring observability for AI systems and platform services in production (tracing, logging, alerting).

 - Mentoring engineers on technical approach across both architecture and AI/agentic best practices, raising the team's execution level over time.

 - Evaluating and incorporating both internal (Nubank) and external AI tools and agents into our workflows, based on what best fits our needs.

 - Partnering with Nubank's central AI/platform teams and other BUs to share learnings and stay aligned on tooling direction.

 - Enabling more Nubankers to safely contribute to AI-powered products over time (engineers and non-engineers)

 - Embedding responsible, auditable practices in everything shipped, across platform and AI systems alike, per applicable regulations and internal risk standards.
   

We are looking for a person who has

Required

 - Proven technical leadership as a senior/staff engineer delivering high-impact, large-scale software systems in production.

 - Track record of mentoring and uplifting peers on technical approach and AI-native workflows.

 - Strong systems/platform engineering experience: architecture, CI/CD, test automation, able to evolve infrastructure to support reliable adoption of new technology.

 - Genuine interest and foundational knowledge of AI/LLM concepts, ready to build hands-on fluency with our agentic tooling.

 - Ownership mindset for rolling out AI/agentic tooling across a team, driving adoption of testing, CI/CD validation, and evaluation practices, not just personal use.

 - Strong full-stack thinking: ability to design maintainable codebases and APIs that bridge model inference/orchestration layers with user-facing surfaces.

 - Experience navigating ambiguous, cross-functional projects that require coordination across multiple business units and stakeholders.

 - Demonstrated strategic acumen, linking technical initiatives to business drivers such as operational efficiency, risk, and customer acquisition or engagement.

 - Experience in fintech or other regulated industries (e.g., financial services, insurance, payments) or similarly complex domains.

 - Advanced English for daily collaboration in a global environment.



Nice to Have

 - AI-first mindset with professional experience implementing LLMs, generative AI, agentic patterns and/or RAG systems in real-world products.

 - Solid understanding of prompt engineering, tool calling, context management, and agent loops, with ability to contribute to shared agent libraries and commands.

 - Experience building or contributing to automated test/CI-CD evaluation frameworks that catch and fix failures with minimal human intervention.

 - Background in insurance or embedded insurance products.

 - Experience scaling products across international markets and languages.

 - Familiarity with Portuguese and/or Spanish to read or review customer-facing copy (optional).

 - Prior experience in AI-first startups or big-tech environments with strong AI/ML teams.



Location for this opportunity

 - São Paulo, Buenos Aires

 - Life Insurance and AD&D

postings.title: Member of Technical Staff, Frontend
postings.descriptionText:
Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.  

Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.

As a Frontend Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping high-performance, visually stunning React applications that power the future of AI-driven marketing experiences.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build and refine sleek, high-quality user interfaces from low-fidelity wireframes

 - Implement god-like CSS to create exceptional, pixel-perfect experiences

 - Optimize front-end performance to ensure seamless interactions

 - Work closely with design and engineering to bring ideas to life with precision and speed

 - Contribute to our product’s core architecture and front-end best practices




WHO YOU ARE

 - Deep expertise in React, Next.js, and TypeScript, with strong knowledge of state management and performance optimization

 - Proven experience architecting and scaling complex Next.js applications (App Router, SSR, SSG, ISR)

 - Strong command of Tailwind CSS, SASS, or SCSS, delivering polished, pixel-perfect UIs
   Experience with data-fetching libraries like React Query (or similar)

 - Skilled in building smooth, engaging interfaces with advanced CSS animations, transitions, and layout techniques

 - Strong understanding of caching strategies and CDN integrations for global performance at scale

 - Experience with React Server Components in production environments

 - Familiar with internationalization and localization strategies in Next.js applications

 - Comfortable operating in a fast-paced startup environment with rapid iteration cycles

 - A strong design eye and portfolio demonstrating high-quality front-end work


NICE TO HAVE (OPTIONAL):

 - Experience with GSAP for advanced animations

 - Experience with Three.js, React Three Fiber (R3F), or immersive 3D experiences




LOCATION

This is an on-site role in our NYC, SF, or Buenos Aires office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact. We are happy to support visa sponsorship for qualified international candidates.

For this role, the expected base salary range is $175,000 to $260,000 (NYC and SF). Comp may vary by location. Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring.

 

#LI-DNI

Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.

postings.descriptionText:
Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.  

Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Design is foundational to our product and our company. As a Product Designer at Profound, you will work on our core data visualization and content workflow tools. This is an opportunity to have deep ownership over our product and ship fast and ship often, while continuing to craft the experience for our users.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design core product experiences end to end, from early exploration through launch and iteration

 - Work closely with product managers and engineers to translate strategy and ambiguous problems into clear, thoughtful solutions

 - Explore multiple directions quickly through sketches, flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs

 - Sweat the details and fine tune layout shifts, typography, spacing, motion, and interactions

 - Balance building good product focused on user needs, technical constraints, and business goals while keeping a high bar for craft

 - Use user feedback, qualitative insights, and product intuition to refine and improve the product over time

 - Contribute to and help evolve Profound’s design language, systems, and product vision

 - Participate in Tuesday and Thursday design critiques to give and receive feedback on in-progress design work




WHO YOU ARE

 - You have 3 or more years of experience designing digital products, ideally in a startup or fast-moving product company

 - You are a strong generalist with taste and are comfortable owning the full stack of design assets, from flows to pixels to final product

 - You care deeply about craft and believe great design is defined by clarity, simplicity, and execution

 - You bring an entrepreneurial and product-thinking mindset to design

 - You like to experiment with AI, new tools, and ways of working, whether through new Figma plugins or tools such as v0, Cursor, or other prototyping tools

 - You are good at collaborating with product managers, engineers, and data scientists to solve problems

 - You have a portfolio that shows thoughtful problem-solving and high-quality visual design

 - Experience working on a data visualization or B2B marketing product

 - Enjoy prototyping directly in code and shipping directly to production using git and GitHub

 - Blur the lines between where design ends and product or engineering work begins

 - You can just do things




NOTE FROM OUR CO-FOUNDER

In the evolving landscape of product development, exceptional design is not merely a nice-to-have, it is foundational. As software engineering becomes increasingly accessible, it is taste, creativity, and thoughtful execution that differentiate outstanding products from the rest.

I believe deeply that design sits at the core of our success. At Profound, my goal is to build a design team renowned for setting a new standard of excellence, crafting experiences so compelling they become benchmarks in our industry.

If you are someone who believes in the transformative power of great design and wants to create work that genuinely shapes the future, join us. Let’s redefine what’s possible together.

Dylan Babbs, Co-founder & CTO

We are hiring a Technical Operations Engineer to own the reliability, security, and scalability of our identity, endpoint, and IT infrastructure systems. You will work directly with our Engineering and Operations team to transform reactive IT support into proactive, automated systems that scale with our rapid growth.

This role is ideal for someone who sees IT operations as a strategic enabler of engineering velocity rather than just a support function. You will be based in our Union Square office, collaborating closely with colleagues in person and remotely across San Francisco, London, and Buenos Aires.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Triage and resolve technical issues with a focus on automation and continuous improvement

 - Manage and troubleshoot macOS devices and development environments at scale

 - Trace root causes across complex, multi-system failures, including Google Workspace, MDM, and AWS

 - Build runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and documentation that elevate team capabilities

 - Identify patterns in recurring issues and implement systematic fixes

 - Analyze downstream impacts before making changes and understand the blast radius of identity and access management decisions

 - Lead projects that address operational pain points such as device provisioning, access control, and compliance automation

 - Design self-service solutions that empower engineers to move faster

 - Translate technical issues for stakeholders across Engineering, People Ops, and Finance

 - Partner with security to implement and maintain compliance controls

 - Support rapid hiring by streamlining onboarding and provisioning processes

 - Mentor future IT team members on troubleshooting methodology and systems thinking




WHO YOU ARE

 - 2 or more years of experience in IT operations or technical support, ideally supporting engineering teams in high-growth SaaS or AI companies

 - Systems thinker who naturally traces dependencies and asks why something broke, not just how to fix it

 - Strong incident management skills including triage, root-cause analysis, and pattern recognition

 - Experience with identity management, single sign-on, and access control with Okta

 - Clear communicator who can explain complex technical issues to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders

 - Self-directed with strong judgment on when to escalate versus resolve independently

 - Expert troubleshooting across the Apple ecosystem, including MDM tools such as Mosyle

 - Advanced Google Workspace administration, including SAML or OIDC, lifecycle automation, and SCIM

 - Multi-cloud support experience with AWS as primary and familiarity with GCP or Azure

 - Network troubleshooting experience including DNS, VPNs, and routing

 - Scripting and automation skills using Python, TypeScript, or Bash for repetitive tasks and integrations

 - Experience with infrastructure as code and configuration management

 - Strong technical judgment and good taste across both software and hardware

 - Motivated by building the operational foundation for a company defining a new category

 - Comfortable with autonomy as an early technical operations hire and excited to shape how systems scale




LOCATION

This is an on-site role based in our NYC, San Francisco, BA office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact.

For our NYC or San Francisco office, the expected base salary range is $130,000 to $170,000. Comp can vary by location. Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring.

It measures what works and gets better every day.

We're looking for a Brand Designer to define and shape how Profound looks and feels across every channel, from campaigns and events to the visual systems that scale our brand as we grow.

This is a hands-on design role. The Brand Designer works closely with the Creative Director and Brand lead to shape the visual language of the brand, build the systems that make it scalable, and push it into new territory as Profound expands.

You'll sit on the marketing team and collaborate closely with content, demand gen, product, and leadership. You'll be the person in the room with a strong opinion on what the brand should look like, with the craft to back it up.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Define and evolve the visual brand. You will shape the look and feel of Profound across all brand touchpoints: campaigns, website, events, social, and beyond. You'll build the systems to get it there consistently.

Build flexible, scalable design systems. You'll create and maintain a brand design system that gives the broader team, including our Visual Designer, the building blocks to execute on-brand work at speed. Systems that hold up under pressure and leave room to push.

Design campaign creative. You'll work on visual direction for marketing campaigns from concept through execution, ensuring every asset, digital and physical, tells a coherent, compelling story about what Profound is and why it matters.

Shape brand experiences. From in-person conferences and events to OOH activations, you'll extend the brand into physical and experiential formats. You'll think about how the brand feels, not just how it looks.

Push the creative bar. You'll participate in design reviews alongside the Brand lead and Creative director, and be a visible standard-setter for craft across the marketing team. You'll make the work around you better.

Experiment and challenge. Profound's visual identity has room to grow. We want a designer who can bring their ideas to life and execute on them, and who is curious about where the brand could go next.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years of experience in brand design, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong visual identity work, not just execution

 - A clear, opinionated point of view on typography, color, layout, and composition, with the ability to defend creative decisions clearly

 - Experience building and maintaining brand systems that work across digital and physical formats

 - Proven ability to design campaign creative from concept through final delivery

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills: you work well with marketers, writers, and leadership, and you know how to align stakeholders without losing your creative conviction

 - Deep proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite

 - Comfort managing multiple workstreams in a fast-moving environment and making independent priority calls

 - A high bar for craft and the discipline to hold it under deadline pressure




BONUS POINTS

 - Motion design or animation experience

 - Experience designing for SaaS, martech, or data/AI products

 - Background in experiential or event design

 - Familiarity with AI tools in a creative workflow

What You’ll Do

 - Own inbound customer security reviews from start to finish: complete security questionnaires and respond to RFPs and RFIs accurately and within the timelines our sales cycles demand

 - Act as the security point of contact during the sales process, working alongside the sales team to unblock deals and answer prospective customers’ security and privacy questions directly and credibly

 - Build and maintain reusable answer libraries and templates so each customer’s security review goes faster than the last

 - Build and improve AI-assisted workflows that cut the manual effort on each questionnaire and audit, so the function scales as our volume grows

 - Answer buyers' AI-trust questions (training-data handling/retention, subprocessors, data residency, our stance on ISO/IEC 42001, the EU AI Act, and NIST AI RMF), and flag the right internal owner when something's outside your call

 - Flag recurring themes in customer questions, objections, and new requirements, and collaborate with Information Security, Product, and Legal to eliminate gaps and duplicate effort

 - Help shape the function from the ground up: design the processes, workflows, and standards that the team will need to operate globally

Who You Are

 - 1+ years of experience conducting customer-facing information security work or you come from a solutions engineering or sales engineering background

 - You are able to translate technical security and AI-governance controls into clear, customer-facing responses, exercising sound judgment about when to answer directly, when to add a caveat, and when to escalate

 - You can hold your own on calls when a prospect's security team challenges our answers, thinking on your feet while keeping the deal moving

 - You have real fluency in security and compliance. You're comfortable across frameworks like ISO 27001, ISO 42001, SOC 2, GDPR, and CCP

 - You are an avid user of AI tools. You already reach for AI in your daily work and are excited to use it to make security reviews faster and more consistent

 - You bring a customer-first mindset, sharp organization, and close attention to detail, even under tight deadlines

It is a plus if you also have experience with:

 - Contract negotiation across DPAs, MSAs, security exhibits, subprocessor agreements, BAAs, and SLAs

 - Working with procurement and/or legal teams

 - Vendor risk management. We are a vendor, and most of our customers run vendor risk assessments on us, so understanding both sides of that process goes a long way

postings.title: Engineering Manager - AI Product(100% Remote EMEA)
postings.descriptionText:
Location: Remote (Europe Time Zone)
Start date: ASAP
Language: English
Team: AI



ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is a European technology company operating a cloud and infrastructure platform, and we are looking for an AI Engineering Manager to lead the small, high-leverage team behind their AI product.

The Engineering Manager is to lead a team of AI engineers and researchers building the systems that power an AI-enabled products and the model inference offering. You’ll manage the people and the roadmap: hiring and developing a high-caliber team, setting technical direction alongside senior ICs, and driving delivery on projects that range from applied ML features inside the products to the infrastructure that serves models in production at scale.

This is a hybrid people/technical leadership role. You should be comfortable running a team day-to-day (1:1s, planning, performance, hiring) while also being comfortable enough technically to review designs, unblock research and engineering tradeoffs, and represent the team to other engineering and product leaders.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Manage, coach, and grow a team of AI/ML engineers and researchers, including hiring, career development, and performance management.

 - Own delivery for AI-enabling projects across the product portfolio, translating ambiguous product and research goals into scoped, sequenced engineering plans.

 - Co-own the roadmap and operations of the inference offering, including reliability, latency, cost, and scaling of model serving infrastructure.

 - Partner with research scientists to move promising models and techniques from experimentation into production, balancing research rigor with shipping velocity.

 - Set and maintain engineering standards for the team: code quality, experimentation practices, evaluation methodology, on-call, and incident response for production inference systems.

 - Work closely with Product, Infrastructure, and Data teams to prioritize work and remove cross-team blockers.

 - Report on team progress, risks, and capacity to engineering leadership, and represent the team’s work in planning and roadmap discussions.

 - Stay current on the AI/ML and inference landscape (models, serving frameworks, hardware) and bring relevant developments back to the team’s technical strategy.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 7+ years of experience in a technical leadership or engineering management role (AI/ML teams preferred), plus a strong prior track record as a hands-on engineer or researcher.

 - Proven experience building and operating AI/ML platform or inference infrastructure in production (model serving, GPU workloads, latency and cost optimization)

 - Working knowledge of the AI/ML lifecycle: model training or fine-tuning, evaluation, and production deployment.

 - Experience with, or strong technical fluency in, model inference and serving infrastructure (e.g., GPU scheduling, batching, quantization, latency/throughput tradeoffs, serving frameworks such as vLLM, Triton, or similar).

 - Demonstrated ability to manage both researchers and engineers, who often have different working styles, timelines, and definitions of “done.”

 - Strong judgment on scoping and sequencing ambiguous, research-adjacent projects into shippable increments.

 - Excellent communication skills; able to translate technical tradeoffs for both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Experience owning production systems, including reliability and incident response, is a plus.


WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS FOR YOU

 - Own a product, not a component: Lead the team behind the company's AI product and shape the capabilities the wider business builds on

 - High leverage, small team: With three engineers, your technical and strategic decisions translate directly into what ships

 - Grow as a leader: Manage, mentor, and inspire a talented team while influencing strategic technical decisions

 - Stay hands-on: Balance leadership with coding in a modern, high-scale AI platform environment

 - Work with cutting-edge technology: Deepen your expertise in LLMs, inference infrastructure, GPU compute, and distributed systems at scale

 - Drive platform evolution: Directly impact architecture, reliability, and AI quality across the organization

 - Collaborate across teams: Work closely with Product, Infrastructure, Security, and Backend teams, expanding your cross-functional expertise

 - Remote-first flexibility: Enjoy a fully remote role while aligning with the European time zone

Pragmatike is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants without discrimination. We recruit on behalf of our clients and prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. We are committed to a fair and inclusive hiring process. We process your personal data solely for recruitment purposes, in accordance with applicable privacy laws, and maintain reasonable safeguards to protect your information. Your data may be shared with our client(s) for hiring consideration, but will not be disclosed to third parties outside of the recruitment process.

FOUNDING TECH RECRUITER (FREELANCE)




ABOUT PRAGMATIKE

Pragmatike is on a mission to help early-stage startups, and scaelups — win the talent war and build exceptional tech teams.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Founding Tech Recruiter to build out our team as we embark on our next phase of growth. Someone smart — connected to the tech world — that moves, operates fast and efficiently — a superstar, a pirate. You'll operate as a strategic partner in the heart of the startup ecosystem, pioneering how we find, attract, and engage the world’s best talent.

 


WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

 - Shape the future of tech hiring: Engage directly with the startup and tech talent community, and become a visible advocate for Pragmatike.

 - Zero-to-one impact: Design the recruiting systems, processes, and standards from scratch, and partner with product and engineering to refine our hiring approach.

 - High leverage: Recruit across a variety of functions, from engineering to go-to-market, and see your impact on the business firsthand.

 


YOU’RE A FIT IF YOU…

 - Have 5+ years of experience recruiting for technical roles in-house or at a search agency

 - Are at ease in startup environments and thrive amid ambiguity, rapid iteration, and high growth

 - Communicate clearly—both written and verbally—and make every candidate feel valued

 - Are well-connected, respected by peers, and have a personal brand in the recruiting community (e.g., active LinkedIn, trusted network)

 - Care deeply about quality, processes, and candidate experience

 - Are excited to work flexibly—this role is fully remote and freelance-friendly

 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Previous experience recruiting at early-stage startups or high-growth tech companies

 - Familiarity with AI, SaaS, or B2B talent markets

 - Enjoy writing or speaking about recruiting, talent, or startup culture

 


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Flexible freelance contract with autonomy

 - Direct impact on company growth and culture

 - Opportunity to be Pragmatike’s first recruiter and shape our future

 - Fully remote work environment and flexible hours

 - Direct partnership with founders

 

Ready to shape the future of tech hiring at Pragmatike? Apply now and join us at the beginning of our journey. 🍜 🏴‍☠️

postings.title: Server Engineer (On-site Hong Kong)
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

Location: Hong Kong — Hybrid (factory floor, test lab and manufacturing sites; this is not a remote or desk-based role)
Start date: ASAP
Languages: Fluent English and fluent Mandarin are both mandatory
Industry: HPC / GPU Server Manufacturing / Sovereign Cloud Infrastructure

Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a European deep-tech company building a sovereign, energy-efficient alternative to traditional cloud providers. Unlike most cloud players, our client designs and manufactures its own HPC infrastructure end to end — chassis, boards and containerized units — and deploys it as the hardware layer of a vertically integrated AI cloud. The company is growing fast and is expanding its manufacturing and testing capability in Hong Kong.

Professional Background:

We're looking for a Server Engineer with hands-on GPU/HPC hardware experience who has tested and validated servers, not just operated them. You should be comfortable moving between the factory floor and the test lab, with a strong Linux background and real familiarity with firmware and GPU software stacks (CUDA, NCCL). You take ownership of quality: if a server ships, it is because you signed off on it.
Startup or hyper-growth experience is a strong plus. Autonomy, rigor and problem-solving are essential.

Your Responsibilities:

 - Own quality control across the client's manufacturing sites, on the factory floor.

 - Run the hardware test lab: board and system bring-up, validation and stress testing of new server builds.

 - Oversee the assembly and end-to-end testing of GPU servers before they are deployed into the client's sovereign cloud.

 - Define and maintain test procedures, acceptance criteria and QC checkpoints for chassis, boards and full systems.

 - Diagnose hardware, firmware and driver-level issues (BIOS/BMC, GPU firmware, PCIe, thermals, power) and drive root-cause analysis with the design and manufacturing teams.

 - Validate GPU compute and interconnect performance under Linux using CUDA, NCCL and related benchmarking tools.

 - Document failures, yields and test results, and feed findings back into hardware design and production processes.

 - Coordinate day to day with manufacturing partners and local suppliers in both English and Mandarin.

What You Bring:

 - Proven hands-on experience testing and validating GPU/HPC servers (bring-up, burn-in, validation), not only using them.

 - Strong Linux skills at the system and hardware level.

 - Firmware knowledge: BIOS/UEFI, BMC/IPMI, GPU and NIC firmware, flashing and troubleshooting.

 - Working knowledge of the NVIDIA GPU stack: drivers, CUDA, NCCL, and how to benchmark and diagnose multi-GPU systems.

 - Solid understanding of server hardware: motherboards, PCIe topology, power, cooling, storage and networking components.

 - Experience with QC or manufacturing test processes in a hardware production environment.

 - Fluent English and fluent Mandarin (both non-negotiable).

 - Willingness to work on-site in Hong Kong, on the factory floor and in the lab.

Nice To Have:

 - Experience with containerized or micro-datacenter deployments (power, thermal and environmental constraints).

 - Familiarity with high-speed interconnects (InfiniBand, RoCE, NVLink) and their validation.

 - Scripting skills (Bash/Python) to automate test sequences and reporting.

 - Exposure to hardware supply chains or contract manufacturers in Hong Kong / Southern China.

 - Cantonese.

Why Join Us:

Our client is one of the very few cloud companies that builds its own hardware from the board up. Their mission is to deliver a sovereign, energy-efficient, high-performance alternative to traditional cloud providers, and the servers you test and validate are the physical foundation of that platform.
Expect real ownership from day one, a fast-paced environment that values autonomy and problem-solving, and the chance to build something that doesn't exist yet.

Pragmatike• is dedicated to a fair, transparent, and inclusive recruitment process. We ensure that no applicant is discriminated against based on age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation. In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), your personal data will be processed lawfully, fairly, and securely. We collect and use your personal data solely for recruitment purposes, including sharing it with our client(s) for employment consideration. You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your data at any time. We are committed to maintaining the confidentiality and security of your information throughout the recruitment process.

postings.title: Embedded Systems & Cloud Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Location: Remote-First, South Korea (Seoul, Pangyo, Busan, Daejeon)
Employment: Full-Time
Start Date: ASAP
Experience: 4+ years
Language: Fluent English required, Korean or Mandarin is a strong plus
Industry: Robotics / Physical AI / IoT

 


ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of an early-stage, venture-backed Physical AI company building the data layer that robots need to operate in the real world.

Most robot training data today is vision-only. But grasping, inserting and handling objects depends on contact, force and slip, which cameras cannot see. Our client captures synchronized vision and touch data from real human work, using low-cost wearable sensing devices and cameras, and turns it into high-fidelity datasets used to train and evaluate robot manipulation models.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will own the full technical chain that makes data collection work in the field: from the firmware running on the sensing devices to the cloud pipelines that ingest, store and process the data at scale. You will work remotely as the technical owner of deployments in your region, collaborating closely with hardware, ML and data teams.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Firmware: Design, develop and maintain firmware for wearable sensing devices (microcontrollers, sensor integration, real-time data acquisition).

 - Device-to-cloud: Build reliable communication and data streaming between devices and cloud services for synchronized vision and tactile data.

 - Cloud infrastructure: Design and operate the AWS stack (EC2, S3, Lambda, IoT Core) handling large-scale collection, storage and processing of multimodal data, with a focus on scalability, security and performance.

 - Data pipelines: Develop APIs, ingestion services and data pipelines in Python for high-throughput, reliable processing.

 - Fleet & deployments: Remotely deploy, monitor and maintain the device fleet and capture setups used at real-world collection sites, and turn field issues into engineering fixes. Occasional travel to sites may be required.

 - Full-stack debugging: Troubleshoot issues across the whole chain, from device firmware to cloud deployment.

 - Collaboration: Work with hardware, ML and data teams to define system requirements, and contribute to testing, documentation and continuous improvement of the data collection infrastructure.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years of engineering experience across embedded systems and cloud.

 - Strong embedded and firmware skills: C/C++, RTOS, microcontrollers, real-time systems, sensor integration, low-level programming.

 - Hands-on AWS experience: EC2, S3, Lambda, IoT Core, and data pipelines built for high throughput and reliability.

 - Solid software engineering in Python or similar: APIs, data streaming services, hardware-to-cloud integration.

 - Good grasp of networking, security best practices, performance optimization, monitoring and logging.

 - Strong debugging skills across hardware, firmware and cloud layers, and comfort in fast-paced, experimental environments.

 - Strong ownership and the ability to work independently in a remote-first, distributed environment.

 - Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Fluent English. Korean or Mandarin is a strong plus.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with robotics, tactile or force sensing, wearables or IoT devices.

 - Experience building real-world data collection systems (sensor fusion, time synchronization, multi-camera capture).

 - Exposure to ML data pipelines or datasets for robot learning.

 - Experience deploying and supporting hardware in the field, including remote device management.




WHY JOIN

 - Join a very early team at the core of Physical AI, one of the fastest-growing fields in tech.

 - Own a critical system end to end, from device firmware to cloud.

 - Your work directly shapes the datasets used to train next-generation robot manipulation models.

 - High ownership, fast iteration and real-world impact from day one.

Pragmatike is committed to a fair, transparent, and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

In accordance with GDPR, your personal data will be processed lawfully, fairly, and securely and used solely for recruitment purposes, including sharing it with our client(s) for employment consideration.

À PROPOS DU POSTE

Pragmatike recrute pour le compte d’une entreprise technologique en forte croissance, orientée produit, qui développe des plateformes traitant d’importants volumes de données et utilisées à grande échelle sur plusieurs marchés. Son produit repose sur l’automatisation, l’extraction de données et des workflows intelligents, avec un fort accent mis sur la fiabilité du backend et la rapidité d’exécution.

Nous recherchons un(e) Full-Stack Engineer à dominante backend, capable de prendre en charge des fonctionnalités de bout en bout. Le poste est réparti à environ 70 % sur le backend et 30 % sur le frontend. Il convient particulièrement aux ingénieurs qui aiment travailler en profondeur sur le backend tout en restant proches du produit et de sa mise en production.




VOS MISSIONS

 - Concevoir, développer et maintenir des services backend en Python et Node.js

 - Prendre en charge les API, la logique métier et les flux de données s’appuyant sur PostgreSQL et MongoDB

 - Contribuer aux fonctionnalités frontend (environ 30 %) afin de proposer des expériences produit complètes

 - Développer et maintenir des pipelines de web scraping et d’ingestion de données, dans le respect des cadres légaux et éthiques applicables

 - Travailler efficacement avec des outils de développement assistés par l’IA (Cursor, Copilot, etc.)

 - Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes produit et engineering pour transformer les besoins en solutions évolutives

 - Améliorer les performances, la fiabilité et la maintenabilité des systèmes existants

 - Participer aux décisions techniques et aux discussions liées à l’architecture




PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

 - 4 ans d’expérience ou plus en Full-Stack Engineering ou Backend Engineering

 - Solide expérience backend avec Python et/ou Node.js

 - Bonne maîtrise de PostgreSQL et MongoDB

 - À l’aise pour intervenir ponctuellement sur des bases de code frontend

 - Expérience ou intérêt pour le scraping et les systèmes traitant d’importants volumes de données

 - Bonne connaissance des méthodes modernes de développement assisté par l’IA

 - Forte capacité à prendre des responsabilités et à travailler de manière autonome

 - Être basé(e) en Amérique latine




LES PETITS PLUS

 - Expérience en OCR, computer vision ou traitement de documents

 - Expérience sur des produits fortement orientés automatisation ou data

 - Expérience en startup ou scale-up




POURQUOI CE POSTE PEUT FAIRE ÉVOLUER VOTRE CARRIÈRE

 - Une forte autonomie sur des fonctionnalités directement mises en production

 - Un impact concret sur les systèmes backend au cœur du produit

 - Une exposition à l’automatisation, au scraping et aux workflows intelligents

 - Une utilisation quotidienne d’outils modernes de développement assisté par l’IA

 - De réelles possibilités d’évolution au sein d’une équipe engineering orientée produit




STACK TECHNIQUE

 - Backend : Python, Node.js

 - Bases de données : PostgreSQL, MongoDB

 - Frontend : Frameworks JavaScript modernes

 - Data : Scraping, pipelines d’ingestion

 - Atouts : OCR, computer vision




AVANTAGES

 - 100 % télétravail

 - Horaires de travail flexibles

 - Poste d’ingénieur avec un haut niveau d’autonomie





Pragmatike s’engage à garantir un processus de recrutement équitable, transparent et inclusif. Aucun candidat ne fait l’objet de discrimination fondée sur l’âge, le handicap, le genre, l’identité ou l’expression de genre, la situation matrimoniale ou le statut de partenaire civil, la grossesse ou la maternité, la race, la religion ou les convictions, le sexe ou l’orientation sexuelle.

Conformément au Règlement général sur la protection des données (RGPD), vos données personnelles sont traitées de manière légale, équitable et sécurisée. Nous collectons et utilisons vos données personnelles uniquement dans le cadre du processus de recrutement, notamment afin de les partager avec notre ou nos client(s) dans le cadre de l’étude de votre candidature. Vous disposez à tout moment d’un droit d’accès, de rectification ou de suppression de vos données.
