postings.descriptionText:
About WON

WON redesigns how a business works: what its customers experience on the outside, and how its operation runs  on the inside. We do that for retail and consumer brands, travel, hospitality, financial services, and private equity  portfolios. We are not a consultancy that separates the thinking from the doing, and we are not a platform  company with something to sell you. Those two halves are our two disciplines: Experience Intelligence and  Operational Intelligence.

This is not a social media job. We are not hiring someone to post content. We are hiring the person who will  design, operate, and continuously improve the AI-powered media engine behind WON, turning every founder  conversation, workshop, keynote, podcast, interview, and strategy session into a continuous stream of exceptional content across every major platform. The role sits inside Operational Intelligence and points that discipline at our  own operation.

AI gives exceptional people extraordinary leverage. It increases capacity, it does not replace judgment. That is the  bet this role is built on: the systems absorb the repetition, and your taste decides what is actually worth  publishing.

This role reports to the CEO and works directly with the technical team on the internal tooling behind the pipeline.



What You’ll Own

 - The complete content production lifecycle: capture, intake, AI-assisted production, review, publishing, and the searchable library where everything lands

 - Editorial judgment: which moments are worth cutting, which assets ship, and where the quality bar sits • Coordination of editors and creative resources, including review of every asset before it publishes

 - The measurement layer: production velocity, turnaround time, quality, and what the content actually does for audience and pipeline

 - Work with the technical team to design the internal tooling behind the pipeline: ingestion from Zoom, Google Meet, Riverside, Loom, etc, scoring of high-value moments, generation of titles, hooks, captions and platform-specific variations, routing through editing and approval, and scheduling across platforms

 - Build the quality checks that run before publication, so moving fast never means shipping something that doesn’t align with the company's point of view or quality standards.

 - Keep a prioritized list of what to automate next, with the manual cost of each item quantified, and bring it to the technical team as specific proposals rather than general frustration



How Success Is Measured

 - By day 30, every meaningful conversation enters a structured production pipeline

 - By day 60, production is predictable, measurable, and repeatable: volume and turnaround time are known  numbers rather than estimates

 - By day 90, WON consistently publishes more than 500 high-quality pieces of content a month

 - By month 12, a large share of the work you did by hand in your first month runs through AI-assisted workflows you helped design

 - Over time the capability compounds rather than resets: faster, more autonomous, and cheaper to run each  quarter, and durable enough to outlast any one person operating it



What You’ll Bring

 - Experience running a content or media operation end to end, in-house or agency, where you owned the  pipeline and not a single stage of it

 - Systems thinking evidenced by what you have built: a process you designed, documented, and then  measurably improved

 - Real fluency with AI tools in daily work rather than curiosity about them. You can describe a workflow you  rebuilt around AI and what it saved

 - Editorial judgment you can defend: you can articulate why a moment, a hook, or a cut is good, not just that it  feels good

 - Comfort operating with high ambiguity and little supervision, creating structure where none exists

 - Fluent written and spoken English, with the precision to work closely with both creative and technical  colleagues



Bonus points: hands on with OpusClip, Descript, Vizard, Submagic, CapCut or Canva; have used ClickUp,  Slack and Google Workspace as an operating environment, not just a place to keep notes; publishing and  scheduling at volume through Buffer, Metricool or similar; have specified or shipped an internal automation alongside an engineering team.



How We Work

 - We use AI to remove operational friction, not to create more of it. A system that costs more than it saves gets  killed, not defended

 - Experience with every tool is not required. The ability to master a new one quickly is

 - We care far more about how you think than what your resume says. Finalists may be asked to complete a paid project using real WON recordings

 - Compensation is $4,000 to $5,500 USD per month plus performance incentives tied to production volume,  quality, automation milestones, and audience growth

 - This is a founding role. The production capability you build becomes one of the firm’s durable operating assets, and you will have built it

 - If six months from now you are still doing the manual work you did in your first week, we will both know it went wrong. The role is designed to automate itself forward



Most companies use AI to work a little faster. If you are excited by the idea of building the capability that  produces the work, rather than simply producing the work, we would love to meet you.

SOBRE WON

WON rediseña cómo funciona un negocio: lo que sus clientes experimentan por fuera y cómo opera por dentro. Trabajamos con empresas de retail y consumo, travel, hospitality, financial services y portafolios de private equity.

Combinamos Experience Intelligence y Operational Intelligence. Este rol forma parte de Operational Intelligence y aplica ese enfoque a nuestra propia operación.

No buscamos a alguien para simplemente publicar contenido en redes. Buscamos a la persona que diseñará, operará y mejorará continuamente el AI-powered media engine de WON: un sistema que convierte conversaciones con founders, workshops, keynotes, podcasts, entrevistas y sesiones de estrategia en contenido de alta calidad para las principales plataformas.




LO QUE HARÁS

 - Serás responsable del ciclo completo de producción: captura, intake, producción asistida por AI, revisión, publicación y organización de la biblioteca de contenido.

 - Definirás el criterio editorial: qué momentos vale la pena convertir en contenido, qué assets se publican y cuál es el estándar de calidad.

 - Coordinarás editores y recursos creativos, revisando cada asset antes de su publicación.

 - Medirás velocidad de producción, turnaround time, calidad y el impacto del contenido en audiencia y pipeline.

 - Trabajarás directamente con el equipo técnico para diseñar el tooling interno del pipeline: ingestión desde Zoom, Google Meet, Riverside, Loom y otras fuentes; identificación de momentos de alto valor; generación de titles, hooks, captions y variaciones por plataforma; edición, aprobación y scheduling.

 - Crearás quality checks previos a publicación para mantener velocidad sin comprometer el punto de vista ni los estándares de WON.

 - Mantendrás una lista priorizada de oportunidades de automatización, cuantificando el trabajo manual que cada una puede eliminar y convirtiéndolo en propuestas concretas para el equipo técnico.




LO QUE BUSCAMOS

 - Experiencia gestionando una operación de content o media end-to-end, in-house o en agencia, siendo responsable del pipeline completo y no únicamente de una etapa.

 - Capacidad demostrada de systems thinking: procesos que hayas diseñado, documentado y mejorado de forma medible.

 - Experiencia real utilizando AI en el trabajo diario y capacidad para explicar workflows que hayas rediseñado con AI y el impacto obtenido.

 - Criterio editorial sólido, con capacidad para explicar por qué un momento, hook o cut funciona.

 - Comodidad trabajando con alta autonomía y ambigüedad, creando estructura donde todavía no existe.

 - Inglés escrito y hablado fluido, necesario para trabajar estrechamente con colegas técnicos y creativos internacionales.



Plus: experiencia práctica con OpusClip, Descript, Vizard, Submagic, CapCut o Canva; ClickUp, Slack y Google Workspace; publishing y scheduling a escala mediante Buffer, Metricool o herramientas similares; o experiencia especificando o desarrollando automatizaciones internas junto con un equipo de ingeniería.




CÓMO MEDIREMOS EL ÉXITO

30 días: toda conversación relevante entra en un production pipeline estructurado.

60 días: la producción es predecible, medible y repetible, con volumen y turnaround time conocidos.

90 días: WON publica consistentemente más de 500 piezas de contenido de alta calidad al mes.

12 meses: una parte significativa del trabajo manual inicial funciona mediante AI-assisted workflows que hayas ayudado a diseñar.

La capacidad debe seguir mejorando con el tiempo: más rápida, autónoma y eficiente, sin depender de una sola persona para operar el sistema.




CÓMO TRABAJAMOS

En WON usamos AI para eliminar fricción operativa, no para crear más. Si un sistema cuesta más de lo que ahorra, lo eliminamos.

No necesitas experiencia con cada herramienta. Buscamos capacidad para aprender rápidamente, buen criterio y la capacidad de construir sistemas que mejoren con el tiempo.

El proceso final puede incluir un paid project utilizando grabaciones reales de WON.

Compensación: USD $4,000–$5,500 mensuales + performance incentives vinculados a volumen de producción, calidad, hitos de automatización y crecimiento de audiencia.



Working arrangement: El rol comienza de forma remota. WON está explorando la posibilidad de construir un hub en Medellín a medida que el equipo crezca.



Este es un founding role. La capacidad de producción que construyas se convertirá en uno de los activos operativos duraderos de WON.

Si te interesa construir la capacidad que produce el trabajo —no solamente producir el trabajo— queremos conocerte.

postings.title: AI Strategist - Remote, LatAm
postings.descriptionText:
About WON

WON redesigns how a business works: what its customers experience on the outside, and how its operation runs on the inside. We do that for retail and consumer brands, travel, hospitality, financial services, and private equity portfolios. We are not a consultancy that separates the thinking from the doing, and we are not a platform company with something to sell you. Those two halves are our two disciplines: Experience Intelligence and Operational Intelligence.

The firm is built around senior practitioners. The people you meet are the people doing the work, and the people who find the opportunity stay to design it, build it, and optimize it. AI gives exceptional people extraordinary leverage. It increases capacity; it does not replace judgment.

This role sits in Operational Intelligence, the discipline that gets inside the workflows running a business and rebuilds how they work. We sell a program, not a point solution. We come into a business across a defined set of areas, often led by customer experience, marketing operations, and forecasting and inventory, benchmark how the business performs in each, and use the gap against that benchmark to show where the opportunity actually is. Then we execute across those areas over the life of the engagement. Your accounts today are retail and consumer brands with potential to expand.

 

This role reports to the AI Practices Lead. You are the primary point of contact on your accounts and run them independently, with the Practices Lead joining when a conversation is notable or a decision calls for it.

 

What You’ll Own

 - Running the program rather than a point solution. Clients buy a long-term engagement across our areas, not the one tool they got excited about, and expansion comes from delivering, reassessing what the business needs, and moving into the next area

 - Discovery led by those areas rather than by whatever the client raises first: benchmark how the business performs in each, and stay embedded through recurring touchpoints and their internal channels so you see the opportunity before they package it for you

 - The business case behind everything you scope: what it should move, by how much, what it costs us to deliver, and how we will know

 - Specifications precise enough for a specialist engineer or analyst to deliver against, direction of that delivery across concurrent projects, and adoption once it lands, because a system nobody uses is indistinguishable from a system nobody built

 

How Success Is Measured

 - Clients buy the program rather than the one tool they got excited about, and treat you as an operational and AI partner instead of a vendor contact

 - Work expands past the project that opened the account, because you found the next thing before the client thought to ask

 - Contractors execute from your direction without a second discovery pass or a rewrite of the spec

 - What you scope moves a number the business already tracks, and stays in use after launch

 - Several accounts run at once without quality, client trust, or margin slipping, and the AI Practices Lead is no longer the default path for discovery and scoping

 

What You’ll Bring

 - Startup experience, built or operated, and real comfort creating the playbook while delivering the work including owning a United States client relationship entirely remotely

 - Client-facing experience with the maturity to lead an executive conversation, tell a client something they are paying not to hear, and pull the conversation back to the business problem when they jump straight to the tactical

 - Deeply AI-native rather than a casual user, with AI-enabled tools, products, or workflows you have actually built. The bar is materially above vibe coding, and we will ask you to demo and walk us through an Applied AI case study project

 - Enough technical and analytical fluency to reason through agent systems, data connections, backend architectures, APIs, and implementation tradeoffs, even though you will not be the primary engineer. SQL/Python experience is valuable

 - You can read a P&L,explain how a Shopify or e-commerce business actually makes money, and build financial models

 

Bonus points: time inside a consumer or e-commerce brand on the operator side; published writing or talks on applied AI

 

How We Work

 - We don’t start by asking where AI can be deployed. We start with where value is being left in the business, and we build systems that make the business healthier rather than tools that make one team’s day slightly nicer

 - Insight has to become a shipped system. We work inside our clients’ businesses, not adjacent to them, and strategy that stops at the recommendation is half a job

 - You may own the whole arc: the relationship, the discovery, the business case, the direction of delivery, and the number at the end, with specialists on tap so your scope is not capped by what you can personally build

 - An early hire into the practice, so you shape the offering rather than inherit one, and saying no is part of that. A client asking for the wrong thing is a conversation, not an order

 - Probably not the right environment if you want a fixed scope, a predictable week, or distance from the outcome

 

If you want to write the recommendation and hand it off, this probably isn’t for you. If you want to work directly with clients, find the thing that is actually broken in their business, direct the people who fix it, and be held accountable for whether anything changed, we’d love to meet you.

HI 👋 I’M AIDAN, FOUNDER OF MAPLE.

At Maple https://maple.inc, we’re building AI agents that work for restaurants. These agents answer calls, take orders, book appointments, and handle real customer interactions over natural voice.



But our bigger mission goes deeper: we’re building automated ontologies that model how businesses actually operate — their services, workflows, constraints, and language — so our agents can adapt to them instantly. We meet businesses where they are, not where software wants them to be.



We have many customers, strong revenue growth, years of runway, and backing from world-class investors. I’ll share more once we meet.




WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

When a business signs with Maple, two things must happen:

 1. They must get live quickly.

 2. They must feel like we have their back.

This role sits at the intersection of onboarding and support. You will:

 - Guide new customers through setup

 - Handle live support when issues arise

 - Think quickly when edge cases happen

 - Communicate calmly when a restaurant owner has questions

 - Escalate to engineering clearly and precisely and implement solutions

We need someone who:

 - Thinks on their feet

 - Enjoys talking to business owners

 - Can gather context fast

 - Is comfortable with ambiguity

 - Takes ownership instead of waiting




WHAT YOU’LL DO


ONBOARDING

 - Run onboarding calls with new customers

 - Translate business operations into structured AI configurations

 - Identify gaps or unclear workflows and clarify them live

 - Ensure customers go live quickly and confidently


SUPPORT

 - Handle inbound support calls, texts, and emails

 - Troubleshoot real-time voice agent issues

 - Think creatively when things don’t follow the script

 - Gather complete context before escalating to engineering

 - Own issues end-to-end


SYSTEMS + FEEDBACK

 - Document cases clearly in Salesforce

 - Communicate tightly in Slack

 - Identify recurring friction points

 - Suggest improvements to tooling, onboarding flow, or documentation




WHO YOU ARE


OWNERSHIP MENTALITY

You think like an operator. You take initiative, care about outcomes, and feel energized by solving real problems.




RESPONSIVENESS

You operate with urgency and reliability. When something needs attention, you step in quickly and keep it moving.




GROWTH-MINDED

You enjoy learning, improving, and quickly implementing feedback. 




JOB REQUIREMENTS

 - Fluency in English (C1/C2), with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages

 - 2–5+ years in customer support, onboarding, or high-touch SaaS roles

 - Experience handling escalations and complex customer issues with professionalism, empathy, and sound judgment

 - Strong conversational ability (moderately extroverted, not robotic)

 - Quick thinker — you don’t default to “let me check on that”

 - Comfortable handling ambiguous or messy situations

 - Ability to stay calm, respectful, and solution-oriented in time-sensitive or high-pressure situations

 - Able to gather context when customers provide incomplete information

 - Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize effectively, manage multiple active cases simultaneously, and maintain accuracy under pressure


BONUS IF YOU:

 - Have worked with SMBs or local businesses

 - Have experience with Intercom, OpenPhone, Salesforce

 - Have supported technical products

 - Thrive in early-stage startup environments







HOW WE WORK

 - We optimize for leverage. That means great internal tooling, fast CI/CD, and code that scales across many customer types

 - We believe in deep ownership. Engineers here talk to users, design features, and ship fast

 - We value clarity over process. You’ll spend most of your day building, not waiting on decisions

 - We move in person. We’re a tight-knit team that moves fast and solves problems together




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary + meaningful equity

At Maple https://maple.inc, we’re building AI agents that work for restaurants. These agents answer calls, take orders, book appointments, and handle real customer interactions over natural voice.



But our bigger mission goes deeper: we’re building automated ontologies that model how businesses actually operate — their services, workflows, constraints, and language — so our agents can adapt to them instantly. We meet businesses where they are, not where software wants them to be.



We have many customers, strong revenue growth, years of runway, and backing from world-class investors. I’ll share more once we meet.




WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

When a business signs with Maple, two things must happen:

 1. They must get live quickly.

 2. They must feel like we have their back.

This role sits at the intersection of onboarding and support. You will:

 - Guide new customers through setup

 - Handle live support when issues arise

 - Think quickly when edge cases happen

 - Communicate calmly when a restaurant owner has questions

 - Escalate to engineering clearly and precisely and implement solutions

We need someone who:

 - Thinks on their feet

 - Enjoys talking to business owners

 - Can gather context fast

 - Is comfortable with ambiguity

 - Takes ownership instead of waiting




WHAT YOU’LL DO


ONBOARDING

 - Run onboarding calls with new customers

 - Translate business operations into structured AI configurations

 - Identify gaps or unclear workflows and clarify them live

 - Ensure customers go live quickly and confidently


SUPPORT

 - Handle inbound support calls, texts, and emails

 - Troubleshoot real-time voice agent issues

 - Think creatively when things don’t follow the script

 - Gather complete context before escalating to engineering

 - Own issues end-to-end


SYSTEMS + FEEDBACK

 - Document cases clearly in Salesforce

 - Communicate tightly in Slack

 - Identify recurring friction points

 - Suggest improvements to tooling, onboarding flow, or documentation




WHO YOU ARE


OWNERSHIP MENTALITY

You think like an operator. You take initiative, care about outcomes, and feel energized by solving real problems.




RESPONSIVENESS

You operate with urgency and reliability. When something needs attention, you step in quickly and keep it moving.




GROWTH-MINDED

You enjoy learning, improving, and quickly implementing feedback.

 - Fluency in English (C1/C2), with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages

postings.title: Senior AI Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT DUALENTRY

DualEntry is building the OS for finance.



Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.



In just 2 years we've raised $100M+ from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, Contrary and Google Ventures and earned the trust of customers from $5M ARR to publicly traded companies.



We hire outliers - people who have achieved difficult things, in their careers or beyond. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community.

 

 


WHERE YOU'LL CREATE IMPACT

 - Build!

 - Own AI features end-to-end - agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, and the production infrastructure that runs them at scale

 - Build the evaluation frameworks and experimentation loops that turn good models into reliable, production-grade systems

 - Apply LLMs to financial data - structured, high-stakes, and unforgiving - partnering with product and domain experts to push past what's been done in ERP before

 


WHAT SETS YOU UP FOR SUCCESS

 - Hardcore work ethic and high agency

 - 3+ years in a technical role with strong backend, API, and cloud infrastructure foundations

 - 2+ years shipping production AI systems with real users and real stakes - not research or prototypes

 - Hands-on with production LLM applications: RAG, agentic systems, or structured extraction

 - Proficient in Python, comfortable across the full stack

 


WHY YOU’LL THRIVE HERE

 - Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

 - You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

 - Your feedback shapes the product directly

 - High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations
   
    


MEET THE ENGINEERING TEAM

 - Ignacio https://www.linkedin.com/in/ignaciobrasca/ shaped the baseline of our integration framework from scratch in a single weekend, then spent most weekends - while coordinating the team - shipping what was never on the roadmap: webhooks, a search engine for millions of transactions, and Puma itself. Pure initiative, compounding.

 - Marcin https://www.linkedin.com/in/mkuzdowicz/ took a non-existent tax structure and built it end to end, setting the north star for how the team keeps improving it on top of it; modular and robust, always setting the bar for the rest.

 - Puhiza https://www.linkedin.com/in/puhiza-doci/ grew her team from one to full capacity, while owning our integration framework end to end; scaling it to support migrations, integrations, and bank connections. The queen of I/O on our platform.

 - Danylo https://www.linkedin.com/in/godspell33/ took ownership of our bank connection engine end to end and rebuilt it from scratch over a weekend.
   
    


HOW YOU OPERATE

 - Pragmatic: you like to move forward and make decisions based in reality (not theory). We don't debate if Cassandra has the most theoretical scalability - we use Postgres until it breaks

 - Hard working: 'You can work long, hard, or smart, but [here] you can't choose two out of three' - Jeff Bezos.

 - Curious: you love to learn, are highly curious about new frameworks and solutions to engineering problems

 - Fast-moving: you deploy daily, iterate quickly, and never wait for permission
   
    


BENEFITS & COMPENSATION

 - Equity: $45,000 - $65,000

 - Base salary: $140,000 - $200,000

 - Remote-first team - the fastest team you will have ever worked with

 - Home internet, co-working space & office setup support

 - Flexible PTO (27 days incl. public holidays)

 - Unlimited AI token usage

 - AI skills development & enablement

 - Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

 - Visa sponsorship and relocation support for a move to NYC (after 2 years’ tenure)

 - In-person team meetups (our last ones: Lisbon, Vienna, Warsaw, Cyprus, and more!)

 

“Join us to fix the boring, think the hard, and build the impossible, so we become the most robust engineering platform for accounting the world has ever seen.”

Ignacio Brasca, https://www.linkedin.com/in/ignaciobrasca/ Head of Engineering at DualEntry

Location: Remote – Latin America
Employment Type: Full-Time



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an Instructional Designer to help shape and build engaging, practical, and scalable learning experiences within our learning management system (LMS), Docebo.

This role is an opportunity to help define not only how courses are built, but also what great learning should look like across the organization. You will work closely with subject matter experts and internal stakeholders to transform knowledge, processes, and business needs into clear, engaging, and effective learning experiences.

The ideal candidate combines strong instructional design fundamentals with a modern approach to digital learning, including interactive content, assessments, multimedia, learner engagement, and emerging AI-powered learning tools.




WHAT YOU’LL DO




LEARNING & INSTRUCTIONAL DESIGN

 - Design and develop engaging online courses and learning experiences using instructional design best practices.

 - Translate complex information, processes, and subject matter expertise into clear, learner-friendly content.

 - Apply instructional design methodologies such as ADDIE, backward design, adult learning principles, and/or other relevant frameworks.

 - Define learning objectives, course structures, lesson plans, assessments, activities, and learning paths.

 - Design learning experiences that are practical, relevant, and connected to real-world job responsibilities.

 - Develop different types of learning experiences, including microlearning, self-paced courses, knowledge checks, scenario-based learning, and interactive activities.

 - Ensure content is clear, accessible, engaging, and appropriate for the target audience.

 - Build, configure, and maintain courses within the Docebo LMS.

 - Organize course structures, learning paths, training materials, assessments, and learner activities.

 - Explore and leverage Docebo’s content creation and AI-powered capabilities to improve the speed and quality of course development.

 - Use multimedia, interactive elements, assessments, and other available tools to create engaging learning experiences.

 - Evaluate existing courses and recommend improvements to content, structure, learner experience, and engagement.

 - Maintain consistency in course design, instructional standards, terminology, and branding across the learning library.

Docebo currently supports AI-assisted course creation, interactive lessons, assessments, translation, voiceover, and learner data that can be used to continuously improve courses. LEARNING STRATEGY & VISION

 - Identify opportunities to make learning more personalized, practical, and embedded into the learner’s workflow.

 - Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals and translate them into measurable learning outcomes.

 - Recommend new approaches, technologies, and learning formats that can improve learner engagement and knowledge retention.

 - Help develop a scalable learning framework that can grow with the organization.


COLLABORATION & CONTENT DEVELOPMENT

 - Partner with subject matter experts to gather, organize, validate, and transform knowledge into learning content.

 - Incorporate learner and stakeholder feedback into ongoing course improvements.




MEASUREMENT & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

 - Monitor course engagement, completion, assessment results, and other relevant learning metrics.

 - Use learner data and feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.

 - Evaluate whether learning experiences are achieving their intended outcomes.

 - Continuously iterate on courses based on learner behavior, business needs, and performance data.

 - Help connect learning outcomes to broader business and workforce objectives.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience designing and developing online or digital learning experiences.

 - Hands-on experience with an LMS; Docebo experience is highly preferred.

 - Strong understanding of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies.

 - Experience developing learning objectives, assessments, activities, and structured learning paths.

 - Strong writing, editing, and content-organization skills.

 - Ability to take complex information and turn it into simple, engaging, and actionable learning content.

 - Experience working with subject matter experts and cross-functional stakeholders.

 - Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

 - Ability to manage multiple projects and work independently in a remote environment.

 - Curiosity about emerging technologies, AI, and their impact on learning and workforce development.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with tools such as Articulate Storyline, Articulate Rise, Adobe Captivate, or similar e-learning authoring platforms.

 - Experience creating video-based learning, microlearning, simulations, or scenario-based training.

 - Experience with SCORM or other e-learning standards.

 - Experience using learning analytics to improve course effectiveness.

 - Experience designing AI literacy, technology, or professional skill

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Platform Support Specialist to join our team and support users and creators across a growing digital platform.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for helping users resolve account, access, feature, and transaction-related issues quickly and effectively. You’ll also play an important role in identifying recurring problems, improving support resources, and providing actionable feedback to Product, Engineering, QA, and Trust & Safety teams.

YOUR FIRST 12–18 MONTHS

 - Consistently meeting agreed response, resolution, and case-quality targets.

 - Reducing aged cases and repeat contacts over time.

 - Maintaining accurate and useful help-center content for common user issues.

 - Providing recurring, actionable feedback on user and creator pain points.

 - Helping establish and improve support processes and procedures.

 - Contributing to a reliable, safe, and responsive experience as the platform grows.




CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own account, access, feature, and transaction-related inquiries from initial contact through resolution.

 - Escalate product defects to QA and Engineering with clear, actionable information.

 - Escalate safety-related concerns to the appropriate Trust & Safety team.

 - Keep users informed throughout the resolution process.

 - Follow established support procedures, account-verification processes, and data-protection practices.

 - Maintain and improve help-center articles, internal documentation, and response guidance.

REQUIREMENTS & COMPETENCIES

 - Excellent case management and organizational skills.

 - Experience working with ticketing or customer support systems.

 - Experience troubleshooting web and mobile applications.

 - Familiarity with support metrics and service-quality standards.

 - Ability to work a defined full-time support schedule.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience supporting payments or transaction-related issues, including Stripe.

FIRST 90 DAYS

Days 1–30:

Days 31–60:
 Independently manage an assigned support queue while consistently meeting agreed quality and service targets.

Days 61–90:
 Improve guidance for recurring issues and deliver a prioritized report highlighting key user friction points and opportunities for improvement.




COLLABORATION

You’ll work closely with the Platform Support Lead and collaborate with QA, Engineering, Product, and Trust & Safety teams.

This is an individual contributor role with direct responsibility for user support and case resolution.




WHY JOIN?

Join a growing product team where your work directly impacts the user experience. You’ll have the opportunity to become a strong advocate for users and creators while helping transform their feedback and recurring issues into meaningful product and process improvements.

About the role

We're hiring a B2B SEO Content Strategist to own and grow organic as a predictable revenue channel for Scale Army. This isn't a "manage the blog" role. You'll build and execute the strategy that turns organic — SEO, AEO, social, content, and whatever channels make sense — into a consistent source of pipeline. You've done this before. You know what it takes. And you're ready to make this brand yours.

 
 

The right team and structure to grow

You won't be building in a vacuum. You'll be joining a marketing team that already has the pieces in place — a social media manager, a CRO team, a growth team with paid media buyers, video production, and design capabilities. You'll have access to AI experts within the organization, and we work with external agencies and freelancers when the work calls for it.

The expectation is that you come in, take ownership, and use what's available to move fast. As the channel grows, the structure around it grows with it — and so does your role within it.

 
 

What you'll own

 - Organic as a Revenue Channel: Build and execute a strategy that makes organic a predictable, measurable contributor to pipeline — not just traffic. Set targets, own the roadmap, and report on what's moving the needle. Blog, SEO, social, webinars, newsletters — the channel mix is yours to define.

 - SEO + AEO — Deep Expertise Required. This is a core part of the role, not a checkbox. You'll own keyword strategy, content architecture, on-page and off-page SEO, and — critically — AI Engine Optimization: structuring content to rank and appear in AI-generated answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and what comes next). You know how LLMs crawl and cite content, and you build accordingly.

 - Content Strategy and Execution: Set editorial standards and own the content calendar across blog, SEO, and social. Write, review, and edit — you lead by doing. You don't need to be a social media specialist, but you know enough to guide the channel strategically and elevate whoever is executing it.

 - Conversion and Channel Alignment: Work with the CRO team to optimize conversion across organic traffic. Partner with paid media to amplify what's working organically. Ensure content is aligned with landing page messaging and funnel goals.

 - AI-Powered Workflows You use AI every day — not occasionally. You know how to prompt well, build efficient workflows, evaluate new tools critically, and implement what actually moves the needle. You'll bring this to the team and raise everyone's output.

 
 

What we're looking for

Experience 5+ years in content marketing, with at least 2 years in a senior role. Proven track record of growing organic traffic and turning it into a pipeline in a B2B or SaaS context. Deep, hands-on SEO and AEO expertise — not just familiarity. Experience owning and growing multiple organic channels end-to-end

Tools

We have our preferred tools, but we're open to yours.

 - AI content & workflow building: You've gone beyond prompting. You've used tools like Jasper, Ocoya, or similar for content production, and you've built actual workflows using Make, n8n, or Zapier — automating pipelines, not just connecting apps.

 - Mindset Ownership mentality — you treat the channel like it's your business. High standards for quality without sacrificing speed. Comfortable operating with ambiguity and building from scratch, You've done this before, and you're ready to do it again, better

This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

 

You build production agent systems that run themselves. Not prompts, loops. Not a single assistant, a coordinated swarm.

The role:
We build and ship agent platforms that do real work in production. This role is for an engineer who designs self-running agent loops and multi-agent swarms, not someone who tweaks prompts one turn at a time. You will own systems that find work, do it, verify it, and report back, with humans at the gates rather than in every iteration.
This is a hands-on, ship-first engineering role. You write production code other engineers trust, and you treat agents as software systems that need triggers, budgets, stop conditions, verification, and observability like any other.

What we mean by loop engineering: designing an agent system as a control loop with an explicit trigger, scope, action, budget, stop condition, and report, plus a verifier that can reject bad work, so it runs unattended and knows when to stop or hand back to a human. Not a bigger prompt. A system that prompts the agents for you.
What we mean by swarm agents: a coordinated fleet of specialized agents (planner, builder, reviewer, verifier, scout, coordinator) with file and task ownership, shared state, quality gates, and clean handoffs, run by an orchestrator rather than one do-everything assistant.



What you'll do

 - Design self-running loops. Define the trigger, scope, action, budget, stop condition, and reporting so an agent runs unattended, stays inside cost and iteration limits, and knows when it is done versus when to escalate.

 - Build multi-agent swarms. Orchestrator plus specialized agents with clear file and task ownership, shared state or a shared mailbox, quality gates between stages, and handoffs that do not step on each other.

 - Make verification first-class. Build the part of the system that can say no: the checks, evals, and reviewer agents that catch confident mistakes before they merge. A loop is only as trustworthy as its ability to check its own work.

 - Own agent state and memory. Persistent on-disk state and per-turn context assembly so long-running tasks survive restarts and the system does not forget what the repo already knows.

 - Ship the platform around the agents. APIs, services, queues, and integrations in TypeScript and Node, deployed to AWS, with real tests, tracing, and observability for long multi-iteration runs.

 - Keep humans in the loop where it counts. Plan approval and pull request review, and active management of comprehension debt so the team understands what the swarm ships, not just that it shipped.
   
   

What we're looking for

 - Strong engineering fundamentals. 5+ years writing production software that other engineers depend on. (Adjustable; we care more about what you have shipped than the number.)

 - Hands-on loop engineering. You have designed agent loops with explicit stop conditions, budgets, retries, and self-verification. You can explain the difference between a task on repeat and a real loop, and you know why the verifier matters as much as the maker.

 - Multi-agent or swarm experience. You have built or operated systems where multiple agents coordinate: orchestration, handoffs, shared state, ownership or locking, and quality gates.

 - Fluency with modern agent tooling. Claude Code or Codex style agents, sub-agents, persistent memory and skills files, tool and function calling, MCP, and reason-act-observe loop patterns.

 - Solid TypeScript and Node. Comfort with a service framework (NestJS or similar) and a typed data layer (Prisma or similar).

 - Cloud and delivery. AWS (ECS or Fargate or similar), Docker, and CI/CD. You can take something from repo to production yourself.

 - A verification mindset. You treat "done" as a claim to be proven, and you build the checks that prove it.
   
   

Nice to have

 - Running 10+ parallel agents and managing token and cost budgets at scale

 - Distributed systems, queues, and event-driven design

 - React for agent-facing interfaces

 - Prior work on developer tooling, orchestration frameworks, or internal agent platforms

 - Familiarity with where loop engineering is heading next, including continual learning systems

 - SOC 2 or ISO 27001 awareness for handling client data
   
   

How we work

 - Plan, approve, execute. Agents propose, a human approves the plan, agents build, a senior reviews every pull request before merge.

 - Small loops over big prompts. We design systems that discover work, do it, check it, and report, while we watch instead of type.

 - Ship. Bias to production. Working software in front of users beats a perfect design doc.

 - Direct and concise. Strong opinions, loosely held. Say the hard thing early.



What success looks like in 90 days

 - You have shipped at least one self-running loop into production with a verifier the team trusts.

 - You have extended or hardened a multi-agent workflow with clear ownership and quality gates.

 - You have improved observability or cost control on an existing agent system so we can debug and trust long runs.



Tech environment
TypeScript, NestJS, React, Turborepo monorepo, Prisma, AWS ECS Fargate, Docker, GitHub Actions. Agent layer built on Claude and Claude Code patterns, MCP, sub-agents, and persistent memory.

postings.title: Technical Account Executive
postings.descriptionText:
This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

 

Scale Army is a staffing agency dedicated to connecting international talent with US-based companies. We cover a broad range of positions and industries, from customer support and sales roles to engineering and executive-level positions.

 


ROLE INTENT

We're filling an internal role, and we're looking to hire an Account Executive to turn inbound interest into signed clients for our engineering staffing and technical hiring solutions.

Our AEs are slammed. Demand is high. We need more closers.

We help companies hire:

 - Software Engineers

 - QA Engineers

 - DevOps / Cloud Engineers

 - Data Engineers

 - Technical operators

Most leads already know they need help.

Your job is to understand their technical hiring challenges, guide the conversation, and close the deal.

You will speak with:

 - CEOs

 - Founders

 - CTOs

 - Heads of Engineering

 - Technical operators

Your job is to make technical leaders feel safe, confident, and excited about building teams with us — and then get them to sign.

You report to the Sales Manager and work closely with the CEO and senior sales leadership.

You are evaluated on revenue generated, not activity completed.

 


THIS IS NOT A TYPICAL SALES ROLE

You will not:

 - Cold call

 - Build lead lists

 - Run outbound campaigns

You will:

 - Think

 - Ask smart questions

 - Advise

 - Challenge assumptions

 - Close deals

This is consultative selling, not order-taking.

 
 


WHO YOU TALK TO ALL DAY

Your buyers are typically:

 - CTOs

 - Heads of Engineering

 - Technical founders

 - CEOs of SaaS and tech-enabled companies

They come to us because:

 - Hiring engineers is slow and expensive

 - Their roadmap is blocked

 - Their team is overloaded

 - They need to scale quickly

They know the pain.

They don’t always know the best solution.

You help them figure that out.

 
 


WHAT YOU OWN

You own the journey from:

First call → Signed engagement letter

You are responsible for:

 - Running discovery calls

 - Guiding hiring strategy conversations

 - Handling objections and concerns

 - Creating urgency and momentum

 - Closing deals

You do not “support revenue.”

You create revenue.

 
 


CORE RESPONSIBILITIES





RUN HIGH-QUALITY DISCOVERY CALLS

 - Lead conversations with technical buyers

 - Ask smart questions about:
   
   - Engineering roadmap
   
   - Current team structure
   
   - Hiring challenges
   
   - Delivery bottlenecks

 - Diagnose what they actually need (often different from what they think)

A client may ask for “a senior developer.”

You may help them realize they actually need:

 - Two mid-level engineers

 - A QA engineer first

 - DevOps before backend

 - Or a technical project manager

You are expected to win those debates.

 


TECHNICAL HIRING STRATEGY CONVERSATIONS

You will regularly discuss roles such as:

 - Backend / Frontend / Full-Stack Engineers

 - QA Engineers

 - DevOps / Cloud Engineers

 - Data Engineers

 - Technical Project Managers

You don’t need to code.

But you must understand:

 - How engineering teams are structured

 - When companies need specific roles

 - How technical hiring impacts delivery speed

We will quiz you on this.

 


CLOSE DEALS

 - Guide prospects toward signing engagement letters

 - Handle objections confidently and calmly

 - Create urgency without being pushy

 - Maintain momentum from call to close

Your calendar turns into revenue.

 
 


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 


FIRST 60–90 DAYS

 - Running calls confidently

 - Demonstrating strong technical hiring knowledge

 - Closing your first deals

 - Building pipeline momentum


6–12 MONTHS

 - Consistent deal flow

 - Strong close rate

 - Reliable revenue contribution

 - Trusted voice on improving the sales process

 


IDEAL BACKGROUND

This role is designed for someone who:

 - Has sold technical services, SaaS, or developer-focused products

 - Has worked around engineering or product teams

 - Is naturally outgoing and fast-talking

 - Enjoys persuading and debating

 - Thrives in fast-moving environments

You should already be familiar with concepts like:

APIs / Cloud / DevOps / Agile / SaaS / Tech roadmaps.

If these sound unfamiliar, this role is not a fit.

 


REQUIREMENTS

 - 2+ years in Account Executive or Account Management roles

 - Experience selling to technical buyers or SaaS companies

 - Exceptional communication and persuasion skills

 - Excellent English skills

 - Comfortable working US East Coast hours (9am–6pm EST)

 - Comfortable using Google Sheets (we will test this live)

All applications must be submitted in English.

 
 


PERSONALITY FIT

You will love this role if:

 - You speak quickly

 - You think quickly

 - People naturally like you

 - You enjoy high-energy teams

 - You like turning conversations into outcomes

If you want a slow, quiet sales environment, this is not the role.

 

If you want to:

 - Talk to founders and CTOs all day

 - Help companies ship faster

 - And get paid for closing deals

We'd love to meet you


APPLICATION PROCESS:


TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE THESE STEPS NEED TO BE FOLLOWED:

 - Fill in the application form

 - Record a video showcasing your skill sets

postings.title: Technical Sales Manager
postings.descriptionText:
This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

 

Client Overview: Our client is seeking an experienced and strategic Sales Manager to lead and grow our team of Account Executives (AEs). This role is responsible for overseeing day-to-day inbound sales operations, training and mentoring the AE team, implementing new sales campaigns/strategies, auditing sales calls, and ensuring accurate CRM management.

The Sales Manager is fully accountable for the sales team hitting its revenue goals, conversion targets, activity standards, and overall sales performance. This person owns the number, identifies what is blocking performance, and is responsible for fixing the people, process, training, systems, or execution gaps required to hit the target.

The Sales Manager acts as both a leader and a hands-on contributor when needed, stepping into calls for strategic opportunities and large accounts when necessary.



Location: Fully Remote (Work from Home), 9 AM – 5 PM EST

 
 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Team Leadership & Development

 - Own AE performance management, including scorecards, call coaching, reviews, and development plans.

 - Set clear individual goals for each AE and hold the team accountable to revenue, conversion, pipeline, activity, and CRM standards.

 - Train, mentor, and grow the AE team to ensure consistent skill development and high performance.

 - Identify individual AE underperformance early and create clear coaching or performance plans to improve results.

 - Turn top-performing AE behaviors into repeatable team-wide best practices.

 - Approve PTO requests and manage scheduling for inbound sales personnel.

 - Monitor and manage AE calendars to ensure proper coverage, optimal scheduling, and time management.

 - Conduct retroactive post-mortem reviews/trainings of sales calls for continuous improvement.

Revenue Ownership & Goal Achievement

 - Own the inbound sales revenue target and ensure the team consistently meets or exceeds monthly and quarterly goals.

 - Take full responsibility for diagnosing why the team is ahead, behind, or on track against goal.

 - Build and manage the sales operating rhythm required to hit target, including daily performance reviews, weekly pipeline reviews, call audits, coaching sessions, and conversion analysis.

 - Track team and individual performance against core KPIs including close rate, average deal size, gross margin, follow-up completion, pipeline value, and revenue closed.

 - Create action plans when the team is pacing behind goal and proactively communicate risks, blockers, and solutions to leadership.

 - Ensure every AE understands their target, current performance, performance gaps, and exact next steps to improve.

Campaign & Strategy Execution

 - Collaborate with marketing and outbound teams to implement new promotions, campaigns, and product rollouts.

 - Own the sales team’s execution of new campaigns and ensure AEs are trained, prepared, and held accountable for proper follow-up and conversion.

 - Provide strategic input on promotions, lead qualification processes, and new campaign initiatives.

 - Analyze campaign performance from a sales perspective, including lead quality, conversion rate, objections, close rate, and revenue generated.

Sales Operations & Performance Oversight

 - Audit daily sales calls/transcripts, and CRM entries to ensure quality and accuracy.

 - Monitor AE pipeline management, ensuring consistent and accurate reporting in CRM systems.

 - Identify bottlenecks and areas for improvement in inbound processes, workflows, and sales techniques.

 - Run weekly pipeline reviews to ensure deals are moving properly, next steps are clear, and no qualified opportunities are being missed.

 - Own sales forecasting and provide leadership with clear visibility into expected revenue, pipeline health, risks, and performance trends.

 - Ensure HubSpot reflects accurate real-time data across deal stages, lead sources, close probability, notes, next steps, and revenue reporting.

 - Review lost deals, stalled opportunities, and low-converting lead sources to identify patterns and fix root causes.


AI, AUTOMATION & SALES ENABLEMENT

 - Use AI and automation to improve sales performance, AE productivity, call quality, follow-up execution, and reporting.

 - Identify repetitive sales workflows that can be automated or improved through HubSpot workflows, AI tools, dashboards, call review systems, or enablement resources.

 - Build and maintain sales enablement assets including call scripts, objection-handling guides, discovery frameworks, follow-up templates, sales playbooks, and qualification guides.

 - Continuously improve the tools (AE scorecard), systems, and resources that help AEs close more deals and operate more consistently.

Sales SOPs & Process Optimization

 - Build, document, and maintain comprehensive Sales SOPs for AE inbound processes.

 - Continuously iterate and improve SOPs based on team performance, feedback, and new initiatives.

 - Roll out new initiatives, such as outbound outreach campaigns and follow-up sequences to nurture old pipelines, revive leads, and/or optimize conversion rates.

 - Continuously test and improve scripts, qualification criteria, sales sequences, objection handling, offers, and closing strategies to increase conversion rates.

 - Ensure alignment with leadership and adoption of new processes across the team with clear guidance and training.


HIRING, INTERVIEWING & TEAM SCALING

 - Interview, assess, and evaluate AE candidates through structured interviews, role plays, mock calls, and sales scenario exercises.

 - Partner with leadership or recruiting to identify when the team needs additional headcount, replacement hires, or role changes based on quota coverage and performance needs.

 -

Our client is a fast-growing transportation company dedicated to providing reliable, safe, and efficient services across multiple industries. As the company continues to expand, they are seeking a Healthcare Recruiter to manage and optimize the hiring process, ensuring qualified candidates are efficiently identified, screened, and moved through the recruitment pipeline while supporting the organization's continued growth.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The Healthcare Recruiter will be responsible for managing the full recruitment lifecycle, including Applicant Tracking System (ATS) administration, candidate sourcing and screening, outbound candidate outreach, interview coordination, and recruitment process management. The Healthcare Recruiter will collaborate with hiring managers to ensure an organized, efficient, and positive hiring experience while maintaining accurate candidate records and supporting the company's talent acquisition goals. This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, proactive, and experienced in high-volume recruiting and ATS management.




LOCATION

Fully Remote | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


APPLICANT TRACKING SYSTEM (ATS) MANAGEMENT

 - Set up, maintain, and optimize the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

 - Import candidate information from spreadsheets and ensure records remain accurate and organized.

 - Track job postings, candidate activity, and recruitment progress throughout the hiring process.

 - Maintain a clean and organized candidate database.
   
   


CANDIDATE OUTREACH & SCREENING

 - Conduct outbound calls to follow up with applicants and move them through the recruitment process.

 - Screen candidates to evaluate qualifications, experience, and overall fit.

 - Answer candidate questions and communicate next steps throughout the hiring process.

 - Maintain a positive candidate experience through timely communication.
   
   


JOB POSTING & RECRUITMENT COORDINATION

 - Manage and maintain job postings across multiple hiring platforms.

 - Screen resumes, application responses, and initial candidate information.

 - Coordinate interviews and facilitate communication between candidates and hiring managers.

 - Support candidates through each stage of the hiring process.
   
   


RECRUITMENT OPERATIONS

 - Maintain consistent communication with candidates regarding application status.

 - Schedule interviews, callbacks, and recruitment activities.

 - Track recruitment metrics and hiring progress.

 - Support continuous improvements to recruitment workflows and hiring efficiency.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS


EXPERIENCE

 - 2+ years of experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, or human resources.

 - Experience managing Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).

 - Experience importing and organizing candidate data within an ATS.

 - Experience conducting candidate screening and outbound recruiting calls.

 - Experience coordinating interviews and managing recruitment pipelines.

 - Experience supporting high-volume recruiting environments is preferred.
   
   


SKILLS

 - Strong proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).

 - Strong organizational and time management skills.

 - Strong outbound calling and candidate engagement skills.

 - Excellent candidate screening and interviewing abilities.

 - Ability to manage multiple job openings and recruitment priorities simultaneously.

 - Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy.

 - Self-motivated with the ability to work independently.

 - Strong problem-solving and relationship-building skills.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - The Applicant Tracking System remains organized, accurate, and up to date.

 - Qualified candidates are efficiently screened and advanced through the hiring pipeline.

 - Candidates receive timely, professional communication throughout the recruitment process.

 - Hiring goals are achieved while maintaining high candidate quality and positive hiring experiences.

 - Recruitment processes become increasingly efficient through strong organization and follow-through.
   
   


OPPORTUNITY

This is an exciting opportunity to join a rapidly growing transportation company and play a critical role in scaling its workforce. As the Healthcare Recruiter, you'll help build high-performing teams by managing recruitment operations, improving hiring processes, and ensuring top talent is identified and hired efficiently.

You own the middle of that journey — the paid, human, in-the-room part. Everything upstream (prospecting, qualification, the diagnosis build) feeds you; everything downstream (the pod, the delivery) depends on what you sold being true.  - Run the close with the account executive as your wingman: you own the narrative and the ask; they own the relationship history and the paperwork.

 - Hold the core-versus-custom discipline: roughly 70% of every Intensive is our fixed, reusable core taught the same way every time; 30% is this client. Paid acquisition drives most of Scale Army's growth. We invest over $80K/month and plan to increase that investment if the results earn it. You'll own how that growth happens: the strategy behind the spend, the offers and funnels it sends traffic to, and how each dollar turns into qualified pipeline.

Running campaigns yourself is part of the job, and you need to be excellent at it. But it's only one part. You'll also decide where budget goes, craft and build lead magnets, offers, and the landing pages paid traffic converts on, work with Sales on lead quality, and be the team's go-to person for what's driving growth and where to invest next.

You'll be measured on business outcomes, not platform metrics: meetings held, SQLs, pipeline quality, and what each one costs.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Growth strategy and numbers. You'll own the full funnel that paid feeds, from spend to conversion, MQLs, meetings held, SQLs, and pipeline. You'll know our marketing CAC by channel and product line, where the funnel leaks, and what more spend will realistically return. Before we commit to $150K/month, you'll forecast what it will deliver. Once you deliver on it, you'll get more budget to spend.



Offers and conversion funnels. You'll decide what paid traffic is sent to: which offers and lead magnets we run, how they're positioned, and which landing pages and funnel paths we test. You'll set the testing roadmap and the hypotheses behind it, you’ll work with our  CRO to build and execute the tests, and you'll be accountable for whether they turn into qualified pipeline.



Budget allocation. Spend increases are gated by efficiency. You'll decide when a channel, campaign, or offer has earned more budget and when it needs to be pulled back, and you'll explain those calls with data.



Paid media execution. You'll build, launch, and optimize campaigns yourself across 2–3 product lines. Meta is our main channel, and you need to be an expert operator there. You'll also turn Google, LinkedIn, X, CTV, and other channels into real contributors.



Creative direction. We have an in-house team of creative strategists, designers, video editors, and copywriters. You own what runs and why: the hypotheses, the testing roadmap, and the feedback loop that shows the team what converts.



Revenue alignment. You'll work closely with Sales, Sales Ops, and Marketing Ops on offline conversions, HubSpot attribution, and lead quality. You'll push back on targeting and ICP assumptions when the data says we're wrong.



An AI-native way of working. At Scale Army, AI is central to how we work, not a side tool. You'll use it to do the work of a much larger team:

 - Building your own tools and workflows with Claude Code, such as scripts, automations, and lightweight internal apps

 - Creating and maintaining reusable skills and agents for recurring work like performance reviews, creative analysis, reporting, and campaign QA

 - Building and managing your own dashboards by connecting ad platform and HubSpot data, without waiting on anyone else

 - Using AI to speed up analysis, testing, and creative iteration, so your time goes to decisions instead of manual work

 - Ideating the V1s for growth funnels and lead magnets
   
   


HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED

 - Marketing CAC

 - Cost per MQL and cost per SQL

 - MQL meetings held and cost per meeting held

 - Conversion rates across offers, landing pages, and funnel steps

 - Pipeline quality

We don't measure you on CTR, CPM, or cheap lead volume.



Where this goes

This role is built to grow. Paid acquisition is central to how Scale Army scales, and as performance becomes predictable, there's real opportunity to take on more ownership of our growth strategy, including building a team.




WHAT YOU BRING

Must-haves

 - Senior-level, hands-on experience running paid acquisition, with deep Meta + LinkedIn Ads expertise and a history of personally managing significant monthly budgets

 - Experience owning growth outcomes beyond the ad platform, including offers, lead magnets, landing pages, and conversion testing

 - A track record of scaling spend while holding or improving downstream metrics like meetings, SQLs, pipeline, and CAC, not just CPL

 - Strong command of funnel math: CAC, conversion rates by stage, and forecasting spend against outcomes

 - Strong HubSpot skills, including lifecycle stages, offline conversion setup, attribution, and reporting

 - Advanced AI fluency that goes well beyond prompting. You've built things with tools like Claude Code, created reusable skills or agents, and set up your own dashboards and automations. Be ready to show us examples.

 - An ownership mindset. You don't wait to be told what to test next, and you don't stop at the edge of the ad platform.
   
   

Strong plus

 - B2B demand generation experience, especially lead-gen with a sales-assisted funnel

 - Hands-on experience with X, or CTV

 - Experience hiring or mentoring media buyers
   
   


WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You'll work with the Head of Marketing, creative strategists, designers, video editors, copywriters, CRO, Sales, Sales Ops, and Marketing Ops.

 

Scale Army is a staffing agency dedicated to connecting international talent with US-based companies. We cover a broad range of positions and industries, from customer support and sales roles to engineering and executive-level positions.

postings.descriptionText:
This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

 


ABOUT SCALE ARMY

This is a big boy job.

You will report directly to the CEO and sit on the leadership team.

We’re a staffing + AI services business serving B2B companies with 50–200 employees and $5M+ in revenue.

Nearly all our pipeline comes from paid media. You’ll lead the team responsible for managing that engine, which is why this role matters so much.

Our leadership team is incredibly fast and analytical. That should not intimidate you.




THE ROLE

You are Scale Army’s marketing leader. Every part of marketing reports to you: paid media, creative, conversion, brand, content, and SEO.

You’ll build the team, set marketing strategy with the leadership team, and own the results. Those results are business outcomes, not platform metrics.

You’ll be accountable for marketing CAC, cost per MQL and SQL, cost per meeting held, paid pipeline quality, organic traffic, rankings, and organic-sourced pipeline. We don’t measure you on CTR, CPM, or cheap lead volume.



What you’ll own:

 - Paid Media: Manage the media buyer, whether agency or in-house, across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and X. Oversee 2–3 product lines with approximately $80K/month in ad spend today.

 - Conversion & Funnel Optimization: Own what paid traffic is sent to and how it converts, including offers, lead magnets, landing pages, forms, booking and show rates, and the testing roadmap behind them.

 - Marketing & Sales Alignment: Bridge marketing and sales. Work with the sales team every week, gather feedback on lead quality and messaging, and turn it into improvements in targeting, offers, and creative.

 - Sales Enablement: Help the sales team convert the meetings you generate by providing the messaging, content, and market insights they need.

 - Lead Generation Strategy: Work with the leadership team to develop a lead-generation strategy that serves sales, and challenge ICP assumptions when the data disagrees.

 - Attribution & Analytics: Help diagnose HubSpot attribution with Sales Ops so both teams can trust the same numbers.

 - AI-Native Operations: Set the standard for an AI-native team. Build your own dashboards, automations, and reusable agents, and expect the team to work the same way.

 - Creative Leadership: Manage the creative team, including what they produce, how they work, and how quickly they deliver. You can hire for this. Oversee thought leadership, social, video, and podcast production, and decide how to structure the content and organic team.

 - SEO & Organic Growth: Manage our SEO agency. You won’t execute SEO yourself, but you’ll set the direction and hold the agency accountable for organic traffic, rankings, and the pipeline it generates.




THE TEAM YOU’LL LEAD

You’ll lead a flat team of six to eight people across four lanes, all reporting to you. Several seats are already filled, and you’ll shape and hire the rest.

 - Paid Media: A media buyer is already in place. An agency or senior buyer may also be hired. This lane owns budget, campaign structure, bidding, and channel mix.

 - Creative: Includes a creative strategist, video editor, and production assistant. This lane owns concepts, hooks, scripts, and ad volume.

 - Conversion: Includes a CRO specialist and a web and analytics specialist. This lane owns landing pages, forms, testing, and tracking.

 - Brand, Content & SEO: Includes a part-time organic social lead, an SEO agency, and a senior content marketing manager to be hired. This lane owns thought leadership, social, video, podcasts, SEO, and organic growth.




YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

 - Days 1–30: Audit the funnel end to end, from impression to held meeting. Learn the account, creative pipeline, and team. Sit in on sales calls, establish a weekly sync with sales, and identify the three biggest leaks.

 - Days 31–60: Finalize the paid media setup, whether through an agency or senior hire. Establish a weekly creative testing cadence and ship the first conversion improvements.

 - Days 61–90: Demonstrate a measurable reduction in cost per meeting held. Have a senior content marketing manager hired or in final rounds, with a clear plan for content and organic growth.




WHAT YOU’VE DONE BEFORE

 - 10+ years of growth experience, including at least 3 years in paid media and at least 4 years in management. For this role, management means you have fired at least four people.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building a brand or thought-leadership program alongside performance marketing.

 - Experience with CRO testing tools

postings.descriptionText:
This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

 

Our client is a B2B advisory firm that works closely with business owners through high-trust, detail-oriented engagements. The company is focused on building a consistent thought-leadership presence across its corporate social media channels and the personal brands of its leadership team.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The Content & Social Media Manager will manage the day-to-day creation, organization, and publishing of thought-leadership content across multiple social media channels. This role involves transforming leadership ideas, existing videos, podcast appearances, industry insights, and AI-assisted drafts into polished, platform-specific content while maintaining an organized content calendar and approval process.

The ideal candidate is creative, highly organized, and proactive, with experience managing B2B content and multiple personal brands. This individual should be comfortable working independently, adapting content to different leadership voices, and maintaining a consistent publishing process that keeps the team at least 30 days ahead.




LOCATION

Fully Remote | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


CONTENT PLANNING & CALENDAR MANAGEMENT

 - Collaborate with leadership to translate quarterly themes, priorities, and ideas into monthly and weekly content plans.

 - Build and maintain a forward-looking content calendar that keeps planned content at least 30 days ahead.

 - Organize content by platform, advisor, topic, format, approval status, and publishing date.

 - Coordinate content approvals and incorporate feedback efficiently.
   
   


SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT CREATION

 - Transform rough ideas, notes, Word documents, transcripts, and AI-assisted drafts into polished social media content.

 - Develop platform-specific captions, post copy, hooks, calls to action, and light supporting visuals.

 - Adapt content to reflect the individual voice and preferences of different leadership team members.

 - Ensure content remains clear, professional, on-brand, and appropriate for a B2B audience.
   
   


VIDEO & PODCAST REPURPOSING

 - Repurpose advisor-recorded videos and podcast appearances into short-form social media content.

 - Use Opus Clip, CapCut, Descript, or similar tools to identify, refine, and prepare short-form video clips.

 - Review AI-generated clips for accuracy, visual quality, captions, and alignment with the brand before publication.

 - Create or coordinate light video edits, thumbnails, captions, and supporting social media assets.
   
   


MULTI-CHANNEL PUBLISHING & PERSONAL BRAND MANAGEMENT

 - Schedule and publish content across LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.

 - Manage content publishing for company pages and the personal profiles of multiple advisors.

 - Maintain consistent posting schedules, messaging, formatting, and content quality across channels.

 - Adapt content to meet the formatting and publishing requirements of each platform.
   
   


CONTENT PERFORMANCE & ASSET ORGANIZATION

 - Monitor basic engagement metrics and content performance trends.

 - Identify content topics and formats that generate stronger audience engagement.

 - Recommend opportunities to repurpose high-performing content or improve future content themes.

 - Maintain organized content assets, source files, drafts, calendars, and published materials for team access.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS


EXPERIENCE

 - 3+ years of experience in social media management, content marketing, personal-brand content, or a related role.

 - Experience repurposing long-form videos, podcasts, interviews, or webinars into short-form social media content.

 - Experience managing LinkedIn and supporting B2B, founder-led, or professional-services content is strongly preferred.
   
   


SKILLS

 - Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills for creating polished social media content.

 - Strong understanding of LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube, and TikTok.

 - Proficiency with Canva for creating supporting visual content.

 - Familiarity with Opus Clip, CapCut, Descript, or similar video-editing platforms.

 - Experience using social media scheduling and content-management tools.

 - Ability to use AI tools for content ideation, drafting, organization, and repurposing.

 - Ability to independently transform broad direction and raw ideas into organized, polished content.

 - Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when managing content calendars, assets, and approval workflows.

 - Ability to manage multiple content streams and approval processes simultaneously.

 - Ability to balance creative execution with consistent processes and deadlines.

 - Ability to incorporate feedback and adjust content tone, formatting, and messaging efficiently.

 - Professional and dependable approach to working with senior leadership.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Quarterly, monthly, and weekly content planning processes consistently keep the team at least 30 days ahead.

 - High-quality content is published consistently across company and personal-brand social media channels.

 - Content ideas, drafts, approvals, assets, and publishing schedules remain organized and accessible.

 - Advisor-recorded videos and podcast appearances are regularly transformed into polished short-form content.

 - Leadership spends less time coordinating content logistics and more time providing high-level direction.
   
   


OPPORTUNITY

The Content & Social Media Manager will have the opportunity to take ownership of an executive thought-leadership content process, managing content planning, creation, repurposing, approvals, and publishing across multiple channels.
