This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

 

Our client is a B2B advisory firm that supports business owners through confidential, high-trust engagements. The firm works with a small team of advisors and relies on accurate information, organized systems, and efficient administrative processes to support its client and deal-related activities.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The Operations Assistant will support the internal systems and administrative workflows of a B2B advisory team. This role focuses on maintaining accurate CRM records, researching and verifying contacts, organizing client information, supporting onboarding activities, and ensuring important information is properly captured and accessible.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently within established processes. This is not a traditional calendar-management Executive Assistant position; it is an operations-focused role suited to someone who enjoys data management, research, identifying inconsistencies, and keeping internal systems organized.




LOCATION

Fully Remote | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


CRM & DATA MANAGEMENT

 - Maintain accurate contact, buyer, seller, and prospect records within Streak CRM.

 - Enter, update, and clean CRM records using inbound emails, internal notes, and advisor instructions.

 - Identify and resolve duplicate records, incomplete data, and outdated information.

 - Ensure relevant communications and follow-up information are accurately captured in the CRM.

 - Support ongoing CRM cleanup and data-quality initiatives.
   
   


RESEARCH & CONTACT LIST BUILDING

 - Conduct targeted research to identify business owners, companies, potential buyers, and strategic acquirers.

 - Build and validate contact lists based on industry, geography, business type, and campaign requirements.

 - Use AI-assisted research outputs and internal resources while manually verifying information for accuracy.

 - Research company and contact information using public sources, websites, LinkedIn, and approved data tools.

 - Maintain organized Google Sheets containing accurate, usable, and well-documented research data.
   
   


CLIENT ONBOARDING & ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT

 - Support client onboarding through welcome emails, onboarding communications, and follow-up coordination.

 - Organize client-related documents, information, and internal checklists.

 - Ensure relevant client information is prepared and accessible to the advisory team.

 - Provide general administrative and operational support as needed.
   
   


GOOGLE WORKSPACE & INFORMATION ORGANIZATION

 - Maintain organized Google Sheets, Google Docs, Gmail workflows, and Google Drive folders.

 - Support standardized processes for documenting research, client information, and internal updates.

 - Help establish organized and repeatable operational processes as the team grows.
   
   


PROCESS IMPROVEMENT & OPERATIONAL PROJECTS

 - Identify recurring administrative and data-management issues and recommend improvements.

 - Document recurring workflows to support accurate and consistent task execution.

 - Assist leadership with ad hoc research, data cleanup, and operational projects.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS


EXPERIENCE

 - 2+ years of experience in operations support, administrative coordination, CRM administration, research, or data management.

 - Experience maintaining CRM records and working with contact or customer data.

 - Experience with research, contact list building, data verification, or lead and contact enrichment is strongly preferred.

 - Previous experience with Streak CRM is helpful but not required.
   
   


SKILLS

 - Strong proficiency with Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Sheets, Google Docs, and Google Drive.

 - Ability to learn and work with new systems and software platforms.

 - Ability to research companies and contacts, verify information, and maintain accurate records.

 - Experience using AI tools to support research, organization, and workflow efficiency.

 - Exceptional attention to detail when managing records, documents, and confidential information.

 - Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities without overlooking details.

 - Ability to work independently and take ownership of recurring responsibilities.

 - Process-oriented approach to maintaining accurate and organized information.

 - Proactive and dependable approach to administrative and operational responsibilities.

 - Ability to handle confidential client, buyer, seller, and transaction information with discretion and professionalism.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - CRM records remain clean, accurate, and organized, with fewer duplicate or incomplete contacts.

 - Relevant email and contact information is consistently captured within the CRM.

 - Buyer, seller, and business-owner contact lists are well-researched, verified, and usable.

 - Client onboarding communications are handled smoothly, and client information remains organized.

 - Advisors spend less time on data cleanup, research administration, and repetitive operational tasks.
   
   


OPPORTUNITY

The Operations Assistant will have the opportunity to become a trusted member of a growing B2B advisory team, taking ownership of the systems, research, and administrative workflows that support daily operations.

This role provides the opportunity to contribute to organized and efficient internal processes, allowing advisors and leadership to focus on higher-value client and deal-related work.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

This hire owns day-to-day accounting execution: monthly close, AR, AP, and billing-related tickets.

JOB DETAILS

postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT XBOW

Build the future of offensive security with XBOW. Attackers are already using AI to move faster than defenders can react—we’re creating the platform that puts security ahead in the arms race. Our AI-powered system autonomously discovers, validates, and even exploits vulnerabilities, giving organizations proof-backed results in hours instead of weeks.

Founded by Oege de Moor, creator of GitHub Copilot, and backed by Sequoia, Altimeter, and other leading investors, XBOW is applying cutting-edge AI to one of the world’s most urgent problems. In just over a year, our AI, built by a world-class AI team and legendary security researchers — has uncovered thousands of real-world zero-days across the software billions rely on, and became the first autonomous system to reach number 1 on HackerOne.

We’re a team of builders, hackers, and researchers who thrive on solving problems others think are impossible. If you want to push the boundaries of AI, reshape how security is done, and join the group defining this new era of defense — we’d love to talk.




YOUR ROLE

We’re looking for a Software Engineer with deep expertise in LLM prompting, orchestration, and software engineering. In this role, you’ll design and implement systems that coordinate large language models with real-world tasks, advancing the intelligence at the heart of our platform. You’ll collaborate with our AI, Engineering and Security teams to create novel prompting strategies, build orchestration layers, and deliver production-ready systems in TypeScript.

This role is for someone who thrives in a fast-moving, research-driven environment and enjoys turning ambiguous ideas into robust, scalable solutions.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build LLM-powered software that actually works, by designing prompt flows and orchestrations that ensures great performance with no false positives.

 - Architect and build an AI-powered software stack that is production-grade, testable and maintainable.

 - Design and build experiments and evaluation frameworks for performance testing of the system at scale. Conduct data analysis to draw conclusions.

 - Collaborate with the rest of the AI team, with security experts, and both frontend and backend developers to create end-to-end systems that work and customers love.

 - Own projects end-to-end: from basic ideation and experimentation to deployment and production monitoring.

 - Continuously conduct research on how to harness the advancements in LLMs to make our system better and faster.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Strong experience with building software around LLMs: prompting, agentic orchestration, fault-tolerance, and integration of LLM parts with hard-coded logic.

 - Strong software engineering skills: architecting and building production-grade software that runs reliably and can be maintained.

 - Experience with TypeScript or proven ability to learn a new programming language quickly.

 - Strong skills in structured and independently-driven problem-solving. Able to work with incomplete information and rapidly testing hypotheses.

 - Comfortable with an energetic environment that mixes the fast-paced agile prioritisation of a startup with the curiosity mentality of a research lab.

 - Eager to own projects and jump into the deep end, learning as you go. Curious, adaptable and collaborative.

 - MSc or equivalent or higher in computer science, math, physics or machine learning.




BONUS IF YOU HAVE

 - Prior experience with the security sector, especially involving offensive security and/or applying LLMs in a security context.

 - Contributions to open-source software, particularly within applications of or frameworks for LLMs.

 - Strong theoretical background, e.g. a Ph.D in machine learning, computer science or math.

 - Startup experience and comfort with ambiguity.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Compensation & Equity: Competitive salary and a generous equity package, making you a true owner of the company.

 - Career Growth: Shape your role, lead the function, and grow with the company as we redefine cybersecurity.

 - Meaningful Work: You will tackle technically complex challenges and play a pivotal role in the growth of our business, working alongside an amazing team and some of the world’s experts to shape how AI transforms cybersecurity.




WHAT ELSE YOU SHOULD KNOW

 - Location: Remote (all team members are remote but we meet regularly and you’re supported to travel to collaborate with colleagues in person)

 - Contract: Full-time.

 - Hiring Process:
   
   1. 45-min introductory chat with our Talent team.
   
   2. 45 minutes with one of our Engineering Leads.
   
   3. 2-3 hour technical deep dive around relevant case study.
   
   4. 30-min final meeting with the Engineering Lead for the assigned team.

We believe in people who are driven by curiosity and a willingness to learn. Even if you don't check every box, we encourage you to apply if you're excited about the role and our mission.

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Postgres Engineer to join our Postgres Team and help maintain and expand the stability and functionality of our hosted Postgres offering . You’ll work closely with customers, partners, product, engineering, support and success, helping us maintain a secure, stable, performant, and functional Postgres foundation.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

What you'll own:

•
Build and maintain PostgreSQL extensions in C and Rust, with a deep understanding of internals — parser, planner, WAL mechanics, and MVCC

•
Diagnose and resolve issues in managed PostgreSQL deployments, including custom extension failures, core dump analysis, and performance bottlenecks

•
Own idempotent deployment pipelines across thousands of running PostgreSQL instances, including testing and rollout strategies

•
Manage complex extension ecosystems — compatibility, upgrade paths, and conflict resolution

•
Work with PostgreSQL's background worker framework, shared memory management, and hook system to build reliable, scalable functionality

•
Collaborate closely with customers, partners, product, engineering, support, and success teams to maintain a secure, stable, and performant Postgres foundation

What you bring:

•
Deep expertise in PostgreSQL internals - query planner, executor, and storage engine mechanics

•
Proven experience building PostgreSQL extensions in both C and Rust

•
Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL's permission model : RLS, roles, and grant systems

•
Experience troubleshooting production issues in managed PostgreSQL environments, including custom extension issues, performance bottlenecks, and resource contention

•
Comfortable building, testing, and owning idempotent deployments across thousands of running Postgres instances

•
Ability to read and navigate PostgreSQL source code confidently

•
Experience with multi-tenant database architectures

•
Experience running PostgreSQL at scale

What We Offer

•
Fully Remote

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

•
ESOP

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

•
Tech Allowance

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

•
Health Benefits

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

•
Annual Off-Sites

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

•
Flexible Work

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

•
Professional Development

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

•
~400 team members

•
60+ countries

•
20+ languages spoken

•
Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

•
540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

postings.title: Chief Technology Officer
postings.descriptionText:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce .

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Position Description:

As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it.

You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down.

You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence.

You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency.

Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards.

You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal.

This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the detiwls.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction.

AI and agentic engineering

• Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against.

• Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for.

• Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed.

• Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.

Team, resourcing, and accountability

• Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.

• Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.

• Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows.

Platform and execution

• Own the architecture end to end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.

• Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. postings.title: Multigres Deployment Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

We're looking for an engineer to own the deployment and operational infrastructure of Multigres, our distributed Postgres platform. You'll be responsible for building and maintaining the Multigres Operator, ensuring reliable cloud deployments, and creating the tooling that powers our Kubernetes-based infrastructure.

What You’ll Be Responsible for:

•
Build and maintain the Multigres Operator - Maintain our Go-based Kubernetes operator that orchestrates distributed Postgres deployments

•
Architect cloud deployment infrastructure - Design and implement robust deployment patterns for EKS and other Kubernetes platforms

•
Manage storage and networking layers - Work with CSI drivers, persistent volumes, and cross-cloud networking to ensure data reliability and connectivity

•
Develop deployment tooling - Create internal tools and automation for provisioning, scaling, and managing Multigres clusters

•
Ensure operational excellence - Build monitoring, alerting, and diagnostic capabilities into the deployment layer

•
Collaborate across teams - Work with database engineers, SRE, and product teams to deliver seamless deployment experiences

You Might Be a Good Fit If You have:

•
Strong systems programming skills - Proficiency in Go and experience building production-grade operators or controllers

•
Deep Kubernetes expertise - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes internals, custom resources, and cloud-managed Kubernetes services (EKS, GKE, AKS)

•
Database operations knowledge - Understanding of database deployment patterns, backup/restore, replication, and high availability

•
Distributed systems experience - Familiarity with consensus protocols, failure scenarios, and designing for resilience

•
Cloud infrastructure background - Experience with cloud-native deployment tooling, IaC (Terraform, Pulumi), and cloud provider APIs

•
Production operations mindset - Track record of building reliable, observable, and maintainable systems

Nice to Have:

•
Experience with CSI storage drivers and storage orchestration in Kubernetes

•
Knowledge of cross-cloud networking tools like Cilium, Istio, or similar service mesh technologies

•
Prior work with sharded query serving systems like Vitess

•
Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects

What We Offer

•
Fully Remote

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

•
ESOP

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

•
Tech Allowance

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

•
Health Benefits

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

•
Annual Off-Sites

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

•
Flexible Work

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

•
Professional Development

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

•
~400 team members

•
60+ countries

•
20+ languages spoken

•
Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

•
540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

Channel Growth & Cross-team Collaboration

• 
Leverage your local network — KOLs, fintech partners, payment providers, regulatory contacts — to accelerate market entry and growth.

Your work was growth experimentation and product intervention, not just media buying.

As the CSA Team Lead, you will be responsible for both people management and customer outcomes - supporting team execution while developing repeatable best practices across pre-sales discovery, proof-of-value onboarding, and technical success.


What You’ll Do

At Supabase, CSA Leads oversee a portfolio of high-value customers by empowering their team to deliver technical excellence and long-term customer success. You'll work directly with the team to:



• 
Hire, coach, and grow a global team of CSAs who serve as trusted technical advisors to our customers.




• 
Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Engineering to define and scale the CSA motion across the full customer journey—from discovery through adoption and renewal.




• 
Create structured onboarding, training, and development plans for CSAs to level up in technical storytelling, Postgres optimization, and customer success strategy.




• 
Ensure CSAs consistently deliver successful outcomes, unblock adoption, and drive value for paid Team and Enterprise accounts.




• 
Work directly with strategic customers when needed—especially during complex escalations, architectural deep dives, or critical onboarding milestones.





You'll be joining our team to support Supabase Team & Enterprise customers, where you will be expected to lead and innovate around the following areas of responsibility:


Pre-Sales Discovery:



• 
Lead and review technical discovery led by CSAs to uncover business and technical objectives, set appropriate expectations of the Supabase platform, and define the criteria for success.




• 
Guide CSAs in designing and presenting platform demonstrations tailored to high-value customers, helping them clearly articulate the value of the Supabase platform and team.




• 
Collaborate with Growth team members to size deals, provide anticipated usage estimates, and identify potential workloads supported by the Platform.






Proof-of-Value Onboarding



• 
Support your team in defining and executing proof-of-value scopes that balance business outcomes with low-friction onboarding.




• 
Ensure CSA-owned timelines, success criteria, and engagement tactics result in a high proof-to-conversion success rate.




• 
Build reusable onboarding flows (email sequences, docs, templates, webinars) that accelerate time-to-value for new customers.






Customer Success & Expansion



• 
Help your team build detailed account plans focused on both short-term adoption and long-term expansion opportunities.




• 
Provide ongoing technical coaching for CSAs conducting architecture reviews, schema design evaluations, and performance tuning for production workloads.




• 
Partner cross-functionally to advocate for customer feedback, share emerging customer needs with Product & Eng, and communicate roadmap milestones back to customers.






Trust & Platform Advocacy



• 
Coach CSAs to act as internal and external champions of Supabase, building trust with customers through consistency, clarity, and deep product expertise.




• 
Uphold a standard of excellence in customer engagement, ensuring Supabase becomes embedded in the way our customers build.






Preferred Experience



• 
6+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Technical Account Management, or Database Engineering.




• 
2+ years of people management or team leadership experience , ideally in a high-growth, technical startup environment.




• 
Strong background with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred), with a deep understanding of schema design, indexing, and query performance.




• 
Hands-on experience building modern web applications using frameworks like React, Svelte, Vue, or Node.js.




• 
Clear, confident technical communicator and storyteller. Must be able to distill complex technical topics into actionable outcomes for customers and team members alike.




• 
Experience navigating stakeholder alignment, conflict resolution, and collaborative problem-solving across teams.




• 
Familiarity with tools such as HubSpot, BigQuery, and internal BI dashboards.






What We Offer



• 
Fully Remote

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.




• 
ESOP

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.




• 
Tech Allowance

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.




• 
Health Benefits

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.




• 
Annual Off-Sites

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.




• 
Flexible Work

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.




• 
Professional Development

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that support…

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. This role is part of our Experience & Engineering team based in Copenhagen. We combine our skills in developing future-ready technical solutions with our expertise in creating beautiful designs to deliver exceptional and engaging digital experiences that build lasting relationships with our clients like Bolia, Nilfisk and Magasin.

As an Associate Design Director, you operate at a studio-wide level: shaping the craft vision, elevating design excellence, and steering the strategic direction of our visual design practice. You ensure quality across accounts, drive operational standards, and keep our craft innovative, consistent and competitive. You influence senior stakeholders, guide multidisciplinary teams, mentor talent, and represent DEPT® externally, strengthening our creative reputation and contributing directly to sales, growth and thought leadership.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Own craft direction across complex projects and accounts, ensuring work is aligned, elevated and unmistakably DEPT®.

• Raise the bar by defining standards, sharpening processes, and enabling teams to deliver consistently exceptional work.

• Drive innovation through experimentation and curiosity, creating work that sets benchmarks and wins awards.

• Support pitches and growth opportunities with strong creative POVs that connect craft to business impact.

• Represent DEPT® externally through talks, posts and publications that amplify our creative reputation.

WHAT YOU BRING:

• 10+ years of experience in visual/UI/UX design, including 3+ years at senior or leadership level.

• Serious craft expertise: a portfolio demonstrating strategic impact, systems thinking, and high-quality execution across complex digital ecosystems.

• A strategic thinker who influences product, design, and business decisions with clear vision and rationale.

• A recognised design voice: inspires teams, elevates craft standards, and contributes to the wider design community.

• Mentorship mindset: actively builds others up through coaching, structured feedback, and knowledge sharing.

• Continuously curious: eager to master emerging tools, AI workflows, motion, and design trends.

• Deep understanding of visual principles, accessibility, and modern interaction patterns.

• Mastery of Figma and design systems; motion skills (Jitter, AE, etc.) are a plus.

• Confident communicator able to articulate design direction with clarity and conviction.

• Working proficiency in English.

WE OFFER

• A healthy, varied and delicious lunch.

• Pension & healthcare scheme.

• 25 vacation days per year.

• A lot of fun social events such as Friday bars, company parties, team events, etc.

• A flexible, hybrid working policy and a great workplace in our awesome office in Christianshavn.

• A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021 and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.

• Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!

• The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training and development.

• Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

postings.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer- Auth Team
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer on the Platform Team, you will develop and operate Alpaca’s authentication, authorization, and Identity Provider (IdP) systems - the systems that handle user login, access control, and secure access across our APIs, customer products, and internal tools.

We are looking for experienced engineers who are comfortable owning services end to end: API design, data modeling, deployments, and production debugging. Most of your time will be spent writing Go (backend services, gRPC/REST APIs, shared client libraries), with meaningful work in React/TypeScript for auth-related UI, and occasionally Java for identity-provider extensions. You will also work with Helm charts, analyze logs and metrics, manage deployments, and help other teams to integrate with our services.

Things You Get To Do

• Build and improve authentication-related experiences in customer and partner web applications, including login, permissions, and credential management.

• Develop and maintain the platform’s authentication, authorization, and IdP services.

• Create and evolve shared libraries and SDKs.

• Integrate with identity providers and keep login and access policies working reliably across products.

• Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot identity services in production.

• Help modernize legacy authentication patterns as the platform evolves.

• Own work end to end, from requirements through delivery and follow-up.

• Collaborate with other engineering teams on identity and access integration.

• Maintain high code quality, write tests, and participate in code reviews.

• Help investigate incidents and bugs, including on-call rotation.

Who You Are (must-haves)

• You have 5+ years of experience writing code in strongly-typed languages, with at least one year of experience in Go .

• You have experience building web applications with React and TypeScript .

• You have worked with relational databases before - we use PostgreSQL , but we are not particularly picky about this one as long as you have a solid grasp on the fundamentals.

• You have worked at a startup before - you thrive in ambiguous environments, embrace changing priorities, know when to balance technical debt with speed, and proactively tackle whatever needs to get done without relying on pre-existing processes or documentation.

• You are not afraid of taking a task from start to finish - gathering requirements, figuring out and implementing the best technical solution, then deploying and monitoring the results.

• You have worked at least 3 years on systems at scale .

Who You Might Be (nice-to-haves)

• You know what a JWT token is, and how OpenID Connect and SAML work. Maybe you even heard about Keycloak , or have worked on authentication systems before.

• You have experience with role-based access control .

• You have built or maintained OpenAPI-driven HTTP APIs.

• You are familiar with Kubernetes and Helm .

• You have experience with Java .

• You understand how Kafka works - maybe you even worked with Redpanda before.

• You have experience with Grafana ’s observability stack - Prometheus , Tempo and all the rest. You might have even written a PromQL query for a new alert once or twice.

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Privacy Manager who is best in class, with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Sezzle is building a formal, company-wide privacy program on the NIST Privacy Framework, and we are hiring the person who will build it and run it. Your job is to turn that foundation into an operating program, and then to own the program as it matures.

As our Privacy Manager, you will drive the implementation end to end: the enterprise data map, the privacy risk assessments, the privacy review process, the de-identification standard, and the governance rhythm that keeps it all running. This role sits at the intersection of privacy and product. The goal is not to slow the business down; it is to give every data initiative a fast, well-documented path to yes, including the data-driven products and analytics that are central to Sezzle’s strategy. You will ensure our data practices protect our users across the US and Canada while enabling our product and engineering teams to build at speed.

• Build the program: Drive Sezzle’s implementation of the NIST Privacy Framework from roadmap to operating program, including Current and Target Profiles, gap analysis, a prioritized and costed action plan, and ongoing monitoring, aligned with US state and federal requirements (CCPA/CPRA and other state comprehensive privacy laws, GLBA, TCPA) and Canadian privacy laws (PIPEDA and Quebec’s Law 25).

• Run privacy review: Own privacy risk assessments and Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) for new products, features, and third-party vendors, and operate an intake and disposition process that gives every proposal a fast, documented answer: approved, approved with controls, or needs redesign.

• Own the data map and consumer rights: Build and maintain the enterprise data inventory and data map in partnership with Engineering, tracking the lifecycle of consumer information, and manage the automation and fulfillment of consumer access, deletion, and opt-out requests.

• Operationalize privacy-enhancing techniques: Administer Sezzle’s de-identification and aggregation standard and its approval workflow so that data-driven products and analytics ship with the right controls designed in from the start.

• Embed privacy-by-design: Partner directly with Engineering, Product, and Marketing teams during early-stage development so that privacy requirements are designed in, not bolted on.

• Govern, measure, and report: Run the cadence of Sezzle’s cross-functional privacy working group, maintain the program’s decision log and obligations register, track program metrics, and support executive and board-level reporting. Collaborate closely with the Information Security team to manage, investigate, and mitigate privacy incidents and cross-border data transfer risks.

What We Look For:

• Proven Builder: 4+ years of dedicated experience managing data privacy programs, including at least one program or major program component (a data inventory, a consumer rights operation, a privacy review process) that you stood up from early stage to steady state rather than inherited. High-growth fintech, e-commerce, or SaaS experience operating in both the US and Canada is ideal.

• Framework Fluency: Hands-on experience implementing a recognized privacy or security framework (NIST Privacy Framework strongly preferred; NIST CSF or ISO 27701 also relevant), including profiles or maturity assessments, gap analyses, and action plans.

• Deep Regulatory Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of major North American privacy frameworks (CCPA/CPRA and the broader US state privacy law landscape, TCPA, GLBA, PIPEDA, Quebec Law 25) and a sharp knack for translating complex legal mandates into clear, actionable business processes.

• Product-Enablement Mindset: You treat privacy as the path to yes. You are fluent in de-identification, aggregation, and other privacy-enhancing techniques as tools that let data products launch responsibly, and you can defend the line between what is de-identified and what is not.

• Problem-Solving Ownership: A self-starter mindset with the ability to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously in an environment where speed and agility matter.

Preferred Qualifications:

• CIPM (privacy program management) plus CIPP/US or CIPP/C; CIPT is a plus.

postings.title: Quality Evaluator – Fluent English (Argentina)
postings.descriptionText:
QUALITY EVALUATOR – ENGLISH

Help shape the future of AI by evaluating and comparing responses from advanced AI models.

 - Location: Remote

 - Type: Independent contractor / Part-time

 - Commitment: up to 3 months

 - Compensation: $7-$12/hour




ABOUT THE ROLE

At Anyone AI, we create high-quality training and evaluation data for frontier AI models.

We’re looking for English-fluent experts with strong writing skills, critical thinking, and extensive hands-on experience using large language models (LLMs).

In this role, you’ll interact directly with AI models and compare their responses side by side to determine which best meets the user’s needs. Your evaluations and written explanations will help improve the accuracy, helpfulness, and reliability of AI systems.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Interact with different AI models and tools across a wide range of prompts and topics.

 - Compare two or more AI-generated responses side by side.

 - Assess accuracy, helpfulness, instruction-following, clarity, and overall response quality.

 - Follow detailed rating guidelines and multi-step evaluation workflows.

 - Write clear, well-reasoned explanations supporting your evaluation decisions.

 - Apply evaluation criteria consistently across tasks.
   
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Fluency in English, with strong reading comprehension and writing skills.

 - Extensive hands-on experience using LLMs and critically assessing their outputs.

 - Strong analytical judgment and the ability to weigh multiple dimensions of response quality.

 - Excellent attention to detail and the ability to follow complex instructions carefully.

 - Ability to explain evaluation decisions clearly and convincingly.

 - Comfort switching between AI models, tools, and multi-step workflows.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Previous experience in AI response evaluation, data annotation, or quality assurance.

 - Experience in editing, research, fact-checking, or analytical writing.

 - Familiarity with evaluation rubrics and side-by-side comparison tasks.

postings.title: Customer Journey Manager
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT HALTER

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund https://foundersfund.com, Bessemer Venture Partners https://www.bvp.com/, BOND, https://www.bondcap.com/ DCVC https://www.dcvc.com/, Blackbird https://www.blackbird.vc/, Promus Ventures https://www.promusventures.com/, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures https://www.icehouseventures.co.nz/?utm_term=icehouse%20ventures&utm_campaign=Brand+Keywords&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_acc=4064636360&hsa_cam=16902737884&hsa_grp=134004309485&hsa_ad=592971340272&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-1082530126230&hsa_kw=icehouse%20ventures&hsa_mt=b&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gclid=Cj0KCQjw2v-gBhC1ARIsAOQdKY0J0DepRVFDmjQlAkJPbZuQnLSA5UVzUzOXYiPxkjX-SeVa513_BhkaAr-MEALw_wcB.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.



About the role

A farmer who buys Halter is trusting us with their herd, their pasture and their season. When it works, they get time back and stop worrying about fences. When it breaks, it's usually in the gaps between our teams: a handoff that drops, a promise that doesn't match what arrives, a question nobody owns. We need a Customer Journey Manager to close those gaps, so every farmer gets the best of Halter from the first conversation to renewal, in every country we serve.



This role sits across the whole company. You'll design the farmer, rancher and animal journey end to end, measure it, and fix it hands-on with the teams who run each part. We call this the golden path: the best experience a farmer can have with us. A smooth install day. A first week where the collars just work. A support call that sorts it first time.



You'll report to the VP Customer as a senior manager, working across New Zealand, Australia, the United States and South America. Function leads own their processes and stay accountable for them. You own the journey that runs across them. When a fix crosses teams and leads can't agree, the VP Customer and the go-to-market President make the call.



What you'll do

• Design the golden path for farmers, ranchers and their animals, from the first conversation through install, first week, support and renewal

• Get on farm early and often, in at least two countries in your first 90 days, to see the journey the way farmers live it

• Map today's journey with the teams who run each part, and find where handoffs drop and promises don't match what arrives

• Agree a starting point and a target for the measures that matter most, such as churn at first renewal or support contacts per farm

• Build a service blueprint and get it live within six months, so function leads work from one shared view of the journey

• Prioritise and fix the handoffs that hurt farmers most, working hands-on with the teams involved rather than handing over recommendations

• Bring the evidence and the redesign to function leads, and take cross-team fixes to the VP Customer and the go-to-market President when leads can't agree

• Account for how the journey differs across New Zealand, Australia, the United States and South America

• Report regularly to the VP Customer and wider leadership on progress against the measures we agreed up front



What we're looking for

• Senior experience in customer journey management, service design, customer experience or operations, with a track record of improving outcomes customers feel

• A history of fixing problems that cross teams, using evidence and relationships rather than formal authority

• Hands-on experience mapping journeys and building service blueprints, then turning them into changes that stick

• Comfort with data: setting baselines, choosing the right measures and showing whether a fix worked

• Willingness to spend real time on farm and in the field, not just in workshops

• A clear communicator who can bring function leads to agreement and present the case to senior leadership

• Experience operating in a fast-growing, evolving environment where processes are still being built out



Nice to have

• Exposure to agri-tech, farming, or hardware products with a physical install and setup

• Experience improving a customer journey across several countries at once

• Experience reducing churn or support contacts through journey redesign

• Familiarity with subscription businesses where renewal is the moment of truth



Our Office First Approach

There's a reason you visit your friends in person, live with your family and don't do dinners over Zoom. Humans are wired for connection. We believe a world-class, in-person office culture is the best way for high-performing teams.



Being office first is a core pillar of our culture. We believe in-person connections are key to driving your own growth, learning, impact, and building genuine long-lasting relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful and aligned work. We don't like having heaps of rules or policies, but this means having strong, trusted relationships is critical.

ABOUT THE ROLE:



We're looking for a Senior Campaigns Specialist who's great at doing one thing above all else: turning a commercial goal into a campaign that actually moves it, and knowing whether it worked.

This role runs campaigns across the whole customer journey, from a farmer first hearing about Halter to getting more value from it years in. Where the focus sits will shift as the business grows, and you'll go where the opportunity is. Every campaign is graded on the same bar: did it move the number it was built to move.

Your job is the campaign itself: the strategy, the plan, the targeting, the sequencing and the read on whether it's working.




WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - Experienced at owning outcomes. You've got 5+ years running campaigns, and you've owned the results, not just the execution. You can talk through what you learned when a campaign hit and when it missed.

 - Data-driven and commercially minded. You think in revenue, not activity, and you default to what the numbers say over what feels right. You'd rather run fewer campaigns that move the business than a busy calendar that doesn't.

 - Full-funnel minded. You care about the whole customer journey. You'd put the same energy into helping an existing farmer get more from Halter as into winning a new one.

 - A natural connector. You can look at a busy, slightly messy calendar and see the through-line. Where others see a one-off event, you see a campaign waiting to happen. You bring sales, partnerships and global teams along on a single plan.

 - Hands-on with media. You've planned and bought media yourself, you know your way around paid social, and you can tell when a placement is worth it and when it's just visibility.

 - Organised and comfortable with ambiguity. You can run several campaigns at different stages without things slipping. You don't need a perfect brief to get moving, you make good calls when the data is incomplete, and you know when to escalate and when to just decide.




WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE:

 - Owning the Australian campaign strategy. Every campaign should trace back to a revenue priority and to where Halter is heading in Australia. You'll work with the revenue team to understand the commercial plan, including targets, priority regions and segments, and turn it into a campaign strategy: which audiences and stages of the customer journey to focus on, and a calendar built around calving seasons, field days and the moments that matter on farm. When priorities shift, your plan shifts with them.

 - Owning the inbound leads number. You'll own inbound leads for Australia: the target, the forecast and the read on what's driving it. You won't hold the paid digital budget, but you'll work with Global Performance Marketing to test and refine our paid social approach in Australia, from audiences to creative and timing.

 - Turning scattered activity into cohesive campaigns. Field days, sales events, partner activity, regional pushes, one-off content and global paid activity don't always connect. You'll bring them together under joined-up campaigns that support Halter Australia's priorities. You'll also spot the moments that could be much bigger, like turning a single field day into a campaign with invites beforehand, local paid and social around it, content captured on the day and a follow-up that hands warm leads to sales.

 - Running campaigns end to end. You'll plan, launch and manage campaigns across the customer journey, from the goal, audience, channel sequencing and timeline through to the results review.

 - Working with data, not just gut feel. You'll track response rates, pipeline sourced or influenced, and the impact on customers once they're on board, and you'll know your numbers cold. When the data says something needs to change, whether that's the audience, channel mix, message or timing, you own that call and make it mid-campaign. If the messaging or positioning isn't landing, you brief the right teams, whether that's Content, design or Global Brand, on what needs to change and why.

Este rol tiene como objetivo dar soporte a la gerencia de finanzas de Rincon en el proceso mensual de control presupuestario.
Al formar parte del equipo de Finanzas, tus principales responsabilidades serán:
Seguimiento y control presupuestario de las inversiones de capital.
Soporte financiero al equipo de operaciones, incluyendo análisis de costos.
Asegurar el cumplimiento de controles y procesos financieros.
Preparación de reportes y análisis financieros para apoyar toma de decisiones.
Soporte en los procesos de planeamiento, interactuando con otras áreas.

Información sobre vos
Para este rol, es importante que cuentes con:
Un compromiso firme con tu seguridad y la del equipo
Graduado/a de Contador Público o Licenciado/a en Administración
Experiencia en análisis presupuestario, planificación y control de gastos operativos e inversiones de capital.
Conocimiento en: Excel intermedio, inglés y SAP (no excluyente).

Qué ofrecemos

Un entorno de trabajo donde la seguridad es una prioridad en todo lo que hacemos.
Un paquete de remuneraciones competitivo con incentivos anuales.
Programas de salud de primer nivel, pensados para la familia.
Un Programa de Asistencia al Empleado/a para acompañarte cuando lo necesites.
Apoyo continuo para tu bienestar personal y profesional.
Licencias para todas las etapas de la vida (vacaciones, licencias parentales y médicas).

About Rio Tinto
Rio Tinto is a leading global mining and materials company. We operate in 35 countries where we produce iron ore, copper, aluminium, critical minerals, and other materials needed for the global energy transition and for people, communities, and nations to thrive.
We have been mining for 150 years and operate with knowledge built up across generations and continents. Our purpose is finding better ways to provide the materials the world needs – striving for innovation and continuous improvement to produce materials with low emissions and to the right environmental, social and governance standards. But we can’t do it on our own, so we’re focused on creating partnerships to solve problems, create win-win situations and meet opportunities.
Where you will be working
Recognized as a pioneer and leader in the industrial minerals industry due to product quality, supply reliability and technical support; we are proud to make modern life work. Lithium is part of our portfolio of materials essential to a low-carbon future and is a key element needed for low-carbon technologies. The Battery Materials unit is comprised of the Borates operations in US, the Jadar Project in Serbia and the Rincon project in Argentina, leading in mining borates and lithium for a more sustainable future. The Rincon lithium project is a large undeveloped lithium brine project located in the heart of the lithium triangle in the Salta Province of Argentina, an emerging hub for greenfield projects. It is a long-life, scalable resource with one of the lowest carbon footprints of lithium assets in the world. This acquisition is a significant further endorsement of our commitment to the battery materials sector and lithium's role in a low-carbon future.

Respect and Inclusion
At Rio Tinto, we particularly welcome and encourage applications from Indigenous Peoples, women, the LGBTQ+ community, mature workers, people with disabilities, and people from different cultural backgrounds. We are committed to an inclusive environment where people feel comfortable being themselves. We want our people to feel that all voices are heard, all cultures respected and that a variety of perspectives are not only welcome – they are essential to our success. We treat each other fairly and with dignity regardless of race, gender, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, age, sexual orientation, or anything else that makes us different.

postings.descriptionText:
En Bidcom impulsamos el comercio electrónico a través de la innovación, el análisis estratégico y un entorno dinámico enfocado en la mejora continua. Somos líderes en el sector y buscamos profesionales apasionados por los desafíos, con la capacidad de transformar datos en estrategias concretas que potencien nuestro crecimiento. Si te motiva generar un impacto real en la experiencia de miles de usuarios y escalar el rendimiento de una plataforma de primer nivel, este desafío es para vos.
Tareas y Responsabilidades
Analizar datos de ecommerce: Recopilar y examinar métricas de ventas, tráfico web y comportamiento del cliente mediante Google Analytics y herramientas afines para generar insights accionables.
Monitorear y reportar KPIs clave: Evaluar de manera constante la tasa de conversión, ticket promedio, unidades por ticket, tasa de abandono de carrito y engagement, consolidando informes periódicos para la toma de decisiones directivas.
Gestionar proyectos de optimización: Colaborar con equipos interdisciplinarios y stakeholders en iniciativas de mejora del sitio web, asegurando la alineación con los objetivos comerciales del área.
Soportar la estrategia comercial: Asistir al Jefe de Ecommerce en la planificación e implementación de estrategias orientadas a escalar las ventas y optimizar la experiencia del usuario.
Realizar análisis de mercado y competencia: Monitorear tendencias de la industria e investigar mejores prácticas para identificar nuevas oportunidades de negocio.
Requisitos
Formación académica: Graduados/as en Marketing, Administración de Empresas, Estadística, Economía, Ciencias de la Computación o carreras afines.
Experiencia laboral: Entre 2 y 3 años de experiencia comprobable en análisis de datos, optimización de ecommerce y elaboración de informes.
Herramientas técnicas: Dominio excluyente de Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Looker Studio y Google Sheets. Se valorará la experiencia en herramientas de comportamiento de usuario como Mouseflow, Clarity, Hotjar o similares.
Capacidad analítica: Altamente orientada/o al detalle, con habilidad demostrada para transformar grandes volúmenes de datos en recomendaciones estratégicas.
Conocimientos deseables: Comprensión y aplicación de estrategias de optimización de tasa de conversión (CRO).

Cobertura médica prepaga de primer nivel.
Membresía con descuento en red de gimnasios Sport Club.
Día de cumpleaños libre (Day Off).
Descuentos corporativos en productos de la compañía.
Licencia por paternidad extendida.
Posibilidades reales de crecimiento y desarrollo en una empresa líder.

Lugar de trabajo: Saavedra (Híbrido)

Representa a la organización dentro de las comunidades de abastecimiento y posee un conocimiento sólido del mercado commodities.

Gestión Contractual: Administra las relaciones diarias con clientes/productores en el marco de planes de gestión contractual establecidos y es responsable de la posición interna de los clientes/productores de su cartera.
Cumplimiento Operativo: Identifica y reporta posibles incumplimientos normativos o de políticas internas, elevando los casos según corresponda.

Centralidad en el cliente/productor: Releva y desarrolla arco geográfico de acopio/oficina LDC.  Información de Mercado: Reporta datos del mercado en sistemas específicos para alimentar estrategias comerciales y planes de originación.

Capacidad para comprender y abordar información compleja desde distintas perspectivas.
Comunicación clara y profesional adaptada a diferentes audiencias.
Conocimiento del negocio y del mercado para alinear su accionar a los objetivos organizacionales.
Responsabilidad por los resultados propios y del equipo.
Gestión eficiente de recursos ante contextos cambiantes o de escasez.
Trabajo colaborativo y construcción de vínculos de valor.
Capacidad para interpretar indicadores financieros relevantes.
Valentía para abordar temas sensibles o difíciles con claridad y respeto.
Mejora continua y optimización de procesos.
Planificación efectiva y alineación del trabajo a los objetivos estratégicos.
Qualifications
Habilidades técnicas:
Costos y presupuesto
Gestión de contratos
Análisis de datos
Negociación
Planificación de acciones
Reportes de gestión
Conocimiento comercial
Gestión de territorio
Educación requerida: Título universitario o formación equivalente.
Additional Information
Lugar de trabajo: Oficina comercial en General Pico y acopio en Trilí

postings.attribution: Publicado en el sitio de empleo de Natura (Natura Life Science) · índice Fantastic.jobs
postings.descriptionText:
OUR PEOPLE, TOGETHER, LEAD WITH CONSCIOUSNESS.

At Natura, we have the potential to drive meaningful transformations. This is made possible through the innovative products of Natura and Avon; the memorable experiences of Bluma's beauty services and our financial education platform, Emana Pay. Brands and services that are relevant to those who use them and recognized for our commitment to leading regenerative businesses.
Role Type
Temporary Cover
What will you be doing here?
Recepsion y gestion de la estrategia comercial.
Se encarga de recibir la estrategia comercial proveniente de Planeamiento y de gestionar cada una de las caídas de productos debido a problemas de abastecimiento, con el objetivo de que la propuesta a la consultora no pierda atractivo y llegue de la mejor manera en tiempo y forma.
Armado y envío de documentos a revista.
Así como recibe la estrategia comercial, es la encargada de traducirla para que la revista impresa y la digital de ambas marcas comuniquen de manera efectiva cada una de las dinámicas promocionales que se quieren presentar a la consultora. Ambas marcas con sus procesos por separado.
De igual forma, se encarga de gestionar, validando los distintos plazos (deadlines), la realización de los cambios pertinentes en las distintas instancias a consecuencia de las incidencias de abastecimiento.
Planificación de Foros de RP y RePlan.
Este rol tiene a su cargo el armado del calendario de Foros de RP y RePlan, en el cual se definen y validan las propuestas comerciales ciclo a ciclo. Además, tiene como responsabilidad conducir el foro, generar la minuta y hacer seguimiento de que las distintas partes cumplan con lo que se cierra en cada uno de los foros.
Archivo de Tendencias
Este rol tiene a su cargo también el armado del archivo de tendencia una vez aperturado el ciclo. Este archivo es crítico debido a que va ajustando los planes con el performance real del ciclo, mostrando las distintas tendencias por producto y alertando sobre los distintos quiebres o superaciones que se proyectan a futuro. Esta es una tarea de gran responsabilidad, debido a que alerta a el Area de disponibilidad de producto con el fin de atender las posibles superaciones a tiempo y al Area de monitoreo de cara al control de Stock y propuesta de Planes B.
What knowledge and experiences will you need to bring to share with our network?
Gestión y Ejecución Comercial: Adaptación de la estrategia comercial y resolución de contingencias por quiebres de stock para garantizar una oferta continua y atractiva.
Comunicación Multicanal: Elaboración de documentos y traducción de dinámicas promocionales para los catálogos impresos y digitales de dos marcas independientes.
Gobernanza y Coordinación: Líder de foros comerciales ciclo a ciclo, garantizando la validación de propuestas, definición de calendarios y seguimiento de acuerdos.
Análisis de Tendencias y Gestión de Inventario: Monitoreo del desempeño comercial en tiempo real para proyectar desviaciones de demanda, alertar a Supply Chain y proponer planes de contingencia (Planes B).

#LI-RL1
What will you find here?

We are more than just a workplace: we build and live the Well-Being Ecosystem daily, based on the harmonious relationship between each individual, their surroundings, and the environment they are part of. In addition to offering benefits focused on social, physical, financial, mental, and emotional well-being, we promote an environment of prosperity, belonging, and purpose, strengthening a solid network of support, expanded awareness, and respect for diversity, equity, and inclusion.
We are a movement that transforms the way of living and doing business across 14 countries in Latin America, always guided by consciousness.

Natura celebrates and embraces diversity in all its forms and pluralities.

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer, Security Platform
postings.attribution: Publicado en el sitio de empleo de Sezzle · índice Fantastic.jobs
postings.descriptionText:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)
About Sezzle:
With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!
Compensation:
For this senior role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD based on experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the strong expertise and significant contributions expected at this level. This is a fully remote role. We believe the best engineers can do world-class work from anywhere, and we hire accordingly. Work from where you do your best work.
About the Role:
We are seeking a hands-on Senior Software Engineer, Security Platform, to build and own the platform the security team runs on: the services that discover, scan, triage and route security findings, the event-driven bus that connects them, and the CI security gates every team's pipeline runs through.
This is a development role on the security team, not a security-analyst role. Most of your time goes into designing, building and operating services in Go and Python on Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, the existing fleet where it has grown faster than its upkeep, and the NATS-based event platform that moves findings, inventory changes and notifications between them. The security gates in our GitLab CI (SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning) and the agentic triage and review workflows are part of that platform, not the whole of it. Your job is to make these systems fast, low-noise, and reliable enough to be trusted by default without slowing delivery.
You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own detection and response and network and zero trust — your platform is what their work composes with.
At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we build. In this role you will build reusable agentic workflows (Claude Code skills, CI review agents, automated triage and verification) that multiply what the team can cover, and hold that review discipline in the platform code you own.
What You’ll Do:
Design, build, and operate security engineering services primarily in Golang and Python, on AWS and Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, and the upkeep, hardening and retirement of the existing ones.
Own the event-driven platform between the security services: the NATS bus, its contracts and consumers, delivery guarantees and observability — so a finding, an inventory change or an alert reaches every service that acts on it.
Integrate the platform end-to-end: scanners → finding system-of-record → tickets → metrics, so remediation state is visible and exam evidence is a by-product of engineering.
Own delivery of the security gates — SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning: scanner selection and tuning, suppression workflow mechanics, false-positive burn-down, and the rollout tooling that takes a gate from advisory reporting to enforcing without blocking delivery.
Build agentic security workflows: CI review agents, automated finding triage and verification, remediation helpers — tooling other engineers actually adopt.
Build the triage-to-remediation automation: validate true positives by hand enough to prove the tooling right, then automate the loop — reproduction context, fix guidance, and routing to the owning teams and to vulnerability-management operations.
Participate in threat modeling and secure design reviews for the services you build and the pipelines you own.
Participate in the on-call rotation for the services you own.
What We Look For:
6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant backend experience.
Deployed significant changes to a production application in the past 30 days.
Strong proficiency in Golang, plus working proficiency in Python.
Hands-on experience building and operating event-driven or message-based systems (NATS, Kafka, or similar): contracts, idempotent consumers, replay, back-pressure.
Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipeline tooling — jobs, shared templates, runners — GitLab CI at fleet scale is a strong plus.
Hands-on web application security knowledge: the OWASP Top 10 in real code — able to find these issues, fix them yourself, and encode the detection so they stop recurring.
Hands-on experience with SAST, SCA, and secret-scanning tooling (e.g., Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, Trivy, Grype, gitleaks), including tuning them to a signal-to-noise ratio developers will tolerate.
Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your development work today, have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't, and have built agentic workflows that other engineers adopted.
Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes as deployment targets for the services you build.
Preferred Knowledge and Skills:
Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or consumer lending, especially with systems in cardholder-data or regulated scope.
Working knowledge of PCI DSS and SOC 2 as they apply to software development and change management — the platform you build is what produces that evidence.
Software supply-chain integrity: SBOM pipelines, dependency governance, artifact signing and provenance (Sigstore, SLSA).
Familiarity with policy-as-code and admission control (OPA, Kyverno, conftest) — your gates compose with the cluster's runtime policy-enforcement layer.
Exposure to bug bounty or external vulnerability report triage — enough to know what the automation you build has to get right.
Experience with threat modeling at a system level.
About You:
You measure yourself by other teams' code - a fix you shipped is good; a vulnerability class that stopped appearing across the fleet is better.
You'd rather ship a gate than publish a policy - you know that enforcement changes behavior and documents do not, and you build the enforcement so well that engineers want to keep it.
You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You're not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things.
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting.
You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.
Sezzle’s Technology Stack:
Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
Frontend: Typescript - React…
