postings.title: Product Manager, Orchestration Platform
postings.attribution: Publicado en el sitio de empleo de Felix Technologies, Inc. · índice Fantastic.jobs
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT US

At Félix [https://felixpago.com/], we are building the indispensable financial
companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first
interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money
movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances
powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and
wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our
ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of
a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically
overlooked.

We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding
from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle
Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value
Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our
investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as
an “Endeavour Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech
Startups Award.

Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that
will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply
meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long
because we are obsessed with our customers. We get things done with urgency and
focus, driven by extreme ownership over our impact. We collaborate without ego,
fostering radical transparency and fierce loyalty so we can grow together.
Because we aim for insanely great rather than just good enough, we stay
insatiably curious—always experimenting, building the future today, and
delivering a product that truly makes our users' lives better.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We've built an orchestration platform that runs our remittance transaction flow
end to end. It handles the long-running, stateful, failure-prone work between
"customer pressed send" and "money arrived": routing, compliance checks, partner
calls, payouts, reconciliation, retries and compensation when a step fails.

Remittance is the first product on the platform. Our intent is for future
products to launch on this layer rather than rebuild transaction orchestration.
This is the senior product role for that piece of core company infrastructure.

RESPONSIBILITIES

* Platform strategy: Define what the orchestration platform is and isn't: its
boundaries, guarantees, and non-goals. Decide which capabilities are platform
primitives and which belong in consuming products, and hold that line under
pressure.
* The path to multiple products: Own the sequencing and core changes needed
before a second product can onboard, and the migration approach for
remittance as the platform evolves underneath it.
* The product surface: Define the contracts teams build against — workflow
interfaces, idempotency, retry and compensation semantics, timeouts, state
visibility, SLAs — and the docs, onboarding and observability tooling that
make the platform self-serve and operable.
* Roadmap and delivery: Run the platform engineering team's roadmap, balancing
remittance reliability against platform investment, and own the platform's
success metrics (workflow success rates, time-to-completion, manual
intervention rate, time to resolve stuck workflows, time-to-integrate).
* Stakeholders and architecture: Represent the platform to operations,
compliance and finance; partner with the engineering lead on architecture
decisions with product consequences.

REQUIREMENTS

* 5+ years in product management with at least 3 years owning a platform,
infrastructure, API, or backend product whose primary customers were other
engineering teams. You have shipped something other teams built on, lived
with the consequences of its abstractions, and can talk concretely about what
you got wrong.
* Strong grounding in distributed-systems concepts: asynchronous processing,
eventual consistency, at-least-once delivery, idempotency, compensation
versus rollback, and the failure modes of long-running workflows. You can
hold a design conversation with senior engineers as a peer.
* Payments, remittance, banking, ledger or transaction-processing experience.
You understand settlement, reconciliation, payout partners and compliance
screening well enough to know where the domain-specific logic ends.
* Exceptional written communication. Your specs and contracts will be the
reference others depend on.
* Direct comfort with data: querying, reading dashboards, investigating
anomalies without an intermediary.
* A track record of saying No to powerful internal stakeholders and being right
often enough that they kept coming back.
* These are the applicable requirements, although equivalent competencies in
any of the above will also be considered.

Nice to have:

* Hands-on product experience with a workflow or durable-execution engine —
Temporal, Cadence, Step Functions, Camunda, or an in-house equivalent.
* Experience owning platform reliability outcomes, not just features.

WHAT WE OFFER

* Competitive salary
* Initial stock options grant
* Annual performance bonus
* Unlimited PTO
* Paid parental leave
* Work model: currently fully remote, with a future transition to a hybrid
setup
* Health, dental, and vision plans
* 401(k) with employer matching, for US-based employees
* Continuous learning opportunities
* Empowering opportunities for growth in a dynamic entrepreneurial environment

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Félix, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all
qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, religion,
nationality, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability. This
policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment,
hiring, placement, promotion, training, compensation, benefits, and termination.

Want to learn more about our privacy practices? Check out our Privacy Policy
[https://www.felixpago.com/en/legal].

postings.title: Sr/Ssr Software Engineer - Agent Platform
postings.attribution: Publicado en el sitio de empleo de Kleva · índice Fantastic.jobs
postings.descriptionText:
Sobre Kleva
Kleva construye agentes de IA que deciden cuándo y cómo contactar a cada persona, y después llaman, conversan y resuelven. Hoy recuperan deuda para bancos, fintechs y empresas de servicios en 8 países de América Latina, con miles de llamadas concurrentes. No somos una agencia de cobranzas ni un dialer con IA.
Nuestra visión es ser la voz de las empresas en Latam, y cobranzas es el primer paso. Los modelos de IA están disponibles para todos; lo difícil es lo que está alrededor: que la persona atienda, que la llamada suene real, que el agente sepa qué decir y que cada conversación cueste poco. Eso es lo que construye nuestro equipo de ingeniería.
Conocé Kleva en video
El rol
Buscamos a una persona que se sume al equipo que construye la plataforma con la que se crean, configuran, orquestan y evalúan nuestros agentes. La plataforma ya está en producción: vas a evolucionarla y escalarla de punta a punta, en frontend y backend.
No es un rol de forward deployed ni de implementación. No vas a construir agentes para clientes: vas a trabajar en la plataforma sobre la que se diseñan, prueban, despliegan y operan todos nuestros agentes.
Problemas en los que vas a trabajar
Cómo modelamos un agente para que sea versionado, testeable y reutilizable, sin perder la flexibilidad que pide cada cliente?
Cómo sabemos, antes de que hable con una persona real, que un cambio de prompt no rompió una negociación? Evals antes de cada cambio, con simulación y regresión sobre sistemas no deterministas.
Cómo hacemos que el agente recuerde entre llamadas y canales? Si alguien dijo que cobra después del 10, no lo llamamos el 5. Si rechazó una propuesta, no se la repetimos.
Cómo elegimos, llamada por llamada, qué voz, tono y guion rinden mejor con cada perfil, y cómo dejamos que la plataforma pruebe variantes y se quede con la que gana?
Cómo decidimos a quién contactar, cuándo, por qué canal y cuándo frenar, respetando los horarios, la frecuencia máxima y los registros de no llamar de cada país?
Qué vas a hacer
Desarrollar features de punta a punta, frontend y backend, con ownership completo: desde entender el problema del cliente hasta tenerlo en producción.
Diseñar el modelo de configuración de agentes: prompts, herramientas, reglas, voces y políticas por cliente, versionadas, con rollback y con variantes para experimentar.
Desarrollar la infraestructura de evals junto a QA: deudores simulados, suites de regresión y scoring automático, para que ningún cambio de agente o de prompt llegue a producción sin pasar por ella.
Construir la memoria y el contexto por persona que alimentan cada conversación, entre llamadas y canales.
Desarrollar el motor de orquestación de campañas y canales: ejecuta las decisiones de timing y priorización del equipo de data, sigue la conversación por WhatsApp si no atienden y aplica las reglas de cumplimiento de cada país.
Diseñar e implementar las APIs, contratos, webhooks e integraciones con los sistemas enterprise de cada cliente: carga de carteras, consulta de deuda, registro de promesas y confirmación de pagos.
Contribuir a la arquitectura del sistema a medida que escala en volumen y países.
Resolver incidentes en producción. Si surge un problema crítico, esperamos que te involucres y ayudes a resolverlo.
Stack
Frontend: TypeScript, React y Next.js.
Backend: Node.js con TypeScript, Go y Python.
Datos: PostgreSQL y Redis.
Infraestructura: AWS y Docker.
Contexto del rol
Reporta a: Head of Engineering.
Trabaja con: Producto, Operaciones, Delivery, QA y Data.
Qué no buscamos
Quien siente que ya llegó al nivel profesional que quería
Perfiles que necesitan un spec cerrado para arrancar. Acá recibís un problema, no un ticket. Si necesitás tres reuniones para empezar a codear, no es tu lugar.
Quien necesita certeza antes de avanzar. Ir rápido significa equivocarse seguido, hacer y rehacer; lo aceptamos porque equivocarnos rápido enseña más que acertar tarde. No hay PMs que te mastiquen tickets.
Quien construye la plataforma antes de entender el patrón. Primero entendemos cómo opera cada cliente; después generalizamos.
4+ años de experiencia profesional en desarrollo de software, con track record de llevar producto a producción en ambientes de ritmo alto.
Dominio de TypeScript, React, Next.js y Node.js.
Sólido manejo de PostgreSQL y experiencia con bases NoSQL.
Experiencia diseñando REST APIs, contratos y webhooks, y modelos de datos que aguanten el cambio.
Comodidad con Git, CI/CD y AWS.
Mentalidad de plataforma: pensás en abstracciones reutilizables y sabés cuándo todavía no conviene generalizar.
Capacidad de trabajar de forma independiente, tomar ownership y resolver sin supervisión constante.
Uso intensivo y crítico de asistentes de código con IA (Claude Code o Cursor). La IA escribe; el criterio y lo que mergeás son tuyos.
Deseable
Experiencia construyendo con LLMs en producción: prompting, tool use, structured outputs y evals.
Experiencia en plataformas de agentes, workflow engines, motores de reglas o developer tooling.
Experiencia construyendo copilots o asistentes conversacionales que operan sobre APIs de producto.
Experiencia en Go.
Sistemas multi-tenant, de alta concurrencia o altamente configurables.
Arquitecturas event-driven y colas.
Background en fintech, cobranzas o productos B2B enterprise.
Experiencia en startups early stage.
Salario competitivo en dólares.
Tres semanas pagas de vacaciones por año.
Esquema híbrido en Buenos Aires. Al menos 1 día por semana vamos a la oficina.
Un equipo chico donde lo que construís llega a producción en días
En cada interacción, valoramos los resultados por encima de los egos o jerarquías.
Cómo es trabajar en Kleva
Equipos chicos, talentosos y emprendedores. Vas a trabajar en equipos autónomos y orientados a resultados, junto a algunas de las personas más brillantes en lo suyo.
Una oportunidad excepcional para crecer. Hacemos todo lo posible por contratar personas con un potencial fuera de lo común, y después nuestra prioridad es ponerlas en el lugar ideal para que se destaquen. En Kleva, la responsabilidad se gana con resultados, no con antigüedad:
Amplificá tu impacto con IA. Integrá las herramientas de IA más potentes en todo tu flujo de desarrollo (diseño, implementación, testing y documentación) para ir más rápido sin bajar la vara en calidad, confiabilidad y mantenibilidad.
Simplificá sin descanso. Cuestioná cada capa de complejidad. Mejorá arquitecturas, pipelines y codebases para construir sistemas más simples, más escalables y más fáciles de mantener.

postings.title: Staff QA Automation Engineer

postings.descriptionText:
About Meeru AI
Meeru AI is building an AI-native platform that transforms how finance and accounting teams operate. We connect to enterprise financial systems — ERPs, CRMs, billing platforms, HRIS — and apply machine learning to turn fragmented operational data into grounded, auditable intelligence for CFOs, controllers, and FP&A leaders.
We deploy on customer terms — SaaS multi-tenant, SaaS single-tenant, and on-premises — across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Our customers are Fortune 500 finance teams who require data isolation, auditability, and compliance.
The Role
We are looking for a Staff Data Engineer to build and own the major subsystems of the data foundation — the pipelines, connectors, and curated models that feed the platform's analytics and AI layers. You take the data architecture and standards set by the data lead and turn them into robust, production-grade systems that don't break and don't lie about the numbers.
You own significant pieces of the platform end to end: complex transformations over the warehouse, source integrations for new customer systems, and the reconciliation and lineage that prove the curated model ties back to source. This is a hands-on, high-ownership engineering role with a clear path toward Senior Staff.
Why this role is exciting
High ownership — own major pipelines and integrations end to end, including their performance, reliability, and cost.
Correctness that matters — your reconciliation and lineage work is what makes the platform auditable next to real financials.
Build for reuse — integrations are configuration against a shared framework, not throwaway scripts.
Multi-cloud, multi-tenant — pipelines run inside customer clouds with strong isolation and no data egress.
8+ years in QA and test automation, including 3+ years leading people. You've hired, run 1:1s and performance reviews, and mentored QA engineers, not just led a project.
You've built automation frameworks from scratch. You've taken a product from little or no automation to a working framework across API, UI and backend tests, and you can explain the design choices.
Strong coding in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript. You write maintainable test code daily in both: PyTest for the backend, TypeScript for the frontend.
Deep API testing experience. REST, GraphQL and WebSockets, using tools like PyTest, Postman or REST Assured, including contract, negative and auth testing.
Modern end-to-end UI testing. Playwright or Cypress against React/Next.js apps, with reliable, low-flake suites covering critical user journeys.
Backend and database testing. Testing Python/FastAPI services and PostgreSQL (SQLAlchemy), with SQL-based data validation and attention to database performance.
CI/CD integration. You've wired tests into GitHub Actions, Jenkins or GitLab CI, set up deployment quality gates, and worked with Docker/Kubernetes environments.
Performance and load testing. You've designed load, stress and scalability tests with tools like k6, Locust or JMeter, plus front-end checks like Lighthouse.
Security testing. SAST/DAST in the pipeline (e.g. SonarQube, Snyk, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite), and testing authentication, role-based access and data encryption.
Multi-tenant SaaS experience. You've tested platforms where many customers share infrastructure and know how to prove one tenant can't see another's data.
Compliance-driven testing. You've supported SOC 2, GDPR or HIPAA requirements with test processes and evidence.
Cloud experience. AWS preferred (EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda); GCP or Azure also welcome.
Quality leadership and process. You've defined QA standards, metrics and KPIs, release and regression procedures, and runbooks, and you report quality clearly to leadership.
Clear communication and collaboration. You work closely with Product on acceptance criteria, Engineering on testability and DevOps on releases, explaining risk to technical and non-technical people alike, in an Agile/Scrum setup.
Nice to have
Testing AI/LLM applications. You've tested LLM features or agentic workflows, can handle non-deterministic output, validate prompts and model outputs, and check for bias and fairness. LangChain/LangGraph familiarity is a plus.
FinTech or financial services background. Experience where accuracy, audit trails and reliability around money matter.
Startup experience. You're comfortable building from zero in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.
Observability and production monitoring. Datadog, CloudWatch, Prometheus or New Relic, including monitoring AI behavior in production.
Chaos engineering and resilience testing.
Test management tools. TestRail, Zephyr or Jira-based test management.
Certifications. ISTQB Advanced (or similar), AWS Certified Developer or Solutions Architect.
Community involvement. Open-source contributions to testing frameworks, technical writing or conference talks.

postings.title: HE3 - Software Developer, E-Commerce Systems
postings.attribution: Publicado en el sitio de empleo de Rockcruit · índice Fantastic.jobs
postings.descriptionText:
We run three home furnishings storefronts on a catalog of 100,000+ SKUs from a long list of manufacturers. Almost all of it runs on software we built ourselves: a Django backend, a React storefront on Cloudflare Workers, and a set of pipelines that turn messy vendor spreadsheets, emails, SFTP drops and websites into clean product, pricing and inventory data.
We're looking for a developer to work alongside our lead developer on that stack. Most of the job is solving concrete business problems: a vendor feed that breaks every month, a pricing rule nobody can explain, a task the team still does by hand in a spreadsheet. You'll figure out what's actually going on, then build the fix, and look for places where AI can make the process itself work better.
What you'll work on
● Product data. Vendor imports and feeds, our in-house PIM, categorization, images and data quality across a large, inconsistent catalog.
● Inventory and pricing. Feed ingestion (AWS Lambda, S3, SFTP), scrapers for vendors without feeds, and the pricing, deals and cart logic that depend on them.
● The storefront API. We're replacing Shopify with our own Django backend and a React Router storefront. You'll build and test the API endpoints the new site depends on.
● Search. Elasticsearch-backed search, facets and recommendations.
● Internal tools and automation. Find the manual, repetitive work across the business (merchandising, customer service, operations) and replace it with something reliable. Sometimes that's a script or an admin screen. Sometimes it's an LLM-based workflow, if that's the right tool for the problem.
● Infrastructure. We're moving hand-built AWS and Cloudflare resources to OpenTofu. Some exposure here is useful but not required.
How we work
● Tests come first. We write a failing test, then the code. Tests build their own data and assert on exact values. A test that only checks for a 200 response doesn't count.
● Typed, reviewed, small. Python is type-annotated and checked, TypeScript runs in strict mode, and changes go in as small, focused pull requests with one fix per commit.
● Production is careful work. Migrations, data fixes and infrastructure changes get agreed on before they run, and we don't commit secrets.
● We use AI coding assistants every day, and we review everything they produce. We keep written project conventions that the agents follow. We want someone who gets real speed out of these tools and still owns every line that ships, and who can spot when the assistant got it wrong.
What we're looking for
● Strong Python. Django (ORM, migrations, admin) experience is a big plus.
● Solid SQL and PostgreSQL. Comfortable reading query plans and pushing work into the database when it makes sense.
● Experience building and consuming APIs. Django Ninja, Pydantic or OpenAPI is a plus.
● Experience working with messy real-world data: CSV/Excel imports, vendor feeds, scraping, ETL.
● Enough TypeScript/React to work on the storefront when a feature spans both repos.
● Good judgment about when automation (including LLMs) helps and when a plain script or a better process is the right answer.
● Clear written communication. You'll write PR descriptions, docs and tickets that someone else can act on.
Nice to have
● E-commerce experience, especially catalog, PIM, order management or checkout (Stripe).
● Elasticsearch or another major search platform.
● AWS (Lambda, S3, ECS), Cloudflare Workers, OpenTofu/Terraform.
● Experience in furniture, home furnishings or another product-heavy retail business.

**Previous experience in a similar Talent Acquisition / Recruiting / HR coordination role, with **hands-on experience working with an ATS (ideally Greenhouse)****.
Advanced level of English (written and spoken); ability to communicate confidently with global stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills with a proven track record of prioritization, motivation, and follow-through.
Self-motivated with a high sense of urgency, while collaborating effectively within a team environment.
Flexibility and adaptability to thrive in a dynamic, evolving business.
A charismatic, people-first mindset—you’re approachable, fearless, and excited to help build something meaningful.

COMPENSATION & PERKS

Competitive full-time salary based on experience and meaningful equity in an industry-leading company
This is a role based in our Palermo office, with a mandatory in-office presence four days per week.
The opportunity to be a key player and build your career at a rapidly expanding, global technology company in an exciting, emerging industry.
Performance-based bonuses
Apple equipment provided by the company
Work from Anywhere Policy: You can work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 20 days per year.

Blockchain is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, and apprenticeship. You may contact our Data Protection Officer by email at dpo@blockchain.com. Such processing is legally permissible under Art. 6(1)(f) of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation) as necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the Controller, which are the solicitation, evaluation, and selection of applicants for employment.

Because the European Union Commission has determined that United States data privacy laws do not ensure an adequate level of protection for personal data collected from EU data subjects, the transfer will be subject to appropriate additional safeguards under the standard contractual clauses.

Your personal data will be retained by Controller as long as Controller determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for employment. Under the GDPR, you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted. postings.title: Recruiter / Headhunter
postings.descriptionText:
Job Title: Remote Recruiter

The Ideal Candidate:
This is not a typical recruiting job. We’re hiring ambitious, hardcore recruiters who take ownership of outcomes. Energized by a dynamic startup environment, you thrive in fast feedback loops, drive momentum, and bring exceptionally high standards to recruitment.
If you’re looking for fixed hours, rigid boundaries, and work life balance, this isn’t it. If you’re driven, responsive, have a strong work ethic, value growth, and want to be rewarded for results, we should talk.

Summary of the Role:
The Remote Recruitment Specialist is primarily responsible for outbound sourcing and headhunting passive candidates, outreaching, engaging, and qualifying them, then facilitating structured candidate assessments to deliver objective, transparent, data driven hiring outcomes.

Our operations team supports you by building and automating the administrative, assessment, and reporting processes behind the scenes, so your time stays focused on delivering candidate results.

Recruitment covers two tracks: internal hiring and Canadian candidate headhunting for our clients. You will collaborate and iterate with our Co founders and Account Manager over Slack and recorded Zoom meetings to align on strategy, build our team, and drive client hiring outcomes.

Adaptable Scope:
The full role spans client hiring, candidate work, internal recruitment, sourcing, and assessments. We may consider narrower or fractional roles for strong candidates missing some pieces.

About Us:
Objective Recruiting is a new start-up that supports small and medium-sized businesses with objective, operator-grade hiring. It’s not who you know, but what you know.

We run a transparent, data-driven recruitment process that empowers key decision-makers to hire with facts — not feelings, ensuring company and candidate achieve a durable, mutually productive fit.

We’re building a geographically diverse, remote team of analytical professionals to transform the traditional recruitment model from an opaque, biased and subjective evaluation of fit into one rooted in transparency, merit, and objective best-fit between client and candidate.

For insights into how we operate check out our website: https://objectiverecruiting.ca

Schedule & Availability: Flexible with common sense. We stay responsive to Canadian clients, candidates, and a remote internal team across time zones.

Key Responsibilities:
Sourcing: Source and qualify passive candidates in line with screening criteria and outbound sourcing strategies, utilizing methods such as headhunting, Boolean search, and networking. Ensure Sourced Qualified Leads are captured in company systems with the core screening materials required for the role.
Outreach & Engagement: Execute high quality, personalized outreach to passive candidates you source to build rapport, sell the opportunity, maintain momentum, and move candidates through the funnel. Manage follow ups, scheduling, and candidate communication to maximize conversion from Sourced Qualified Leads to Assessed Candidates. Adapt outreach, scheduling, and handoffs to candidate time zones.
Candidate Assessments: Facilitate structured candidate assessments over recorded video interviews, maintaining alignment with recruitment strategies and briefs. Capture key outputs in company systems and progress qualified candidates toward hiring outcomes.
Hiring Outcomes: Drive late stage progression from Assessed Candidates to Hired Candidates, including reference checks, ad hoc follow-up interviews, and gathering work samples as needed. Collaborate closely with stakeholders to maintain momentum, remove friction, and support closing steps through to hiring outcomes, ensuring positive stakeholder experience, strong company reputation, and lasting candidate and client success.

Expectations:
Stakeholder-Facing Professionalism: Conduct all stakeholder video meetings and candidate interviews in business-professional attire, from a Professional Workspace or Home Office.
Transparency and Proof of Work: Provide objective, transparent and verifiable proof of work, including: recorded meetings, interviews, calls, and system updates that allow stakeholders to validate work quality.
High Communication Standards: Deliver accurate and timely updates, prompt response times, follow-ups and ensure candidates, clients and stakeholders are informed and aligned.
Timesheet & Invoicing: Maintain and submit an accurate timesheet on days worked that itemizes recruitment outcomes, projects, and billable hours to ensure transparency and alignment with your invoicing.
CRM Logs: Maintain accurate activity logs, notes and next steps for all leads and candidates under your ownership ensuring accurate attribution, insights and minimizing duplication of efforts with other recruitment specialists.
Flexibility & Collaboration: As a startup in a dynamic phase, we may pivot tactics or evolve offerings. We expect flexibility, collaboration, and comfort adapting with a solutions oriented approach.
Collaborative Optimization: Provide feedback and share insights with the Operations team to enable their creation and optimization of our recruitment systems and workflows.

Seniority & Fit: We care less about title or years of experience than proof of ability. What matters is track record, work ethic, responsiveness, and ability to deliver recruiting outcomes.

Requirements:
MANDATORY:
Outbound Headhunting: Demonstrated ability and track record sourcing and engaging passive candidates through outbound headhunting, outreach, screening, qualification, interviews, reference checks, and closing support.
English Proficiency: CEFR C1 English or better is required across speaking, listening, reading, and writing.
Professional Workspace or Home Office: You have or will have a dedicated, quiet, well lit, confidential workspace with reliable high speed internet, a high resolution webcam, and high fidelity audio for professional video calls. Background must be real and professional: no bedrooms, shared spaces, clutter, people, virtual backgrounds, or blur effects.
PREFERRED:
LinkedIn Network Depth: Your network is geographically diverse and exceeds 2000 connections.
Developed Market Recruiting: Full cycle recruiting experience in developed markets such as Canada, the US, UK, EU, or Australia.
AI Usage: Successfully uses AI models such as ChatGPT, Gemini, etc. in recruitment or business contexts.
Remote Startup Experience: Worked remotely in a company of fewer than 20 people.
Contingency Recruiting: Experience working in a success fee model where compensation or firm revenue depends on making hires.
External Client Management: Experience owning communication, expectations, updates, issue resolution, and outcomes with external clients throughout a hiring process.
Boolean Search: Ability to build and iterate precise candidate search strings across sourcing platforms such as LinkedIn and Google.
Talent Mapping: Ability to identify relevant titles, target companies, and adjacent talent pools, then prioritize leads for systematic outbound sourcing.

Senior Business Developer – Industria 4.0 / Software industrial
📍 País Vasco · Híbrido · Disponibilidad para viajar

¿Quiénes somos?

SmartPM | Tecnología, innovación y crecimiento internacional

En SmartPM somos una empresa tecnológica especializada en la digitalización, automatización y optimización de procesos industriales. Desarrollamos tecnología propia para ayudar a las empresas a transformar sus operaciones, mejorar su competitividad y afrontar los retos de la industria del futuro.

Nuestra plataforma MIC (Manufacturing Intelligence Core) integra soluciones avanzadas de software industrial, automatización e inteligencia artificial, con aplicaciones en sectores estratégicos como defensa, aeronáutica, automoción y fabricación avanzada.

Con sede en Gipuzkoa y una clara vocación internacional, trabajamos con compañías industriales de referencia, desarrollando proyectos de alto valor tecnológico en mercados nacionales e internacionales. Somos una empresa consolidada, con un equipo multidisciplinar, una fuerte apuesta por la innovación y una ambiciosa estrategia de crecimiento.

Estamos en un momento especialmente ilusionante de nuestra evolución: ampliando nuestra presencia internacional, desarrollando nuevas alianzas estratégicas y posicionando nuestra tecnología en sectores de gran potencial.

Buscamos profesionales con visión de negocio, iniciativa y ambición que quieran formar parte de este proyecto, contribuir activamente a su expansión y crecer profesionalmente junto a nosotros.
En SmartPM no solo ofrecemos incorporarse a una empresa tecnológica, sino la oportunidad de participar en la construcción de su futuro.

El reto

Estamos reforzando nuestro equipo de desarrollo de negocio y buscamos un/a Senior Business Developer: un perfil con experiencia que quiera estar en primera línea, abriendo cuentas y cerrando operaciones complejas en grandes organizaciones industriales.

No buscamos a alguien que mantenga cartera, sino a alguien que abra puertas. Tendrás autonomía total sobre tus cuentas y oportunidades, y trabajarás junto a la dirección del área para hacer crecer MIC en España y fuera.

¿Qué harás?

Abrir y desarrollar cuentas estratégicas en grandes organizaciones industriales.
Liderar de principio a fin ventas consultivas complejas, con ciclos largos y varios interlocutores: CEO, COO, Dirección de IT, Ciberseguridad, Operaciones…
Analizar los retos de cada cliente, detectar dónde aporta valor MIC y diseñar la estrategia de entrada en cada cuenta.
Hacerte cargo de tus cuentas, sectores o mercados asignados, incluidos los internacionales (Portugal, LATAM, Europa del Este, India o Norteamérica).
Desarrollar relaciones con distribuidores, integradores, prescriptores y partners tecnológicos que abran acceso a nuevos clientes.
Gestionar tu pipeline y tu previsión comercial con rigor, anticipando riesgos y desbloqueando oportunidades.
Representar a SMARTPM en eventos y foros del ecosistema industrial.
Ser la voz del mercado dentro de la empresa y trasladar a producto, desarrollo e implantación lo que piden los clientes.

¿Qué buscamos?

Al menos 5 años en desarrollo de negocio y venta compleja B2B en sector industrial, tecnología industrial o software para manufactura.
Experiencia demostrable abriendo cuentas nuevas y cerrando operaciones con perfiles de Dirección y C-Level.
Base técnico-industrial: idealmente formación en Ingeniería Industrial o similar, y experiencia previa en ingeniería, producción, operaciones o calidad.
Experiencia en desarrollo de negocio internacional.
Conocimientos de software suficientes para defender una solución como MIC.
Autonomía, perseverancia y orientación a resultados.
Inglés nativo o alto.

Se valorará:

Experiencia y red de contactos en el ámbito industrial.
Conocimiento de MES, PLM, trazabilidad, automatización e Industria 4.0.
Perfiles de Dirección de Operaciones o de Proyecto con mucha relación con cliente que quieran dar el salto a negocio.
Experiencia con herramientas CRM.
Portugués, francés o alemán.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Incorporación a un proyecto tecnológico sólido y en plena expansión, con producto propio, una clara diferenciación en el mercado y un importante potencial de crecimiento nacional e internacional.
Participación activa en la estrategia de crecimiento de SmartPM, con capacidad real de influencia en el desarrollo del negocio, la apertura de nuevos mercados y la generación de alianzas estratégicas.
Proyectos innovadores y de alto valor tecnológico, trabajando con clientes de referencia en sectores estratégicos como defensa, aeronáutica y fabricación avanzada.
Entorno dinámico, innovador y multidisciplinar, con contacto directo con la dirección y colaboración estrecha con los equipos técnicos y de producto.
Autonomía, responsabilidad y capacidad de decisión, con espacio para aportar ideas, impulsar iniciativas y desarrollar nuevas oportunidades de negocio.
Proyección profesional y oportunidades de crecimiento, vinculadas a la evolución de la compañía y a los resultados alcanzados.
Condiciones económicas competitivas, con una retribución fija y variable vinculada a objetivos, acorde con la experiencia y responsabilidad del puesto.
Flexibilidad y un entorno de trabajo basado en la confianza, el compromiso y la orientación a resultados.

¿Te ves abriendo cuentas para la industria del futuro? Nos encantará conocerte. 🚀

#BusinessDevelopment #Industria40 #Manufacturing #AerospaceAndDefense #MES #SmartManufacturing #Empleo

postings.title: Product Manager - Accounting
postings.descriptionText:
Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.

We chose hard problems on purpose.

We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.

Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.

If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.

Jeeves is looking for a Product Manager who understands accounting to drive our Accounting & Finance Automation work. You'll build products that accountants, controllers, and finance teams use to manage corporate spend across 20+ countries — automating manual workflows, ensuring data accuracy, and connecting Jeeves to the ERP and accounting systems our customers rely on.

Location: This role is remote based out of Argentina .

What You'll Do

Ship improvements to the accounting user experience: spend data management, reconciliation, compliance, and audit trails
Identify and validate AI automation opportunities — prototype solutions, know when AI fits vs. when deterministic rules are required
Drive integration work with ERP and accounting platforms (NetSuite, SAP, QuickBooks, etc.)
Run customer discovery with controllers and CFOs; turn findings into clear specs engineering can build

What We're Looking For

Product Manager with financial systems experience — 3+ years of B2B SaaS/fintech PM experience building products that integrate with ERP or accounting platforms
Working knowledge of GAAP/IFRS
Strong analytical skills (SQL, data analysis)
Hands-on comfort prototyping with AI tools, and excellent written communication.
LatAm accounting and compliance knowledge is a big plus.

Logistics

Remote or Hybrid, LatAm-based (MX/COL/BR/ARG)

Why This Role Matters

Accounting and finance workflows in spend management are fundamentally broken. Finance teams spend dozens of hours per month on repetitive manual work that should be automated. This isn't just inefficiency—it delays financial reporting, introduces errors, and frustrates talented professionals who should be focused on strategic work, not data entry.

As our Accounting & Finance Automation PM, you'll have the opportunity to:

Transform how finance teams work for 5,000+ global businesses
Build AI-powered solutions that finance professionals actually trust and adopt
Solve complex multi-market problems across LatAm, US, and Europe
Shape the future of financial automation in spend management

If you're passionate about accounting and finance, love building products that solve real workflow problems, and want to use technology to transform how finance teams work—we'd love to talk to you.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

postings.title: Senior QA Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
En Tech-House, impulsamos productos digitales escalables y de alto impacto. Creemos que la calidad no es una etapa final ni un simple check al terminar un desarrollo: es una cultura que se construye desde el primer día. Buscamos a un/a Sr. QA Engineer con visión estratégica, mentalidad analítica y pasión por la automatización para liderar la estrategia de testing de nuestros principales proyectos.

🚀 ¿Cuál va a ser tu desafío?
Liderar la cultura de QA: Definir, implementar y hacer evolucionar la estrategia de pruebas (funcional, automatización, perfomance y regresión).
Construir y escalar frameworks: Diseñar y mantener suites de automatización robustas e integradas a nuestros pipelines de CI/CD.
Ser partner técnico del equipo: Trabajar codo a codo con Developers, Product Managers y DevOps desde la etapa de concepción y diseño de requerimientos.
Impulsar las mejores prácticas: Mentorear a otros miembros del equipo y fomentar una mentalidad de prevención de fallas antes que detección.
Garantizar excelencia: Mantener altos estándares de performance, seguridad y experiencia de usuario en cada release.

🎯 ¿Qué buscamos en vos?
Experiencia: +5 años en roles de Quality Assurance, con foco fuerte en el ecosistema digital/web/mobile.
Automation Mastery: Dominio de frameworks de automatización (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium o similares) usando lenguajes como JavaScript, TypeScript, Python o Java.
Integración y CI/CD: Manejo de herramientas como Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps o similares.
API Testing: Sólida experiencia probando APIs y microservicios (Postman, REST Assured, Bruno, etc.).
Bases de datos: Conocimientos sólidos de SQL para validación y manipulación de datos.
Soft Skills: Capacidad de comunicación asertiva, pensamiento crítico, autonomía y orientación a resultados.

postings.title: Sr. Product Manager - Loyalty & Promotions
postings.descriptionText:
¡Hola! Somos Cashea 👋 y nuestra misión es devolverle a los venezolanos la oportunidad de acceder al crédito a través de un modelo de negocios BNPL. Desde nuestro lanzamiento en 2022, nos hemos dedicado a promover la inclusión financiera. Hoy día tenemos más de 9 millones de usuarios activos, tanto para consumidores como para comercios, y nos hemos convertido en una marca de confianza en Venezuela, conquistando mentes y corazones.

Sobre este rol

En Cashea, queremos construir una relación con nuestros usuarios que vaya mucho más allá de una transacción.

Loyalty & Promotions es el espacio desde el cual diseñamos cómo recompensamos a nuestros usuarios, cómo generamos incentivos para impulsar comportamientos y cómo construimos capacidades que nos permitan hacerlo de forma cada vez más inteligente, escalable y medible.

Buscamos un/a Product Manager Senior que lidere este espacio combinando visión de producto, un fuerte entendimiento del negocio y sus métricas, y una gran capacidad de ejecución.

Vas a trabajar en la intersección entre producto, growth, tecnología y economics, construyendo experiencias para nuestros usuarios y capacidades que puedan ser aprovechadas por distintos equipos de Cashea.

Lo que vas a hacer

Ser owner de las métricas de su producto, entendiendo profundamente qué las mueve, identificando oportunidades y tomando decisiones de producto a partir de ellas.
Definir y ejecutar la estrategia de producto de Loyalty & Promotions, conectándola con los objetivos de crecimiento, engagement y rentabilidad de Cashea.
Liderar la optimización del funnel de los usuarios desde la segunda compra asegurando la mejora en frecuencia, retención y progresión de usuarios dentro del club.
Evolucionar nuestro Motor de Promociones, construyendo capacidades reutilizables para crear, configurar, distribuir y medir promociones e incentivos a escala.
Diseñar productos e incentivos a partir de comportamientos concretos que queremos generar en nuestros usuarios.
Asegurar la integración del motor de promociones con todo el ecosistema de Cashea.
Convertir necesidades y oportunidades de Growth y negocio en problemas de producto bien definidos y soluciones escalables, trabajando en conjunto sobre las capacidades necesarias para habilitarlas.
Diseñar experimentos con grupos de control, definir hipótesis y medir el impacto incremental real de las iniciativas.
Entender los economics detrás de los incentivos y encontrar el equilibrio entre valor para el usuario e impacto para el negocio.
Trabajar muy cerca de Negocio, Engineering, Design, Data, Growth y Commercial para llevar las iniciativas desde la oportunidad hasta su ejecución y aprendizaje.
Construir loyalty loops escalables basados en producto, datos y automatización.
Diseñar junto con Negocio estrategias para aumentar engagement, MABs, recurrencia y LTV.
Impulsar la adopción y cross-sell de nuevos productos y beneficios.
Elevar la disciplina de procesos, documentación y experimentación del equipo.

¿Qué buscamos en vos?

+6 años de experiencia como Product Manager liderando productos digitales con impacto directo en métricas de negocio.
Experiencia en growth, loyalty, fintech, marketplaces, promotions o productos con fuerte foco en engagement y monetización es especialmente valiosa.
Fuerte business acumen y experiencia trabajando cerca del negocio, entendiendo sus economics y tomando decisiones de producto conectadas con objetivos comerciales.
Fuerte orientación a outcomes y capacidad para conectar decisiones de producto con métricas de negocio.
Capacidad analítica y comodidad trabajando con funnels, cohortes, segmentaciones y experimentos.
Buen entendimiento de unit economics y capacidad para razonar sobre el costo y retorno de incentivos.
Fluidez técnica para trabajar cerca de Engineering, entender restricciones y participar activamente de los trade-offs.
Criterio para priorizar y tomar decisiones en contextos dinámicos y de alta velocidad.
Excelente comunicación y capacidad para alinear equipos con perspectivas diferentes.

Porque te encantará trabajar en Cashea

En Cashea tenemos una cultura de trabajo basada en la confianza y el propósito. Si necesitas una pista de por qué somos una buena opción, estos son nuestros valores fundamentales:

No trabajamos en piloto automático. Todo lo que hacemos es intencional. Nos encanta elaborar ideas plenamente conscientes del impacto que pueden tener en nuestros usuarios.
Tu creatividad y curiosidad son el activo más Importante.
Tu voz importa. Escuchamos y damos espacio a las ideas y al feedback. Todos pertenecen y lo que es importante para ti, también lo es para nosotros.
Valoramos la transparencia. La claridad nos mantiene conectados y con los pies en la tierra.
Por último, pero no menos importante, nos enfocamos en el impacto real.

postings.title: Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET & Angular)
postings.descriptionText:
About The Role

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will make an impact by designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications using modern Microsoft technologies. You will be a valued member of the engineering team, collaborating with product managers, architects, designers, and fellow developers to deliver high-quality digital solutions that support business objectives.

In This Role, You Will

Design, develop, and maintain modern web applications using Angular 16+ and.NET 6+.
Build and maintain secure, scalable, and high-performing RESTful APIs.
Develop and optimize SQL database solutions, including schema design, query tuning, and data integrity management.
Implement cloud-native and serverless solutions using Azure Functions and other Microsoft Azure services.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver new features and enhancements throughout the software development lifecycle.
Participate in code reviews and promote best practices related to code quality, security, performance, and maintainability.
Manage work items and project delivery using Azure DevOps Boards.
Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate testing, deployment, and release processes.
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application and performance issues.
Stay current with emerging technologies, AI-assisted development tools, and software engineering best practices.

Work model

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on business requirements, this position is open to qualified applicants located in Argentina and may operate in either a hybrid or remote work model, depending on project needs. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. [Global Job...oilerplate | Word]

What you need to have to be considered

Advanced English communication skills, both written and verbal.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
Proven experience as a Full Stack Developer or Software Engineer delivering enterprise-grade applications.
Strong hands-on experience with Angular 16+,.NET 6+, and ASP.NET MVC.
Experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs.
Strong knowledge of SQL databases, including query optimization and performance tuning.
Experience with Azure Functions and serverless application architectures.
Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, including Boards, Repositories, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Copilot Agent Mode, or similar productivity tools.
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, communication, and teamwork abilities.

These will help you stand out

Experience with Azure App Services, Azure Storage, and Azure Active Directory.
Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience designing or supporting microservices architectures.
Experience with automated testing frameworks, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
Exposure to additional front-end frameworks or modern JavaScript libraries.
Experience implementing DevOps and cloud-native engineering best practices.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Architect and maintain the code base for ETL and ELT pipelines, along with large batch, micro-batch, and streaming systems

Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements, such as automating manual tasks, optimizing data delivery, and redesigning infrastructure for greater scalability

A minimum of 3 years of relevant experience
Strong core Python skills for data engineering tasks
Proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and querying
Experience with Apache Spark for large-scale data processing
Familiarity with Anthropic Claude Code
Experience with Databricks for data engineering and analytics workflows

Nice to have

Experience with Apache Kafka for event streaming
Familiarity with Java
Experience with PySpark
Familiarity with Scala
Experience with Spark Streaming

International projects with top brands

Upskilling, reskilling and certification courses
Unlimited access to the LinkedIn Learning library and 22,000+ courses

postings.title: Automation QA Engineer (QVAC) (100% remote)
postings.descriptionText:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About The Job

We’re looking for an Automation QA Engineer with strong automation skills who also takes ownership of manual testing for our desktop and mobile applications.

Responsibilities

Build and maintain desktop and mobile test automation for critical user flows.
Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines and keep them fast and reliable.
Investigate failures, fix flaky tests, and manage test data and environments
Report clear, reproducible bugs and verify fixes
Work with developers and product on testability and acceptance criteria
Perform hands-on functional, exploratory, and regression testing of new features
Choose manual or automated coverage based on risk; maintain regression suites.

Mandatory:

4+ years in QA automation, plus hands-on manual and exploratory testing experience.
Strong programming skills in TypeScript/JavaScript.
Experience running tests in CI/CD pipelines (for example, GitHub Actions).
Hands-on experience with Playwright for desktop or web, and WebdriverIO + Appium for mobile.
Experience testing Electron and/or React Native apps, including on real iOS and Android devices.
Experience using AI tools in QA and critically reviewing their output. Testing AI-powered applications is a plus.

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io
We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About The Job

Tether Wallet is our self-custodial wallet, built to bring USDT and XAUT directly to the people who rely on Tether every day, especially in markets where access to stable money and savings is hardest. For that to work, getting into these assets has to be simple, fast and affordable. Our goal is to give every Tether Wallet user the best option to exchange any local currency or token into USDT and XAUT, wherever they are.

In this role, you will define and own the strategy for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT across our target markets. You will work hand in hand with our expansion teams to map the payment landscape in each market: which payment methods people actually use, which card schemes and bank rails dominate, and which on-ramp and swap providers can serve them. Based on that, you will identify the best partner for each market and bring them on board as a service partner of Tether Wallet.

This role sits at the intersection of product, payments and partnerships. You will own the outcome end to end, from the first partner evaluation through integration and the in-app experience to the conversion numbers after launch. If you enjoy turning a fragmented global payments landscape into a buy button that just works, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

Buy & Swap Strategy: Define and own the strategy and roadmap for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT in Tether Wallet, covering fiat on-ramps, card payments, local payment methods and token-to-token swaps.
Market & Payment Landscape: Work with our expansion teams to build a deep understanding of each target market, including dominant payment methods, card schemes, bank transfer and instant payment rails, mobile money, local regulation, and the on-ramp and swap providers active there.
Partner Evaluation & Selection: Define clear evaluation criteria such as market and payment method coverage, fees and FX spreads, approval and conversion rates, KYC experience, settlement speed, reliability and compliance standing, and use them to select the best on-ramp or swap partner for each market.
Partner Onboarding: Lead selected partners from evaluation to go-live as service partners of Tether Wallet, coordinating with Legal, Compliance and Business Development on due diligence, commercial terms and contracts.
Integration & Delivery: Translate partner capabilities and APIs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with engineering and design to deliver a seamless in-app buy and swap experience.
Routing & Optimization: Define the logic that decides which partner and payment method a user is offered based on country, currency, amount, price and availability, so every user gets the best available option.
Performance & Partner Management: Define and track KPIs across the buy and swap funnel, such as conversion, payment approval rates, KYC drop-off, total cost to the user and volume by market and partner. Use the data to improve the experience, manage partner performance and incidents, and regularly review whether each market still has the right partner.

5+ years of product management experience in the financial industry (banking, payment service provider, FinTech)
3+ years of product management experience in DeFi or crypto industry
Good understanding of crypto wallets and DeFi features, including token swaps, DEX aggregators and on-chain transaction flows.
Good understanding of global payment systems and credit card schemes (e.g. Visa, Mastercard), including authorization, 3-D Secure and chargebacks, as well as local payment methods such as bank transfers, instant payment rails and mobile money.
Hands-on experience with fiat on-ramp, off-ramp or swap providers, or with integrating third-party payment providers and gateways into a consumer product.
Proven experience evaluating, selecting and onboarding external partners, and managing their performance after launch.
Working knowledge of KYC/AML requirements and how they affect user onboarding and conversion.
Technical enough to read partner API documentation, assess integration options and work closely with engineering teams.
Data-driven: experience defining funnel KPIs and using data to improve conversion and make partner decisions.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with partners, expansion teams and engineers across time zones in a remote environment.

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io
We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Our client is looking for a Senior QA Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, security, and compliance of a modern, cloud-based dental practice management platform. The application includes a Ruby on Rails backend and a React frontend.

This role will focus on manual and automated testing, improving test coverage, identifying defects, and ensuring software quality throughout the development lifecycle. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Ranorex, Mabl, Postman, Selenium, or similar automation frameworks, along with experience using AI tools to improve testing efficiency and coverage.

You will work closely with developers and other stakeholders to identify issues early, strengthen regression testing, and establish reliable quality processes. Since the platform operates in a healthcare environment, a strong understanding of data privacy and the importance of protecting sensitive patient information is essential.

Key Responsibilities

Design, execute, and maintain manual and automated tests for web applications, APIs, and software integrations
Build and maintain automated test suites using Ranorex, Mabl, Selenium, or similar frameworks
Perform API testing using Postman or equivalent tools to validate endpoints, integrations, and expected application behavior
Conduct functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and end-to-end testing
Collaborate with developers to identify testing requirements, improve test coverage, and prevent regressions
Validate critical workflows, including scheduling, provider workflows, patient lookups, authentication, and other dental practice management functions
Identify, document, reproduce, and track defects, providing clear steps, environment details, and expected versus actual results
Support the development and maintenance of automated quality checks within CI/CD pipelines
Review test results and identify gaps in test coverage, reliability, and overall software quality
Use AI tools to accelerate test creation, identify coverage gaps, and improve QA workflows
Critically review AI-generated tests to ensure assertions, mocks, and test scenarios accurately reflect application behavior
Participate in code and pull request reviews to identify potential quality, security, and compliance risks
Maintain test documentation, test cases, coverage reports, and QA procedures
Work with synthetic and mock data exclusively to prevent exposure of real patient information
Identify potential security vulnerabilities and patient data privacy risks during testing
Collaborate with engineering teams to continuously improve testing processes and release confidence

Requirements

Proven experience in software quality assurance, including both manual and automated testing
Hands-on experience with Ranorex, Mabl, Postman, and Selenium or similar automation frameworks
Experience designing, executing, and maintaining automated test suites
Strong understanding of functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end testing
Experience testing web applications, APIs, and third-party integrations
Experience using Postman or similar tools to validate REST APIs
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates
Ability to investigate application behavior, reproduce defects, and document clear, actionable bug reports
Experience collaborating with developers to improve test coverage and software quality
Familiarity with Git-based workflows, pull requests, and Agile development practices
Ability to understand application behavior across frontend and backend systems
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a methodical approach to troubleshooting
AI Tooling & Automation — Required
Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent tools
Experience using AI tools to support test generation, test automation, test case development, or coverage analysis
Ability to evaluate AI-generated tests for correctness, meaningful assertions, and realistic test scenarios
Ability to identify hallucinated mocks, incorrect assumptions, and tests that would not detect actual regressions
Understanding that AI-generated code and tests must be reviewed and validated before being accepted
Willingness to incorporate AI tools into existing QA processes to improve efficiency without compromising quality
Nice to Have
Experience testing healthcare, dental, or other regulated SaaS applications
Familiarity with dental practice management systems, such as Orthotrac, PracticeWorks, SoftDent, or WinOMS
Experience with Ruby on Rails and React applications
Familiarity with RSpec, FactoryBot, WebMock, or VCR
Experience with Playwright or other end-to-end testing frameworks
Experience with performance and load testing tools such as k6 or Locust
Familiarity with Azure Cosmos DB and document-based data structures
Experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD) or Behavior-Driven Development (BDD)
Familiarity with healthcare data exchange standards such as HL7 or FHIR
Experience with visual regression testing or component testing.

Benefits

Work remotely Monday - Friday, 40 hours a week (no weekends)
Health Care Reimbursement
Active Lifestyle Reimbursement
Quarterly Home Office Reimbursement
Payroll Deduction Purchase Plans
Continuous Learning Bonus
Access to Training and Professional Development Platforms
Did we mention it's REMOTE?!!

One of our core values at Zipdev is "Be authentic." that's why we encourage you to answer the application form in your own words; we are interested in getting to know you, not a digital assistant.

Wondering how our remote environment or our payment method work? We've put together some helpful answers in our FAQs at the bottom our our career site. Take a look and let us know if you have any other questions!

Experience integrating NetSuite with Shopify and other business applications is required. This role focuses on improving system functions, making business processes smoother, keeping integrations working well, and ensuring accurate data flow. You will play a key role in making sure business systems work together efficiently. You will support business growth with scalable technical solutions and reliable system integrations.

Design, develop, customize, and maintain Oracle NetSuite solutions.

Customize NetSuite records, forms, fields, workflows, saved searches, and reports.

Build and optimize integration flows between NetSuite, Shopify, and other business applications.

Optimize integration flows to improve data accuracy, processing speed, and reliability.

Develop solutions that support inventory management, order processing, purchasing, fulfillment, and financial operations.
Improve data consistency and reduce manual entry across connected systems.
Collaborate with finance, inventory, e-commerce, and operations teams to understand system requirements.
Recommend improvements to NetSuite configuration, integrations, and business processes.
Help ensure systems can support increasing transaction volumes and business growth.
Investigate and resolve complex NetSuite, Celigo, and Shopify integration issues.
Perform unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing support.
Monitor system performance and proactively identify potential issues.
Manage system updates, code changes, deployments, and ongoing maintenance.
Follow development best practices, including version control, change management, and technical documentation.
Ensure system changes are implemented carefully to minimize disruption to business operations.
Provide technical support and guidance to internal stakeholders.
Work closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements and define technical solutions.
Lead complex development and integration projects from planning through implementation.
Provide recommendations on system architecture, integration design, and automation opportunities.
Communicate technical issues and solutions clearly to non-technical team members.
Help establish development standards and maintain the quality of technical solutions.
Identify opportunities to improve system reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

Required Experience And Qualifications

Significant professional experience as a NetSuite Developer or in a comparable senior ERP development role.
Strong knowledge of Oracle NetSuite customization, development, and administration.
Hands-on experience with SuiteScript 2.x and NetSuite APIs.
Proven experience developing and maintaining integrations using Celigo integrator.io.
Practical experience integrating NetSuite with Shopify.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, web services, data mapping, and integration architecture.
Experience working with JSON, XML, and other data exchange formats.
Understanding of ERP workflows, including order management, inventory, fulfillment, and financial transactions.
Experience troubleshooting complex system and integration issues.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
Ability to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions.
Excellent documentation, communication, and project management skills.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical projects.

Preferred Skills

Experience supporting e-commerce or direct-to-consumer businesses.
Experience with Shopify order management, product catalogs, inventory synchronization, and fulfillment workflows.
Familiarity with NetSuite financials, purchasing, inventory management, and warehouse-related processes.
Experience with additional integration platforms, middleware, or third-party APIs.
Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
Experience with sandbox environments, deployment processes, and release management.
NetSuite certifications or relevant technical certifications.
Experience managing high-volume e-commerce transactions and complex system integrations.

Personality

You are a senior-level developer who combines deep NetSuite technical expertise with practical experience connecting ERP systems to e-commerce platforms.
You are comfortable managing complex integrations, writing and maintaining SuiteScript, and working with Celigo integration flows.
You can ensure that Shopify and NetSuite exchange accurate information reliably.

postings.title: QA Engineer (AI & Feature Testing)
postings.descriptionText:
We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to join a team building and validating AI-powered and traditional features for a leading personal finance platform. You’ll own quality across web, mobile, and API — with a particular focus on testing AI/LLM-integrated components where standard deterministic methods don’t apply.
This role requires someone who understands the fundamental difference between testing software that has a right answer and evaluating AI outputs that have a probability distribution — and who has done both in production.

What you’ll do
Plan, design, and execute test cases for AI-powered components and traditional features, applying the appropriate methodology — eval-based or deterministic — based on the target behavior.
Analyze traditional functional requirements as well as AI model behavior specifications, prompt outputs, and edge-case scenarios.
Turn business requirements, user flows, and business process procedures into comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts.
Perform manual feature testing across platforms and verify bug fixes.
Create clear, detailed defect reports and document unexpected AI model responses, hallucinations, and performance regressions.
Assist in developing QA practices for emerging technologies including AI frameworks, and disseminate best practices across the team.
Become a subject matter expert in core systems, interfaces, business processes, and reporting tools.
Partner closely with functional teams, engineers, and IT in a global environment with aligned LATAM working hours.

Required skills & experience
5–7 years of experience in software testing across web, mobile, and API.
Hands-on experience with Playwright in a production testing environment — this is a primary requirement for this role.
Hands-on AI feature testing experience — validating AI/LLM-integrated products for accuracy, relevance, robustness against adversarial prompts, edge cases, and safety/toxicity.
Clear understanding of eval vs. deterministic testing — the difference between pass/fail based on exact input/output and evaluating probabilistic AI outputs using human-in-the-loop evaluations, score metrics, benchmark datasets, and semantic evaluation.
Strong understanding of web and mobile application development lifecycles including iOS and Android specifics.
Proven experience in integration, regression, performance/load, and UAT.
Hands-on knowledge of browser DevTools and log monitoring.
Advanced proficiency in Jira and Confluence.
Experience with test management systems.

Preferred qualifications
Experience with HTML proxy tools such as Charles Proxy or Fiddler.
Hands-on knowledge of Xcode logs and ADB logs.
Experience in the financial services or fintech domain.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent.
