postings.title: Billing Operations Associate
postings.descriptionText:
About AppDirect
Become a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world. AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device - as a service. We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations. We do this by our values-driven culture—one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.
About Firstbase, an AppDirect Subsidiary
Firstbase helps companies equip their teams with everything they need to do great work—from computers and furniture to company swag and perks. We give businesses the ability to instantly support employees with the right physical goods, and give employees the flexibility to choose what works for their unique needs. Firstbase is part of AppDirect, a subscription commerce platform that powers millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations selling any product, through any channel, on any device—as a service.
About You
The ITAD Billing Operations Associate will own the financial side of our IT Asset Disposition program, a small, fast-moving team responsible for what happens to hardware at the end of its life, and for the money that comes back when it's resold or recycled. You'll own the final word on whether a settlement is right. Half of that is investigative: a deposit that doesn't match any invoice, a partner file that's quietly missing a hundred devices, revenue a vendor earned months ago that never reached our books. You find it, you prove it, you close it. Increasingly, you won't do that hunting alone. We're building AI agents that work these queues inside ITAD OS, our internal operations platform, pulling partner files apart, matching deposits against revenue, flagging the rows that look wrong, and we're putting the best AI tooling available into this team's hands as fast as it ships. That moves the job up, not away: the agent proposes, you decide. Your value becomes knowing what the right answer should look like, catching the case the agent got confidently wrong, and turning a workflow you've been running by hand into one that runs itself with you supervising it. If you'd rather be the person who automates their own job than the one it gets automated around, this is that seat.
This posting is for the finance-focused seat on the team. Alongside your primary ownership, you'll be trained across the rest of our ITAD operations —data destruction documentation, vendor management, shipping and logistics — so the team can cover for one another. Everyone here rotates.
The position offers a flexible hybrid schedule: you will work one day per week onsite and four days remote. Compensation includes 15 paid working days (PTO) plus local holidays, comprehensive medical coverage (OSDE Plan 310) for you and your dependents, reimbursement for eligible wellness activities, English lessons, global and local events participation, and much more!
What you’ll do and how you’ll have an impact

- Ingest settlement and revenue reports from our resale and recycling partners. Every partner sends a different format, and a real part of the craft is turning messy vendor data into clean, trustworthy records without introducing errors.
- Reconcile device-level and order-level ITAD revenue against actual bank deposits, and allocate deposits to settlements.
- Investigate unmatched records, ambiguous serials and variances.
- Own the end-to-end credit issuance workflow in partnership with Finance.
- Raise and resolve discrepancies directly with our vendor partners.
- Own financial reporting for the ITAD program, including revenue and margin, and produce executive-ready summaries that go straight to leadership.
- Review and ingest Certificates of Destruction and data destruction reports from partners, matching them to the devices they cover.
- Monitor ITAD action queues, ensuring steps are followed per SOPs and that we're hitting our service level objectives.
- Support shipment and recycling order workflows with our warehouses and partner facilities: pick lists, ship and receipt dates, and resolving receipt exceptions.
- Maintain and enrich our internal database of fair market value estimates per device, drawing on secondary market platforms, trade-in partners and historical resale data.
- Act as a primary point of contact between Operations, Finance, Customer Success and Warehouse teams for ITAD financial workflows.
What we’re looking for

- 2–5 years in reconciliation, cash applications, billing, audit, accounts payable/receivable, or financial operations. This is a hands-on execution role.
- Demonstrated experience finding and resolving discrepancies, not just processing transactions. We'll ask you about a number that didn't tie and what you did about it.
- Strong Excel / Google Sheets: lookups, pivots, text-to-columns, deduplication, and genuine comfort cleaning up badly formatted exports.
- Strong spoken and written English. You'll speak and write directly to partners in the US and UK, and to colleagues over Slack. Expect this to be assessed.
- The judgment to know when something is wrong, and the confidence to escalate rather than force a match.
- High attention to detail, and the ability to run several parallel workflows without losing track of any of them.
- Comfortable with structured SOPs, but restless about improving them.
(*) Interested candidates should submit their resume in English. Please note that Spanish versions will not be reviewed.
About AppDirect:
AppDirect is the only end-to-end commerce platform for selling, distributing, and managing cloud-based products and services to succeed in the digital economy. The AppDirect ecosystem connects channels, developers, and customers through its platform to simplify the digital supply chain by enabling the onboarding and sale of products with third-party services, for any channel, on any device, with support. Powering millions of cloud subscriptions worldwide, AppDirect helps organizations, including Jaguar Land Rover, Comcast, ADP, and Deutsche Telekom connect their customers to the solutions they need to reach their full potential in the digital economy.
We believe that the unique contributions of all AppDirectors is the driver of our success. To make sure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience we never discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.
At AppDirect we take privacy very seriously. For more information about our use and handling of personal data from job applicants, please read our Candidate Privacy Policy. postings.title: Analista de Operaciones
postings.descriptionText:
¡Hola! Gracias por la curiosidad 👋

Nos impulsa la ambición y nos guía una visión audaz. A medida que ampliamos nuestro ecosistema de herramientas y servicios, buscamos un/a Analista de Operaciones con espíritu emprendedor: alguien que se meta en la operación, encuentre lo que no funciona y lo resuelva sin esperar a que se lo pidan. Vas a reportar directamente al Manager de Operaciones.

Quiénes Somos

Zubale es una empresa de tecnología que empodera a los retailers para triunfar en el comercio electrónico (e-commerce). Atendemos a una amplia gama de clientes —desde supermercados, tiendas especializadas y farmacias hasta tiendas departamentales y marcas de moda— en México, Brasil, Chile, Costa Rica, Perú, Colombia y, ahora, Argentina. ¿Cómo lo hacemos? A través de dos productos clave:

- Flexifleet: Un marketplace de freelancers para realizar tareas de recolección (picking), empaque (packing) y entrega para retailers y agregadores.
- Consumer Connect: Comercio conversacional impulsado por inteligencia artificial vía WhatsApp para impulsar las ventas y mejorar la experiencia del cliente.

Nos apasiona ayudar a marcas, agregadores y retailers a optimizar sus operaciones de e-commerce, reducir costos y aumentar la rentabilidad. Respaldados por más de 70 millones de dólares en capital de riesgo (venture capital), hemos mantenido un crecimiento constante durante los últimos seis años y procesado más de 100 millones de pedidos a través de nuestra plataforma. Hoy atendemos a más de 100 clientes y conectamos a miles de freelancers dentro de nuestra red. Y esto es solo el comienzo. Estamos construyendo un ecosistema rentable y escalable, con la visión de convertirnos en el aliado número uno para el crecimiento del comercio electrónico de los retailers.

¿Quién sos?
Sos una persona dinámica, con iniciativa y obsesionada con hacer las cosas mejor. Cuando ves un problema, no lo reportás: lo investigás, proponés una solución y la probás. Preferís ver la operación con tus propios ojos antes que leerla en un reporte, te sentís cómodo/a en una tienda en plena hora pico y también frente a una planilla armando el caso para un cambio. Actuás como dueño/a de los resultados y te motiva construir en un entorno que se mueve rápido.

¿Qué vas a hacer?

En la operación

- Visitar tiendas y puntos de operación con frecuencia para observar procesos, detectar fricciones y entender la realidad del día a día.
- Trabajar codo a codo con supervisores, shoppers y equipos de cliente para implementar mejoras directamente en campo.
- Resolver incidencias operativas de principio a fin y convertir cada problema recurrente en un proceso corregido.
- Proponer e impulsar por iniciativa propia proyectos que reduzcan costos, tiempos o errores en la operación.
- Estar presente en lanzamientos de nuevos clientes, picos de demanda y fechas críticas (Hot Sale, CyberMonday, Black Friday, campañas estacionales).

Procesos y mejora continua

- Mapear y documentar procesos operativos end-to-end, a partir de lo que ves en campo.
- Rediseñar flujos para ganar eficiencia y probarlos en la práctica antes de escalarlos.
- Definir SLAs, controles y mecanismos de seguimiento por proceso, con foco en la experiencia del cliente.

Data como herramienta

- Monitorear métricas operativas para saber dónde intervenir y medir si las mejoras funcionaron.
- Automatizar reportes y tareas repetitivas para liberar tiempo del equipo (SQL, Python, n8n, Apps Script).
- Mantener dashboards operativos en Looker.

Lo que este rol no es

No es un rol de análisis de escritorio ni de coordinación a distancia. Esperamos que pases una parte importante de tu semana en terreno, que te involucres de lleno en la operación y que ayudes a sacar el trabajo adelante cuando el día lo pide.

Lo que vas a aportar

Operaciones

- Experiencia en operaciones de campo, retail, logística o última milla.
- Experiencia mapeando y rediseñando procesos para hacerlos más eficientes.
- Espíritu emprendedor: autonomía, sentido de urgencia y ganas de resolver sin esperar instrucciones.
- Mentalidad lean y comodidad con la ambigüedad.
- Capacidad de influir y movilizar a otros sin autoridad formal, trabajando con equipos operativos y áreas como Contabilidad, Customer Success y Data Ops.

Herramientas

- Google Sheets a nivel avanzado.
- SQL y Python para análisis de datos.
- Automatizaciones con n8n o Apps Script (deseable).

Formación y experiencia

- Carrera en Administración, Economía, Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería en Sistemas, Estadística o afines.
- 1 a 2 años de experiencia en operaciones, consultoría operativa o roles similares.
- Experiencia en startups, retail, logística o plataformas digitales (deseable).
- Inglés intermedio.

Lo que ofrecemos

- Modalidad híbrida: 3 días por semana en nuestra oficina de Vicente López y trabajo frecuente en tiendas y puntos de operación.
- Una cultura de alto rendimiento donde los datos y la calle se complementan.
- Impacto directo y visible en la operación.
- Oportunidades de crecimiento en una empresa en expansión.

¿Te suena a vos? ¡Postulate y charlemos!

This position requires an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the desire to strive for excellence. People that thrive in these roles are proactive problem solvers who are passionate about collaborating with sales and business development teams, our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and contributing to initiatives in support of Canonical's continued success. The role entails

- Supporting all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales and business development functions globally
- Driving data quality, through checking opportunities for accuracy, clean order processing, new hire training, policy and process documentation, reporting and data cleansing
- Supporting and enabling the sales team globally on CRM and other revenue operations policies, processes and systems such as Sales Engagement, Training/Enablement, Data Enrichment, Configure Price Quote, Analytics and Commissions

What we are looking for in you

- Understanding of working in a global, multicultural organization including within a team based remotely in multiple time zones

We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

- Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

postings.descriptionText:
Summary

- Role: Accounting and finance ops for a portfolio of venture-backed climate tech companies.
- Preferred experience: 4–10 years, including time at a leading national or regional accounting firm
- Location: Remote — US or LATAM (working hours that overlap with US time zones)
- Expected start: Dec '26 or Jan '27

Overview
Planetary Scale partners with climate and energy-transition companies as their strategic finance arm, working alongside founders from seed through growth. We help them refine their business model, raise venture funding, manage their finances and get through the hardest moments on the path to scale.

For many of these companies, we also maintain their books, prepare financial reports, and handle day-to-day finance work like paying bills, invoicing customers and running payroll. Founders rely on us to get the numbers right and make sure everyone gets paid on time. That side of our work is growing, and we're hiring a Senior Accountant to take on a group of clients and work closely with the rest of our team to provide world-class finance function support.

The Role
You'll run the accounting and day-to-day finance work for several client companies at once, alongside a peer accountant who looks after a separate set of clients. For each company, you'll work with our engagement lead who owns the relationship, and often with the founder and their team directly. Our clients primarily use QuickBooks Online or Xero, plus bank, bill-pay and payroll tools. We also have a set of internally developed tools to make the monthly close process flow smoothly and help to share context across our accounting and strategic finance work.

You'll be in real client work from your first week, paired with experienced teammates while you learn each company's financial picture and the nuances of working with early-stage companies that are commercializing complex new technologies.

- You'll own the month-end close for each of your companies: reconciliations, accruals, prepaid and fixed-asset schedules, and financial statements you've reviewed yourself before they reach the engagement lead and the founder.
- Where a company relies on us for its payables and receivables, you'll run them, including bill-pay runs in tools like Bill.com and Brex, as well as invoicing and collections, so vendors are paid on time and cash comes in when it should.
- For some clients, you'll also run payroll and take care of occasional filings like Delaware Franchise Tax, state sales tax returns or year-end 1099s.
- You will figure out and apply the correct accounting treatment for various revenue recognition scenarios, government grants, venture debt and multi-currency transfer pricing. You'll need good judgement on when to ask others for help.
- You'll support audits and investor diligence, preparing schedules and answering auditors' and investors' questions so the founder can focus on running the company. At year end, you'll prepare each company's package for its outside tax preparer.
- You'll help make our close faster and more consistent across clients, noticing where a checklist, template or automation would save the team time.

About You
You hold yourself to a high standard — and you want to work somewhere that does the same. A few things that matter here:

- Accuracy is your baseline. Founders, their boards and their investors make decisions from the numbers you close, and a wrong one can undermine a founder's credibility at the worst possible moment. You tie out every balance before you call a month closed, and you'd rather catch your own mistake than have a founder find it.
- You dig in, and you ask when you're not sure. When a balance won't reconcile or a transaction looks off, you trace it back to its source and find out why. If you're unsure how something should be treated, you ask before you book it.
- You're a good teammate. You'll work alongside a peer accountant and each client's engagement lead. You keep them up to date, leave workpapers anyone could follow, and help out when someone else is stretched.
- You aspire to be great at what you do. You put in the time to sharpen your technical skills, including the less common topics our clients run into, like grants and venture debt. When part of the close is slow or easy to get wrong, you build a better way of doing it.
- You take ownership before you're asked. When something needs doing, you do it. If you see the wrong info being communicated, you jump in to fix it before it becomes a bigger issue. At a firm this size, if you assume something is someone else's job, it usually doesn't get done.

Beyond that, for this role specifically:

- You learned the craft at a leading accounting firm. You've spent time at a leading national or regional accounting firm, in audit, assurance or client accounting, and you've owned a close from start to finish. You know US GAAP well enough to handle accruals, fixed assets and revenue recognition with confidence, and you're hands-on in QuickBooks Online or Xero.
- You're a CPA, or hold your country's equivalent qualification. It's what we generally expect. If you don't hold one yet but you're exceptional in every other way, we'd still like to hear from you.
- You communicate clearly in English and work US hours. Our clients and most of our team are in the US, so professional written and spoken English is a must, and so are working hours that overlap fully with at least one US time zone.
- You care about this work specifically. Climate and the energy transition matter to you, and you want your accounting to support the companies building a better future.

It helps a lot if you've also worked inside a venture- or private-equity-backed company, or at an outsourced accounting firm that serves them. Beyond that, experience with sales tax, payroll or year-end tax work, or with a company's first audit, is a plus.

postings.title: General Ledger (GL) Accountant - Buenos Aires, Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
About The Role

We're looking for a highly proactive, self-driven General Ledger Accountant to own the day to day accounting across multiple entities in a high transaction volume environment. This is a hands-on role at the center of our finance operations: bank reconciliations, AP/AR, cost allocations, intercompany, and month end close  all run primarily in QuickBooks Online (QBO).

This is not a role for someone who waits to be told what to do. We need someone with an active, ownership-driven personality who spots what needs to happen and makes it happen who chases down discrepancies, follows up with stakeholders without being prompted, and takes full responsibility for keeping the books accurate and on time across all business units.

Key Responsibilities

- Monitor multiple bank accounts, capture movements in QBO, and perform daily bank reconciliations across entities.
- Own AP end-to-end: capture, route invoices for approval, archive and post in QBO, and manage vendor/contractor payment runs.
- Own AR end-to-end: issue and track invoices, monitor outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments.
- Oversee the billing process, ensuring invoicing is completed accurately and on time (e.g., by the 1st business day).
- Capture and reconcile deposits across QBO and related platforms; tie and allocate incoming payments to the correct business unit.
- Process intercompany transactions and recharges between business units, HQ/Corp and Holdco, ensuring both sides reconcile.
- Manage cost allocations, internal BU recharges, amortization, accrued liabilities, and ensure all transactions are allocated to a BU.
- Review credit card expenses (200+ transactions/month), cross-check Credit Cards statements against the QBO GL, and ensure accuracy.
- Produce daily and month-end reporting; support month-end close end-to-end.
- Proactively identify, investigate and resolve discrepancies — bringing the root cause and a proposed fix, not just the problem.
- Follow up directly with internal stakeholders (tax, billing, managers, other entities) to keep processes moving.
- Continuously identify and implement process improvements and automation opportunities.

What We're Looking For

- A genuinely proactive, self-starting personality someone who takes initiative, works independently, and drives tasks to completion without needing to be pushed.
- Ownership mindset: treats the accuracy and timeliness of the books as their personal responsibility.
- Resourceful and resolutive: comfortable with ambiguity, chases down answers, and solves problems rather than escalating them unresolved.
- 3+ years of hands-on general ledger / full-cycle accounting experience, ideally in a high-volume, multi-entity environment.
- Strong, hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online (QBO) is required.
- Experience with intercompany transactions, cost allocations, and bank reconciliations.
- Comfortable working across multiple bank accounts and foreign-currency payments.
- Strong attention to detail and the discipline to perform high-volume, recurring work accurately every day.
- Comfortable with reporting and tech-savvy including using AI and automation tools to streamline workflows.
- Excellent English (written and spoken), for working with internal stakeholders.

Why CKH is the best choice?

CKH is a boutique accounting & financial services firm that provides local expertise aided by global experience. We have presence in Atlanta, South Africa, Ukraine, Poland, Azerbaijan, Germany, Spain and Greece.

Our Tree Logo Is Representative Of CKH's Ideals

- The roots of the tree remind us to stay grounded and humble.
- The trunk represents the support we have for each other, making our team strong. But we also like to shake the tree!
- Churning up new ideas and positive change as the world around us grows.
- The fruit our tree grows reminds us to never stop growing, producing the best quality service for our clients.
- The treetop helps us reach higher, always stretching to new heights and goals.

Nice to Have

- Experience with Expensify, or similar expense-management tools.
- Experience with automation / workflow tools (Zapier, Make, Power Automate, or similar).
- Experience working with US-based companies or clients.

postings.title: Senior Accounting Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Responsibilities

Job Description

- Perform General Ledger and monthly close activities, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with US GAAP, Argentine accounting standards, GM policies, and internal controls.
- Prepare journal entries, accruals, reclassifications, account reconciliations, variance analyses, and supporting working papers.
- Identify and analyze accounting risks, unusual balances, and complex transactions, applying sound technical judgment and escalating significant matters when required.
- Prepare the conversion of financial information from local currency to the USD functional currency and analyze foreign exchange impacts.
- Prepare statutory trial balances, US GAAP-to-Local GAAP adjustments, inflation accounting calculations, and complete statutory financial statements, including notes and supporting schedules.
- Prepare statutory and government reports and support filings with IGJ and other applicable authorities.
- Coordinate external audit requirements and ensure timely resolution of audit requests and accounting matters.
- Execute internal controls and SOX-related procedures, maintaining complete and review-ready documentation.
- Partner with Finance, shared service centers, and regional teams to obtain inputs and resolve accounting and reporting matters.
- Support process improvement and automation initiatives using data-analysis tools.
- Provides direction to a team of individuals with similar functional responsibility
- Research and interpret new accounting standards and brainstorm how each applies to GM as well as comply with external 10-Q/10-K reporting requirements

Required Experience

Mandatory

- Certified Public Accountant (CPA) degree.
- Strong knowledge of Argentine Professional Accounting Standards.
- Proven experience with inflation accounting adjustments.
- Experience preparing complete financial statements, including notes and supporting schedules.
- Conversion of financial statements into USD functional currency.
- Preparation of financial information for external audits.
- Proficiency in excel,

Preferred

- Proven experience in general accounting, month-end closing, and financial reporting.
- Experience working within complex corporate groups.
- Hands-on experience managing month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
- Experience with statutory reporting and filings before the IGJ (General Inspection of Justice) or other public entities.
- Advanced SAP knowledge, preferably SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI).
- Advanced Excel skills and experience handling large volumes of data.
- Ability to prepare auditable journal entries and working papers.
- Knowledge of US GAAP and reconciliation with Argentine accounting standards.
- Intermediate or higher English proficiency to interact with regional teams.
- Experience in Big Four
- 3-4 years of exprience
- Experience with data automation and analytics tools such as Power Query, Power BI, or KNIME (preferred) Google workspace

Required Competencies

- Ability to independently execute complex activities with minimal supervision.
- Strong technical judgment to identify appropriate accounting treatments and assess risks.
- Excellent organizational skills and discipline to work within financial close calendars.
- Strong attention to detail and focus on internal controls.
- Analytical skills to investigate discrepancies and explain variances.
- Ability to document processes thoroughly and in an organized manner.
- Team player with strong communication skills, capable of effectively interacting with both accounting and non-accounting teams.

GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need gm immigration sponsorship now or in the future. This role is categorized as hybrid. postings.title: Financial Accountant
postings.descriptionText:
Finance

Bachelor, Master

Como Financial Accountant gestionarás tareas financieras para un equipo de 10 colegas. Tu rol es clave para brindar soporte administrativo en contabilidad y finanzas. Crecerás profesional y personalmente en un entorno saludable en Rijk Zwaan Argentina.

Tu trabajo en Rijk Zwaan

Como Financial Accountant, reportará a los directores de Rijk Zwaan Argentina y será co-responsable de la contabilidad general de la empresa, que incluye:

- Mantener registros y estados contables para asegurar que las transacciones queden registradas con precisión.
- Valuación y control de Stock y Preparación para auditorías.
- Realizar inventario trimestral de stock junto con Soporte de Ventas
- Preparar informes contables; preparar declaraciones de IVA, documentación de reintegros de IVA y otras; procesar y dar seguimiento a los pagos;
- Realizar informes periódicos a organismos oficiales (p. ej., estadísticas nacionales);
- Realizar validación y registros de declaración de gastos.
- Dar seguimiento a la cobranza de deudores y gestionar pagos;
- Mantener contacto estrecho con el/la Especialista de Soporte de Ventas, el departamento Comercial, otros departamentos internos y proveedores respecto de los asuntos diarios.
- Preparar reportes de la operación comercial, analizar e interpretar datos y reportar a la Dirección.
- Contabilidad - Extraer datos del sistema contable y realizar cálculos, identificar y analizar anomalías y explicar diferencias.
- Preparar declaraciones, mensuales y anuales de impuestos, y declaraciones mensuales de impuestos de importación/exportación.
- Otras tareas operativas y de back office.

Además, trabajarás en diversos proyectos financieros, o prestarás apoyo a tus compañeros con algunas tareas administrativas.

Tu aporte

Buscamos un/a Contador/a Financiero/a con:

- Título universitario (Lic./BSc.) en Contabilidad, Economía/Administración o Finanzas;
- Al menos 3 años de experiencia relevante en un área/departamento de Contabilidad;
- Habilidades sólidas y comprobables en finanzas y contabilidad;
- Conocimiento de normas contables, laborales y tributarias de acuerdo con la legislación argentina;
- Nivel de inglés al menos intermedio (laboral);
- Experiencia de trabajo en entorno M365 será una ventaja adicional.

Además:

Si tú residencia es en CABA / AMBA.

Ser una persona honesta y confiable, en quien tus colegas pueden apoyarse.

Te entusiasma el desafío de formar parte de una empresa internacional.

Sos alguien “hands on”, con interés amplio en funciones administrativas, y que te guste trabajar de manera independiente y autónoma en un equipo chico dentro de la oficina.

Con buenas habilidades analíticas, meticuloso/a y buena comunicación.

Que te guste colaborar y coordinar con colegas en un entorno internacional para lograr el mejor resultado.

Que te gusten los equipos unidos y valoras el equilibrio entre la vida y el trabajo.

¿Qué podés esperar de nosotros?

Como Financial Accoutant vas a ser parte del equipo de la oficina. Vas a cumplir un rol importante apoyando a nuestros managers y asegurando que puedan trabajar de forma fluida.

Nos alegra ofrecerte:

- Contrato permanente desde el inicio;
- Equilibrio entre vida personal y vida laboral;
- Seguro médico para el grupo familiar;
- Un entorno de trabajo emprendedor, con desafíos constantemente nuevos;
- Capacitaciones internas y externas, tanto profesionales como personales;
- Un programa de onboarding completo, posiblemente con el acompañamiento de un/a colega internacional.

Rijk Zwaan: ¿tu próximo empleador?

La oficina de Rijk Zwaan Argentina. está en la Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires y cuenta con actividades comerciales dentro de Argentina y actividades de Importación / Exportación de productos. Nuestro equipo está dedicado a acompañar a nuestros distribuidores y clientes en cada una de las zonas productivas, abordando los desafíos del mercado hortícola. Como la cultura corporativa de Rijk Zwaan está enfocada en las personas, vas a contar con todas las oportunidades de desarrollo dentro de Rijk Zwaan.

Rijk Zwaan es una empresa multinacional familiar con una cultura centrada en las personas. Rijk Zwaan se encuentra al inicio de lo que es la cadena alimenticia. Desarrollamos variedades de frutas y hortalizas y vendemos globalmente las semillas producidas a partir de ellas a productores y otros socios de la cadena. Desde nuestra posición estratégica contribuimos al abastecimiento mundial de alimentos.

Todo lo que hacemos tiene que ver con el crecimiento saludable: el crecimiento de productos naturales y saludables que exportamos a todo el mundo.

El crecimiento de nuestra empresa; y, por, sobre todo, el crecimiento de nuestra gente: le damos a los colaboradores todas las oportunidades para tomar iniciativa propia y alcanzar su máximo potencial.

🎯 Tu misión

Garantizar el control y la correcta registración de la información contable y administrativa de los establecimientos agropecuarios, actuando como nexo con la administración central y contribuyendo al cierre contable mensual.

💼 Responsabilidades clave

- Controlar y supervisar la carga de información administrativa y contable proveniente de los campos en el sistema de gestión de la empresa.
- Realizar conciliaciones de cuentas bancarias y controles de las cajas de los establecimientos agropecuarios.
- Revisar y controlar planillas de cereal, información de producción y documentación respaldatoria de las operaciones.

Requisitos

- Formación secundaria completa. Se valorarán estudios terciarios vinculados con Administración, Contabilidad o Administración Agropecuaria.
- Manejo fluido de sistemas de gestión y herramientas informáticas. Se valorará el conocimiento de Physis.
- Experiencia previa en el sector agropecuario
- Experiencia en conciliaciones, control de documentación, registración e imputaciones contables.
- Organización, atención al detalle, autonomía y capacidad resolutiva.
- Buenas habilidades interpersonales y firmeza para solicitar información y dar seguimiento a los temas pendientes.

Creamos infraestructura financiera de clase mundial que permite a cualquier empresa lanzar tarjetas de crédito, débito o prepago de manera ágil, rápida y con los más altos estándares de seguridad.

Con una integración sencilla a través de APIs y tecnología totalmente en la nube, nuestros clientes pueden migrar su infraestructura antigua, como también lanzar y expandir su negocio a toda la región

Sumate al equipo de +250 personas que está revolucionando el ecosistema financiero en LATAM. A lo largo de este 2026 seguiremos creciendo, ¡tenemos muchas posiciones abiertas! Si tenés ganas de sumarte al team y ser un pomeler, ¡conocé todas las oportunidades que tenemos!

¡Building Better Cards! 💳

En el equipo de Accounting regional estamos buscando un/una Lead/Manager de Accounting para liderar la operación contable, garantizar la precisión de la información financiera y potenciar la evolución del área en un entorno dinámico y de fuerte crecimiento.

¿Qué desafíos te esperan?

- Liderar la auditoria anual de los Estados Financieros consolidados, coordinando al equipo y garantizando el acceso a documentación, análisis y soporte técnico.
- Ser responsable del cierre contable mensual end-to-end, validando integridad, razonabilidad y consistencia de los rubros financieros.
- Consolidar y presentar reportes clave para stakeholders internos y externos, asegurando la calidad y puntualidad de la información enviada para la toma de decisiones.
- Full ownership de la implementacion de reporteria regulatoria (incl. CNBV/Mexico, BACEN/Brasil, CMF/chile) y coordinación de requerimientos regulatorios con las áreas involucradas.
- Garantizar el cumplimiento de normativas contables locales e IFRS, asegurando la correcta interpretación y aplicación.
- Identificar riesgos contables y operacionales, diseñar controles internos y asegurar su ejecución.
- Diseñar, proponer y ejecutar mejoras via automatización en procesos contables y financieros para incrementar precisión, eficiencia y escalabilidad.
- Liderar, acompañar y desarrollar al equipo de contabilidad, garantizando calidad técnica, cumplimiento y crecimiento profesional.

¿Qué esperamos de vos?

- Ser profesional de Contador/a Público/a.
- Sólida experiencia (+7/8 años) en roles de contabilidad y auditoría externa.
- Experiencia comprobada liderando auditorías anuales de Estados Financieros consolidados y cierres contables mensuales.
- Experiencia previa liderando equipos o siendo referente técnico.
- Conocimiento de IFRS y normativas contables locales.
- Experiencia utilizando herramientas de IA para automatizar y agentizar procesos contables
- Nivel de inglés avanzado.

¿Por qué Pomelo?

- Innovación que lidera: Somos una empresa referente en tecnología y evolución constante.
- Colaboración regional: Trabajamos junto a personas talentosas de toda Latinoamérica, compartiendo desafíos y aprendizajes.
- Impacto real: Tu trabajo tiene efecto tangible en toda la región y en una industria dinámica y desafiante.
- Cultura de "aprender haciendo": Acá el crecimiento es práctico, aprendés mientras creás impacto.
- Flexibilidad auténtica: Apostamos a un modelo híbrido, donde elegís tu mejor forma de trabajar, y cuando nos encontramos, potenciamos grandes ideas juntos.

Nuestro propósito es construir un mundo mejor de negocios para nuestra gente, para nuestros clientes y para nuestras comunidades. Trabajamos continuamente para mejorar la calidad de nuestros servicios, invirtiendo en nuestra gente y en innovación. Las oportunidades de crecer, tener éxito y desarrollarse en EY son ilimitadas.  

EY cree en la igualdad de oportunidades y no discrimina por motivos de género, edad, estado civil, credo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico u origen nacional, discapacidad o características físicas.

Todas nuestras oportunidades de trabajo están abiertas a personas con discapacidad y buscamos alentar a que se postulen para nuestras diferentes posiciones. En caso de necesitar algún ajuste razonable o apoyo, por favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación.

Sobre el área de impuestos

Nuestros/as profesionales de impuestos, coordinados/as globalmente, ofrecen servicios conectados a través de todas las disciplinas tributarias para ayudar a nuestros clientes a prosperar en una era de cambios rápidos. postings.descriptionText:
Sumá tu energía a la compañía que contribuye al desarrollo de nuestro país.En YPF buscamos personas que quieran ser parte de un gran equipo que transforma desafíos en oportunidades y que actúa con excelencia para generar valor. ¡Sumarte a YPF es unirte a un proyecto que combina experiencia, pasión y la energía necesaria para seguir construyendo nuestro futuro!

¿Qué buscamos?

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un Contador Público con sólida experiencia en tributación corporativa, especializado en la determinación y análisis del Impuesto a las Ganancias corriente y diferido.
Buscamos un especialista con sólida formación técnica, autonomía, capacidad de análisis y criterio profesional. Se valorarán especialmente perfiles que combinen formación y experiencia adquirida en firmas Big Four con experiencia corporativa.

La posición requiere un profesional con fuerte autonomía, capacidad analítica y orientación a resultados, capaz de desenvolverse en entornos dinámicos y complejos, participando activamente en procesos de cierre contable, reporting financiero y asesoramiento tributario a las distintas unidades de negocio.

Formación: Contador/a Público/a graduado/a.

Conocimientos:

- Manejo avanzado de Excel y experiencia en SAP.
- Orientación a la mejora continua y optimización de procesos.

Si sos una persona que:

¡Este puesto es para vos!

Un entorno donde podés aportar lo más valioso que tenés: tu energía. Esa energía que impulsa, que se adapta, que aprende, que suma, que transforma.

🤝 Formar parte de una empresa comprometida con la equidad y la inclusión.

postings.title: Accounts Receivable & Refunds Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Location: Remote, only for candidates in LATAM

Ryz Labs is seeking an Accounts Receivable & Refunds Specialist to play a pivotal role in our client's daily financial and support operations. Positioned at the crossroads of finance, client experience, and workflow improvement, you will drive operational clarity and trust across our ecosystem.

In this role, you will lead the end-to-end execution of core financial transactions—ranging from collections management and scale refunds to journal entries and high-touch support for key accounts. We are looking for an analytical, details-driven professional who seamlessly balances technical accuracy with clear, empathetic communication. If you are as confident navigating NetSuite spreadsheets as you are demystifying complex billing inquiries for sellers and buyers, this is the place for you.

What You Will Do

- Address Customer Experience support tickets related to payments, invoicing, and refunds
- Monitor customer accounts and assist with the application of cash receipts, incoming Wire and ACH payments, and reconciliation of discrepancies
- Preparing daily/monthly journal entries in the ERP system for Cash and A/R transactions
- Processing Sales Team Requests, Refunds, Credits, Rate adjustments, and other one-off payment issues in Admin, NetSuite and Avalara
- Identify opportunities to streamline and enhance automation across key accounts payable and accounts receivable workflows, contributing to process efficiency and scalability, creating and updating accounting policy memos and process flowcharts
- Sales Tax Exemption maintenance and refund processing in Avalara
- Serve as a point of contact for key sellers, delivering proactive updates on sales proceeds and payout schedules

What We Are Looking For

- +3 years of experience in Accounts Receivable, Treasury, Bookkeeping, Customer Support or related finance support roles
- Familiarity with basic accounting principles and ERP systems (NetSuite or Oracle Fusion)
- Proven experience working with Salesforce (CRM/billing workflows) is required
- Strong Excel skills and attention to detail in data entry and transaction processing
- Excellent communication and organizational skills
- Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment

About RYZ Labs:

RYZ Labs is a startup studio built in 2021 by two lifelong entrepreneurs. The founders of RYZ have worked at some of the world's largest tech companies and some of the most iconic consumer brands. They have lived and worked in Argentina for many years and have decades of experience in Latam. What brought them together is the passion for the early phases of company creation and the idea of attracting the brightest talents in order to build industry-defining companies in a post-pandemic world.

Our teams are remote and distributed throughout the US and Latam. They use the latest cutting-edge technologies in cloud computing to create applications that are scalable and resilient. We aim to provide diverse product solutions for different industries, planning to build a large number of startups in the upcoming years.

At RYZ, you will find yourself working with autonomy and efficiency, owning every step of your development. We provide an environment of opportunities, learning, growth, expansion and challenging projects. You will deepen your experience while sharing and learning from a team of great professionals and specialists.

Our values and what to expect:

- Customer First Mentality - every decision we make should be made through the lens of the customer
- Bias for Action - urgency is critical, expect that the timeline to get something done is accelerated
- Ownership - step up if you see an opportunity to help, even if not your core responsibility
- Humility and Respect - be willing to learn, be vulnerable, and treat everyone that interacts with RYZ with respect
- Frugality - being frugal and cost-conscious helps us do more with less
- Deliver Impact - get things done in the most efficient way
- Raise our Standards - always be looking to improve our processes, our team, our expectations. Status quo is not good enough and never should be

postings.title: Finance Manager (Financial Control)
postings.descriptionText:
About Revolut
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.
As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role
The Finance team keeps Revolut moving with clarity and confidence. From accounting to strategic support, they work across the business to assess risk, guide decisions, and drive growth. Their insight shapes everything from daily operations to long-term plans and plays a key role in how we scale.
We're looking for a Financial Control Manager who'll report to the Head of Accounting. You'll be pulling together accounts that cover banking, insurance, and trading functions.
Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll be doing

- Preparing consolidated GL accounts for Argentina in ERP Oracle NetSuite under IFRS
- Coordinating the accounting and month-end closing process
- Ensuring accurate and timely closing of the books for monthly and annual reporting
- Analysing changes in key general ledger accounts
- Managing the accounting policy, ensuring it's up-to-date and latest changes in IFRS and group policies are implemented
- Implementing process improvements to boost the efficiency and accuracy of monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting through automation and control measures
- Participating in annual and interim audits
- Advising on accounting and reporting issues
- Contributing to and defining consolidation as well as financial control processes and procedures

What you'll need

- 4+ years of experience in a fund accounting, fund administration, or audit role within asset management
- A recognised accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or CPA)
- Expertise in fund accounting, finance, and operations
- Expertise with management and financial oversight of third-party fund administrators and depositaries
- An academic background from a top university

Nice to have

- A solid understanding of illiquid asset valuation methodologies, cap tables, accounting methodologies, and cash management
- Experience implementing or managing API integrations between fund administrators and internal ledgers
- A degree in STEM, business, or finance

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

- Orientación a la mejora continua y automatización de procesos.
- Curiosidad y aprendizaje continuo.

- Graduado/a de Contador Público o carreras afines.
- Experiencia sólida en impuestos directos y liquidación del Impuesto a las Ganancias.

- Experiencia en cierres fiscales, impuesto diferido y tax reporting.
- Conocimientos de IFRS / US GAAP.
- Experiencia en coordinación o liderazgo de equipos.
- Inglés y portugués (deseables)
- Se valorará experiencia en compañías multinacionales y/o estudios de primera línea, así como conocimientos de Pilar II y procesos de reporting global.

postings.title: Senior Revenue & Settlement Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Senior Revenue & Settlements Analyst

🌎 Location: Latin America (Remote)
⏰ Schedule: Full-time

🧭 About the Role
We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Revenue & Settlements Analyst to support our growing renewable energy operations.
This role focuses on managing revenue and settlement processes, analyzing large volumes of complex data, and ensuring accurate financial reporting. The ideal candidate combines a solid understanding of accounting and financial operations with advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills, strong analytical capabilities, and the ability to independently manage recurring processes with a high degree of accuracy.
Working closely with the settlements and accounting teams, this person will be responsible for validating financial data, investigating discrepancies, reconciling information from multiple sources, and ensuring that settlement results are accurate, well-documented, and delivered on time.
We are looking for someone who takes ownership, demonstrates exceptional attention to detail, and is comfortable navigating complex data and learning new processes. A proactive mindset and willingness to identify opportunities for process improvement are essential. Experience with automation is a plus, but the priority is understanding the underlying data and business processes.

📊 Key Responsibilities
Revenue & Settlements Operations

- Independently manage monthly revenue and settlement processes, ensuring accurate and timely reporting for month-end close.
- Collect, analyze, manipulate, and reconcile large volumes of complex data from multiple sources, including market operators, utilities, and internal systems.
- Review settlement data, validate financial calculations, investigate discrepancies, and ensure the accuracy of reported results.
- Prepare counterparty invoices and weekly revenue allocations.
- Interpret contractual terms, market transactions, and utility settlement structures to understand and validate settlement outcomes.
- Coordinate with accounting to ensure settlement data is accurate, complete, and ready for month-end reporting.
Data Analysis & Quality Assurance

- Work extensively with Google Sheets and Excel to organize, analyze, and reconcile complex datasets.
- Review data for inconsistencies, missing information, calculation errors, and discrepancies between different sources.
- Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot spreadsheet formulas and workflows to improve data accuracy and reliability.
- Perform detailed validation checks to ensure the integrity of settlement calculations and financial reporting inputs.
- Investigate issues independently, identify root causes, and communicate findings clearly to relevant stakeholders.
- Meet strict reporting deadlines, particularly during month-end close, when settlement data must be reviewed and delivered to accounting within a short turnaround window.
Controls, Documentation & Process Improvement

- Maintain accurate, well-documented, and audit-ready settlement processes in accordance with internal control requirements.
- Ensure that calculations, reconciliations, and supporting documentation are complete and traceable.
- Develop a thorough understanding of existing processes before recommending or implementing improvements.
- Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, reduce manual work, and improve operational efficiency.
- Take initiative in exploring AI tools, automation, and other technical solutions when they can meaningfully improve data management and reporting.
Accountability & Execution

- Take full ownership of recurring deliverables, consistently meeting deadlines with minimal supervision or follow-up.
- Proactively identify and resolve issues rather than relying on step-by-step instructions.
- Independently prioritize tasks, manage competing deadlines, and maintain accuracy when working with large volumes of data.
- Learn new processes and industry concepts quickly, developing a strong understanding of the business context behind the data.
- Communicate effectively with the settlements and accounting teams to resolve questions and ensure smooth handoffs.

✅ Required Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in accounting, finance, financial settlements, revenue reporting, financial operations, or a related analytical field.
- Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets and Excel, including complex formulas, data manipulation, analysis, and reconciliation of large datasets.
- Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial calculations, and reconciliation processes.
- Demonstrated ability to identify discrepancies, investigate data issues, and validate the accuracy and completeness of financial information.
- Proven ability to independently manage recurring deliverables and consistently meet strict deadlines.
- Exceptional attention to detail, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
- Strong organizational skills, initiative, accountability, and the ability to work with minimal supervision.
- Ability to interpret complex financial information and communicate findings clearly.
- Willingness and ability to learn new processes, understand unfamiliar datasets, and develop knowledge of the energy settlements industry.

🌟 Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in renewable energy markets, ISO settlements, utility operations, or energy-related financial processes.
- Knowledge of US GAAP, particularly ASC 606.
- Familiarity with internal controls, SOX requirements, and audit documentation.
- Experience with SQL, Python, APIs, or other data extraction and automation tools.
- Experience improving spreadsheet-based workflows, automated reporting, or data processing procedures.
- Familiarity with AI tools to support problem-solving, data analysis, and process improvement.

🎯 What We're Looking For
We are looking for a proactive, resourceful, and highly detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with complex data and takes pride in delivering accurate results.
The ideal candidate understands that effective analysis begins with understanding the data, the business context, and the process behind it. They are comfortable investigating discrepancies, learning unfamiliar concepts, and taking ownership of tasks from start to finish.
This person should be curious, eager to learn about energy markets and settlement operations, and capable of working independently in a fast-paced environment with limited resources. They do not need to be an expert programmer, but they should be open to using technology and AI to solve problems and improve the way work gets done.

Cerro Negro is a high-grade gold mining complex located in Argentina's Patagonia region, in the province of Santa Cruz. It consists of multiple underground mines and deposits spread across a large area of the region. Because the operation is located approximately two hours by road from the nearest town, our workforce lives on site and works on rotational schedules.

Life at Cerro Negro takes place in a modern, well-equipped camp where safety, camaraderie, and teamwork are fundamental pillars of our daily activities. This commitment is also reflected in our focus on innovation. In 2022, Cerro Negro became the first underground mine in Argentina to implement remote-operated mining, significantly improving safety and efficiency. This achievement is a clear example of our culture of continuous improvement.

Our team is committed to responsible mining and to supporting the development of communities in this sparsely populated region. Working at Cerro Negro offers the opportunity to be part of a pioneering team in a unique environment, advance your professional development, and contribute to Newmont’s goal of creating sustainable value for the province of Santa Cruz.

Your Contribution

Help foster a respectful, inclusive, and compliant workplace by conducting workplace investigations and supporting employee relations processes across Newmont Argentina. In this role, you will independently gather facts, analyze information, and partner with key stakeholders to address workplace concerns fairly and professionally.

As Part of Our Team, You Will

- Conduct workplace investigations related to employee concerns, harassment, discrimination, bullying, sexual harassment, retaliation and other behavioral misconduct matters.
- Gather and assess information through interviews, documentation reviews, and fact-finding activities.
- Partner with employees, leaders, HR, Legal, Compliance, and other stakeholders throughout the investigation process.
- Prepare clear investigation reports, findings, and recommendations.
- Maintain accurate and confidential case records.
- Support the implementation of employee relations, compliance, and workplace conduct programs.
- Comfortable navigating ambiguity and adjusting priorities to meet evolving business needs.
- Identify opportunities to improve processes, controls, and employee awareness.

Prerequisites for your success in this role

- Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Employee Relations, Business, Law, Psychology, or a related field.
- Experience conducting workplace investigations, employee relations reviews, compliance reviews, or similar case management activities.
- Experience with investigation methods, interviewing techniques, and case documentation practices.
- Workplace investigation certification is considered an asset.
- Strong critical thinking and ability to analyze information objectively.
- Ability to navigate sensitive conversations with professionalism, discretion, and empathy.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office and case management or compliance systems.
- Ability to build positive relationships with people from diverse backgrounds.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Fluent in English and Spanish.

Your work environment

- You will work closely with employees, leaders, Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, and other internal and external stakeholders. This role requires handling sensitive and confidential matters while helping create a safe, respectful, and inclusive workplace for everyone.
- Work Location: Buenos Aires Office
- Work schedule: Hybrid

Why Join Newmont

At Newmont, you'll be part of a values-driven organization committed to safety, integrity, inclusion, and sustainability. You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by supporting fair workplace practices, promoting respectful behaviors, and helping build a culture where everyone can succeed.

At Cerro Negro, we value the well-being, development, and recognition of the people who are part of our team. That is why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees and their families. This includes medical coverage, recognition programmes for performance and outstanding contributions, as well as fair and competitive salary reviews, aligned with our commitment to attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional talent.

At Newmont, our people are our strength and we’re committed to a safe, inclusive and supportive workplace. If you’re passionate about doing work that matters, join Newmont and help shape the future of mining.

postings.descriptionText:
About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.

Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

Our vision

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

Our traction

Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website.

More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.

Our team

Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.

We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.

Where we work

Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!

The role

You’ll run full-cycle recruiting for our LATAM teams, with a focus on customer-facing roles like Customer Support and Onboarding. You’ll own the process from intake to signed offer: sourcing, screening, managing hiring managers, and making sure every candidate has a great experience. You’ll work closely with our recruiting team and with hiring managers, and you’ll have real influence on how we hire in the region.

What you’ll do

- Run full-cycle searches end to end, from intake through offer and close
- Source proactively across LinkedIn, local job boards, communities, and referrals. Don’t wait for applicants.
- Run high-quality recruiter screens and give hiring managers clear, honest recommendations
- Partner with hiring managers to set expectations, calibrate on the bar, and keep searches moving
- Keep Ashby clean, and use pipeline data to flag risks and bottlenecks early
- Build market knowledge across LATAM: talent pools, compensation, and what works in each market
- Help improve our process, from outreach and screening to candidate experience

What we’re looking for

- 3-5 years of recruiting experience, agency or in-house, with full-cycle ownership
- Experience hiring in Latin America
- Fluent English and Spanish, written and spoken.
- Strong sourcing instincts and comfort running high-volume and niche searches at the same time
- Sound judgment on candidates and the ability to give hiring managers direct, data-backed advice
- Organized and fast, with a bias toward action and clear communication
- Comfortable working async and across time zones, with overlap with US hours

Big plus

- Experience recruiting for Customer Experience roles (Support, Onboarding, Success, or similar), especially at scale
- Experience at a startup or high-growth company
- Experience with Ashby or a comparable modern ATS

Pay And Benefits

The estimated base salary range for this role is $50,000-$60,000 USD converted to your local currency. Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, a remote-first workplace, unlimited PTO, and extra fun perks.

Notice - Employment Scams

Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address.

We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond.

postings.title: Recruiter
postings.descriptionText:
Job title: Recruiter/Talent Acquisition Specialist

Type: Full-time
Schedule: Monday–Friday
Working Hours: 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM Pacific Time / 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time
Work Environment: Remote

About the Role
Talent Global is looking for a sharp, fast-moving, and highly proactive In-House Recruiter to help identify, evaluate, and present exceptional talent for our clients.

This role is ideal for someone who can quickly understand different types of positions—from digital marketing and creative roles to sales, operations, and other specialized functions—and translate those requirements into an effective recruiting and interview strategy.

We want someone who thinks quickly, adapts easily, asks the right questions, and takes ownership of finding strong candidates.

Speed matters in this role. The right person will be able to work with urgency while maintaining a high standard for the talent selection process, communication, and candidate evaluation.

Key Responsibilities

- Conduct Interviews: Perform structured Zoom interviews daily to evaluate candidates’ experience, communication skills, technical capabilities, professionalism, and overall fit for roles across Marketing, Design, Sales, Operations, and other functions.
- Evaluate Candidates: Review applications, resumes, work samples, and portfolios to determine whether candidates meet client expectations. This includes evaluating graphic design and advertising portfolios when relevant.
- Understand New Roles Quickly: Rapidly learn the responsibilities, terminology, required skills, and performance expectations of unfamiliar positions before beginning candidate evaluation.
- Maintain a High Talent Bar: Identify strong candidates rather than simply candidates who meet minimum requirements. Exercise sound judgment around experience, communication, problem-solving ability, professionalism, and overall quality.
- Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with account managers and talent sourcers to understand client hiring requirements, priorities, feedback, and changes in recruiting strategy.
- Present Candidates: Prepare clear, professional, and accurate candidate summaries and evaluations for shortlisted candidates presented to clients.
- Manage the Talent Pipeline: Build and maintain a strong pool of pre-vetted professionals for recurring client needs and frequently requested positions.
- Maintain CRM & Documentation: Keep candidate records, interview notes, evaluations, compensation expectations, and recruiting activity accurate and up to date in internal systems.
- Develop Interviews & Assessments: Create role-specific interview questions, scorecards, assignments, and assessments that accurately measure candidates’ capabilities.
- Stay Market-Informed: Continuously learn about trends, terminology, tools, compensation, and expectations across digital marketing, creative, sales, and other commonly recruited functions.
- Contractor Follow-Up: Check in with placed contractors after hiring to support onboarding, identify issues early, and help maintain successful placements.
- Negotiate Rates: Discuss compensation expectations with candidates and negotiate rates within client budgets while protecting both candidate quality and company margins.
- Improve Recruiting Operations: Help improve internal recruiting systems, assessment scoring, reporting, data visualization, and workflow efficiency through automation using AI, Make.com, and related tools.
- Work Independently & Collaboratively: Manage responsibilities independently while maintaining fast, clear communication with talent sourcers, account managers, and the sales team.

What We Are Looking For
The ideal candidate is:

- Fast-moving: Works with urgency and maintains strong output without needing constant follow-up.
- Sharp: Quickly identifies important details, inconsistencies, strengths, weaknesses, and potential hiring risks.
- A fast learner: Can understand a new role, industry, or skill set quickly enough to evaluate candidates intelligently.
- Accurate: Moves quickly without becoming careless. Candidate evaluations and documentation must be dependable.
- Highly proactive: Does not wait to be told every next step. Identifies problems, asks questions, follows up, and pushes recruiting processes forward.
- Adaptable: Comfortable switching between very different roles, priorities, clients, and recruiting situations.
- Highly selective: Has a strong standard for talent and is willing to reject average candidates rather than lowering the bar to fill a pipeline.
- Curious: Actively researches unfamiliar terminology, tools, industries, and job functions rather than interviewing candidates with only surface-level knowledge.
- Decisive: Can form clear candidate opinions and explain the reasoning behind them.
- Organized: Able to manage multiple interviews, candidates, roles, and follow-ups without losing important details.
- Clear communicator: Communicates efficiently and professionally with candidates and internal teams.
- Process-minded: Looks for ways to make recruiting faster, more consistent, and more scalable through better systems and automation.

Success in This Role
A strong recruiter in this position should be able to receive a new job requirement, truly understand what the client actually needs quickly, develop the right evaluation criteria, interview candidates intelligently, and confidently distinguish exceptional candidates from average ones.

The goal is not simply to conduct interviews or move candidates through a pipeline.
The goal is to find strong talent quickly, evaluate them accurately, and maintain a consistently high hiring standard.

- Advise the Group Executive President, MPP, project executives and senior leaders on critical workforce, talent and organisation decisions
- Americas-based global leadership opportunity

About Us

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

About The Role

Reporting to the Chief People Officer, you will lead the People and organisation agenda for Worley’s Major Projects & Programs group. You will translate business, portfolio and project priorities into integrated workforce, talent and organisational strategies that strengthen project delivery capability, leadership effectiveness, workforce readiness and long-term business performance.

As a trusted executive advisor to the Group Executive President, MPP, the MPP leadership team and project executives, you will shape critical decisions across workforce planning, global mobilisation and deployment, organisation design, leadership, succession, talent, culture, performance, transformation and employee relations.

You will use commercial insight, workforce analytics and labour-market intelligence to anticipate delivery and workforce risk, secure scarce capability and ensure MPP has the organisational capacity and talent to safely and successfully deliver complex projects for customers. You will mobilise People capabilities across Business Partnering, People Operations, regional People teams, People Strategy & Governance and Global Process Owners to provide coherent, practical and globally integrated solutions.

What You Will Be Accountable For

- Partner with the Group Executive President, MPP, the MPP leadership team and project executives to translate portfolio, project and customer priorities into integrated People plans with clear outcomes.
- Lead strategic workforce planning across the MPP portfolio, anticipating capacity constraints, scarce-skill requirements, critical capability gaps and material workforce risks.
- Develop strategies to secure, mobilise, deploy, redeploy and retain project talent and specialist capability globally, balancing schedules, customer commitments, cost, risk and employee experience.
- Shape leadership and talent strategies, including executive and senior leadership succession, talent reviews, leadership assessment, development, mobility and hiring actions.
- Coach senior leaders to strengthen leadership effectiveness, team performance, decision quality, accountability and project execution capability.
- Lead organisation design, operating-model and transformation initiatives, including project start-ups, transitions, restructuring, integrations and close-outs.
- Oversee complex workforce and employee-relations matters, ensuring appropriate governance, risk management and compliance.
- Mobilise People Business Partners, People Strategy & Governance and Global Process Owners, People Operations and regional People teams around MPP priorities.
- Lead, coach and develop People professionals supporting MPP, building project and commercial acumen, disciplined execution and enterprise orientation.
- Represent MPP within the People Leadership Team and contribute to enterprise People strategy, governance and continuous improvement.

About You

- A bachelor’s degree in human resources, business administration, organisational development, psychology or a relevant field, or equivalent directly relevant experience.
- Significant People leadership experience in large project-based, consulting, engineering, construction, infrastructure, energy or resources organisations.
- Experience as a principal People partner to senior executives responsible for major project delivery, project portfolios or global delivery organisations.
- Deep expertise in strategic workforce planning, global mobilisation and deployment, organisation design, succession, executive talent management, leadership development, culture and large-scale change.
- Strong commercial and financial acumen, including project delivery models, resource planning, labour markets, workforce cost and workforce risk management.
- A proven ability to anticipate and address scarce-skill and critical-capability requirements in complex, matrixed and globally distributed environments.
- Executive advisory and influencing capability, with the confidence to frame complex issues, challenge assumptions constructively and build alignment.
- Strong analytical judgment, integrating workforce data, project demand, market intelligence and business context into evidence-based recommendations.
- Experience leading organisation design, operating-model change, transformation, restructuring, integration or cost and productivity initiatives.
- Sound understanding of employee relations, employment risk and governance in complex international and project environments.
- Global and cross-cultural leadership experience, with the ability to lead, coach and develop senior People professionals.
- Excellent executive-level written and verbal communication, and a strong technology and continuous-improvement mindset.

Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.
