postings.title: AI-Driven Lead Engineer (Logistics & Transportation)
postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview

At Bridgenext, we engineer Growth Operating Systems. Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. More than a technology company or marketing agency, we're a global digital consultancy with experts in engineering, data, AI, creative and more.

Our teams are made up of experts who believe in engineering impact, starting with putting people at the center of everything we do. Every team member directly shapes our work, culture, and values. Nothing matters more to us than a kind, respectful, fulfilling environment that supports everyone. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive.

Position Description

We're looking for an experienced technical lead with an AI-driven mindset, who already knows how to get more out of a team by working alongside AI agents.

The team combines developers and QA engineers with AI agents covering product, business, development and QA work, all building production systems for one of North America's largest transportation companies. Deciding what each of them works on, giving them the right context and reviewing their output sits at the center of the job.

Much of the work happens close to the business. Workshops with product owners and stakeholders are where assumptions get challenged, scope gets negotiated and goals become clear, buildable work. Delivery runs in short cycles: build something real, validate it with stakeholders, learn and adjust. Keeping architects, QA, product, and the DevOps and cloud teams aligned, and coaching the wider team in this way of working, completes the picture.

Responsibilities

- Own delivery. Take full responsibility for what the team ships, including quality, timelines and production stability.
- Lead people. Manage a team of dev and QA engineers, covering priorities, growth and team health.
- Work with the business. Run discovery and requirements workshops with product owners and business stakeholders, negotiate scope, and turn the outcomes into clear specs. Product decisions stay with the client.
- Iterate in short cycles. Ship working increments quickly, validate them with product, business, QA and architecture, and feed what you learn into the next cycle.
- Align stakeholders. Keep architects, QA, product, and the DevOps and cloud teams on the same page, and explain trade-offs in terms each audience understands.
- Run AI agents. Coordinate agents across product, business, dev and QA work: break down tasks, run them in parallel, verify the output.
- Own the architecture. Design and evolve .NET microservices on Azure, built around events on Confluent Kafka.
- Curate the agents' knowledge. Maintain the specs, ADRs, conventions and skills that make agents reliable, and keep them up to date.
- Hold the quality bar. Test-first development, automated pre-PR gates, and security and correctness review of all AI-generated output.
- Coach the team. Help engineers adopt AI-augmented ways of working, mainly by example.

Workplace: This is a remote position open to candidates based in LATAM willing to work Central Timezone hours

Must Have Skills

- Leadership and communication

- 10+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years as technical lead of a mixed team (dev, QA, DevOps) of at least 5 people.
- Has delivered and supported production systems, APIs and UI products.
- Track record of delivering in short build-and-validate cycles, getting regular feedback from stakeholders and adjusting direction based on it.
- Experience facilitating workshops with both technical and business audiences.
- Comfortable working with architects, QA, product owners, business leaders, and DevOps and cloud teams.
- Client-facing experience; English at C1/C2 level, spoken and written.
- Technical depth (demonstrable without AI)

- .NET 10+ and C# at expert level.
- Azure: Functions, Container Apps/AKS, Service Bus/Event Hubs, Managed Identity.
- Event-driven microservices on Kafka, ideally Confluent (Schema Registry, delivery semantics, idempotency).
- API design, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and testing strategy.
Preferred Skills

- Okta / OIDC / OAuth2
- Cosmos DB, Redis, OpenTelemetry
- Trucking, freight, telematics/IoT or fleet domain experience
- GitHub Copilot agent mode, Claude Code, MCP or RAG

Professional Skills

- Strong English written and verbal communication
- Excellent problem-solving skills and comfort operating in a fast-paced, iterative environment
- Strong organizational and time management skills
- Strong team and individual player
- Maintains composure during all types of situations and is collaborative by nature
- High standards of professionalism, consistently producing high quality results

How We Work With AI

This is how we build, and we'll help you go deep on it. Hands-on experience with any of the following is a strong plus; the rest you'll pick up with us.

- Running agents on real work. Coordinating several AI agents at once on delivery work, not just using a chat assistant.
- Giving agents the right context. Writing rules files, skills and specs that noticeably improve what agents produce.
- Building the harness, not just the prompt. Setting up tools and guardrails (analyzers, architecture tests, type and contract checks, hooks, pre-commit gates, MCP tools) that keep agents on track and make their output accurate by design.
- Proving the output is right. Where correctness isn't obvious, such as a front-end, creating ways for agents to check their own work: Playwright E2E flows, visual regression baselines, screenshot diffs, contract tests and golden datasets. "Done" means proven, not assumed.

Bridgenext is an Equal Opportunity Employer

postings.title: Consultor/a SAP Logística – Transporte y Fletes (TM)
postings.descriptionText:
Remoto | Full Time | Freelance | Front-End y Back-End | Argentina y LATAM

MaxIT Consulting – Max Corporate Group busca Consultores/as SAP TM (Transportation Management), para roles Front-End y Back-End, para sumarse a un servicio AMS de largo plazo sobre SAP S/4HANA en una compañía líder del sector energético / Oil & Gas.

Los roles se integran a una célula ágil de consultores funcionales y técnicos, con foco en la planificación y ejecución del transporte, las órdenes de flete y la liquidación de fletes.

EL DESAFÍO

El transporte es una de las palancas de costo más relevantes de la operación: planificar bien, ejecutar a tiempo y liquidar los fletes sin errores es clave para el negocio.

Según el rol, vas a ser referente funcional o soporte especializado de TM dentro de una célula ágil, sosteniendo la operación diaria y llevando adelante evolutivos sobre S/4HANA.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES

- Front-End: ser referente funcional de SAP TM en el servicio de soporte y evolución.
- Back-End: dar soporte funcional y resolver GAPs del módulo junto al referente.
- Gestionar los procesos de planificación y ejecución del transporte, órdenes de flete y liquidación de fletes.
- Relevar requerimientos con usuarios clave y traducirlos en diseño funcional.
- Configurar el módulo y acompañar desarrollos, pruebas integrales y pruebas de aceptación (UAT).
- Resolver incidentes y evolutivos dentro de los acuerdos de nivel de servicio, con análisis de causa raíz.
- Documentar soluciones y transferir conocimiento al equipo y a los usuarios.

REQUISITOS EXCLUYENTES

- Experiencia funcional comprobable en SAP TM (Transportation Management), según el rol: Front-End (referente funcional), al menos 10 años en la especialidad; Back-End (soporte funcional y GAPs), al menos 3 años.
- Experiencia en planificación y ejecución del transporte, órdenes de flete (freight orders) y liquidación de fletes (freight settlement).
- Experiencia real en SAP S/4HANA (proyectos o servicios AMS). No aplica experiencia limitada a R/3 / ECC.
- Ciclo funcional: relevamiento de requerimientos, diseño funcional, configuración y pruebas.
- Para el rol Front-End: experiencia con SAP Activate o ASAP.

CONOCIMIENTOS DESEABLES

- Experiencia en SAP TM sobre S/4HANA (embebido o advanced).
- Integración de TM con SD, MM y FI.
- Experiencia previa en la industria Oil & Gas o en transporte de graneles.

CONDICIONES DE LA POSICIÓN

Modalidad: Remoto, con reuniones presenciales puntuales en Puerto Madero (CABA) para residentes en AMBA

Dedicación: Full time

Contratación: Freelance / contractor

Rol: Front-End (referente funcional, senior experto) o Back-End (soporte funcional y GAPs)

Inicio: A coordinar

Duración: Servicio de largo plazo

Ubicación: Argentina o Latinoamérica

Para residentes en Argentina, prepaga de salud 100% bonificada. El CV es evaluado por el cliente final, que puede entrevistar a los candidatos antes de la incorporación.

POSTULACIÓN

Si querés trabajar en una solución clave para la operación de una de las principales compañías de energía de la región, esta es tu oportunidad.

Postulate por este mismo medio con tu CV actualizado, indicando tarifa pretendida por hora (con moneda), país de residencia y disponibilidad para comenzar.

postings.descriptionText:
Únete al Grupo de Gestión Financiera (FMG) de MetLife, un motor financiero estratégico que impulsa la toma de decisiones críticas a través de la planificación financiera, el análisis y la gestión de riesgos. Como miembro del equipo, participarás en áreas como la presentación de informes financieros, tesorería, actuaría corporativa, impuestos, relaciones con inversionistas, así como fusiones y adquisiciones. Situado en la intersección entre las finanzas y la estrategia, ayudarás a garantizar que MetLife cumpla con sus obligaciones con los clientes, al mismo tiempo que impulsas sus objetivos estratégicos. Desarrollá experiencia en diversas disciplinas en un ambiente colaborativo y orientado a resultados, mientras mantenés la solidez financiera y la ventaja competitiva de una de las instituciones líderes a nivel mundial.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a strategic, technology-forward leader to help modernize how Group Benefits Finance delivers sales reporting, analytics, and performance insights. In this role, you will shape the future of reporting by building scalable, trusted, and cloud-enabled analytics capabilities that help senior leaders make faster, data-driven decisions.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of finance, data, technology, and transformation. You will partner across Finance, Distribution, Compensation, Operations, Technology, and Enterprise Data to advance self-service analytics, automation, AI-enabled solutions, and modern data platforms, including Azure cloud and Databricks.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the modernization of Group Benefits Finance sales reporting and analytics, creating accurate, timely, and trusted insights for business and executive leaders.
- Build scalable reporting capabilities that improve transparency, strengthen data governance, and make performance metrics easier to access and use.
- Partner with Technology and Enterprise Data teams to advance cloud-enabled analytics solutions using Azure, Databricks, SQL, Power BI, Power Platform, Alteryx, and emerging AI capabilities.
- Create executive dashboards, scorecards, KPIs, and self-service analytics tools that translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.
- Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting activities, improve data quality, and simplify how teams consume and act on information.
- Translate business needs into practical data, analytics, and technology solutions that support growth, efficiency, and better decision-making.
- Influence and collaborate across Finance, Distribution, Compensation, Operations, Technology, and Enterprise Data to align modernization priorities with business outcomes.

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in finance, analytics, reporting, business intelligence, data management, sales operations, or a related field, preferably within insurance or financial services, with experience leading reporting modernization, data transformation, or technology-enabled process improvement initiatives.
- Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal) – mandatory requirement.
- Strong technical fluency with modern analytics tools and platforms, including Power BI, Power Platform, Alteryx, SQL, and cloud-based data environments such as Azure and Databricks or similar cloud analytics platforms.
- Ability to turn business questions into data models, dashboards, automated workflows, and clear recommendations.
- Experience leveraging generative AI and emerging technologies to improve business processes, enhance analytical capabilities, increase productivity, and accelerate data-driven decision making. Demonstrated ability to evaluate AI-generated outputs, apply appropriate governance and controls, and drive responsible adoption across teams.
- Strong data governance, metric definition, data quality, and control mindset.
- Ability to build strong relationships with senior leaders and cross-functional partners, influence priorities, and lead through change.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and executive presentation skills.
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Economics, Statistics, or a related discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, or related cloud data services.
- Experience with enterprise data modernization, cloud migration, reporting transformation, or self-service analytics programs.
- Certifications in Azure, Databricks, Microsoft Power Platform, Alteryx, AI, analytics, business intelligence, or data science.

MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, Economics, or a related discipline

Beneficios que Ofrecemos

Nuestros beneficios están diseñados para cuidar tu bienestar integral mediante programas de salud física y mental, bienestar financiero y apoyo a las familias. Ofrecemos cobertura de atención médica para ti y tu familia, descuentos en seguros para proteger tu hogar, automóvil y mascotas, así como licencia parental. También ofrecemos una membresía premium de gimnasio para ti y tus familiares directos, tiempo libre para voluntariado, descuentos en universidades seleccionadas, viernes flexibles, reembolso de gastos de conectividad y mucho más.

Acerca de MetLife

Reconocida por Fortune entre las compañías más admiradas del mundo y los mejores lugares para trabajar, MetLife es una de las compañías líderes de servicios financieros a nivel global. A través de nuestras subsidiarias y afiliadas, ofrecemos seguros, anualidades, beneficios para empleados y soluciones de gestión de activos a clientes individuales e institucionales. Con presencia en más de 40 mercados, ocupamos posiciones de liderazgo en Estados Unidos, Latinoamérica, Asia, Europa y Medio Oriente.

Como parte de nuestra estrategia New Frontier, estamos construyendo un futuro centrado en las personas e impulsado por la Inteligencia Artificial. Buscamos personas curiosas, adaptables y con mentalidad de crecimiento, que quieran aprovechar el potencial de la IA para transformar la forma en que trabajamos, mejoramos la experiencia de nuestros clientes y generamos valor para nuestras comunidades. En MetLife, la IA es una herramienta que complementa el criterio humano, potencia la creatividad y promueve la mejora continua, siempre de manera responsable y ética.

Nuestro propósito es simple: ayudar a nuestros colaboradores, clientes, comunidades y a la sociedad en general a construir un futuro más seguro y confiable. Guiados por nuestros valores Ganamos Juntos, Hacemos lo Correcto, Generamos Impacto por Encima de la Actividad y Pensamos en el Futuro, trabajamos para transformar el futuro de los servicios financieros.

postings.title: Data Analytics Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

Toptal prides itself on being a data-driven organization. The primary objective of the Data Analytics Engineer is to help drive business impact and better decision making by laying the data foundation for a world-class analytics function. This role will be critical to fostering trust in our data and confidence in our decisions.

Our Data Analytics Engineers focus on creating a data environment that is conducive to analytics and business decision making. You will own and maintain the data transformation layer. This will require data governance (quality, accuracy, coverage, security), data modeling (structure, relationships, integrity), technical communication (data dictionaries, user training), quality control (code reviews, data validation), raw data analysis, and building AI data systems and pipelines. You will be the product owner for our data warehouse and will coordinate closely with our functional Business Analysts on one side, and Data Engineers on the other.

This role sits within the Business Analytics Center of Excellence and will ensure trustworthy data is available for all downstream data users. Positive relationships with both Data Engineers and Business Analysts will be key, but you must also think independently and bring your own point of view. To be successful in this role you must live and breathe SQL daily and be a critical thinker, problem solver and self-starter.

This role requires an AI-heavy workflow and skillset. We’ve transformed our codebase to be instrumented for agentic development and continue to build our internal AI tooling, and you will be part of this process. Fluency with using LLMs and agentic coding tools is a requirement of this role. The flip side of that is the part machines cannot do: understanding our business and metrics deeply, and making decisions on what matters and what doesn’t in terms of pushing the company’s business objectives forward.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

- Design, write, review and ship SQL models across our repositories that transform raw data into usable data products for all organizational stakeholders. Own and maintain the transformation layer.
- Proactively work with the Data Engineers to ensure new data sources are added and available, and then modeled and published in our data warehouse.
- Proactively monitor the data warehouse and extract insights to identify opportunities to improve data operations, data accuracy and quality, coverage, integrity, structure, and general usability.
- Turn ambiguous business asks into modeled data. Run requirements gathering with stakeholders. Establish the grain, surface the edge cases, write down the business rules, and push back when the request would produce a misleading number.
- Implement measures and processes to improve data quality, accuracy, coverage, lineage, access and retention across dozens of source production databases.
- Own the data dictionary. Write table and column documentation that traces each field to its true origin. This documentation is consumed by AI agents as well as humans, and is an integral part of the semantic layer.
- Diagnose and resolve data incidents.
- Review your teammates’ code and provide feedback to maintain the hygiene of the data warehouse production environment.
- Work closely with Business Analysts, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and business process owners to empower data-driven decision making.
- Enable end users to better use data, understand complexities, nuances, and limitations.
- Help make the team faster. Improve the agent playbooks, documentation, and tooling the team uses to work with the warehouse.

In the first week, expect to:

- Onboard and integrate into Toptal, and begin learning our history, culture and vision.
- Get your environment running end to end: GCP access, BigQuery, the Dataform repositories, and our agentic development tooling.
- Shadow the teams whose data you will own to learn the core of Toptal’s operations and capabilities, including Growth, Talent Operations, Enterprise, and SMB.

In the first month, expect to:

- Understand the data generated through company operations and activities and where/how that data is stored.
- Understand our ETL processes, timing, tools, monitoring, roadmap, and pain points.
- Understand our source systems, and where they fit into our business processes.
- Start receiving and researching inbound data questions from Business Analysts.
- Build your first Dataform pull request independently and start reviewing your teammates’ PRs.

In the first three months, expect to:

- Develop a mastery of our core data elements and entities.
- Begin standardizing definitions and creating SQL logic to push definitions into the data layer.
- Be a first responder for data incidents, diagnosing root cause with evidence and a methodical approach.
- Begin documenting data flows, definitions, calculation methodologies, and data elements to continuously build and improve the semantic layer.

In the first six months, expect to:

- Contribute architectural ideas that impact our data environment and pipelines. Exercise discretion and independent judgment.
- Be an integral part of the analytics team that ensures a world-class data warehouse service to our stakeholders.

In the first year, expect to:

- Play a critical part in setting up the Business Analytics Center of Excellence for success.
- Be the person the organization trusts about what a number means and whether it can be believed.
- Have made the warehouse meaningfully more usable by both analysts and AI agents.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in Engineering or a related technical field.
- 4+ years of experience in an Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, or Data Analyst role where you personally shipped production data models.
- Expert-level SQL skills and a working knowledge of Python.
- Fluency with LLMs and agentic coding tools. You already use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent as part of your daily working practice. You know where they are reliable, where they should not be used, and how to verify their output.
- Experience with cloud data warehousing, such as BigQuery or Snowflake.
- Good understanding of a modern transformation framework (dbt, Dataform, SQLMesh or similar). You understand dependency graphs, refs, incremental strategies, tests and environment promotion as concepts, not just as commands.
- Git fluency. Branching, pull requests, code review, conflict resolution and generally working with a critical production environment.
- Strong familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Cloud Composer, Dagster or Prefect. You can read a DAG, understand its schedule and dependencies, and find out why a task failed.
- Process discipline. Jira, ticket hygiene, and code review etiquette. It’s mandatory you understand how to avoid shipping unverified LLM-generated code.
- Experience in doing exploratory/raw data analysis, data modeling, and data governance (quality, accuracy, coverage, security, etc.).
- Experience translating business logic and objectives into SQL code and linking data and analytics to business strategy and operations to drive real impact.
- Familiarity with BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.).
- Detail oriented, methodical, and thorough.
- Team player who builds strong relationships and collaborates with others.
- Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex issues in a simple and intuitive way.
- Ability to work collaboratively and independently; take ownership of quality, accuracy, and timeliness of deliverables.
- You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

postings.title: Commercial Performance & Growth Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
PedidosYa forma parte de Delivery Hero, empresa líder mundial en servicios de delivery con presencia en ~65 países. PedidosYa es la empresa de tecnología líder en delivery y quick-commerce en Latinoamérica. Es una plataforma simple, rápida y accesible que conecta a millones de personas usuarias, empresas y repartidores con una amplia variedad de productos y servicios. PedidosYa opera en 15 países en latinoamérica, y en 2020 lanzó PedidosYa Markets, el primer mercado 100% digital que entrega alimentos y artículos para el hogar en 15 minutos. Delivery Hero cotiza en la Bolsa de Frankfurt desde 2017 y forma parte del índice bursátil MDAX.

Job Description

En PedidosYa, no solo entregamos pedidos; diseñamos el futuro del supermercadismo. Como Commercial Performance & Growth Specialist, serás el arquitecto estratégico detrás de nuestra vertical de Supermercados. Tu misión es clara: transformar datos en market share y coliderar la estrategia comercial trabajando en conjunto con el equipo de ejecutivos comerciales, llevándonos a capturar el doble de la penetración en el mercado.

Buscamos a alguien con visión de dueño y hambre de crecimiento. Alguien con alta autonomía, mirada estratégica y la capacidad de traducir datos en la detección de oportunidades y planes de acción concretos para la vertical.

Serás la pieza clave y el motor analítico que conecte las agendas de Pricing, Marketing y Cuentas (Accounts), escalando iniciativas de alto impacto, maximizando la rentabilidad y asegurando que nuestra propuesta de valor esté siempre un paso adelante en el mercado.

Responsabilidades PrincipalesPrincipales Responsabilidades

- Estrategia de Pricing & Rentabilidad: Liderar la agenda con el equipo de Pricing para alinear la estrategia a los objetivos del negocio y la propuesta de valor de la vertical. Diseñar e impulsar A/B tests continuos para optimizar la rentabilidad y acelerar el crecimiento.
- Growth & Conversion Rate (CVR): Co-crear y empujar la agenda junto al equipo de Marketing para definir iniciativas enfocadas en el aumento de sesiones y usuarios, la optimización del Conversion Rate (CVR) y la fidelización/retención a largo plazo.
- Iniciativas de Crecimiento Comercial: Diseñar, estructurar y cuantificar hipótesis de crecimiento en conjunto con el equipo de Accounts, estableciendo un calendario de ejecución claro y accionable.
- Adquisición de Partners Estratégicos: Liderar el diseño, la planificación y el seguimiento del plan de adquisición de nuevos partners clave para expandir el negocio.
- Maximizador del Choice (Propuesta de Valor): Velar por la propuesta de valor integral para el usuario final. Garantizar que el supply, la estrategia promocional, el precio y el surtido estén siempre maximizados y perfectamente alineados a las expectativas del mercado no solo en lo general sino por zona geográfica o ciudades.
- Product-Led Growth & UX Opportunities: Identificar, priorizar y levantar oportunidades de mejora en el producto (App) que impacten directamente en la conversión y el crecimiento del negocio. Trabajar en sinergia con el equipo de Producto para robustecer la experiencia de compra en la vertical y remover fricciones en el embudo.
- Business Intelligence & Reporting: Construir, iterar y supervisar tableros de gestión (dashboards) que permitan monitorear el pulso de la vertical en tiempo real, proveyendo insights clave para la toma de decisiones de todas las áreas involucradas.

Qualifications

- Profesional de las carreras de Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial, Economía o afines. Se valorará un MBA o Posgrado en Negocios Digitales o Business Analytics.
- Experiencia: Mínimo de 3-4 años en roles de Performance, Growth, Business Intelligence, Consultoría Estratégica o Desarrollo de Negocios (idealmente en industrias Tech, E-commerce o Marketplace).
- Dominio avanzado de herramientas de análisis de datos (Tableau, Looker o Power BI). Conocimiento de SQL y manejar Excel/Sheets a nivel experto.
- Capacidad para proponer estrategias de alto impacto de forma autónoma, no solo gestionar lo existente.
- Mentalidad Analítica: Capacidad para traducir datos complejos en estrategias comerciales concretas.
- Comodidad trabajando en entornos de alta incertidumbre y ritmo vertiginoso, donde el dato de ayer ya es viejo.
- Habilidades Blandas: Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y liderazgo de proyectos cross-functional (intersección entre Marketing, Operaciones, Comercial y Finanzas). Proactividad, autonomía y orientación a resultados.

Additional Information

En PedidosYa, el impacto no se mide solo en resultados sino en cómo los alcanzamos. Buscamos al mejor talento: personas que vibren con nuestros valores, la forma en la que pensamos, decidimos y colaboramos todos los días.

Lo que lográs es clave, pero el “cómo” lo hacés es lo que nos define. Jugando en equipo, hacemos que el negocio y nuestro ecosistema sigan creciendo, mientras le simplificamos el día a día a millones de personas.

postings.title: Senior Analytics Engineer - Finance
postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We’re looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to join Kraken’s Finance Data Eng & Analytics team within Data Platform. You’ll build trusted financial data products, using automation and AI to reduce manual work and improve the close process.

Working at the intersection of data engineering and accounting, you’ll turn complex financial data into reliable pipelines, models and automated reconciliations. You’ll use AI-assisted tools to accelerate development and investigations, keeping financial outputs tested and traceable.

The opportunity

- You’ll work closely with Data Engineers, Finance and Platform Accounting to improve reporting and decision-making. Clear communication and collaboration will help you agree priorities, explain findings and drive adoption.
- Partner with Finance to understand workflows, identify pain points and translate business needs into practical data and automation solutions.
- Build and maintain automated workflows for data preparation, reconciliations, reporting and follow-ups, with clear controls, monitoring and exception handling.
- Build intuitive dashboards and visualizations that help stakeholders understand performance, investigate issues and make decisions.
- Resolve finance data issues and reconciliation breaks with Finance, Product and Engineering, addressing root causes and communicating progress.
- Build scalable, reliable pipelines to collect, transform and curate data from internal platforms and external systems.
- Support the design and rollout of a trusted finance data lake, with clear definitions, ownership and quality checks.
- Improve data timeliness, enabling near-real-time insights where they add business value.
- Evaluate new technologies, including AI-assisted automation, and prototype solutions to Finance needs that can be reliably supported in production.

What You Bring

- 7+ years of experience in data analytics and data management within financial services or a regulated industry, working directly with Finance teams.
- Strong SQL and Python skills, including writing, debugging and maintaining production code.
- Solid experience with Git, merge requests, and code reviews, supported by strong software engineering practices, including testing and documentation.
- Hands-on experience building and operating pipelines and models using dbt, Spark, Airflow or comparable tools.
- Direct experience with finance or accounting data, such as reconciliations, subledgers, cost basis or month-end close, including investigating discrepancies and validating outputs with accounting stakeholders.
- A track record of owning pipelines end to end, making sound technical decisions and improving reliability as requirements and systems evolve.
- Judgment and autonomy to lead complex work, navigate ambiguity and remain accountable for production outcomes.
- Experience supporting recurring financial close activities, combined with a proactive approach to identifying manual processes and replacing them with reliable, sustainable automation.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across Engineering and Finance, explain complex technical issues, articulate financial implications, and recommend actionable solutions.

Nice to haves

- Experience with cryptocurrency transaction data and how digital-asset activity flows into financial records and reconciliations.
- Experience processing large volumes of financial transactions using distributed frameworks such as Spark or PySpark.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

We are looking for a highly analytical and execution-oriented Associate to join our Traffic Monitoring Team. Como RevOps Analyst, te sumarás a un equipo que actúa como socio estratégico de crecimiento para asegurar la retención, el incremento de ventas y la salud financiera de la unidad de negocio en Argentina y México. Tu rol combinará la gestión operativa con un fuerte liderazgo de negocio e inteligencia estratégica para optimizar embudos, procesos y decisiones comerciales.

El tamaño de tu desafío

- Liderar iniciativas y procesos estratégicos de Revenue Operations para potenciar el crecimiento, la retención y el revenue de la unidad de negocio en Argentina y México.
- Colaborar directamente con los equipos de Ventas, Customer Success, Customer Experience y FP&A para diseñar e implementar flujos de trabajo eficientes.

- Participar activamente en la planificación de presupuestos (budget) y realizar el seguimiento de métricas e iniciativas trimestrales.

- Transformar proyectos desde la idea inicial hasta la implementación efectiva, manteniendo autonomía y ejecutando con agilidad aun en escenarios con poco contexto.

Lo que buscamos

- Experiencia sólida en posiciones de RevOps, Revenue Management, Inteligencia de Negocios o Análisis Estratégico.
- Visión generalista del negocio con perfil analítico, orientado a la resolución de problemas y al impacto estratégico.

- Experiencia previa en el uso y gestión de plataformas de CRM (preferentemente HubSpot).
- Habilidad destacada para la gestión de stakeholders y trabajo colaborativo con equipos multidisciplinarios.

Nuestro proceso

Queremos que tengas la mejor experiencia posible a lo largo de nuestro proceso de selección. Después de que te postules, el equipo de Talent Acquisition va a analizar tu perfil con atención e, independientemente del resultado, vas a recibir una respuesta.

Las etapas y los plazos pueden variar según cada vacante, pero no te preocupes — vamos a mantenernos en contacto con vos durante todo el proceso.

Lo que te proponemos

- Cobertura de salud OSDE 310 para el grupo familiar (cónyuge + hijos);
- Clases de portugués 100% cubiertas;
- Reintegro del servicio de Internet;
- Descuentos en cursos de Coderhouse;
- La asistencia de guardería es un beneficio que tiene como objetivo apoyar a los colaboradores en la provisión de un entorno seguro para sus hijos desde los 45 días de vida, hasta los 3 años de edad, durante tu jornada laboral;
- Licencia familiar extendida a 21 días corridos para personas no gestantes o adoptantes;
- 15 días hábiles de vacaciones a lo largo del año;
- Además de las vacaciones, disponemos de una semana de descanso para recargar energías entre final/principio de nuevo año;
- Una Tiendanube gratuita para vos o alguien de tu entorno;
- Somos #remotefirst, priorizamos el trabajo remoto dentro del país de contratación, siempre que el rol lo permita;
- Es un entorno de desafío constante, propósito y protagonismo — acá la innovación nace de pensar en grande y tener actitud gigante.

Política de Privacidad

Tiendanube se compromete a proteger la privacidad y garantizar la seguridad de las personas indicadas para las vacantes que ofrecemos.

Para analizar tu solicitud, tendremos acceso a parte de tu información que será revisada antes de continuar. Utilizaremos estos datos para realizar los procesos de reclutamiento y selección. Además, cuidamos muy en serio a nuestras personas y solo compartimos información realmente necesaria. En última instancia, solo los mantendremos en nuestro sistema durante el tiempo que realmente lo necesitemos.

Para obtener más información sobre cómo manejamos los datos, incluidos tus derechos según la ley, simplemente accedé a nuestra Política de Privacidad.

postings.descriptionText:
We are seeking a Lead Data Scientist / Data Analyst to design, validate, and integrate scalable ML solutions that standardize clinical signalment attributes and generate health-predisposition insights in high-volume data pipelines. You will lead deterministic-first modeling, rigorous evaluation, and production transition with strong documentation and governance.

Responsibilities

- Lead design and delivery of optimized models for species, gender, breed, weight classification, and age classification
- Build health-predisposition insights models using standardized signalment attributes and governed ontologies
- Apply a deterministic-first approach and use machine learning primarily for high-ambiguity scenarios
- Define class-frequency tiers, calibrated thresholds, and evaluation plans that go beyond overall accuracy
- Produce confidence scores, method traces, exception flags, and model versioning artifacts for each model
- Create model cards and documentation that support governance, reproducibility, and transition to operations
- Validate performance across common, rare, ambiguous, and clinically significant cases using appropriate classification metrics
- Incorporate animal-health domain knowledge into life-stage thresholds, breed-dependent reference ranges, and risk mappings
- Implement training and evaluation pipelines in Databricks with MLflow tracking and reproducible builds
- Collaborate with SMEs to refine labels, interpret validation feedback, and adjust modeling strategies
- Support integration into production data pipelines and contribute to stabilization and knowledge transfer

Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in data science and machine learning for classification problems
- Hands-on experience building hybrid deterministic + ML solutions for ambiguous cases
- Lead-level ownership of end-to-end model delivery from prototyping through stabilization and knowledge transfer
- Strong project execution skills in fixed-scope, milestone-driven delivery with multiple parallel model tracks
- Hands-on Python.ML skills for feature engineering, training, and evaluation workflows
- Databricks and MLflow experience for reproducible training, evaluation, and model versioning
- Computer vision and natural language processing experience to support fuzzy matching and embedding-based approaches
- OMOP Common Data Model knowledge and SNOMED CT Veterinary Extension concept-mapping experience
- Strong analytical skills to define class-frequency tiers, calibrated risk bands, and performance thresholds
- Strong communication skills to interpret annotation and validation plans with domain SMEs and translate them into model updates
- Advanced English proficiency (C1+ level)

Nice to have

- Expertise with classification metrics for imbalanced data such as PR AUC, F1 by class, and balanced accuracy
- Experience using calibrated probability and reliability diagrams to assess confidence scores
- Ability to set per-tier metric targets and acceptance criteria for rare and clinically significant classes

- Award-winning culture recognized by Glassdoor, Newsweek and LinkedIn

- Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy

- Technical skills in Python, SQL, Databricks, and Alteryx

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

ABOUT US

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

Brainlabs is the independent, founder-led agency building the future of media. We have over 1000 Brainlabbers based across the global, all united through the 12 principles laid out in our Culture Code. We're full-service, with people and AI agents working side by side, all aligned to one thing: maximizing our clients' revenue through a genuinely scientific approach to media. If you want to help play your part in achieving this for the world's biggest brands in an environment that will support and challenge you in equal measure, this is where you do it.

As a Senior Business Intelligence Specialist, you will be the engine behind Brainlabs’ client dashboarding delivery, building accurate, well-maintained reporting solutions that are genuinely tailored to each client’s business. You are responsible for the quality and reliability of every dashboard you own, from initial build through to ongoing maintenance, and for ensuring what you deliver speaks directly to what the client is trying to achieve. Working within the wider BI team, you will bring technical proficiency and a careful eye for detail to every project, using Claude to work smarter and delivering solutions clients can trust.

What You Do

- Deliver Client Dashboarding Solutions: You build and maintain accurate, client-ready dashboards using Funnel, BigQuery, and Looker Studio, tailoring each solution to the specific business needs of the client rather than applying a one-size-fits-all approach.
- Ensure Accuracy and Maintenance: You own the ongoing reliability of every dashboard in your portfolio, proactively identifying and resolving issues before they affect the client and maintaining a consistent QA standard across all deliverables.
- Apply Claude to BI Work: You use Claude as a standard part of your workflow, finding practical applications that save time or improve output quality and sharing what works with the wider team.
- Manage Day-to-Day Client Communication: You handle regular client communication around your BI deliverables independently, responding promptly and setting clear expectations on delivery timelines and scope.
- Contribute to Practice Development: You share knowledge within the BI team, contribute to documentation, and flag ideas for improving the quality or efficiency of our solutions.

Who You Are

- A Technically Proficient BI Practitioner: You are solid in SQL and experienced with Funnel, BigQuery, and Looker Studio, with a background building reporting solutions in-house or at another agency.
- Detail-Oriented: You take data accuracy seriously and apply a consistent personal QA process to everything you deliver.
- A Practical AI User: You use AI tools in your day-to-day work, with a habit of exploring how they can improve your outputs or speed up your workflow.
- A Clear Communicator: You explain dashboard outputs and technical concepts clearly to clients, adapting your language to the audience.
- Reliable and Proactive: Clients and internal stakeholders can count on you to flag issues early, meet deadlines, and take ownership of your deliverables without being chased.

How You Succeed

- Delivery Accuracy: Every dashboard you build passes QA on the first pass, and clients report no data reliability issues on your accounts.

- Maintenance Reliability: Every dashboard in your portfolio is current and functioning correctly at all times, with issues resolved proactively rather than reactively.
- Practice Contribution: You contribute at least one improvement or piece of knowledge to the BI team each quarter, evidenced by adoption or feedback from peers.

We know searching for a job is tough and that you want to find the best career and employer for you. We also want to ensure that this position is the best fit for both you and us. Therefore, you will participate in a comprehensive interview process that includes skills interviews with our team. The goal of this process is to allow you to get to know us as we learn more about you.

A note on our offices: We pride ourselves in being a company with an office-centric culture and, for the majority of roles we expect people to be in commuting distance of the office and come in for around 3 days per week.

Brainlabs actively seeks and encourages applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and identities. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace: we are committed to equal opportunity for all applicants and employees regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion, or belief, and marriage and civil partnerships. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the application process, please let us know!

For details regarding our data processing activities, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice

Please note that we will never ask you to transfer cash or make any other payment to us in order to apply for a role or to work for Brainlabs. Any such asks are fraudulent and should be reported to the appropriate authorities in your area.

The role will document and benchmark the portfolio on an ongoing basis, evaluate the impact of proposed changes, and translate insights into clear, actionable recommendations that support decision-making and drive differentiation.

The Senior Analyst, Disney+ Portfolio Strategy will be responsible for:

- Monitor and document the portfolio (tiers, plans, content, perks, channels, sports rights) and perform portfolio benchmarking across SVOD and other industries.
- Monitor Disney+ portfolio KPIs (tier mix, upgrade/downgrade, ad fill rate, etc.) as well as competitor performance and market drivers, continuously assessing the company's own ability to compete.
- Navigate existing dashboards with agility, pull and cross-reference tables from different sources, and track the health of the tier mix, acquisition/retention, upgrade/downgrade, feature usage, and Disney+ content consumption, monitoring tier mix by channel and country.
- Develop portfolio improvement and change recommendations that contribute to differentiation, including new bundles and new add-ons.
- Lead research requests to evaluate proposed changes, run impact modeling, and evaluate the impact of proposed initiatives.
- Identify and translate business insights (market, consumer, and product) into clear, actionable inputs for the financial modeling and sizing of initiatives, in coordination with Finance.
- Ensure feasibility of initiatives, maintaining a fluent relationship with Legals, PMO / Product / Commerce.

What we need from you to be part of this story:

- 3+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Market/Consumer Insights, Finance, or similar roles.
- Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Marketing, Statistics, or related fields.
- Advanced level in English.
- Experience working in data-driven environments, driving decision-making through data.
- High numeracy and analytical rigor, attention to detail.
- Agility reading and interpreting existing dashboards (Looker), pulling tables, and cross-referencing information from multiple sources.
- Building dashboards from scratch is not required, but comfort navigating BI tools is essential.
- Ability to turn portfolio and competitive data into clear opportunities and insights, and from there into concrete recommendations.
- Experience with competitive benchmarking across SVOD and other industries.
- Ability to evaluate the feasibility and impact of proposed initiatives, and to translate that evaluation into clear inputs for modeling, without needing to run the model itself.
- Excellent stakeholder management, with experience working closely with PMO, Product, and Business Operations teams.
- Curiosity and a critical eye for industry trends and competitor moves.
- Strong communication skills to present findings and recommendations to stakeholders, including Finance and Product.

About Niche
Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.
Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.
About The Role

- We are currently recruiting for this role in Argentina and Brazil only. We will not be considering US based candidates at this time. All interviews are being held remotely. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.**
- Only applications/resumes written in English will be accepted.**
Niche's product teams make dozens of decisions each quarter about what to build. We are looking for an analytically rigorous, product-minded Senior Product Analyst to help Niche decide what to build and know whether it worked. This is a senior individual contributor role on the Analytics team, embedded with our product teams and reporting to the Director of Product Analytics.
You will own how we measure key product areas across our family-facing and school-facing experiences, such as rankings, scholarships, registration, and new products. You will be a strategic partner to product leadership, not a request queue. That means shaping questions before work starts, running the experiments that answer them, and staying with the work through the decision.
Our analytics team works Claude-first: you will use Claude and Claude Code every day and help shape how the team and its partners use them.
What You Will Do
Product Strategy & Insight

- Embed with product teams as their analytics partner. Join planning and roadmap conversations and help identify and size opportunities before work is prioritized
- Define the metrics that matter for each product area and keep definitions consistent across dashboards and the semantic layer
- Own the measurement of product funnels, feature adoption, engagement, and retention for both families and school partners
- Run deep-dive analyses on user behavior and segments, and pair every finding with a recommendation and a clear next step
- Identify where users struggle or drop off and bring those opportunities to product managers proactively. Partner with Design and UX Research to pair behavioral data with qualitative insight
Experimentation

- Own A/B tests with product teams end to end: design and sizing based on product requirements, guardrails and duration, tracking setup in GTM and GA4, and interpreting results with honest calls on signal versus noise
- Contribute to experimentation standards and apply them across your teams so tests are tied to business outcomes, not just clicks
- Measure launches that can't be randomized, using appropriate causal methods and clear statements of confidence
Measurement Partnership

- Write clear measurement requirements and GA4 event specs for new features before launch, build and test the GTM tags, and partner with Data Engineering on server-side and pipeline needs
- QA product data after launch, review GTM changes from partner teams, account for consent and tracking gaps, and flag quality issues early
- Build and maintain the dashboards and self-serve views (Streamlit) that let product managers answer their own recurring questions.
- Contribute to dbt models and the self-serve semantic layer with Data Engineering
- Support new data systems and tracking changes, such as consent management, with reporting requirements, GA4 reconciliation, and launch measurement
Claude-Powered Analytics

- Use Claude and Claude Code as core daily tools: writing and reviewing SQL, exploring data, drafting readouts, and building Streamlit apps
- Build and maintain the semantic layer, Claude skills, and context (metric definitions, table guides, experiment standards) that make Claude reliable on Niche's data
- Automate recurring work, such as test readouts, KPI monitoring, and launch reviews, with Claude-driven workflows
- Keep pace with AI-assisted product development by using Claude to spot launches that need measurement
- Help product managers self-serve with Claude: maintain the skills and sanctioned definitions they rely on, coach them on reading data, and review findings before they drive decisions
- Help analysts and product partners adopt Claude, and help define the team's standards for validating its output
Analytical Rigor & Influence

- Model rigor in product data: reproducible SQL, documented methods, validated results, and a clear line between correlation and causation
- Hold AI-assisted work to the same bar as your own: check the queries, numbers, and logic before anything ships
- Mentor analysts informally, and review and pressure-test analyses from the team and from product partners, including AI-assisted work
- Present findings to product and company leadership with a clear "so what"
During the First Month:

- Meet stakeholders across Product, Analytics, and Data Engineering to learn team goals, roadmaps, and workflows
- Get set up with Claude, Claude Code, and the team's existing skills. Learn our stack (Snowflake, dbt, Streamlit, GA4 data) and how product events are defined and captured
- Review existing product dashboards and reports to build a baseline view of core product KPIs
Within 3 Months:

- Act as analytics partner to your assigned product teams, including defining metrics and reading out launches and tests
- Write measurement requirements for upcoming launches with Data Engineering
- Learn the boundaries and collaborations between Product Analytics and Data Engineering so ownership of shared data is clear
Within 6 Months:

- Apply and help evolve experimentation standards across your teams
- Become the go-to expert on product behavior data, presenting findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams
- Ship at least one self-directed deep dive that influences a product decision, and build or improve one Claude skill or workflow the team reuses
Within 12 Months:

- Use deep product and user knowledge to inform roadmap prioritization
- Build a scalable measurement framework for your product areas that helps teams make data-informed decisions on their own
- Contribute to the Analytics roadmap with new methods, tools, or process improvements
Experience
What We Are Looking For

- 5+ years in product analytics, data analytics, or a closely related data role
- Demonstrated experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and owning product measurement end to end
- Hands-on experience analyzing web or app behavioral data (GA4, GTM, PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar), including its limitations
- Hands-on experience using Claude, Claude Code, or similar AI tools in analytics work, with examples of workflows you built or automated
- Track record of influencing product decisions and roadmaps with data
- Proven ability to turn complex findings into clear recommendations for non-technical partners, and to say plainly when the data won't support the question
- Experience in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with shifting priorities
Skills

- Senior SQL proficiency; comfortable writing, reviewing, and debugging complex queries independently
- Strong grounding in statistics and experimentation, with Python or R for analysis
- Experience with Snowflake, dbt, and version-controlled analytics work
- Strong dashboarding skills in Streamlit, Looker, or similar
- Fluency with Claude or similar AI tools: prompting well, giving models the right context, and checking every query and number they produce
- Comfort operating as a senior IC: influencing without authority and working self-directed on ambiguous problems
Education

- Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. A Master's degree is a plus
Nice to Have

- Experience building Claude skills, MCP connectors, or agent workflows for a team
- Understanding of K-12 or college admissions processes
- Experience with causal inference methods beyond A/B tests
- Experience contributing to a semantic layer or self-serve metrics layer
- Background in marketplace, consumer internet, SaaS, or education technology
Interview Process
Candidate experience is a top priority for our talent and hiring teams. We believe in providing a transparent, authentic and comprehensive interview process where you have the opportunity to learn about us while we get to know you and your experience. The interview process is outlined here:

- Video Interview with Talent Acquisition Partner - 30 Minutes

- Case Study & Presentation w/ Analytics Team
- Hiring Manager Follow-up if successful - 30 Minutes

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.**

- Your dashboards are trusted because they are accurate and useful, not because they are complex.

About QBE

At QBE, we get to the heart of what matters for our customers. And we do it all with a human touch.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Actuarial Analyst to join our Reinsurance Pricing & Analytics team, supporting the pricing, profitability analysis and portfolio management of Property & Casualty reinsurance business across Latin America. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the heart of commercial decision-making, partnering with underwriters, catastrophe modellers, portfolio managers and actuarial colleagues to help drive profitable growth.

You'll gain exposure to a diverse range of treaty and facultative reinsurance business while working within a collaborative, international team focused on innovation, analytical excellence and continuous improvement.

postings.title: Marketplace Operations & Experimentation Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About The Role

We are seeking a data-driven, highly organized Marketplace Operations & Experimentation Specialist to join our Marketplace team and report to the Product Manager for Marketplace. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

The Marketplace is where shoppers discover stores, products, and deals inside the Sezzle app. Our team runs a lot of features, and there's almost always something being tested. You'll be the person who knows what's live, who it's live for, and how it's performing.

This is an operations role with a strong product and data lens. You'll launch and track A/B tests, keep an eye on our shopping partners, and turn results into clear recommendations on what we do next. You'll work closely with product, engineering, data, design, and partnerships. If you like running a lot of experiments at once and keeping every one of them organized, this role is for you.

The salary range for this role is $2,000 - $2,666 per month (Gross in USD)

What You’ll Do

Experimentation

- Set up, QA, and launch A/B tests across Marketplace features. Make sure targeting, variants, and tracking are right before anything goes live.
- Monitor running tests, flag issues early, and call results once they reach significance.
- Keep a single source of truth for every test: what's live, who sees it, and what we learned.

Partner & Marketplace Operations

- Create and manage placements, promotions, coupons, and offers across the Sezzle app.
- Set up and manage cashback programs in our internal admin tools.
- Onboard new online stores into the marketplace and activate their store domains, so more stores are shoppable in the app.
- Keep a clear map of which user and merchant segments see which features, placements, and offers.
- Run regular QA audits, work through user-reported issues and broken links, and set up alerts so problems get caught before users notice.

Reporting & Process

- Benchmark our shopping experience against competitors and bring new ideas for placements, deals, and offers that get more users shopping.
- Document test plans, results, and processes, and find parts of the workflow that can be automated with AI.

Required

What We Look For

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
- 1 to 3+ years of experience in operations, experimentation, or product analytics.
- Highly organized. You can run many tests and workstreams at once without anything slipping.
- Clear written and verbal communication in English, with teammates across the business and external partners.
- Strong analytical skills. Comfortable with SQL and dashboards, and able to read A/B test results (lift, significance, sample size).
- Comfortable in a fast-changing environment where priorities shift.
- Detail-oriented with a QA mindset. You catch the targeting mistake before it launches.
- Daily user of Claude or a similar AI tool. You use it to analyze data, write queries, draft docs, and automate repetitive work, and you can walk us through real examples.

Nice to Have

- Experience with A/B testing or feature flag tools, such as Optimizely, LaunchDarkly, Statsig, or Firebase.
- Experience with affiliate, cashback, or advertising partnerships.
- Experience with Jira and Confluence.
- Experience with mobile apps and product analytics tools, such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar.

About You:

- You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
- You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
- You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
- You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
- You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
- You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

They work with customers to identify key priorities, then design and run business experiments to establish which ideas work and how to deploy them.

Positions for different specializations and levels are available in separate job postings. Team Collaboration & Culture

Preferred Qualifications

Corporate Security Responsibility

postings.title: Senior Sales Operations Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is hiring exceptional Sales Operations leaders and experienced analysts to grow and manage our global direct, alliance, channel partner and online sales. Our Sales Operations teams analyze and drive interventions to maximize net customer retention, and lead robust, repeatable processes to plan, manage and deliver revenue.

You will partner with Canonical’s executive team across sales, business development, customer success, marketing, product management, commercial systems, delivery, finance and legal and provide a focal point to drive improvements. This position requires leadership, initiative and an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the ability to drive continuous improvements in processes, systems, governance and data quality. People that thrive in these roles are proactive problem solvers who are passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales leadership, our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and the opportunity to design and drive programs in support of Canonical's continued success.

Location: These roles will be based remotely in the EMEA, Americas regions.

The role entails

- Delivering precise, scalable revenue operations for business through direct, indirect or online channels
- Leading and developing a team of revenue operations analysts in developing policies, driving processes and providing daily operational support and enablement to sales teams and partners
- Driving Sales Engagement, Training/Enablement/Data Enrichment, Customer Relationship Management, Configure Price Quote, Analytics and Commissions
- Instrumenting, measuring and improving policies and processes across teams covering the entire revenue operations spectrum
- Delivering metrics and reporting to monitor and improve revenue operations effectiveness, including new leads, pipeline, velocity, sales productivity and renewals.
- Using data to drive insight, manage territories and channels, improve productivity, and agree and implement actionable change with executive management through regular sales and business reviews.
- Overseeing our sales technology and processes, driving automation and process improvements and partnering with our commercial systems engineering team to continuously improve business systems and integration
- Leading the introduction of new products, pricing, packaging and bundling through systems that are easy for sales and partners to navigate and quote
- Driving data quality, through order processing, new hire training, process documentation, reporting and data cleansing
- Leading and enhancing our commercial review process for evaluating and steering sales and alliance opportunities
- Owning the commission plan and leading the process for setting goals, evaluating and paying against that plan

What we are looking for in you

- Experience operating in a leadership Revenue Operations role, driving effectiveness of direct, channel and alliance partnerships
- Data-driven and analytical approach with a high attention to detail
- Track record of providing insight through robust CRM and other Revenue Operations technology platforms, data, analytics, compensation systems and processes to deliver excellent revenue operations
- An energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, a problem solver with skill in measuring, identifying and delivering systems and processes that ensure repeatable, scalable outcomes
- Comfort with commercial pressure, and the ability to put revenue teams under appropriate performance pressure
- Organisational skills and the ability to interact and work with stakeholders within all levels of the organisation
- Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
- Undergraduate degree in a related field, preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics or Economics, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
- Strong communication, interpersonal, negotiation and influencing skills
- Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
- Ability to travel internationally up to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

- Experience gained within a similar, technology subscription-based business
- Deep understanding of working in a global, multicultural organization including driving a team based remotely in multiple time zones
- Experience in mentoring and coaching team members on technical and soft skills, directly contributing to their professional development and performance improvement.

What Canonical offers

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

- Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
- Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
- Annual compensation review
- Recognition rewards
- Annual holiday leave
- Maternity and paternity leave
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
- Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
