Act with integrity. We are transparent and have the courage to do the right thing.
Work together to win together. We believe collaboration is the catalyst that unlocks our full potential.
Innovate with purpose. We shape the market with big ideas that drive big outcomes.
Respect all voices. We embrace differences and foster a culture of connection and belonging.
Empower with accountability. We trust each other to own and deliver on common goals.

Because You Matter
As an Epsilon employee, you deserve perks and benefits that put you, your family and your finances first. Our benefits encompass a wide range of offerings, including but not limited to the following:

Time to Recharge: 15 days of holidays, LATAM rest week at the end of the year, flex-Fridays (working until noon every other week)

Extra Perks: Hybrid work scheme, medical insurance, language training (English and/or Portuguese), professional development, employee recognition, health awareness benefits, home internet fee.

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn.
Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). BUILD SOMETHING BIGGER THAN YOURSELF

The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise with the following business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, Disney Parks, and Experiences and Products. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished.

How will you contribute to our magical experience?

This role will be responsible for understanding the current portfolio and competitive landscape, creating and monitoring portfolio recommendations based on our own performance data and market data and ensuring alignment between Product and Biz Ops on initiative feasibility. The role will document and benchmark the portfolio on an ongoing basis, evaluate the impact of proposed changes, and translate insights into clear, actionable recommendations that support decision-making and drive differentiation.

The Senior Analyst, Disney+ Portfolio Strategy will be responsible for:

Monitor and document the portfolio (tiers, plans, content, perks, channels, sports rights) and perform portfolio benchmarking across SVOD and other industries.
Monitor Disney+ portfolio KPIs (tier mix, upgrade/downgrade, ad fill rate, etc.) as well as competitor performance and market drivers, continuously assessing the company's own ability to compete.
Navigate existing dashboards with agility, pull and cross-reference tables from different sources, and track the health of the tier mix, acquisition/retention, upgrade/downgrade, feature usage, and Disney+ content consumption, monitoring tier mix by channel and country.
Develop portfolio improvement and change recommendations that contribute to differentiation, including new bundles and new add-ons.
Lead research requests to evaluate proposed changes, run impact modeling, and evaluate the impact of proposed initiatives.
Identify and translate business insights (market, consumer, and product) into clear, actionable inputs for the financial modeling and sizing of initiatives, in coordination with Finance.
Ensure feasibility of initiatives, maintaining a fluent relationship with Legals, PMO / Product / Commerce.

What we need from you to be part of this story:

3+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Market/Consumer Insights, Finance, or similar roles.
Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Marketing, Statistics, or related fields.
Advanced level in English.
Experience working in data-driven environments, driving decision-making through data.
High numeracy and analytical rigor, attention to detail.
Agility reading and interpreting existing dashboards (Looker), pulling tables, and cross-referencing information from multiple sources.
Building dashboards from scratch is not required, but comfort navigating BI tools is essential.
Ability to turn portfolio and competitive data into clear opportunities and insights, and from there into concrete recommendations.
Experience with competitive benchmarking across SVOD and other industries.
Ability to evaluate the feasibility and impact of proposed initiatives, and to translate that evaluation into clear inputs for modeling, without needing to run the model itself.
Excellent stakeholder management, with experience working closely with PMO, Product, and Business Operations teams.
Curiosity and a critical eye for industry trends and competitor moves.
Strong communication skills to present findings and recommendations to stakeholders, including Finance and Product.

postings.descriptionText:
About Abacum

Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

Role summary

Abacum is a Series B FP&A platform that helps finance teams plan, report and forecast. Our Strategy & Operations team is the engine behind the company: we run the systems, data and processes that Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Partners and Leadership depend on every day.

As our Salesforce Administrator, you'll own the platform the whole go-to-market organization runs on. You'll report to our Revenue Operations Lead, work directly with GTM leaders, and turn a steady stream of requests into clean, scalable systems.

Why this role

Impact from day one. You'll be our first in-house Salesforce admin and own real problems from your first week, with full accountability for how things get built and how they turn out.

A role that grows. We're automating routine admin with AI (e.g. Claude connected to Salesforce, flagging records that need cleanup every morning). As that matures, your scope expands into new workflows and systems such as lead routing and data enrichment.

Shape a global organization. Join a fast-moving team that operates worldwide. Processes exist, so you won't start from zero, but you'll have the mandate to challenge and reshape them.

Visible, company-wide work. Every team that touches a customer relies on what you build, and you'll partner directly with S&O and GTM leadership.

What success looks like: reps get fast, reliable answers; Salesforce stays clean and well-documented; and most changes ship in-house, safely, without a consultant.

What you'll do

Your first priority is to master Salesforce and become the go-to owner of the platform. As automation takes over routine admin, your time shifts from fixing to building.

Run the front door (~50% of time at start, falling as you automate)

Own the Salesforce support queue: triage, resolve and close requests from Sales, Marketing, Partners and CS.

Handle data hygiene and governance across our GTM systems, including record cleanup, field standards, and regular audits, to keep pipeline, ownership, and attribution data accurate and reliable for reporting.

Manage users, profiles, permission sets, licenses and access across Salesforce and connected GTM tools (Gong, Sales Navigator, Apollo, Nooks, Default).

Maintain picklists, fields, page layouts and reports.

Build and maintain the platform (~35%)

Build and maintain Flows (screen and record-triggered), validation rules, and approval logic.

Own the permission model: profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, role hierarchy.

Monitor flow errors, API usage and integration health (HubSpot, Default, Gong, Clay, Vitally, Introw); fix or escalate.

Run deployments through a sandbox with documented change control.

Make it self-serving (~15%)

Document every flow, rule and integration so nothing lives in one person's head.

Reduce request volume at the source: self-serve options, better defaults, smarter guardrails.

Use AI tools (e.g. Claude with Salesforce access) to automate hygiene checks and repetitive admin work.

Scope larger projects and manage external Salesforce developers when work goes beyond in-house capacity.

Requirements

Must have

3 to 5 years of hands-on Salesforce administration in a B2B SaaS or high-volume sales environment.

Has been the sole or primary admin of an org (roughly 50 to 300 users), not one of many admins at a large enterprise.

Salesforce Certified Administrator, or willing to get certified within your first 6 months.

Builds in Flow Builder: has shipped and maintained record-triggered and screen flows in production, and can walk through one end to end.

Confident managing profiles, permission sets and role hierarchy, and troubleshooting access issues.

Builds reports and dashboards independently.

Understands the B2B SaaS funnel: leads, opportunity stages, ARR, renewals.

AI literacy: uses AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) in day-to-day work and looks for ways to automate repetitive tasks with them.

Fluent English. Spanish a plus.

Builder mindset: you fix root causes, not just tickets. When the same issue shows up twice, you fix the system that creates it, and you have the backbone to push back, ask why, and route requests properly.

Nice to have

HubSpot experience, especially the HubSpot and Salesforce sync.

Platform App Builder or Advanced Administrator certification.

Experience with other GTM tools: Gong, Apollo, Default, Clay, Sales Navigator.

Exposure to forecast categories, attribution and lead routing.

Basic SQL.

Benefits

Competitive compensation including equity package

Competitive vacation policy

Medical Insurance

L&D budget

Access to Meditopia (wellbeing platform)

Language courses (English / Spanish)

Our Values

Customer Obsession: We share the understanding that Abacum's sole purpose is to create value for customers and relentlessly deploy all creativity and energy to that end.

Audacious Ambition: We dream big and embrace discomfort. We assume risks, make on-time mistakes and learn how to methodically accomplish our goals.

Good People: We are self-reflective and praise diversity of thought. We don't justify the end with the means and know where to draw the line. We have fun every day.

Tough Love: We truly care for everyone in the team and embrace honest feedback and radical candor as ways to genuinely help each other.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this senior role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD based on experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the strong expertise and significant contributions expected at this level. This is a fully remote role. We believe the best engineers can do world-class work from anywhere, and we hire accordingly. Work from where you do your best work.

About the Role:

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Software Engineer, Security Platform, to build and own the platform the security team runs on: the services that discover, scan, triage and route security findings, the event-driven bus that connects them, and the CI security gates every team's pipeline runs through.

This is a development role on the security team, not a security-analyst role. Most of your time goes into designing, building and operating services in Go and Python on Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, the existing fleet where it has grown faster than its upkeep, and the NATS-based event platform that moves findings, inventory changes and notifications between them. The security gates in our GitLab CI (SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning) and the agentic triage and review workflows are part of that platform, not the whole of it. Your job is to make these systems fast, low-noise, and reliable enough to be trusted by default without slowing delivery.

You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own detection and response and network and zero trust — your platform is what their work composes with.

At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we build. In this role you will build reusable agentic workflows (Claude Code skills, CI review agents, automated triage and verification) that multiply what the team can cover, and hold that review discipline in the platform code you own.

What You'll Do:

Design, build, and operate security engineering services primarily in Golang and Python, on AWS and Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, and the upkeep, hardening and retirement of the existing ones.
Own the event-driven platform between the security services: the NATS bus, its contracts and consumers, delivery guarantees and observability — so a finding, an inventory change or an alert reaches every service that acts on it.
Integrate the platform end-to-end: scanners → finding system-of-record → tickets → metrics, so remediation state is visible and exam evidence is a by-product of engineering.
Own delivery of the security gates — SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning: scanner selection and tuning, suppression workflow mechanics, false-positive burn-down, and the rollout tooling that takes a gate from advisory reporting to enforcing without blocking delivery.
Build agentic security workflows: CI review agents, automated finding triage and verification, remediation helpers — tooling other engineers actually adopt.
Build the triage-to-remediation automation: validate true positives by hand enough to prove the tooling right, then automate the loop — reproduction context, fix guidance, and routing to the owning teams and to vulnerability-management operations.
Participate in threat modeling and secure design reviews for the services you build and the pipelines you own.
Participate in the on-call rotation for the services you own.

What We Look For:

6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant backend experience.
Deployed significant changes to a production application in the past 30 days.
Strong proficiency in Golang, plus working proficiency in Python.
Hands-on experience building and operating event-driven or message-based systems (NATS, Kafka, or similar): contracts, idempotent consumers, replay, back-pressure.
Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipeline tooling — jobs, shared templates, runners — GitLab CI at fleet scale is a strong plus.
Hands-on web application security knowledge: the OWASP Top 10 in real code — able to find these issues, fix them yourself, and encode the detection so they stop recurring.
Hands-on experience with SAST, SCA, and secret-scanning tooling (e.g., Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, Trivy, Grype, gitleaks), including tuning them to a signal-to-noise ratio developers will tolerate.
Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your development work today, have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't, and have built agentic workflows that other engineers adopted.
Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes as deployment targets for the services you build.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or consumer lending, especially with systems in cardholder-data or regulated scope.
Working knowledge of PCI DSS and SOC 2 as they apply to software development and change management — the platform you build is what produces that evidence.
Software supply-chain integrity: SBOM pipelines, dependency governance, artifact signing and provenance (Sigstore, SLSA).
Familiarity with policy-as-code and admission control (OPA, Kyverno, conftest) — your gates compose with the cluster's runtime policy-enforcement layer.
Exposure to bug bounty or external vulnerability report triage — enough to know what the automation you build has to get right.
Experience with threat modeling at a system level.

About You:

You measure yourself by other teams' code - a fix you shipped is good; a vulnerability class that stopped appearing across the fleet is better.
You'd rather ship a gate than publish a policy - you know that enforcement changes behavior and documents do not, and you build the enforcement so well that engineers want to keep it.
You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You're not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things.
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting.
You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle's Technology Stack:

Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
Backend: Golang
Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
Version Control: Git
CI/CD: Gitlab
Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

We’re expanding across Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile , and Peru , and we’re looking for an experienced Clinical Data Manager to help build the foundation of our growing LATAM Data Management team, ensuring the delivery of high-quality clinical data that drives successful clinical trials and accelerates innovative therapies to patients.

Position Summary:
The Senior Clinical Data Manager/Principal Clinical Data Manager is responsible and manages all aspects of the clinical trial data management process from study start up to post database lock for assigned projects. Standard Operating Procedures / Work Instructions (SOPs/WIs); regulatory directives; study specific plans and guidelines will be followed. This position will also oversee and/or perform database development and testing.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

• Primary Data Management (DM) contact (Lead DM role) for assigned clinical project(s) / program(s), ensuring that there is back-up, continuity, responsiveness, and that tasks are performed in a timely manner. May support another Lead DM as a back-up and/or team member. May include DM oversight of sponsor programs.

• Oversee project data entry process including development of data entry guidelines, training, data entry quality and resourcing

• May perform quality control of data entry

• Provide input, assesses and manage timelines. Ensure that clinical data management deadlines are met with quality. Assess resource needs for assigned projects, as needed.

• Develop CRF specifications from the clinical study protocol and coordinate the review/feedback from all stakeholders

• May assist in building clinical databases

• Conduct database build UAT and maintain quality controlled database build documentation. Oversee overall quality of the clinical database.

• May specify requirements for all edit check types e.g. electronic, manual data review, edit checks, etc. Oversee development of the edit check specifications and manual data review specifications

• Responsible for creating, revising, appropriate versioning and maintaining data management documentation. Oversee completeness of data management documentation for the Trial Master File.

• Train clinical research personnel on the study specific CRF, EDC, and other project related items as needed.

• Review and query clinical trial data according to the Data Management Plan

• Perform line listing data review based on the guidance provided by the sponsor and/or Lead DM

• Run patient and study level status and metric reporting

• Perform medical coding of medical terms relative to each other in order to ensure medical logic and consistency

• Coordinate SAE/AE reconciliation

• Liaises with third-party vendors such as external data and EDC vendors in a project-manager capacity in support of timelines and data-related deliverables

• May assist with SAS programming and quality control of SAS programs used in the Data Management department

• Identify and troubleshoot operational problems, issues, obstacles, and barriers for studies based on metrics data, audit reports, and input from project team members and other stakeholders

• May assist in reviewing and providing feedback on protocols, Statistical Analysis Plans (SAP) and Clinical Study Reports (CSRs), if required by the project

• Participate in the development and maintenance of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and corresponding process documentation related to data management and database management activities

• May attend strategy meetings, bid defense prep meetings, bid defenses, capability presentations, potential client engagement meetings

• May review Request for Proposals (RFP), proposals, provide project estimates

• Provide leadership for cross-functional and organization-wide initiatives, where applicable

• Trains and ensures that all data management project team members have been sufficiently trained

• Communicate with study sponsors, vendors and project teams as needed regarding data, database or other relevant project issues

• May present software demonstrations/trainings, department/company training sessions, present at project meetings

• May require some travel

• Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications:
Minimum Required:

• Bachelors and/or a combination of related experience

Other Required:

• 8+ years’ experience for a Sr. Clinical Data Manager and 10+ years for a Principal Clinical Data Manager

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook

• Able to handle a variety of clinical research tasks

• Excellent organizational and communication skills

• Professional use of the English language; both written and oral

• Experience in utilizing various clinical database management systems

• Broad knowledge of drug, device and/or biologic development and effective data management practices

• Strong representational skills, ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing

• Strong leadership and interpersonal skills

• Ability to undertake occasional travel

Preferred:

• Experience in a clinical, scientific or healthcare discipline

• Dictionary medical coding (MedDRA and WHODrug)

• Understanding of CDISC standards (CDASH, SDTM, ADaM, etc.…)

• Oncology and/or Orphan Drug therapeutic experience

Documo is on a mission to help businesses digitize and streamline their document workflows. As a fast-growing B2B SaaS company, our platform makes it easier to handle unstructured files like faxes and forms through tools like Intelligent Document Processing - turning messy paperwork into structured, usable data. We believe great products start with great people. That’s why we invest in top talent, value strong culture, and prioritize customer success and design excellence.

If you’re excited to do impactful work and want to grow with a team that values innovation, collaboration, and purpose - we’d love to meet you!

Job title Senior DevOps Engineer (Remote)

Team Engineering

Department function

The Engineering Department is crucial in designing, developing, and maintaining our company's software products. Our department manages critical areas such as development, infrastructure, operations, quality assurance, and product management, collaborating to provide reliable, secure, and scalable technology solutions.

Our primary objective is to build and sustain software products that satisfy customer needs and align with our long-term business strategy. The department is instrumental in researching and integrating new technologies to enhance our internal products and operations. We are also responsible for ensuring our products meet the company's IT, information security, and compliance program requirements.

Department Responsibilities

• Providing the strategic technical direction for the business

• Architecting, developing, and maintaining Documo’s software product catalog in collaboration with the Product Team, internal stakeholders, and customers

• Ensuring technology solutions meet high standards for reliability, security, and scalability

• Maintaining technical documentation and procedures to ensure the effective development, maintenance, and support of software products

• Researching and implementing new technologies that improve internal operations

• Implementing requirements to satisfy information technology, information security, and compliance programs

• Providing escalated technical support to customers and internal stakeholders as needed

Reports to Engineering Manager, DevOps

Direct reports None

Key Relationships

Internal: Applied AI, Customer Success, Development, Information Security, Product Management, Quality Assurance, System Architects

External: Cloud and tooling vendors, compliance auditors, and customer technical stakeholders as needed for escalations and integrations

Role Purpose

The Senior DevOps Engineer designs, builds, and operates the cloud platform that runs Documo's document processing and fax products, including the infrastructure behind our AI and machine learning services. You will own how code gets from a pull request to production, how production stays healthy, and how the platform scales securely as our product catalog and AI workloads grow.

You will bring 6+ years of DevOps, site reliability, or platform engineering experience, use AI tools in your daily work, treat infrastructure as a product, and act as a technical lead who mentors other engineers.

This role can be up to 10% customer-facing, mainly escalations, connectivity and integration discussions, and security reviews.

Why join Documo?

•

•
In-person company kick-off to connect, collaborate, and celebrate.

•
Equity opportunities to grow with us.

•
Flexible remote work that fits your life, plus flexible paid time off.

•
Competitive paid parental leave, mental health support, and Employee Assistance Programs (EAP).

•
Be part of a small, fast-growing tech company with a supportive, inclusive, and fun culture.

We celebrate differences.
Documo welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, especially those underrepresented in tech. We do not discriminate based on ancestry, race, place of origin, political belief, religion, marital or family status, physical or mental ability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other legally protected characteristic. • Distinguish the reasons people initially subscribe from the value they experience through sustained, habitual use.

• Investigate acquisition, engagement, retention, and cancellation journeys to pinpoint where perceived value declines and what ultimately causes churn.

postings.descriptionText:
Our mission at Greenhouse is to make hiring work for everyone – so we go to great lengths to hire great people because we believe that they’re the foundation of our success. At Greenhouse, you’ll join a team that collaborates purposefully, fosters inclusivity, and communicates with transparency and accountability so we can achieve our mission.

Join us to do the best work of your career, solving meaningful problems with remarkable teams.

This is an independent contractor engagement in Argentina. Deel will serve as Contractor of Record and will contract with and pay the independent contractor. The independent contractor will provide services to Greenhouse on a non-exclusive basis, may provide services to other clients, and will be responsible for determining the manner and means of performing the services, subject to the applicable statement of work and agreed deliverables. This engagement is not an employment relationship with Greenhouse. No employment relationship, social benefits, or labor entitlements under Argentine Law 20,744 are created by this engagement.

Through this arrangement, Deel is hiring an independent contractor to provide services to the Governance team. This team owns how permissions and authorization work across the Greenhouse product.

This role will support the development and maintenance of the Company’s web-based applications as part of an approximately 12-month engagement.

This is a collaborative, execution-focused, non-exclusive engagement. You will spend the majority of your time in the code building features, fixing bugs, and ensuring our products remain stable and performant for users.

Contract & location details

• Contract duration: Approximately 12 months

• Engagement type: A non-exclusive contract role engaged through a Contractor of Record (COR) via Deel in Argentina

• Location: Argentina (remote)

• Working model: Collaboration with a distributed, US & Canada-based team with reasonable availability for coordination with Greenhouse stakeholders

Who will love this job

• A Pragmatic Builder - You enjoy the craft of coding and take pride in writing clean, readable code. You aim for the simplest solution that satisfies the business requirement.

• A Full-Stack Contributor - You are comfortable moving across the stack, whether updating a PostgreSQL schema or building a new UI component in React.

• A Quality Advocate - You believe a feature isn’t “done” until it’s tested. You regularly write unit and integration tests to catch regressions early.

What you’ll do

• Build, modify, and maintain features using Ruby on Rails and React, following established engineering patterns

• Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code that aligns with existing architectural standards

• Maintain RESTful APIs and update PostgreSQL data models to support evolving feature needs

• Write comprehensive unit and integration tests (e.g., RSpec, Jest) to ensure feature stability

• Collaborate closely with other engineers through code reviews, standups, and technical discussions

• Participate in a shared support rotation during working hours, diagnosing and resolving issues to maintain application health

You should have

• 2+ years experience in contributing production code (required)

• Experience contributing to projects, helping drive them to completion (required)

• Experience with Ruby, C#, Java, or Python (Ruby preferred)

• Direct experience with AI and agentic software development (Claude code, Codex, etc)

• Proficient understanding of Javascript or Typescript fundamentals, including React

• Experience working in the full stack

• Proficient understanding of architectural patterns

• REST/web development experience

• Experience partnering closely with Product and Design partners

• Experience with Rails, preferred

• Experience with authorization and permissions, a plus

• Your own unique talents! Your background has given you a unique perspective and set of transferable skills that aren't always in alignment with a given role - but those are qualities we value at Greenhouse. If you don't meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, we still strongly encourage you to apply

Who we are

At Greenhouse, we live by our mission through using our own product to help us hire the right person for the job, every time. We’re committed to designing and responsibly using AI tools to transform how we work while keeping people at the center. We are a remote-first company and have shared office spaces in New York City and Ireland, and optional co-working spaces that give us flexibility to do our best work anywhere. We take an active role in our growth through a performance review program that’s committed to providing actionable feedback, and a bonus structure that rewards great performance. We believe that bringing together a variety of perspectives makes us a stronger company – and we nurture leaders who create an inclusive culture and invest into employee resource groups that celebrate our differences and life experiences. We’re proud to have built an award-winning culture that’s been recognized as Fortune’s Best Places to Work and Inc.’s Best Workplaces multiple years in a row.

Juntas, nuestras marcas líderes ofrecen soluciones que cubren todas las etapas del proceso de viviendar: Inmuebles24 (México), Zonaprop (Argentina), Adondevivir y Urbania (Perú), Plusvalía (Ecuador), ImovelWeb y QuintoAndar (Brasil).

Con el apoyo de un equipo de inversionistas y consultores de clase mundial, como Kaszek, Qualcomm, General Atlantic y SoftBank, QuintoAndar Group está actualmente valorado en más de 5.100 millones de dólares y sigue creciendo año tras año.

Aquí trabajarás con los mejores profesionales del mercado, en un entorno que respira innovación, colaboración y alto rendimiento. Para conocer más sobre nuestra historia, visita https://grupoquintoandar.com/es/ .

Ubicación y Modelo de Trabajo Híbrido
Nuestro equipo de Software Engineer trabaja bajo el modelo “híbrido”, siendo necesario estar presencialmente en la oficina, ubicada en Buenos Aires, 1 vez por semana al menos.

Etapas del Proceso Selectivo:

Las etapas de nuestros procesos de selección tienen como objetivo evaluar tus experiencias y brindarte la oportunidad de conocer a nuestros equipos y oportunidades de carrera, y están estructuradas en los siguientes pasos:

• People Interview

• Tech Screening

• Tech Interview 1

• Tech Interview 2

Acerca del puesto

En nuestro equipo de Data Science , tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar como parte de nuestros product squads , desarrollando funcionalidades que enriquecen nuestro producto y brindan la experiencia de primer nivel por la que somos reconocidos. Trabajarás junto a profesionales brillantes con distintas especialidades: Product Managers, Designers, UX Writers, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Software Engineers , entre otros. Prepárate para el trabajo de tu vida: desafíos complejos, altas expectativas, mentes brillantes trabajando juntas, conversaciones significativas y una productividad extraordinaria .

Algunos de los problemas específicos en los que trabajamos en el equipo de Data Science incluyen sistemas de búsqueda y recomendación; mejora de la experiencia del cliente utilizando machine learning (como el enrutamiento automático de tickets); modelos de pricing, liquidez y crédito; y la construcción de una plataforma que nos permita desarrollar y desplegar todas estas soluciones .

Nota: Esta es una posición senior . Esperamos que tengas al menos 3+ años de experiencia aplicando Data Science y creando modelos de machine learning . Si tienes las habilidades pero estás comenzando tu carrera en Data Science, te recomendamos postularte a la posición de Data Scientist .

Responsabilidades

•
Arquitectar, desarrollar y desplegar sistemas de machine learning en producción . Los principales casos de uso están relacionados con chatbots y sistemas de búsqueda .

•
Diseñar y ejecutar experimentos .

•
Analizar una amplia variedad de datos ( estructurados y no estructurados, observacionales y experimentales ) para mejorar los modelos actuales o crear nuevos.

•
Aplicar el método científico para desarrollar aplicaciones impulsadas por LLMs , incluyendo probar diferentes prompts, explorar y comprender las capacidades de los LLMs, evaluar agentes y prompts, analizar guardrails de aplicaciones de IA y construir PoCs para validar la viabilidad de IA generativa en funcionalidades de producto.

•
Participar activamente en discusiones y decisiones relacionadas con todo el chapter de Data Science (Guilds, Design Reviews, Demos, etc.).

Lo que buscamos

•
Personas que quieran aprender y generar impacto real a través de Data Science .

•
Conocimiento experto en conceptos de machine learning : regresión y clasificación, clustering, redes neuronales, selección de features, validación cruzada, curse of dimensionality , bias-variance tradeoff , explicabilidad de modelos, entre otros.

•
Buena comprensión de los desafíos de ingeniería para desplegar sistemas de machine learning en producción .

•
Dominio de Python .

•
Conocimientos o experiencia con Deep Learning .

•
Experiencia brindando asesoramiento técnico a otros data scientists (liderazgo técnico).

•
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación técnica escrita y verbal . Buscamos a alguien apasionado por Data Science y Machine Learning , dispuesto a compartir su conocimiento con los demás miembros del Data Science Chapter .

•
Buen nivel de inglés (oral y escrito) es obligatorio.

Te destacarás si

•
Tienes un MSc. (o licenciatura + experiencia sólida) en machine learning, data science, information retrieval, ranking systems, recommender systems, natural language processing u otros campos relevantes.

•
Tienes experiencia con IA generativa aplicada : agentes de IA, prompt engineering, fine-tuning de LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT), LLM routing , monitoreo de LLMs y LLM guardrails .

•
Tienes experiencia trabajando en startups de rápido crecimiento .

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Business Development Representative to our Sales Development team in Buenos Aires !

The Business Development Representative II drives pipeline growth and new business generation within an assigned prospecting territory with a high level of autonomy. postings.title: GRC Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a GRC Manager con un perfil disruptivo, innovador y con una sólida visión de futuro. El/la candidato/a seleccionado/a será responsable de liderar las prácticas de Gobierno de seguridad, Data protection, Controles de seguridad, Riesgos, TPMA y Certificación PCI, reportando al Sr Manager de GRC.

El diferencial clave de esta posición no es solo qué hacemos, sino cómo lo hacemos. Buscamos a alguien capaz de desafiar los procesos tradicionales de cumplimiento, posicionando al equipo de GRC como un hub de habilitación de IA interno. El candidato ideal diseñará soluciones donde los agentes de Inteligencia Artificial (LLMs) actúan como redactores y preparadores, mientras que el equipo humano retiene el juicio crítico y la autoridad de aprobación, redefiniendo la eficiencia operativa.

Principales responsabilidades:
•
Innovación, IA y Adopción: Liderar la redefinición de metodologías apoyándose en automatizaciones y agentes inteligentes para flujos de trabajo repetitivos (ej. cuestionarios de proveedores, mapeo de controles). Priorizar la adopción y la reducción de fricción para equipos no técnicos por encima de la complejidad de las herramientas.

•
Gobierno Normativo (Docs-as-Code): Mantener y evolucionar nuestro marco de políticas y procedimientos. Impulsar un enfoque moderno de gestión documental (Docs-as-Code), utilizando repositorios (Git), revisiones de código (PR-as-approval) y frontends renderizados para asegurar la trazabilidad normativa y el control de versiones.

•
Protección de Datos y Gobierno de IA: Definir medidas técnicas y organizativas para proteger datos sensibles y colaborar estrechamente con el DPO. Integrar prácticas tempranas de Gobierno de IA, asegurando políticas claras de manejo de datos antes del despliegue de nuevos agentes o herramientas.

•
Gestión de Auditorías y Riesgos: Actuar como punto focal ante evaluaciones de terceros. Orquestar un roadmap de automatización progresiva, desde tareas de bajo riesgo hasta soporte intensivo en juicio (análisis de brechas, registros de riesgo).

•
Alineamiento Regulatorio e Indicadores: Diseñar tableros de KPIs/KRIs para el Comité Ejecutivo. Mantener la trazabilidad del marco de control hacia normativas clásicas (PCI, SOX) y marcos emergentes (DORA, NIS2, EU AI Act, CSRD).

¿Qué buscamos?
•
Formación: Graduado universitario en Ciberseguridad, Ingeniería, Informática, Administración, Derecho Tecnológico o carreras afines. Valoramos fuertemente la mentalidad sistémica por encima del título específico.

•
Experiencia: Experiencia comprobable en posiciones de liderazgo en áreas de GRC, Protección de Datos y/o PCI (excluyente).

•
Mindset de Automatización: Fuerte interés y experiencia práctica en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial al negocio. Capacidad demostrable para interactuar con LLMs (Prompt Engineering), conceptualizar flujos de trabajo con agentes y entender las limitaciones y controles necesarios para herramientas de IA.

•
Normativas y Frameworks: Conocimiento en normativas de privacidad (ej. GDPR) y familiaridad con ISO/IEC 27001, NIST, CIS Controls, COBIT. Se valorará el conocimiento de frameworks de riesgo de IA (ej. NIST AI RMF).

•
Habilidades: Excelentes habilidades de negociación, visión estratégica y capacidad para traducir requisitos técnicos a un lenguaje de negocio digerible para equipos no técnicos.

•
Certificaciones y Lenguaje: Certificaciones CISM, CRISC, CISA o CISSP valoradas. Nivel de idioma inglés Avanzado.

postings.title: Martech Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
🚀 Join Our Remote Data Products & Machine Learning Startup! 🚀

At Muttdata, we build innovative Data Products and Machine Learning solutions that help companies solve complex business challenges. As a fast-growing, remote-first startup, we're passionate about technology, collaboration, and continuous learning.
We are looking for a proactive, data-driven, and business-oriented Martech Specialist to join our team 🐶🚀

This is a technical consulting role, not a platform admin role: you will own the MarTech side of the architecture and make sure the data foundation and the activation layer work as one system.

🚀 What We Do
• Leveraging our expertise, we build modern Machine Learning systems for demand planning and budget forecasting.

• Developing scalable data infrastructures, we enhance high-level decision-making, tailored to each client.

• Offering comprehensive Data Engineering and custom AI solutions, we optimize cloud-based systems.

• Using Generative AI, we help e-commerce platforms and retailers create higher-quality ads, faster.

• Building deep learning models, we enhance visual recognition and automation for various industries, improving product categorization, quality control, and information retrieval.

• Developing recommendation models, we personalize user experiences in e-commerce, streaming, and digital platforms, driving engagement and conversions.

🌟 Our Partnerships
• Amazon Web Services

• Astronomer

• Databricks

🌟 Our Values
• 📊 We are Data Nerds

• 🤗 We are Open Team Players

• 🚀 We Take Ownership

• 🌟 We Have a Positive Mindset

🔍 Curious about what we’re up to? Check out our case studies and dive into our blog post to learn more about our culture and the exciting projects we’re working on! 🚀

Responsibilities 🤓
• Design the stack: help clients choose between packaged CDPs, composable CDPs and a lakehouse-native approach, and explain the trade-offs in plain terms: cost, time to value, identity, governance and lock-in.

• Build it: configure and integrate CDPs (Adobe Real-Time CDP, Salesforce Data Cloud), composable tools (Hightouch, Census, Amperity) and activation platforms (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable).

• Set up identity resolution, audiences, consent, event tracking and reverse ETL.

• Connect it to the data foundation: work with our data engineers and ML experts to model customer data in Databricks or other cloud platforms, feed it to activation tools, and close the loop with campaign results.

• Run it at scale: define how these platforms operate in production, including data quality, monitoring, cost control, governance and the team workflows around them.

• Bring AI into activation: put our propensity, LTV, churn and next-best-action models to work inside real journeys and campaigns.

• Shape what we sell: join discovery calls, scope projects, write proposals, and help us turn repeat work into reusable accelerators and offerings.

Required Skills 💻
• 5+ years in MarTech or customer data, in a consultancy, agency, vendor professional services team, or an in-house marketing technology role.

• Hands-on depth in at least one tool from each layer: a packaged CDP (Adobe Real-Time CDP, Salesforce Data Cloud, Segment, Tealium), a composable CDP or reverse ETL tool (Hightouch, Census, Amperity), and an activation platform (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, Klaviyo).

• A real point of view on the landscape: you can tell a client when a packaged CDP is the right call and when it isn't, and back it up with projects you have delivered.

• Solid data fundamentals: you write SQL, understand data modeling, identity resolution, event schemas and APIs, and you are comfortable working in a lakehouse or cloud data warehouse.

• Production experience: you have run these platforms at scale, with millions of profiles, many channels, and real consent and privacy requirements (GDPR, CCPA, local LATAM laws).

• Client presence: you explain technical trade-offs to a CMO and a CTO in the same meeting.

• Professional English, written and spoken. Most of our work is documented in writing and many clients are in the US.

Nice to have 💻
• Hands-on work with Databricks, especially as the customer data foundation behind activation tools.

postings.descriptionText:
Blockchain is connecting the world to the future of finance. As the most trusted and fastest-growing global crypto company, it helps millions of people worldwide safely access cryptocurrency. Since its inception in 2011, Blockchain has earned the trust of over 90 million wallet holders and more than 40 million verified users, facilitating over $1 trillion in crypto transactions.

We are looking for a Head of Consumer Operations to own the financial operations backbone that powers our consumer crypto business. This role is accountable for the full lifecycle of consumer money movement — deposits, withdrawals, settlements, and reconciliation — across both fiat and cryptocurrency assets, at scale. You will build and lead a high-performing operations team, drive operational readiness for new products and geographic expansions, and partner closely with Compliance, Treasury, Product, and Engineering to keep our platform fast, reliable, and trustworthy for millions of consumers. This is a highly cross-functional leadership role suited to someone who has run large-scale financial operations in a regulated, high-volume environment and who thrives on building durable, scalable process out of ambiguity.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Financial Operations & Money Movement

• Own end-to-end financial operations for the consumer business — deposits, withdrawals, settlements, and reconciliation — across both fiat and cryptocurrency assets, at scale.

• Define and manage SLAs for customer-impacting operational metrics (withdrawal processing time, transaction success rate, dispute resolution turnaround).

• Build and maintain documented SOPs and a control framework for consumer money movement, including segregation-of-duties and audit-readiness.

Team & Org Leadership

• Build, lead, and scale a high-performing operations team (reconciliation, asset movement, support ops), including workforce planning for distributed or outsourced functions as volume grows.

• Own consumer-facing incident response for operational disruptions (failed withdrawals, settlement delays, banking/exchange outages), including customer communication protocols during incidents.

Growth, Expansion & Product Support

• Drive operational readiness for new product launches and geographic expansions — financial infrastructure, licensing/regulatory dependencies, and go-live runbooks — in partnership with Product, Compliance, and Engineering.

• Develop and refine scalable processes and automation to reduce manual reconciliation and improve headcount-to-volume efficiency as the consumer base grows.

Risk, Compliance & Partnerships

• Partner with Compliance and Legal to operationalize AML, fraud prevention, and KYC-related controls affecting consumer transactions; own fraud-loss and chargeback/dispute metrics for the consumer book.

• Partner with Treasury on liquidity and cash positioning for consumer-facing flows, ensuring operational execution aligns with Treasury's risk and funding strategy.

• Own vendor management and performance monitoring for payment processors and banking partners — uptime, fee structures, dispute rates, and relationship health.

Reporting & Decision Support

• Analyze operational and financial data (transaction success rates, time-to-resolution, cost-per-transaction) to drive strategic decisions and continuously improve performance.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

• 10+ years of experience in financial operations, payments operations, or treasury operations, including 4+ years in a senior leadership role, ideally within crypto, fintech, or a regulated financial institution.

• Direct experience managing fiat and cryptocurrency money movement (deposits, withdrawals, settlements) at meaningful transaction volume and scale.

• Track record building and leading operations teams through periods of rapid growth, including workforce planning across in-house and outsourced/BPO models.

• Strong working knowledge of AML, KYC, and fraud-prevention frameworks, with experience partnering closely with Compliance rather than owning policy directly.

• Experience partnering with Treasury functions on liquidity, cash positioning, or banking relationships in a financial services or crypto context.

• Demonstrated success driving operational readiness for new product launches or geographic market expansions, including navigating regulatory dependencies.

• Vendor management experience with payment processors, banking partners, or crypto trading/custody platforms.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate operational data into performance metrics and strategic recommendations.

• Excellent cross-functional leadership and communication skills; comfortable operating at both strategic and hands-on execution levels.

• Experience operating in a fast-paced, high-growth, and regulated environment; crypto/digital-asset industry experience strongly preferred.

COMPENSATION & PERKS

• Unlimited vacation policy; work hard and take time when you need it.

• Unlimited books policy; order the technical resources you need or simply pick something up from our company library.

• Apple equipment.

• Full-time salary based on experience and meaningful equity in an industry-leading company.

• Role based in our Malta office, with a mandatory in-office presence four days per week

This role, reporting to the Global Head of Financial Crimes Compliance, will be responsible for overseeing Anti-Financial Crime and Compliance operations for the European business.

The MLRO & Compliance Officer will oversee the MiCA licence, engage positively with the MFSA and FIAU, and maintain the highest standards of integrity while managing risk in a fast-evolving regulatory environment for cryptocurrency and blockchain technology.

• Lead the preparation and coordination of responses to requests submitted by regulatory authorities.

• Liaise with law enforcement agencies and respond to requests and inquiries.

• Act as a central contact point with the relevant AML regulators.

• Receive and investigate internal suspicious reports and report external suspicious activity.

• Liaise and collaborate with other teams to prepare data required for the submission of reports requested by regulators.

• Ensure compliance with local law and regulations introduced by Maltese authorities.

• Maintain and implement an AML/CTF training programme and ensure that relevant employees are adequately trained.

• Periodic reporting to the Board and Country Head, including status updates on the AML/CTF risks, controls, and any gaps to be addressed.

• Respond to information requests from regulators, law enforcement agencies, and FIAU.

• Collaborate with internal teams (legal, compliance, risk, and operations) to enhance AML controls.

• Any other MLRO and compliance-related duties as mandated by law or required by the business from time to time.

• Keep up to date with all relevant regulatory changes in the European and Maltese markets and evolving best practices, and conduct gap and business impact analyses of these changes.

• Monitor, analyse and interpret proposed regulatory changes, participate in public consultation processes, solicit and collate feedback from various departments, and compile comments for submission on behalf of the business during the public consultation process.

• Provide advice and guidance on proposed legislation and regulations, and how they may affect business operations, both locally and internationally.

• Identify, evaluate and test the adequacy and effectiveness of compliance controls.

• Develop the compliance monitoring plan and execute compliance monitoring reviews within defined timeframes.

• Identify and manage internal compliance operational controls, and carry out regular independent reviews as required.

• Identify, highlight, and manage regulatory risks, findings, and recommendations, whether internal or from independent reviews.

• Assisting with ad hoc projects, including policy drafting and reviews, ad hoc compliance submissions and/ or regulator requests.

• Prepare compliance audit data by compiling and analysing internal information.

• Internal and external stakeholder engagements at an operational and Board level, including liaising with regulatory authorities.

• Develop and maintain relationships with regulatory authorities and stay abreast of changes in the regulatory environment and best practices.

• Minimum of 10 years of relevant AML experience.

• Minimum 3 years of experience in a compliance role, preferably within the financial services or cryptocurrency sectors.

postings.title: Accountant - AR & Collections
postings.descriptionText:
Remote role - for candidates based in Argentina. 
About the role

Our client is a fast-growing American disaster recovery business headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee. When fires, floods, and storms hit, they respond, and they've done that work coast to coast: from Seattle to Miami, from Massachusetts to Hawaii. They operate four SERVPRO franchises as their home base and a large-loss practice that travels wherever disaster strikes.

The majority of their finance and accounting team is in Bosnia, so Argentine time works great to work with both their Eastern Europe and Nashville based teams. You'd join established teammates, report to the FP&A Analyst, and work in close daily coordination with their other Accounting Analyst, all backed by the Nashville-based Controller and CFO.

Why This Role Is Worth Your Ambition
• You're in-house, not in a BPO. You work for one company, on one business, with one team, and you see the results of your work every month. No client rotations, no billable-hours factory.
• A first-class education in American business. Insurance claims, cash flow, collections strategy, month-end close, real exposure to how a US operating company runs, with mentorship from senior finance leadership in Nashville.
• AI as a core skill, not a buzzword. We use artificial intelligence across our finance workflows. You'll learn to use it two ways: to make yourself dramatically more efficient, and to help build new tools that don't exist yet.
• Cross-training by design. Every accounting analyst there is trained across both AR and AP. This role leans heavily toward AR and collections, but you'll learn the full cycle, because cross-training is how we scale, how we cover each other during vacations, and how you grow into training others. It means your learning curve never flattens.
• A real path upward. We're growing, and we promote from within the team we've built. The person who masters this seat is the person we develop toward finance leadership.

The Work, Honestly
We want to be straight about the day-to-day: a lot of blocking and tackling. High-volume invoice processing, data entry, cash application, chasing documentation, reconciling accounts, and collection calls, done accurately, every day, without drama. This seat keeps cash coming in the door.

We believe that's exactly how finance leaders are built: nobody should manage a close who hasn't run one invoice at a time. If you take pride in unglamorous work done exceptionally well, this is your way in.

Much of our receivables work involves insurance claims, deductibles, and customers navigating the worst week of their year. We collect firmly and through process, and we treat every customer with patience and respect, especially the difficult ones.

What You'll Do
Accounts Receivable & Collections (your primary focus)
• Own the AR aging: monitor balances, prioritize follow-up, and drive aged receivables toward resolution
• Handle collections calls and correspondence with American customers and insurance carriers, professionally and calmly, including escalated accounts
• Work with adjusters and carriers to resolve claim-related payment issues (deductibles, coverage denials, short pays)
• Prepare accounts for formal escalation, including documentation supporting lien filings and third-party referral
• Document all collection activity and keep every follow-up commitment

Invoice Processing & Billing (daily volume)
• Generate, review, and send customer invoices, accurately coded by job, location, and class
• Post customer and insurance payments and handle cash application, including researching unapplied or short payments
• Send customer statements, payment reminders, and follow-up correspondence
• Maintain clean records: job notes in our management system, documentation files, W-9 and certificate-of-insurance tracking

Payroll & Month-End Close
• Process payroll entry accurately and on schedule, coordinating with our payroll provider
• Prepare basic accrual entries and assigned journal entries
• Complete bank and credit card reconciliations and recurring vendor reconciliations on the close calendar
• Maintain fixed asset roll forwards, royalty schedules, and supporting workpapers
• Support the FP&A Analyst, Controller, and CFO on analysis and special projects, increasingly with AI tooling you'll help build

Accounts Payable (cross-trained with our other accounting analyst for coverage)
• Enter, code, and schedule vendor invoices per payment terms, matched to supporting documentation
• Reconcile vendor statements and chase missing invoices so nothing becomes a surprise
• Match credit card transactions to receipts and code expenses; chase down missing receipts
• Maintain vendor master data and support 1099 preparation

What We're Looking For
Required
• 2+ years of accounting, bookkeeping, or AR/AP experience, including invoice processing and reconciliations
• Direct collections experience; this is the heart of the job
• Excellent spoken and written English; you'll be on the phone with American customers and insurance adjusters daily
• Willingness to work a delayed morning / afternoon-shifted schedule with substantial overlap of US Central Time business hours (our team already works this way)
• High accuracy at high volume: you catch your own errors and don't let details slip
• Professionalism under pressure: you can hold a firm line on a past-due balance without ever raising your voice
• Strong follow-through: you close loops, keep commitments, and escalate with facts, not noise
• Proficiency in Excel; curiosity about AI tools and comfort learning new systems fast

Preferred
• Experience collecting from or billing US customers or insurance carriers
• Hands-on experience using AI tools in real workflows
• Experience with ADP, Ramp, QuickBooks Online, or similar
• Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or related field

postings.title: Product Support Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Why are we hiring this role?
Our customers use the product against bid deadlines, so the work it generates is urgent and interrupting
by nature. A customer hits a bug mid-bid. A table sorts on the wrong column. An upload fails for one
account. A compliance task comes due.
Right now that lands on the engineers building our takeoff pipeline, and it fragments them — the most
expensive possible way to answer a support ticket. We are hiring someone to own it properly, because it
deserves an owner rather than whoever is interrupted.
This is not a queue-closing role, and we will not pretend otherwise. Resolving issues properly and
converting the recurring ones into product changes produces unusually broad knowledge of the system.
That knowledge is the basis for moving into other work here, and we expect that to happen.
What you’ll own
- Support issues, end to end. Reproduce, diagnose, fix, and confirm the fix with the customer
who reported it. You close your own loops.
- Turning vague reports into reproducible cases. “The forecast is broken for this account” has to
become a specific, reproducible scenario before anyone can fix it. Doing that well is most of the
job, and it is the part that separates people who are good at this from people who are not.
- The details that make a product feel finished. Sorting, filters, tooltips, empty states, and error
messages that say something useful.
- Stopping the repeats. Operational and compliance work kept current — dependency upgrades,
security remediation — plus the upstream change that ends a class of issue instead of fixing it a
fifth time.
What we expect day to day
- You talk to customers directly. Not through a middle layer. You will write to the estimator who
filed the bug and tell them it is fixed. Strong English, written and spoken, is non-negotiable for
that.
- You live in Linear with the engineers. Issues, findings, and decisions live in Linear, attached to
the work. Daily standup; you show work-in-progress constantly, not big reveals.
- You go outside the codebase to find answers. In the data, in Sentry, in PostHog, and in the
interface the customer is actually looking at. A large share of support work is one SQL query
away from the answer.
- You work in the open and take feedback straight. We are direct. You ship progress to the team
channel, present at reviews, and get honest feedback — including from the founder. We argue
about the work, decide fast, and move.
- You use AI aggressively. Everyone here uses AI daily for research, writing, analysis, and building.
Same bar for this role.
What We’re Looking For
We only hire superstars — expect to be asked why you’re one.
Required
- 2–4 years building production web applications
- Solid TypeScript and React
- Comfortable with SQL — you reach for a query before you reach for a guess
- Strong debugging: reading a stack trace, bisecting a regression, and reproducing an issue from a
screenshot and an incomplete description
- Strong written and verbal English; clear async communication
- Willingness to investigate outside the codebase, and to fix the cause rather than the symptom
Nice to have
- Prior support or on-call experience — ideally with a specific change you made that eliminated a
whole class of issue
- Our stack is TypeScript throughout — Next.js, React, Hono, Drizzle over PostgreSQL on Neon,
Vercel, with AWS and Terraform underneath. Familiarity helps; no construction background?
Fine — the industry is learnable and the founder is your shortcut.

As their Senior Data Analyst, you'll own the numbers the business actually decides on. Pricing, customer cohorts, payment systems, logistics, marketing channel performance — the analysis behind those calls comes from this seat. You'll work across the full width of a real operating e-commerce business: how visits become orders, how orders become delivered shipments, which customers come back, and what each of those is worth. Your job is not to produce dashboards. It is to produce decisions, and to be the person in the room who knows whether a number is trustworthy.
You'll report into Data & Analytics and work daily with Marketing, Operations, Finance, Customer Experience, and Engineering. 
Numeric Defensibility — The Condition of the Seat
In a bootstrapped company, decisions get made on the numbers in front of us, quickly, and often without a second analyst to check the work. That makes accuracy the condition of this seat rather than a quality of it.
Key Responsibilities
Analysis That Drives Decisions
• Own in-depth analysis across the business: customer base and cohort behavior, pricing, payment systems, logistics and fulfillment performance, and marketing channel efficiency.
• Find the trends, patterns, and anomalies that matter, and separate them from noise — then say what you'd do about it.
• Partner with business-unit leaders, Finance, Operations, and executives to understand the decision behind the request, not just the data pull.
• Bring the recommendation, not only the output. An analysis that ends at "here's the chart" isn't finished.
Data Models, Metrics & Definitions
• Build and maintain the data models that support recurring reporting and business requirements.
• Own the definition of the metrics you produce, and defend those definitions when different teams want the number to mean different things.
• Own the accuracy of at least one recurring business report end to end — its definition, its source, and whether anyone can trust it.
• Establish and hold data governance practices: naming, documentation, source of truth, and what happens when two dashboards disagree.
Visualization & Communication
• Build interactive dashboards and reports that a non-technical leader can read without you in the room.
• Present insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executives, and hold up under questioning.
• Write clearly. A short, direct summary of what changed and what it means beats a twelve-tab workbook.
• Deliver inconvenient findings early. A number that undercuts a plan is the most valuable thing this seat produces.
Statistical & Predictive Work
• Apply statistical techniques to test whether what we're seeing is real.
• Build and implement predictive models that support forecasting and planning decisions.
• Use advanced data mining techniques to surface insight nobody thought to ask for.
• Know the limits of your own models, and say them out loud when the output gets used.
Working AI-First
• Work automation-first: use AI tools to draft queries, explore datasets, generate documentation, and accelerate analysis — then apply your own judgment before anything ships.
• Treat any analysis you run more than twice as a candidate for automation.
• Own the quality gate on machine-generated SQL and analysis. Verify the logic and the numbers against source before results leave your hands.
• Leave your reporting surface more automated at the end of each quarter than it was at the start.

• Numeric defensibility. Given a dataset and a business question, you can produce the figure, say where it came from, say how it's defined, and say what would make it wrong. We will test this directly with real data.
• An analysis that changed a decision. A specific piece of work where the business did something different because of what you found. What you looked at, what you found, what changed, and what it was worth.
• A caught-error story. A time you or a tool produced a confidently wrong number, how you caught it, and the checking habit you built as a result.
• An automation portfolio. Two or three recurring analyses or reports you personally automated, with what changed in hours saved or errors avoided. Rough honest numbers beat polished vague ones.

postings.descriptionText:

We are looking for a Production Support Engineer to join a small, high-trust team responsible for the health and reliability of a revenue-critical sales platform. You'll sit between end users — partners and call centers — and engineering, triaging incidents, managing communication, and keeping stakeholders informed and calm when things go wrong.

You'll own the incident management response process end-to-end — from first alert through post-mortem and corrective action follow-up. This is not a developer role. The technical bar is deliberately calibrated: you need to understand how APIs work, read logs, and interpret what you're seeing — not implement fixes. What matters equally is your ability to translate technical issues into plain language and manage expectations across very different audiences.

Longevity and genuine interest in the role matter here. This team values people who want to grow with it, not move through it.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Monitor platform health and triage incoming incidents — distinguishing critical issues (outages, service degradation) from non-critical ones (bugs, defects). 

 - Investigate incidents using logging tools — reading API calls, responses, and log data to understand what happened and where. 

 - Own the incident management response process, post-mortems, and corrective action follow-up. 

 - Notify stakeholders of critical issues proactively — specifying SLA risk and communicating clearly on status via email, phone, or ticket system. 

 - Cross-reference tickets across multiple systems and follow defects through the full lifecycle until closure. 

 - Communicate clearly with partners and call center teams — translating technical findings into plain language and managing expectations throughout resolution. 

 - Manage the incident queue in Jira and prioritize bugs within engineering sprint cycles. 

 - Participate in weekly cross-functional meetings with engineering and account/call center management. 

 - Provide suggestions for continual improvement of applications and processes. 

 - Join on-call rotations after ramp-up — responding to alerts via OpsGenie within defined SLA windows. 




BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - 2+ years of troubleshooting and resolving issues for applications, servers, or infrastructure environments. 

 - 2+ years of providing clear status updates on tasks, issues, and resolutions to stakeholders at multiple levels. 

 - Working knowledge of how APIs function — able to read and interpret API calls and responses; experience with Postman or similar API testing tools. 

 - Ability to navigate logging and observability tools such as Splunk, Datadog, or Sumo Logic. 

 - Experience with SQL queries for troubleshooting and ad hoc reporting. 

 - Basic comfort reading HTML and JSON, and using browser developer tools for investigation. 

 - Ability to participate in technical bridge calls and follow incidents through to resolution. 

 - Exceptional communication skills — able to code-switch between technical and non-technical audiences fluidly; this is the hardest skill to train and the most important one for this role. 

 - Strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills under pressure.

 - Clear understanding of eval vs. deterministic testing — the difference between pass/fail based on exact input/output and evaluating probabilistic AI outputs using human-in-the-loop evaluations, score metrics, benchmark datasets, and semantic evaluation.

postings.descriptionText:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.
